*Nurit Spingarn,Noa Cohen,Tamar Rott Shaham,Tomer Michaeli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现文本到图像扩散Transformer模型主要依赖文本表示中两个简单方面：相邻token合并为词表示和词序（通过位置编码），而非完整的上下文语义信息。使用仅包含词义和词序的"位置标签词袋"表示，即可生成与完整文本嵌入相当质量的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究文本到图像模型在生成过程中究竟利用了文本表示的哪些方面，挑战"模型充分利用了文本嵌入中丰富上下文信息"的普遍认知。

Method: 构造一种仅编码单个词义和词序但缺乏完整提示上下文信息的新型文本嵌入（bag of position-tagged words），与完整文本嵌入进行图像生成质量对比实验。

Result: 该简化表示在视觉质量和文本保真度上与完整文本嵌入引导的生成效果相当，表明复杂语言结构的解码实际由图像模型自身完成。

Conclusion: 文本到图像模型并未充分利用文本嵌入编码的丰富上下文信息，仅依赖个体词义和词序即可成功引导图像生成，颠覆了领域内的普遍认知。

Abstract: Text-to-image models rely on text prompts as their primary interface to human intent. Prompts are encoded by a text encoder into embeddings that condition the image generation process. Beyond individual token meanings, text embeddings encode contextual information across the full prompt, such as compositionality and attribute binding. However, whether image models actually exploit this richer information remains underexplored. Here, we address the question: Which aspects of text representation are essential for image generation? We show that text-to-image diffusion transformer-based models commonly rely only on two relatively straightforward aspects of text representations: (i) the merging of adjacent tokens into a word representation, for words spanning multiple tokens, and (ii) word order, which is imprinted by the positional embedding of the text-encoder. To show this, we construct a new text embedding that encodes only individual word meanings and order but lacks any contextual information about the full prompt. We find that this bag of position-tagged words representation is sufficient to successfully guide image generation, achieving visual quality and text fidelity that are on par with full text embedding-guided generation. This demonstrates that, contrary to common belief, text-to-image models often do not use the rich information encoded in the text embedding beyond individual word meanings and word order. Instead, the decoding of complex linguistic structures is performed by the image model itself. Project webpage: https://nsping13.github.io/contextless-TTI/

</details>


### [93] [Beyond False Stability: High-Noise Drift Gating for Test-Time Adversarial Defenses in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03730)
*Hashmat Shadab Malik,Muzammal Naseer,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现CLIP视觉编码器中存在一个噪声强度转换现象：弱噪声下对抗样本表现出“假稳定”，而强噪声下对抗表示比干净表示更不稳定。基于此提出Drift-Gated机制，利用高噪声特征漂移作为门控信号，仅在检测到类似对抗的不稳定性时触发测试时防御，在13个数据集上改善了干净-鲁棒权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时防御方法虽能提升CLIP对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，但往往以牺牲干净精度为代价，导致不理想的干净-鲁棒权衡。作者希望找到一种无需训练的方法，能在不降低干净精度的前提下有效检测并防御对抗样本。

Method: 作者首先系统分析了CLIP表示空间中不同噪声强度下对抗样本与干净样本的行为差异，发现了噪声强度转换现象。基于此，提出Drift-Gated机制：在测试时计算高噪声水平下的特征漂移量作为轻量级门控信号，只有当漂移超过阈值（表明可能存在对抗攻击）时才触发现有测试时防御方法（如counterattack或noise-anchoring），否则直接用原始分类结果。

Result: 在13个数据集上，该方法一致改善了干净-鲁棒权衡。在8个细粒度数据集上，平均干净+对抗精度从65.7%提升至71.4%（counterattack防御），从68.4%提升至73.2%（noise-anchoring防御）；在ImageNet及4个偏移变体上，从56.1%提升至66.2%和从62.1%提升至67.6%。

Conclusion: 对抗样本在CLIP非鲁棒模型中的局部盆地几何结构比干净样本更脆弱，导致其在强噪声下更不稳定。利用这一差异设计的Drift-Gated机制是一种有效的训练无关、即插即用方法，能显著改善测试时防御的干净-鲁棒权衡。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP show strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Adversarial training improves robustness but is computationally expensive, motivating test-time defenses. Recent approaches exploit how CLIP's visual representations respond to stochastic perturbations: aggregating predictions across noisy views, constructing Gaussian noise-averaged anchors and interpolating features toward them, or applying counter-perturbations. These strategies improve robustness but often degrade clean accuracy, yielding an unfavorable clean-robust trade-off. We revisit stochastic test-time defenses and identify an underexplored noise-regime transition in CLIP's representation space. Prior work explored perturbations mainly in the weak-noise regime, where adversarial examples can appear unusually stable (false stability). Our analysis shows this reverses as perturbation strength grows: beyond the weak-noise regime, adversarial representations become markedly more unstable than clean ones, giving a clearer separation signal. The transition is consistent across uniform and Gaussian noise, photometric and geometric transforms, datasets, and diverse attacks. It largely disappears in adversarially trained models, suggesting it is tied to the fragile local-basin geometry of adversarial representations in non-robust CLIP. We propose a training-free, plug-in drift-gated mechanism that uses high-noise feature drift as a lightweight gating signal to trigger existing test-time defenses only when adversarial-like instability is detected. Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.

</details>

*Tianhe Wu,Kun Yan,Zikai Zhou,Lihan Jiang,Jiahao Li,Jie Zhang,Kaiyuan Gao,Ningyuan Tang,Shengming Yin,Xiaoyue Chen,Xiao Xu,Yilei Chen,Yuxiang Chen,Yan Shu,Yixian Xu,Yanran Zhang,Zihao Liu,Zhendong Wang,Zekai Zhang,Deqing Li,Liang Peng,Yi Wang,Jingren Zhou,Chenfei Wu*

Abstract: Few-step distillation has become an effective strategy for accelerating advanced visual generative models, yet prior work has largely focused on distillation objectives. In this work, we revisit few-step distillation from a complementary perspective, focusing on the training recipe that critically shapes student performance. Using Qwen-Image-2.0 as a representative case, we systematically investigate three factors in unified text-to-image generation and instruction-guided image editing distillation: data composition, teacher guidance, and task mixture. Our empirical analysis reveals several non-obvious behaviors, which motivate the development of Qwen-Image-Flash. Overall, our results suggest that effective few-step distillation requires not only carefully designed objectives, but also principled organization of the broader training pipeline.

### [95] [Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03748)
*Glenn Jocher,Jing Qiu,Mengyu Liu,Shuai Lyu,Fatih Cagatay Akyon,Muhammet Esat Kalfaoglu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Ultralytics YOLO26，一个统一的实时视觉模型家族，通过双头设计实现无NMS的端到端推理、移除DFL以简化检测头，并引入MuSGD优化器、Progressive Loss和STAL标签分配策略等训练改进。在COCO上达到40.9-57.5 mAP，T4 TensorRT延迟1.7-11.8 ms，支持检测、分割、姿态估计、旋转检测和分类等多种任务，并提供了开放词汇扩展版本YOLOE-26。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有YOLO检测器存在多个局限：推理时依赖非极大值抑制(NMS)、检测头因Distribution Focal Loss(DFL)而臃肿、训练周期长、小目标容易缺乏正标签分配。本文旨在通过协调的架构和训练改进来解决这些问题，构建统一的高效实时视觉模型。

Method: YOLO26采用双头设计实现原生无NMS的端到端推理，完全移除DFL使检测头更轻量且回归范围不受约束。训练流程包含三大创新：MuSGD（混合Muon-SGD优化器，源自大语言模型训练）、Progressive Loss（将监督信号逐步转向推理头）、STAL（保证小目标正覆盖的标签分配策略）。此外，为实例分割、姿态估计和旋转检测设计了任务特定的头和损失函数。家族涵盖n/s/m/l/x五种尺度，并推出开放词汇版本YOLOE-26。

Result: YOLO26在COCO上达到40.9-57.5 mAP，T4 TensorRT延迟1.7-11.8 ms，在所有尺度上超越了先前实时检测器的精度-延迟Pareto前沿。YOLOE-26x在LVIS minival上通过文本提示达到40.6 AP。

Conclusion: YOLO26通过架构与训练的协同设计，有效解决了YOLO系列长期存在的NMS依赖、头沉重、小目标标签缺失等问题，在多种视觉任务上实现了精度与效率的同步提升，验证了该统一框架的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.

</details>


### [96] [SLU-2K: A Question-Based Benchmark for Semantic Evaluation of Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03788)
*Zeno Testa,Antonino Furnari,Lorenzo Baraldi,Natalia Díaz-Rodríguez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SLU-2K数据集和评估方法，将手语翻译评估从表面指标（BLEU/ROUGE）转向语义理解，通过2,350个视频问答对评估模型对动作、位置、数字、物体、人物、时间和天气7类语义信息的理解能力。实验表明MLLMs性能接近随机，最优翻译系统准确率仅56.7%-75.2%，说明现有评估协议高估了真实理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLT评估依赖BLEU、ROUGE等词汇重叠指标，无法衡量翻译是否真正保留源手语序列的语义信息，与辅助技术中需要真实理解的目标脱节。因此需要建立以语义理解为核心的评估体系。

Method: 1) 提出SLU-2K数据集，包含2,350个基于PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily的闭合式视频问答对；2) 设计自动化数据生成流水线，覆盖动作、位置、数字、物体、人物、时间、天气7类问题；3) 评估MLLMs和MMSTL、SpaMo等先进翻译系统在该基准上的表现。

Result: MLLMs性能接近随机水平；经过领域内数据微调的最优翻译系统准确率仅56.7%-75.2%，存在显著的语义鸿沟。

Conclusion: 当前SLT评估协议过度估计了真实理解能力，未来进展应不仅以流畅度和n-gram重叠衡量，更应以语义正确性作为评价标准。

Abstract: Sign Language Translation (SLT) is typically evaluated with surface-form metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE, which reward lexical overlap but do not directly measure whether a translation preserves the meaning of the source sign sequence. This is in contrast with the final objective of integrating SLT in assistive technology. In this work, we shift the focus from Sign Language Translation (SLT) to Sign Language Understanding (SLU), with particular emphasis on semantic understanding. Specifically, we evaluate systems based on their ability to correctly recover, from the input video, key semantic aspects of the original sentence, such as actions taking place and facts about people and objects. To enable this evaluation systematically, we propose SLU-2K, a dataset of 2,350 closed-ended video question-answer pairs based on the popular PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily datasets. To obtain SLU-2K, we propose and extensively evaluate an automated data generation pipeline which produces questions across 7 categories, namely actions, locations, numbers, objects, people, time, and weather conditions. We show the potential of SLU-2K by evaluating popular Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and two representative state-of-the-art systems, MMSTL and SpaMo. Our results show that MLLMs reach near-random performance, highlighting the need for a more systematic integration of SLU in current AI systems. Furthermore, state-of-the-art translation systems carefully fine-tuned on in-domain data still exhibit a substantial semantic gap, with results ranging from 56.7% to 75.2%. These findings suggest that current SLT evaluation protocols overestimate true understanding and that future progress should be measured not only by fluency and n-gram overlap, but also by semantic correctness. Code, prompts, and benchmark files are available at https://github.com/ZenoTsT/SLU-2K

</details>


### [97] [Training-Free Multi-Concept LoRA Composition with Prompt-Aware Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03792)
*Georgios Tsoumplekas,Stella Bounareli,Vasileios Argyriou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种提示感知的多LoRA权重组合方法（W-Switch和W-Composite），通过根据目标提示中各触发词的语义重要性动态加权多个LoRA模块的输出，有效缓解多概念定制中的概念干扰问题，并在ComposLoRA测试集上实现了优于现有方法的视觉质量和身份保持能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LoRA模型在单概念定制上表现优异，但多概念组合时简单合并LoRA权重或输出会导致概念间相互干扰，降低视觉质量和概念保真度，亟需一种有效的多LoRA组合方法。

Method: 提出W-Switch和W-Composite两种方法：利用提示中各概念对应触发词的语义重要性，对多个LoRA模块的输出进行提示感知的加权组合；同时提出基于图像相似度的自动分割评估框架，从真实参考图像与生成图像中自动分割的概念区域进行对比评估。

Result: 在ComposLoRA测试集上，该方法在视觉质量、身份保持和组合性方面一致优于现有最先进方法；LLM评估和用户研究进一步验证了有效性，并与新提出的量化指标对齐。

Conclusion: 提示感知的多LoRA加权组合策略能有效解决多概念定制中的概念干扰问题，新提出的图像级评估框架为多概念生成提供了更可靠的量化评测手段。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) successfully enables personalization in text-to-image generation by adapting pre-trained diffusion models to specific visual concepts and styles. However, extending such models to multi-concept customization remains challenging. Naively combining multiple LoRA weights or their outputs often leads to interference among concepts, resulting in degraded visual quality and reduced fidelity to the reference images of individual concepts. This paper proposes a simple yet effective approach for multi-concept customization by optimally combining the outputs of multiple LoRA modules. We leverage the relative importance of each concept during generation, as inferred from its corresponding prompt tokens and introduce two methods, W-Switch and W-Composite, that employ a prompt-aware importance weighting strategy in which each LoRA is weighted according to the semantic influence of its trigger words in the target prompt. In addition, we extend existing quantitative evaluation metrics by proposing a new image-based similarity evaluation framework that assesses image fidelity and identity preservation through comparisons between real-world reference images and automatically segmented concept regions from generated images. We evaluate our approach on the ComposLoRA testbed and demonstrate consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of visual quality, identity preservation and compositionality. Qualitative evaluations, including a Large Language Model (LLM) based assessment and a user study, further validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and align with the newly introduced quantitative image-based metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/Prompt-Aware-Multi-LoRA-Composition.

</details>


### [98] [Template Collapse and Information-Theoretic Limits in Camera rPPG Pulse Morphology Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03802)
*Achraf Ben Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了16种架构在单周期面部rPPG信号中恢复动脉硬化形态学特征的可行性，发现所有架构均无法提取个体特异性形态结构，提出跨被试皮尔逊相关系数作为波形重建基准的必要诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究消费级摄像头远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）获取的单周期波形中是否编码了动脉僵硬度的生物标志物形态学信息，填补该领域对单周期rPPG信号能否恢复个体特异性形态特征的系统性评估空白。

Method: 在153名受试者的3个数据集上评估了6个家族的16种架构，引入跨被试皮尔逊相关系数（cross-subject r）来区分个体特异性恢复与模板坍塌。采用监督对比学习（SupCon）等方法进行验证。

Result: 所有架构均未能恢复个体特异性形态（跨被试r范围0.773-0.9999；真实上限0.601）。SupCon收敛到log N=4.844，证实测试编码器家族无法从单周期rPPG中提取判别性形态结构。VAE解码器恢复了输入rPPG中缺失的群体级谐波内容（H2/H1：输出0.310 vs 输入0.275），零样本泛化到UBFC（r=+0.708）；方向性幻觉缺口（p=0.150）提示部分信号读取。抗坍塌目标在输入无判别性结构时失效。

Conclusion: 消费级摄像头无法编码个体动脉形态；跨被试r是波形重建基准中必要的坍塌诊断指标。

Abstract: Objective: Consumer face camera remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables passive cardiovascular monitoring, but whether single-cycle waveform morphology encoding arterial stiffness biomarkers is recoverable from this measurement has not been characterised.
  Methods: We evaluated 16 architectures spanning six families on 153 subjects across three datasets, introducing cross-subject Pearson r to distinguish subject-specific recovery from template collapse.
  Results: No architecture recovered subject-specific morphology (cross-subject r range 0.773--0.9999; ground-truth ceiling 0.601). Supervised Contrastive (SupCon) converged to log N = 4.844, constituting the strongest available empirical evidence that no discriminative morphological structure is extractable from single-cycle rPPG by the encoder families tested. The VAE decoder restores population-level harmonic content absent from the rPPG input (H2/H1: 0.310 output vs. 0.275 input), generalising zero-shot to UBFC (r = +0.708); a directional hallucination gap (p = 0.150) suggests partial signal reading. Anti-collapse objectives fail when input carries no discriminative structure.
  Significance: Consumer cameras cannot encode individual arterial morphology; cross-subject r is a necessary collapse diagnostic for waveform reconstruction benchmarks.

</details>


### [99] [CropCraft: A Procedural World Generator for Robotic Simulation of Agricultural Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02417)
*Riccardo Bertoglio,Cyrille Pierre,Johann Laconte,Roland Lenain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CropCraft是一个基于Blender和Python的开源程序化世界生成器，能够从YAML配置文件生成适用于农业机器人的3D仿真环境，支持间作、葡萄园和杂草田等多种场景，生成的图像用于训练深度学习模型，在真实农田语义分割任务中实现了约10%的sim-to-real差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代农业中 agroecological practices（生态农业实践）的推广需要能够在高度多样化和复杂田间环境中运行的机器人系统。这类系统的开发与评估高度依赖仿真，但生成能够代表农业生态多样性的真实且可配置的3D环境仍然是一个重大挑战。

Method: CropCraft采用YAML配置文件驱动，基于Blender和Python构建，包含多生长阶段的3D植物模型库（作物、草类、杂草），使用随机放置算法重现真实田间的空间变异性。生成的世界可直接导入Gazebo模拟器，并包含所有元素的ground-truth标注。实验中使用10,000张合成玉米田图像训练多种语义分割架构。

Result: 仅使用合成数据训练的模型在真实田间图像上达到约10% mIoU的sim-to-real差距，优于先前最先进的合成数据生成方法。将少量真实图像与合成数据结合使用可进一步提高跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: CropCraft能够有效生成多样化的农业仿真环境，为农业机器人感知任务提供高质量的合成训练数据，并为如何有效利用合成数据进行农业感知任务提供了新的见解。

Abstract: The adoption of agroecological practices in modern agriculture requires robotic systems capable of operating in highly diverse and complex field environments. Developing and evaluating such systems relies heavily on simulation, yet generating realistic and configurable 3D environments representative of agroecological diversity remains a major challenge. This paper presents CropCraft, an open-source procedural world generator built on Blender and Python, designed to produce 3D simulation environments tailored to agricultural robotics. CropCraft generates crop fields from a simple YAML configuration file, supporting a wide range of scenarios including intercropping, vineyards, and weed-infested fields. The tool includes a library of 3D plant models (crops, grasses, and weeds) at multiple growth stages, and uses stochastic placement algorithms to realistically reproduce the spatial variability observed in real fields. Generated worlds are directly importable into the Gazebo simulator and include ground-truth annotations for all placed elements, supporting both perception and navigation algorithm development. To demonstrate the practical utility of CropCraft, we apply it to the task of crop-weed semantic segmentation using deep learning. A dataset of 10,000 synthetic images of maize fields with varying weed densities, growth stages, and lighting conditions was generated and used to train several segmentation architectures. Models trained exclusively on synthetic data achieve a sim-to-real gap of approximately 10% mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on real field images, outperforming previous state-of-the-art synthetic generation approaches. We further show that combining even a few real images with synthetic data improves generalization across domains, providing new insights into the effective use of synthetic data for agricultural perception tasks.

</details>


### [100] [TeX-1500: A Paired Real-World LWIR Hyperspectral Dataset and Benchmark for Temperature-Emissivity-Texture Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03806)
*Cheng Dai,Jiale Lin,Hongyi Xu,Bingxuan Song,Ziyang Xie,Fanglin Bao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了TeX-1500，一个大规模配对长波红外高光谱成像与温度-发射率-纹理分解数据集，并设计了TeX-UNet基线模型，填补了该领域缺乏监督学习的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TeX分解方法主要依赖场景特定的逆求解器，缺乏配对的长波红外高光谱与TeX真值数据，限制了基于学习的分解方法的发展。

Method: 构建了包含1,522对校准真实场景的TeX-1500数据集，涵盖五个地点、四季、多种采集时间和传感器类型；提出TeX-UNet，一种波长感知的基线模型，将校准HSI波段和波长位置映射到TeX场。

Result: 在留出DARPA IH推扫场景和零样本/少样本迁移到FTIR场景上的实验表明，TeX-1500提供了可用的配对监督和可测量的基准。

Conclusion: TeX-1500数据集及基准为数据驱动的基于物理属性的热感知研究提供了有效的监督学习和评估框架。

Abstract: Temperature-emissivity-texture (TeX) decomposition seeks to recover object heat state, material spectral response, and visible-like geometric texture from long-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging (LWIR HSI). Existing TeX pipelines are mainly scene-specific inverse solvers, and the lack of paired LWIR HSI-TeX supervision has limited learning-based decomposition. To address this gap, we introduce TeX-1500, a large-scale paired LWIR HSI-TeX dataset and benchmark for supervised HSI-to-TeX decomposition. TeX-1500 contains 1,522 calibrated real-scene pairs from DARPA Invisible Headlights (DARPA IH) pushbroom imagery and our FTIR acquisitions, covering five locations, four seasons, diverse acquisition times, heterogeneous wavelength layouts, and two sensor families. Each sample stores a calibrated valid-band radiance cube, calibrated wavelength positions, and aligned temperature, emissivity, and texture supervision constructed through a consistent restoration and TeX-construction protocol. We further provide TeX-UNet, a simple wavelength-aware baseline that maps calibrated HSI bands and wavelength positions to TeX fields. Experiments on the held-out DARPA IH pushbroom scenes and zero-/few-shot transfer to FTIR scenes show that TeX-1500 provides usable paired supervision and a measurable benchmark for data-driven physical-property-centered thermal perception.

</details>


### [101] [FRED: A Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving Dataset for Flooded Road Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22018)
*Connor Malone,Sebastien Demmel,Sebastien Glaser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FRED是首个面向道路积水场景的多模态自动驾驶数据集，包含相机、LiDAR和IMU数据，提供语义标注以支持水患检测方法的训练与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集缺乏针对道路积水（水患）场景的专门数据，而积水对自动驾驶安全性构成重大威胁，亟需一个专门的数据集来支持水患检测算法的研究与开发。

Method: 在五次独立洪水事件期间及之后采集数据，使用2.3MP FLIR相机、64线Ouster OS1-64 LiDAR和iXblue ATLANS-C IMU（由Geoflex RTK GNSS校正），提供KITTI格式和RTMaps格式两种数据格式，并包含语义标签。

Result: 构建了首个多模态道路积水场景数据集，包含多种传感器数据、语义标注及干湿条件对照数据，支持单传感器及传感器融合方法的水患检测。

Conclusion: FRED数据集填补了自动驾驶领域道路积水场景数据的空白，为水患检测、定位及SLAM等任务提供了标准化评测基准。

Abstract: The Flooded Road Environments Dataset (FRED) is, to our knowledge, the first multi-modal autonomous driving dataset specifically targeting the collection of data from scenarios involving water hazards on the road. The dataset contains images from a 2.3 MP FLIR Blackfly USB3 camera, 64-beam 360 degree point clouds from an Ouster OS1-64 LiDAR, and data from an iXblue ATLANS-C IMU corrected by a Geoflex RTK GNSS, from five separate locations captured both during and after flooding events. The data has been released in two formats: a KITTI-style format for easy integration with existing data tools, and the RTMaps format for direct replay of the vehicle's data capture. We provide semantic labels to enable the training and evaluation of both single-sensor and sensor-fusion methods for water hazard detection. Position and velocity, as well as data captured under dry conditions, are provided to enable the development of location-based detection methods that may incorporate maps, and to evaluate other tasks such as localisation and SLAM.

</details>


### [102] [Conditional Latent Diffusion Model with Fourier-based Motion Modelling for Virtual Population Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03827)
*Shaokun Lan,Haoran Dou,Jinghan Huang,Arezoo Zakeri,Fengming Lin,Zherui Zhou,Jinming Duan,Alejandro F. Frangi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出4D F-MeshLDM，一种条件生成框架，用于生成4D心脏网格序列。该方法结合卷积网格VAE、基于截断傅里叶级数的结构潜空间和扩散先验，通过临床协变量条件调制实现可控合成。在5000名UK Biobank受试者上验证，该方法在解剖保真度上优于现有基线，且几乎为零周期闭合误差，生成队列能准确保留临床功能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心血管器械的计算机模拟试验需要生成虚拟人群解剖结构，现有方法多聚焦于静态解剖或缺乏显式周期性的序列建模，无法有效生成具有周期运动特性的4D心脏网格序列。

Method: 提出4D F-MeshLDM框架，包含：(1) 卷积网格VAE对3D网格进行编码；(2) 利用截断傅里叶级数参数化运动的结构潜空间；(3) 扩散先验学习傅里叶系数token的潜分布；(4) 通过仿射调制以临床协变量为条件实现可控合成；(5) 采样token后通过逆傅里叶合成生成周期一致的潜轨迹，解码为3D+t心脏网格序列。

Result: 在5000名UK Biobank受试者上的实验表明，4D F-MeshLDM在解剖保真度上优于现有基线方法，实现接近零的周期闭合误差，且生成队列能准确保留临床功能指标。

Conclusion: 4D F-MeshLDM框架能够生成高保真、周期一致的心脏网格序列，为可靠的计算机模拟心脏试验提供了有效工具。

Abstract: In-silico trials of medical devices require the generation of virtual populations of anatomies. In cardiovascular applications, virtual anatomy is typically represented as a 3D+t mesh sampled from a generative model. However, most existing mesh generators focus on static anatomy, while sequence models often lack explicit periodicity. To this end, we propose 4D F-MeshLDM, a conditional generative framework comprising a convolutional mesh VAE to encode meshes, a structural latent space that parameterises motion using a truncated Fourier series, and a diffusion prior that learns the latent distribution over Fourier coefficient tokens. By conditioning the diffusion process on clinical covariates via affine modulation, we enable controllable synthesis. Sampling tokens and performing inverse Fourier synthesis yield cycle-consistent latent trajectories, which can be decoded into 3D+t cardiac mesh sequences. Experiments on 5,000 UK Biobank subjects demonstrate that 4D F-MeshLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in anatomical fidelity and achieves near-zero cycle closure error. Furthermore, the generated cohorts accurately preserve clinical functional indices, highlighting the potential of our framework for reliable in-silico cardiac trials.

</details>


### [103] [Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03868)
*Dingrui Wang,YuAn Wang,Jinkun Liu,Yue Zhang,Mattia Piccinini,Yu Sun,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了Donk模型，一种统一的手部视频-动作去噪模型，通过分布对齐方法将视频基础模型与机器人可执行动作对齐，支持多条件生成（语言、图像、手部状态），在动作、视频和文本生成任务上均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将视觉-动作先验窄化为仅以观测为条件的策略分布，限制了先验的利用效率。作者从分布视角重新审视这一对齐问题，提出保持更宽分布的方法，建模交互视频与可执行手部轨迹的联合空间。

Method: 提出Donk，一种统一的视频-动作去噪模型。支持多种条件控制：语言、初始图像和初始手部状态，可采样未来视频和双手MANO轨迹作为动作策略；无图像条件时，从文本条件分布中采样配对的视频-动作展开，将视频先验转化为数据引擎。

Result: 在动作、视频和纯文本生成三种评估场景下，Donk提升了灵巧手轨迹精度，保持了强视频保真度，并在统一训练框架下生成了平滑的文本条件动作展开。

Conclusion: 分布对齐相比窄化策略分布能更有效利用视频基础模型的先验知识，统一去噪架构可同时支持动作策略与数据生成，为灵巧手操作提供了一种新的范式。

Abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

</details>


### [104] [Seg2Track++: Probabilistic Track Validation and Data Association for Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03875)
*Diogo Mendonça,Tiago Barros,Cristiano Premebida,Urbano J. Nunes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Seg2Track++框架将SAM2实例分割与新型轨迹管理模块结合，通过掩码质心距离(MCD)、置信感知成本调制(CCM)和概率轨迹验证(PTV)实现零样本MOTS，在KITTI MOTS数据集上提升了身份保持能力并减少了误报传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM2等基础模型在分割上具有强零样本泛化能力，但直接应用于MOTS存在轨迹关联不可靠和误报传播问题，需要一种无需微调即可实现鲁棒多目标跟踪与分割的方法。

Method: 提出Seg2Track++框架，集成SAM2实例分割与轨迹管理模块。使用掩码质心距离(MCD)和置信感知成本调制(CCM)进行轨迹关联，概率轨迹验证(PTV)采用伯努利滤波器验证轨迹存在性并抑制虚假轨迹。

Result: 在KITTI MOTS数据集上，该方法无需微调即实现了改进的身份保持、减少的误报传播和鲁棒的轨迹管理。

Conclusion: Seg2Track++有效解决了基础模型直接用于MOTS时的轨迹关联不可靠和误报问题，实现了零样本条件下鲁棒的MOTS性能。

Abstract: Autonomous systems require robust Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation (MOTS) to operate reliably in dynamic environments, ensuring consistent object identities and precise mask-level delineation. Foundation models such as SAM2 have shown strong zero-shot generalization for segmentation, but their direct application to MOTS is limited by unreliable track association and false-positive propagation. This work introduces Seg2Track++, a framework that integrates instance segmentation with SAM2 and a novel track management module to perform zero-shot MOTS with enhanced temporal consistency. Tracks are associated using Mask Centroid Distance (MCD) and Confidence-Aware Cost Modulation (CCM), while Probabilistic Track Validation (PTV) employs a Bernoulli filter to validate track existence and suppress ghost tracks. Experimental results on KITTI MOTS demonstrate improved identity preservation, reduced false-positive propagation, and robust track management without fine-tuning.

</details>


### [105] [MLP Splatting: Object-Centric Neural Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03877)
*Shinjeong Kim,Yuzhou Cheng,Xin Kong,Paul H. J. Kelly,Andrew J. Davison*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MLP-Splatting 提出用多个紧凑的局部MLP基元替代高斯基元或全局辐射场，实现场景分解与照片级新视角合成，在物体级编辑、开放词汇交互等方面表现优异，且内存消耗降低至1/15，渲染速度提升3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如3D Gaussian Splatting和NeRF）虽能实现照片级新视角合成，但难以将场景分解为少量基元以支持物体级操作，通常需要额外的分割或分组步骤。

Method: 每个基元由一个独立的紧凑MLP表示，具有局部空间支持，预测辐射度和不透明度；通过高效的稀疏体积合成进行光线-基元交互渲染；仅使用RGB监督即可学习；可选语义特征蒸馏以支持开放词汇交互。

Result: 与SOTA语义3DGS方法相比，内存消耗降低至1/15，渲染速度提升3倍；支持无需分割掩码的交互式物体级编辑和开放集实例分割。

Conclusion: MLP-Splatting通过局部神经基元实现了表达力与空间局部性的平衡，在保持照片级渲染质量的同时，显著提升了场景可分解性和编辑能力，并大幅降低了资源消耗。

Abstract: 3D representations are fundamental to scene rendering, understanding, and interaction. Recent approaches, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting and Neural Radiance Fields, achieve impressive photorealistic novel-view synthesis, but lack the ability to easily decompose scene elements into a few primitives, requiring additional segmentation or grouping for object-level manipulation. We present MLP-Splatting, a method that enables scene decomposition via a few expressive light-field primitives while providing photorealistic novel-view synthesis.
  MLP-Splatting models each primitive as an independent compact MLP with localized spatial support that predicts radiance and opacity. In contrast to low-level Gaussian primitives or a single global radiance field, our neural primitives provide greater expressive capacity while remaining spatially localized. Rendering is performed through efficient sparse volumetric compositing over ray-primitive interactions.
  Our primitives are supervised using RGB supervision alone, which yields primitives that represent local scene regions often corresponding to objects or object parts, enabling interactive object-level editing without segmentation masks by selecting a handful of primitives. Our method, augmented with optional semantic feature distillation, enables open-vocabulary scene interaction and open-set instant segmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, we achieve substantially lower memory usage (1/15$\times$) and faster rendering (3$\times$), as we show in our experiments compared to semantic 3DGS methods. Project Page: https://shinjeongkim.com/mlp-splatting

</details>


### [106] [Beyond Encoder Accumulation: Measuring Encoder Roles in Multi-Encoder VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03879)
*Wei Ding,Yudong Zhang,Ruobing Xie,Xingwu Sun,Jiansheng Chen,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在Cambrian-1基准上，通过重新训练全部31种视觉编码器子集（~20K GPU小时），发现：(1) 从头训练与掩码评估的编码器排名不同；(2) 提出Capacity-Necessity分解框架，发现高Capacity编码器配对并非最优，最佳策略是"高Capacity锚点+自适应互补"；(3) 预投影器有效秩解释了残差性能变化，高秩锚点与秩扩展互补编码器的配对效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型缺乏系统工具来理解多编码器联合训练下的交互行为，参数高效的编码器配置在训练前难以确定，现有方法（如基于固定检查点的掩码评估）可能误导对编码器重要性的判断。

Method: 在Cambrian-1套件的16个基准上，统一流水线重新训练5种常见视觉编码器的全部31个非空子集（~20K GPU小时），提出Capacity（单独性能）和Necessity（移除后性能下降）双轴分解框架，并引入预投影器有效秩（effective rank）分析。

Result: (1) 从头训练的编码器排名与掩码评估结果不同；(2) Capacity与Necessity不可互换，两个最高Capacity编码器配对效果次优，高Capacity锚点+自适应互补编码器可匹配完整5编码器性能，额外编码器增益边际；(3) 预投影器有效秩解释残差性能变化，最优配对是联合训练中秩保持的锚点与秩扩展的互补编码器。

Conclusion: 多编码器LVLM设计存在方法论缺陷，Capacity-Necessity分解与预投影器秩分析为关闭这一缺陷提供了具体原语，指导更原理性的编码器配置选择。

Abstract: As foundation models scale toward fusing more heterogeneous visual streams, understanding how diverse encoders interact under joint training becomes a prerequisite for principled design. Yet large vision-language models (LVLMs) currently lack the tools to do so, and parameter-efficient encoder configurations remain hard to identify before training. To re-examine encoder roles under joint training, on the 16-benchmark Cambrian-1 suite we retrain and evaluate all 31 non-empty subsets of five common vision encoders under a unified pipeline (~20k GPU-hours total), and report three findings. First, retraining each subset from scratch reveals encoder rankings that differ from those obtained by masking encoders on a fixed checkpoint, including which encoder ranks first overall. Second, we decompose each encoder's contribution into two axes, Capacity, the score an encoder reaches on its own, and Necessity, the drop when it is removed from the full pool. The two axes are not interchangeable. Pairing the two highest-Capacity encoders is suboptimal, while pairing a high-Capacity anchor with an adaptive complement matches the full five-encoder model. Adding further encoders beyond this pair yields only marginal gains. Third, at fixed parameter count, per-encoder pre-projector effective rank explains the residual score variation. The strongest pairs combine an anchor whose rank survives joint training with a complement whose rank expands under it, suggesting that higher-rank, less-collapsed projector inputs correspond to a more favorable optimization regime at the encoder-projector interface. Together, the Capacity-Necessity decomposition and the pre-projector rank analysis, along with comprehensive evaluation through retraining, expose a methodological gap in multi-encoder LVLM design, and offer concrete primitives for closing it.

</details>


### [107] [CoralBay: A Self-Supervised CT Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03888)
*Ioannis Gatopoulos,Nicolas Känzig,Sebastian Otálora,Fei Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoralBay 是一个基于3D Swin骨干网络和自蒸馏机制的自监督学习框架，通过层次化多尺度特征学习，在医学影像（如CT）上预训练出能同时编码全局语义和局部结构的体积表征，并在多种下游放射学任务中表现优异，同时贡献了开源的3D放射学排行榜基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D自监督预训练方法无法有效建模3D医学影像（如CT）的空间连续性、器官解剖结构和基于强度的组织属性（如亨氏单位），需要一种针对3D体积数据设计的自监督表征学习方法。

Method: 基于DINO自蒸馏框架，扩展为层次化3D Swin Transformer骨干网络，对拼接的多尺度特征进行自蒸馏学习，实现数据高效的3D自监督预训练。

Result: CoralBay在多种下游放射学任务上表现出强且一致的迁移性能，覆盖不同的解剖目标。

Conclusion: CoralBay有效填补了2D预训练与3D医学影像之间的差距，为体积表征学习提供了标准化基准（开源排行榜），推动了3D医学影像自监督学习的发展。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning has enabled large-scale pre-training on 2D natural images, producing general-purpose visual representations that transfer effectively across tasks. However, many medical imaging modalities, such as CT scans, are inherently three-dimensional and differ fundamentally from natural images in both structure and semantics. Volumetric modalities capture spatial continuity, organ anatomy, and intensity-based tissue properties (e.g., Hounsfield Units), which are not adequately modeled by 2D pre-training. To bridge this gap, we introduce CoralBay, a self-distillation framework that extends DINO by using a hierarchical 3D Swin backbone and applying self-distillation to concatenated multi-scale features, enabling data-efficient self-supervised learning of rich spatial representations that encode both global semantics and fine-grained local structure. As a result, CoralBay transfers effectively to a wide range of downstream radiological tasks, demonstrating strong and consistent performance across diverse anatomical targets. In addition, we contribute to the open-source \eva framework by introducing a public, reproducible 3D radiology leaderboard that unifies multiple datasets and establishes a standardized benchmark for evaluating volumetric representation learning methods.

</details>


### [108] [OVO-S-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Streaming Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03890)
*Yifei Li,Pengyiang Liu,Yuhang Zang,Zhongyue Shi,Qi Fu,Hongye Hao,Jiwen Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OVO-S-Bench是一个完全人工标注的流式空间智能基准测试，包含1,680个问题（覆盖348个视频），通过12名标注员的804人小时多层质量保证构建。问题涵盖从即时自我中心感知到异中心映射四个抽象层级。评测显示最佳模型Gemini-3.1-Pro（59.2分）与人类专家（86.6分）差距27分，异中心映射是主要瓶颈，且流式/空间微调MLLMs性能反而下降，链式思维推理会放大空间错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准要么在完整视频上进行离线评估，要么针对事件而非空间结构，缺乏对流式空间智能（机器人、AR、自动驾驶中需要从连续自我中心流中推理位置和布局）的评测能力。

Method: 构建人工标注的流式时空推理基准OVO-S-Bench，包含348个源视频的1,680个问题，每个问题含查询时间戳和证据区间，评测时模型仅可见前缀。问题分为四个抽象层级：即时自我中心感知、时空上下文追踪、空间模拟与推理、异中心映射。

Result: Gemini-3.1-Pro达59.2分，落后人类专家（86.6分）27分；异中心映射是主要瓶颈；流式/空间微调MLLMs性能低于其基础模型；链式思维推理在缺乏流式锚定时放大空间错误。

Conclusion: OVO-S-Bench揭示了当前MLLMs在流式空间智能上的显著局限，为下一代流式空间MLLMs提供了一个高要求的测试平台。

Abstract: Multimodal agents in robotics, AR, and autonomous driving must reason about places and layouts from continuous egocentric streams, often using evidence outside the current view. Existing benchmarks either evaluate offline over full videos or target events rather than spatial structure. We introduce OVO-S-Bench, a fully human-annotated benchmark for streaming spatial intelligence, comprising 1,680 questions over 348 source videos. Annotation involves 12 trained annotators, each also serving as a blind cross-reviewer, across roughly 804 person-hours of multi-round quality assurance. Each question carries a query timestamp and an evidence interval, and at evaluation, the model sees only the prefix preceding the query. Questions span four levels of increasing abstraction: instantaneous egocentric perception, spatiotemporal context tracking, spatial simulation and reasoning, and allocentric mapping. Across 38 proprietary and open-source MLLMs, Gemini-3.1-Pro trails human experts by 27 points, 59.2 vs. 86.6, with allocentric mapping as the dominant bottleneck. Notably, streaming and spatially fine-tuned MLLMs underperform their own backbones. We further find that chain-of-thought reasoning amplifies spatial errors when ungrounded in the stream. By exposing these limitations, OVO-S-Bench establishes a demanding testbed for next-generation streaming spatial MLLMs.

</details>


### [109] [Electromagnetic Navigation for Femoral Osteotomy Using High-Accuracy X-ray-to-CT Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03893)
*Roman Flepp,Arend Nieuwland,Bastian Sigrist,Philipp Fürnstahl,Lilian Calvet,Thomas Dreher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于电磁跟踪（EMT）的股骨截骨导航系统，仅需两张透视图像即可实现术前计划的实时无辐射导航，在合成股骨实验中总角度误差（3.05±0.75°）显著优于徒手操作（6.32±2.36°），且精度与患者特异性导板（PSI）等效，同时避免额外手术暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前股骨矫正截骨术的术前计划执行精度不足，现有技术（徒手操作、PSI）存在准确性差、创伤大、辐射暴露多（徒手>30张、PSI>6张透视图像）等局限，亟需一种微创、高精度、低辐射的导航方案。

Method: 系统整合了CT术前规划、一次性术中C臂校准、以及基于两张透视图像的X射线-to-CT配准，实现EMT实时导航锯片和骨块位置，支持单平面和双平面截骨，无需术中额外透视。

Result: 在18个合成股骨实验中，EMT导航的总角度误差（3.05±0.75°）显著优于徒手操作（6.32±2.36°, p=0.031）；EMT组无超过5°临床阈值的案例，徒手组6次试验中出现4次离群值；EMT与PSI在角度误差（p≤0.02）和位移误差（p=0.048）上统计等效。

Conclusion: 该系统仅用两张透视图像即可转移术前计划，在无额外手术暴露条件下达到PSI级精度，为后续尸体和临床验证提供了依据。

Abstract: Accurate execution of preoperative plans in corrective femoral osteotomies remains challenging. Current techniques are limited by variable accuracy, invasiveness, and radiation exposure, with free-hand methods and patient-specific instrumentation (PSI) often requiring >30 and >6 fluoroscopic images, respectively. We present an integrated, electromagnetic tracking (EMT)-based navigation system for femoral osteotomies that minimizes dissection and intraoperative fluoroscopy. The system couples CT-based preoperative planning with one-time intraoperative C-arm calibration and accurate X-ray-to-CT registration from two fluoroscopic images acquired at initialization. This enables real-time, fluoroscopy-free EMT navigation of the saw blade and bone fragments relative to the preoperative plan, and is compatible with uniplanar and biplanar osteotomies. In a feasibility study using 18 synthetic femora, EMT guidance significantly outperformed free-hand execution in total angular error ($(3.05 \pm 0.75)^\circ$ vs.\ $(6.32 \pm 2.36)^\circ$, $p=0.031$), assuming the same minimal surgical exposure for both. No EMT-guided trials exceeded the >5° clinical threshold, whereas free-hand produced 4 outliers of 6 trials. The system achieved statistical equivalence ($\pm 2^\circ$, $\pm 2,\text{mm}$) to PSI for total angular ($p \le 0.02$) and total translational ($p=0.048$) errors, with no significant differences in user questionnaire scores. By transferring preoperative plans using only two fluoroscopic images while matching PSI accuracy without additional surgical exposure, the proposed system motivates subsequent cadaveric and clinical validation.

</details>


### [110] [An Attention-Based Denoising Model for Diffusion Weighted Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03903)
*Prithviraj Verma,Pawan Kumar,Chandan Deshani,Prasun Chandra Tripathi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合层次化Swin Transformer窗口注意力与基于Transformer的多维门控精化的噪声感知注意力驱动去噪框架，用于处理DWI中由幅度重建引入的依赖信号Rician噪声，在1%-15%噪声水平下达到平均PSNR 33.69dB和SSIM 0.8539，且在高噪声条件下保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DWI用于全身癌症筛查但采集时间长，缩短扫描时间会导致图像质量下降和噪声增加。传统的基于卷积的方法难以处理DWI中幅度重建引入的依赖信号Rician噪声，需要更有效的去噪方法。

Method: 提出噪声感知注意力驱动去噪框架，包含：(1)层次化Swin Transformer窗口注意力机制；(2)基于Transformer的多维门控精化模块；(3)显式噪声水平条件化；(4)残差重建策略，实现对异方差噪声的自适应抑制。

Result: 在1%-15%噪声水平范围内平均PSNR为33.69dB，SSIM为0.8539，在高噪声条件下保持稳定行为，表明注意力引导的上下文建模与通道自适应精化相结合的方法具有鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 注意力引导的上下文建模结合通道自适应精化为DWI去噪提供了鲁棒且可泛化的解决方案，有效解决了传统卷积方法难以处理的Rician噪声问题。

Abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is used for whole-body cancer screening, but it typically requires a long acquisition time. When the scan time is reduced, the image quality often suffers, leading to increased noise in the scans. Magnitude reconstruction in DWI introduces signal-dependent Rician noise, which makes denoising more challenging for conventional convolution-based methods. To address this limitation, we propose a noise-aware attention-driven denoising framework that integrates hierarchical Swin Transformer window attention with transformer-based multi-dimensional gated refinement for DWI restoration. The model incorporates explicit noise-level conditioning and residual reconstruction to enable adaptive suppression of heteroscedastic noise across a wide range of corruption levels. Experimental evaluation on corrupted DWI scans demonstrates strong restoration performance. Our model achieves a mean PSNR of 33.69~dB and SSIM of 0.8539 across noise levels from 1\% to 15\%, while maintaining stable behavior under severe noise conditions. These results indicate that attention-guided contextual modeling combined with channel-adaptive refinement provides a robust and generalizable solution for DWI denoising.

</details>


### [111] [Bootstrap Your Generator: Unpaired Visual Editing with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03911)
*Yoad Tewel,Yuval Atzmon,Gal Chechik,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ByG框架，利用预训练生成模型自身知识进行无配对训练的流匹配编辑模型，通过梯度路由和循环一致性实现无需外部信号的图像视频编辑，在数据稀缺场景下超越有监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成模型具备强大的视觉理解能力，但训练图像/视频编辑模型需要大量配对数据，而视频编辑中配对数据收集成本极高，限制了模型的可扩展性。

Method: 1) 从冻结的基座模型中提取指令跟随线索作为训练信号；2) 采用循环一致性保持结构信息；3) 提出梯度路由机制，将下游损失对干净预测的梯度回传到含噪训练状态，弥合训练-推理差距。

Result: 在数据稀缺的图像和视频编辑场景中达到SOTA，有效泛化到未见领域，超越基于百万级样本训练的监督基线。

Conclusion: 梯度路由弥合了训练-推理差距，从基座模型提取语义线索提供了鲁棒训练信号，无需外部奖励模型，实现了无配对数据的可扩展编辑模型训练。

Abstract: Modern generative models possess a deep understanding of visual content, yet training them for image editing typically requires massive datasets of paired examples. This limits scalability, especially for video editing where collecting paired data is prohibitively expensive. We propose Bootstrap Your Generator (ByG), a general framework for unpaired training of flow matching editing models. It leverages the base model's knowledge without any external signal. Our approach pairs instruction-following cues extracted from the frozen model with cycle-consistency for structure preservation. To make this tractable, we propose to route gradients from downstream losses over clean predictions to noisy training states. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results on challenging data-scarce image and video editing scenarios. Extensive evaluations and user studies show that our method effectively generalizes to unseen domains and outperforms supervised baselines trained on millions of samples. Analysis reveals that our gradient routing bridges the train-inference gap, and extracting semantic cues from a base model provides a robust training signal that obviates the need for external reward models.

</details>


### [112] [PatchScene: Patch-based Voxel Diffusion for Large-Scale Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03915)
*Qingdong Xu,Jiajun Zhu,Shilin Zhu,Xinjing He,Chao Lu,Huanran Wang,Jiyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PatchScene，一种基于补丁体素扩散的大规模LiDAR场景补全框架，通过局部精细化生成、置信度引导的时空融合和环形流扩散策略，在SemanticKITTI上实现SOTA性能，且能从20米泛化到50米场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖全局潜在表示或密集体素网格，难以兼顾大规模场景的精细几何重建与时空一致性，且对远距离区域补全能力有限。

Method: 1) 基于补丁的体素扩散范式，在局部3D区域显式生成细粒度几何；2) 置信度引导的时空融合机制，在统一生成过程中整合重叠补丁和相邻帧；3) 环形流扩散策略，利用LiDAR扫描的径向密度模式，从近到远逐步传播高保真信息，实现无空间边界的场景补全。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI基准上，所有标准指标均达到SOTA，超越此前方法；20米范围训练的模型可直接泛化到50米场景，无需重训。

Conclusion: PatchScene在几何精度和时间一致性上均显著提升，且具备强可扩展性和泛化能力，适用于实际自动驾驶应用。

Abstract: We propose PatchScene, a novel diffusion-based framework for large-scale LiDAR scene completion. Unlike existing methods that rely on global latent representations or dense voxel grids, PatchScene adopts a patch-based voxel diffusion paradigm that explicitly generates fine-grained geometry within localized 3D regions. To ensure coherent reconstruction at both spatial and temporal scales, we introduce a confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion mechanism that integrates overlapping patches and adjacent frames in a unified generative process. Furthermore, we design an Annular-Flow diffusion strategy that leverages the radial density pattern of LiDAR scans to progressively propagate high-fidelity information from near-range to far-range regions, enabling spatially unbounded scene completion. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that PatchScene achieves state-of-the-art performance across all standard metrics, surpassing previous approaches in both geometric accuracy and temporal consistency. Remarkably, the model trained on 20 m LiDAR ranges generalizes effectively to 50 m scenes without retraining, highlighting its strong scalability and generalization capability for real-world autonomous driving applications.

</details>


### [113] [Benchmarking Visual State Tracking in Multimodal Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03920)
*Sihyun Yu,Nanye Ma,Pinzhi Huang,Hyunseok Lee,Shusheng Yang,June Suk Choi,Ellis Brown,Oscar Michel,Boyang Zheng,Jinwoo Shin,Saining Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VSTAT基准，用于评估多模态大模型在视频理解中的视觉状态追踪能力。实验表明，当前最先进的MLLMs在VSTAT上远低于人类水平，且其失败原因并非推理能力不足，而是视觉感知缺陷。现有智能体方法也无法解决这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基准评测主要关注孤立时刻的识别，忽视了视频理解中至关重要的视觉状态持续追踪能力。作者旨在系统诊断MLLMs在这一维度上的表现并分析其失败原因。

Method: 构建VSTAT基准，包含834个视频片段（合成+真实世界）和1,500道问题，要求模型跨整个视频流连续感知和整合事件（无法从单帧或短片段回答）。通过对比MLLMs的思维轨迹与原始视频流，分析失败根源。

Result: 最先进MLLMs在VSTAT上表现远低于人类，仅略高于基于答案先验的基线；模型在文本推理上正确，但视觉感知存在缺陷；现有MLLM视频智能体和代码智能体方法仍无法解决该问题。

Conclusion: MLLMs在视觉状态追踪任务中的主要瓶颈是视觉感知能力不足而非推理能力欠缺，当前智能体方法也不能弥补这一缺陷，该方向仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Understanding a video requires more than recognizing isolated moments, as humans continuously track entities, states, and events over time. This capacity for visual state tracking is fundamental to video understanding, yet remains underexplored in current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). We introduce Visual STAte Tracking benchmark (VSTAT), a video-based benchmark designed to diagnose visual state tracking in MLLMs. VSTAT consists of 834 clips drawn from both synthetic and real-world videos, paired with 1,500 questions that cannot be answered from any single frame or short segment, requiring continuous perception and integration of events across the entire video stream. Despite their strong performance on existing video benchmarks, we find that state-of-the-art MLLMs perform far below humans and only modestly above answer-prior baselines. To analyze this gap, we compare MLLMs' thinking traces with the underlying video stream to understand why and when MLLMs fail on VSTAT. We find that MLLMs reason and track correctly in text, but fail at visually perceiving the events they need to track. Finally, our preliminary evaluation suggests that recent agentic approaches, including MLLM-based video agents and coding agents, do not readily resolve these failures, still falling short on VSTAT.

</details>


### [114] [GARDEN: Gravity-Aligned Reconstruction of Disentangled ENvironments from RGB images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03921)
*Jiahao Sun,Dingkun Wei,Zehong Shen,Hongyu Zhou,Yujun Shen,Liang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GARDEN是一个仅使用RGB输入的框架，通过重力先验将多视图重建分解为物理可交互的场景表示，直接输出包含显式刚体和解耦背景的结构化混合场景，支持物理模拟并保持视觉真实感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图RGB重建方法产生无物理结构的整体场景表示，存在全局旋转任意性、刚体与背景几何纠缠等问题，难以支持稳定物理交互。检索替换CAD资产的方法引入额外延迟并削弱几何保真度。

Method: 以重力作为通用物理先验：(1)将重建对齐到统一的重力视角(Gravity-View)帧以消除度量模糊性；(2)恢复以物体为中心的刚性网格及精确6-DoF放置；(3)通过条件3D点分类从背景中移除重复的物体几何。最终得到显式刚体+解耦背景的混合表示。

Result: 在仿真和真实多视图场景上，GARDEN在物体放置可靠性、解耦质量和渲染-模拟效率上均优于基于检索的基线方法。

Conclusion: 利用重力作为物理先验进行场景分解，可以在无需检索CAD资产的前提下实现高效的物理仿真，同时保持视觉保真度。

Abstract: Converting multi-view RGB observations into simulation-ready 3D environments remains challenging because current reconstruction pipelines produce monolithic scene representations without explicit physical structure. They are typically defined up to an arbitrary global rotation and entangle rigid foreground objects with background geometry, which hinders stable physical interaction. Existing solutions often recover interactivity by replacing reconstructed objects with retrieved CAD assets, but this introduces a slow retrieval-and-replacement stage and weakens scene-specific geometric fidelity. We propose GARDEN, an RGB-only framework that reformulates reconstruction as physically-grounded scene factorization and outputs a structured hybrid scene representation. The key idea is to use gravity as a universal physical prior: we first align the reconstruction to a unified Gravity-View frame to resolve gauge ambiguity, then recover object-centric rigid meshes with accurate 6-DoF placement, and finally remove duplicate object geometry from the background through conditional 3D point classification. The resulting representation combines explicit rigid bodies with a decoupled background, enabling direct physics simulation while preserving visual realism. Experiments on both simulated and real multi-view scenes show that GARDEN improves object placement reliability, disentanglement quality, and rendering-simulation efficiency compared with retrieval-based baselines.

</details>


### [115] [Adaptive Causal Alignment for High-Confidence Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03925)
*Zhiming Luo,Kejia Zhang,Yingxin Lai,Junwei Wu,Juanjuan Weng,Shaozi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示对抗训练中高置信度预测往往源于对背景伪相关性的过拟合，而非对象语义。为此提出HICAT框架，通过“测量-去偏-对齐”流程，利用可学习背景偏差估计器（LBBE）自适应诊断上下文效用，并结合自适应去偏机制与前景区分性正交增强损失（FLOE），在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet-1K上显著提升了鲁棒泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆对抗训练依赖高置信度预测来稳定鲁棒学习，但作者发现高置信度常源于对非因果背景相关性的过拟合，而非内在对象语义。视觉上下文具有双重性——既可作为必要支持先验，也可作为伪混淆变量，导致现有盲目抑制策略造成严重特征丢失。

Method: 提出HICAT框架，基于“Measure-Debias-Align”流水线：(1) 可学习背景偏差估计器（LBBE）自适应诊断上下文效用；(2) 自适应去偏机制进行手术式logit修正；(3) 前景区分性正交增强损失（FLOE）强制执行特征解耦。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1K上，HICAT在多种架构（CNN和ViT）上均一致优于匹配基线，并显著缩小了鲁棒泛化差距。

Conclusion: 提出HICAT建立了“语义均衡”状态，通过自适应区分上下文的有益与有害成分，实现了更有效的鲁棒学习，验证了因果对齐在对抗训练中的关键作用。

Abstract: Inverse adversarial training leverages high-confidence predictions to stabilize robust learning, yet we uncover a critical paradox: high confidence often stems from overfitting to non-causal background correlations rather than intrinsic object semantics. Our investigation reveals that visual context functions as a dual-natured signal, serving as either a necessary supportive prior or a spurious confounder. This insight renders existing blind suppression strategies flawed, as they inevitably lead to severe Feature Loss. To resolve this, we propose High-Confidence Causally Aligned Training (HICAT), a unified framework that establishes a Semantic Equilibrium. Operating on a ``Measure-Debias-Align'' pipeline, HICAT integrates a Learnable Background-Bias Estimator (LBBE) to adaptively diagnose context utility. Guided by this diagnosis, an Adaptive Debiasing mechanism performs surgical logit rectification, complemented by a geometrically grounded Foreground Logit Orthogonal Enhancement (FLOE) loss to enforce rigorous feature disentanglement. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K demonstrate that HICAT consistently improves over matched baselines across diverse architectures (CNNs and ViTs) while significantly reducing the robust generalization gap.

</details>


### [116] [PixVOD: Pixel-Distributed Direct Visual Odometry and Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03989)
*Shinjeong Kim,Ignacio Alzugaray,Callum Rhodes,Paul H. J. Kelly,Andrew J. Davison*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于像素级分布式计算的光流视觉里程计与深度估计方法（PixVOD），利用高斯信念传播在传感器处理器上实现像素间的协同推理，并通过关键帧锚定机制保证几何稳定性，在真实数据集上验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统计算机视觉算法依赖传输冗余、含噪的原始像素数据至处理器，效率低下。因此，本文旨在将计算下沉至焦平面传感器处理器，让像素本地合成高层信号，减少下游负载并提供更丰富的输入。

Method: 提出一种完全可并行的视觉里程计与深度估计方法：像素级传感器处理器通过高斯信念传播（GBP）交换信息，实现对相机运动的一致性共识；并结合逐像素光度观测和表面法线先验推断深度；引入类关键帧锚定机制，调节帧间有效基线以维持优化过程中的几何稳定性。

Result: 在真实数据集上评估，验证了基于GBP的像素级分布式里程计与深度估计结合关键帧锚定在传感器上运行的可行性。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在焦平面传感器处理器上实现分布式像素级视觉里程计与深度估计是可行的，为未来低延迟、高效能的片上视觉系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Images composed of 2D pixel arrays are the standard input to computer vision algorithms, yet many underlying computations can be distributed across pixels. Transmitting raw, redundant, and noisy pixel data off the sensor remains inefficient, motivating a shift toward focal-plane sensor-processors that perform a significant part of the computation directly within each pixel. We envision pixels synthesizing higher-level signals locally, reducing downstream load, and providing richer inputs for higher-level vision tasks.
  We propose a fully parallelizable form of visual odometry and depth estimation across pixels, where sensor-processors exchange information through Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) to achieve consensus about camera motion and infer depth from per-pixel photometric observations and a surface normal prior. To maintain geometric stability during optimization, we introduce a keyframe-like anchoring mechanism that regulates the effective baseline between frames, enabling consistent motion and depth updates. Our method is evaluated on realistic datasets, demonstrating the feasibility of GBP-based pixel-level distributed odometry and depth estimation with keyframe anchoring on-sensor. Project Page: https://www.shinjeongkim.com/pixvod/

</details>


### [117] [WISE: A World Knowledge-Informed Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07265)
*Yuwei Niu,Munan Ning,Mengren Zheng,Weiyang Jin,Bin Lin,Peng Jin,Jiaqi Liao,Chaoran Feng,Fanqing Meng,Kunpeng Ning,Bin Zhu,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了WISE基准，首个专门评估文生图模型世界知识整合能力的基准，包含1000个精心设计的提示词和25个子领域，并引入了WiScore指标来评估知识-图像对齐。测试了20个模型，发现现有模型在生成过程中整合和应用世界知识存在显著局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型的研究和评估标准主要关注图像真实性和浅层文本-图像对齐，缺乏对复杂语义理解和世界知识整合的综合评估。

Method: 构建了WISE基准：包含1000个覆盖文化常识、时空推理和自然科学等25个子领域的结构化提示词，并提出了WiScore定量评估指标用于衡量知识-图像对齐程度。

Result: 对20个模型（10个专用T2I模型和10个统一多模态模型）的测试表明，现有模型在图像生成过程中整合和应用世界知识的能力存在显著局限性。

Conclusion: WISE基准揭示了当前文生图模型的知识整合短板，为下一代模型增强知识融入和应用能力指明了关键改进路径。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models are capable of generating high-quality artistic creations and visual content. However, existing research and evaluation standards predominantly focus on image realism and shallow text-image alignment, lacking a comprehensive assessment of complex semantic understanding and world knowledge integration in text-to-image generation. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{WISE}, the first benchmark specifically designed for \textbf{W}orld Knowledge-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{E}valuation. WISE moves beyond simple word-pixel mapping by challenging models with 1000 meticulously crafted prompts across 25 subdomains in cultural common sense, spatio-temporal reasoning, and natural science. To overcome the limitations of traditional CLIP metric, we introduce \textbf{WiScore}, a novel quantitative metric for assessing knowledge-image alignment. Through comprehensive testing of 20 models (10 dedicated T2I models and 10 unified multimodal models) using 1,000 structured prompts spanning 25 subdomains, our findings reveal significant limitations in their ability to effectively integrate and apply world knowledge during image generation, highlighting critical pathways for enhancing knowledge incorporation and application in next-generation T2I models. Code and data are available at \href{https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/WISE}{PKU-YuanGroup/WISE}.

</details>


### [118] [Edge-Aware and Content-Adaptive Infrared Gas Leak Detection for Industrial Safety Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23234)
*Dongsheng Li,Tianli Ma,Siling Wang,Beibei Duan,Song Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ECAF-Det，一种用于红外热场景中微弱气体羽流检测的边缘感知与内容自适应特征融合检测器，通过局部-全局特征增强、多尺度边缘感知和内容自适应稀疏路由路径聚合网络，在IIG和LangGas数据集上显著提升了检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外气体泄漏检测对工业安全和环境监测至关重要，但气体羽流通常具有微弱、细小、半透明和弱边界的特点，导致自动检测极具挑战性。

Method: ECAF-Det包含三个核心模块：1) 羽流导向的局部-全局特征增强模块，保留精细边界线索并捕获长程上下文连续性；2) 多尺度边缘感知模块，将方向梯度与相位一致性线索转化为分层边缘先验；3) 内容自适应稀疏路由路径聚合网络，动态调节多尺度特征传播以强调信息性羽流特征并抑制冗余背景响应。

Result: 在IIG数据集上，ECAF-Det达到29.8% AP、84.3% AP50和25.3%小目标AP，相比RT-DETR-R18基线分别提升3.0、6.5和5.4个百分点，计算量43.7 GFLOPs，参数量14.9 M。在LangGas数据集上达到36.3% AP和68.5% AP50，展现了良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 主要的AI贡献在于边缘感知表示学习与内容自适应稀疏特征路由用于弱红外羽流感知，该检测器可作为工业气体泄漏监测中早期预警和远程巡检的视觉感知组件。

Abstract: Infrared gas leak detection is important for industrial safety and environmental monitoring, but automatic detection remains challenging because gas plumes are often faint, small, semi-transparent, and weakly bounded. This paper proposes an Edge-Aware and Content-Adaptive Feature Fusion Detector (ECAF-Det) for weak-plume detection in cluttered thermal scenes. ECAF-Det integrates three task-oriented designs: a plume-oriented local-global feature enhancement block to preserve fine boundary cues and capture long-range contextual continuity; a multi-scale edge perception module that transforms directional gradient and phase-consistency cues into hierarchical edge priors for boundary-sensitive plume representation; and a content-adaptive sparse routing path aggregation network that dynamically regulates multi-scale feature propagation to emphasize informative plume features and suppress redundant background responses. Experiments on the IIG dataset show that ECAF-Det achieves 29.8% AP, 84.3% AP50, and 25.3% small-object AP, improving the RT-DETR-R18 baseline by 3.0, 6.5, and 5.4 percentage points, respectively, with 43.7 GFLOPs and 14.9 M parameters. On the LangGas dataset, ECAF-Det achieves 36.3% AP and 68.5% AP50, demonstrating its generalization to different infrared gas plume appearances. The main AI contribution is edge-aware representation learning with content-adaptive sparse feature routing for weak infrared plume perception. The proposed detector can serve as a visual perception component for early warning and remote inspection in industrial gas leak monitoring.

</details>


### [119] [PAND: Prompt-Aware Neighborhood Distillation for Lightweight Fine-Grained Visual Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07768)
*Qiuming Luo,Yuebing Li,Feng Li,Chang Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PAND框架，通过两阶段解耦方法（语义校准+结构迁移）实现从大视觉语言模型到轻量网络的知识蒸馏，在细粒度分类任务上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM知识蒸馏方法依赖固定提示和全局对齐，难以有效处理细粒度视觉分类任务中类别间细微差异的问题。

Method: 两阶段蒸馏框架：第一阶段使用提示感知语义校准（Prompt-Aware Semantic Calibration）生成自适应语义锚点；第二阶段引入邻域感知结构蒸馏策略（neighborhood-aware structural distillation）约束学生网络的局部决策结构。

Result: 在四个FGVC基准数据集上持续优于现有方法，其中ResNet-18学生网络在CUB-200上达到76.09%准确率，比强基线VL2Lite高出3.4%。

Conclusion: PAND通过解耦语义校准与结构迁移，为VLM到轻量网络的细粒度知识蒸馏提供了更有效的范式。

Abstract: Distilling knowledge from large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into lightweight networks is crucial yet challenging in Fine-Grained Visual Classification (FGVC), due to the reliance on fixed prompts and global alignment. To address this, we propose PAND (Prompt-Aware Neighborhood Distillation), a two-stage framework that decouples semantic calibration from structural transfer. First, we incorporate Prompt-Aware Semantic Calibration to generate adaptive semantic anchors. Second, we introduce a neighborhood-aware structural distillation strategy to constrain the student's local decision structure. PAND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on four FGVC benchmarks. Notably, our ResNet-18 student achieves 76.09% accuracy on CUB-200, surpassing the strong baseline VL2Lite by 3.4%. Code is available at https://github.com/LLLVTA/PAND.

</details>


### [120] [Best of Both Worlds: Multimodal Reasoning and Generation via Unified Discrete Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12221)
*Onkar Susladkar,Tushar Prakash,Gayatri Deshmukh,Kiet A. Nguyen,Jiaxun Zhang,Adheesh Juvekar,Tianshu Bao,Lin Chai,Sparsh Mittal,Inderjit S Dhillon,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniDFlow是一个统一的离散流匹配框架，通过任务特定的低秩适配器解耦理解与生成，并利用基于参考的多模态偏好对齐优化相对结果，在八个基准上取得SOTA性能，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在多模态理解与生成任务中面临目标干扰和表示纠缠问题，且缺乏统一的框架来同时处理理解、生成和编辑任务。

Method: 提出UniDFlow统一离散流匹配框架，通过任务特定的低秩适配器解耦理解与生成，避免目标干扰和表示纠缠；引入基于参考的多模态偏好对齐方法，在相同条件下优化相对结果，无需大规模重新训练即可提升忠实性和可控性。

Result: 在八个基准上达到SOTA性能，并在图像修复、上下文内图像生成、基于参考的编辑和组合生成等任务上表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: UniDFlow通过解耦设计和偏好对齐策略，有效统一了多模态理解、生成与编辑任务，且无需针对特定任务进行显式训练即可实现零样本泛化。

Abstract: We propose UniDFlow, a unified discrete flow-matching framework for multimodal understanding, generation, and editing. It decouples understanding and generation via task-specific low-rank adapters, avoiding objective interference and representation entanglement, while a novel reference-based multimodal preference alignment optimizes relative outcomes under identical conditioning, improving faithfulness and controllability without large-scale retraining. UniDFlpw achieves SOTA performance across eight benchmarks and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to tasks including inpainting, in-context image generation, reference-based editing, and compositional generation, despite no explicit task-specific training.

</details>


### [121] [Act Like a Pathologist: Tissue-Aware Whole Slide Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00667)
*Wentao Huang,Weimin Lyu,Peiliang Lou,Qingqiao Hu,Xiaoling Hu,Shahira Abousamra,Wenchao Han,Ruifeng Guo,Jiawei Zhou,Chao Chen,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HistoSelect 是一个面向病理图像问答的粗到细检索框架，通过问题引导的组织区域采样和关键补丁选择，在减少70%视觉令牌的同时提升了三个病理QA任务的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理学全切片图像包含远超问题所需的冗余信息，现有模型采用均匀采样或全局注意力机制，导致模型平等关注无关区域而忽略关键视觉证据，与病理医生先宏观扫描再选择性放大的阅片方式存在根本性差异。

Method: 提出HistoSelect框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 组采样器（Group Sampler）识别与问题相关的组织区域；2) 补丁选择器（Patch Selector）从这些区域中检索最具信息量的补丁。采用粗到细的检索策略，实现问题引导、组织感知的选择性采样。

Result: 在356,000个问答对上进行评估，平均减少70%的视觉令牌使用量，同时在三个病理QA任务上准确率优于现有方法，生成的答案可追溯到符合病理学专家判读习惯的区域。

Conclusion: 将类人的搜索和注意力模式引入全切片图像推理是构建实用且可靠的病理视觉语言模型的有前景方向。

Abstract: Computational pathology has advanced rapidly in recent years, driven by domain-specific image encoders and growing interest in using vision-language models to answer natural-language questions about diseases. Yet, the core problem behind pathology question-answering remains unsolved, considering that a gigapixel slide contains far more information than necessary for a given question. Pathologists naturally navigate tissue and morphology complexity by scanning broadly, and zooming in selectively according to the clinical questions. Current models, in contrast, rely on uniform patch sampling or broad attention maps, often attending equally to irrelevant regions while overlooking key visual evidence. In this work, we try to bring models closer to how humans actually examine slides. We propose a question-guided, tissue-aware, and coarse-to-fine retrieval framework, HistoSelect, that consists of two key components: a group sampler that identifies question-relevant tissue regions, followed by a patch selector that retrieves the most informative patches within those regions. By selecting only the most informative patches, our method becomes significantly more efficient: reducing visual token usage by 70% on average, while improving accuracy across three pathology QA tasks. Evaluated on 356,000 question-answer pairs, our approach outperforms existing methods and produces answers grounded in interpretable, pathologist-consistent regions. Our results suggest that bringing human-like search and attention patterns into WSI reasoning is a promising direction for building practical and reliable pathology VLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/winston52/HistoSelect.

</details>


### [122] [Cryo-Bench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Cryosphere Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01576)
*Saurabh Kaushik,Lalit Maurya,Beth Tellman,Valerio Marsocci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Cryo-Bench 基准，用于评估 Geo-Foundation Models (GFMs) 在冰冻圈应用中的性能。实验表明，冻结编码器时 UNet 表现最佳（mIoU 66.38），少样本场景下 DOFA 和 TerraMind 超越 UNet，全微调时结合学习率调优可提升 12.77%。GFMs 展现出良好的域适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFMs 在多种地球观测任务中表现优异，但针对冰冻圈应用的基准测试缺乏，主要由于缺少合适的评估数据集。

Method: 构建 Cryo-Bench 基准，包含冰川、冰湖、海冰、冰前缘等多传感器多区域数据，评估 14 种 GFM 及 UNet、ViT 基线，采用冻结编码器、少样本、全微调+学习率优化等多种策略。

Result: 冻结编码器下 UNet mIoU 66.38 最优；少样本（10%数据）下 DOFA 和 TerraMind 超越 UNet；全微调时学习率调优带来平均 12.77% 相对提升。

Conclusion: 建议使用编码器微调+超参数优化获得最佳性能，冻结编码器适合快速部署；GFMs 虽预训练数据中冰冻圈数据极少，仍展现出良好域适应能力。

Abstract: Geo-Foundation Models (GFMs) have been evaluated across diverse Earth observation task including multiple domains and have demonstrated strong potential of producing reliable maps even with sparse labels. However, benchmarking GFMs for Cryosphere applications has remained limited, primarily due to the lack of suitable evaluation datasets. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{Cryo-Bench}, a benchmark compiled to evaluate GFM performance across key Cryospheric components. Cryo-Bench includes debris-covered glaciers, glacial lakes, sea ice, and calving fronts, spanning multiple sensors and broad geographic regions. We evaluate 14 GFMs alongside UNet and ViT baselines to assess their advantages, limitations, and optimal usage strategies. With a frozen encoder, UNet achieves the highest average mIoU of \textbf{66.38}, followed by TerraMind at \textbf{64.02} across five evluation dataset included in Cryo-Bench. In the few-shot setting (10\% input data), GFMs such as DOFA and TerraMind outperform UNet, achieving mIoU scores of \textbf{59.53}, \textbf{56.62}, and \textbf{56.60}, respectively, comapred to U-Net's 56.60. When fully finetuning GFMs, we observe inconsistent performance across datasets and models. However, tuning learning rate along with finetuning substantially improves GFM performance. For example, evaluation on two representative datasets (GLID and CaFFe) shows an average relative improvement of \textbf{12.77\%}. Despite having minimal Cryosphere representation in their pretraining data, GFMs exhibit notable domain adaptation capabilities and produce meaningful results across tasks. Based on our findings, We recommend encoder fine-tuning with hyperparameter optimization optimization to achieve the best possible performance, while using frozen encoders when users need quick results without extensive experimentation.(\href{https://github.com/Sk-2103/Cryo-Bench}{GitHub}).

</details>


### [123] [Ref-DGS: Reflective Dual Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07664)
*Ningjing Fan,Yiqun Wang,Dong-Ming Yan,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ref-DGS提出了一种反射双高斯溅射框架，通过将表面重建与镜面反射解耦，利用几何高斯和局部反射高斯的双高斯场景表示，结合全局环境反射场和物理感知的镜面自适应混合着色器，在不使用显式光线追踪的情况下高效处理近场和远场镜面反射，实现了在反射场景上的SOTA性能且训练速度远快于基于光线的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯溅射方法要么无法建模近场镜面反射，要么依赖显式光线追踪带来高昂计算成本，需要在反射质量与效率之间取得平衡。

Method: 1) 双高斯场景表示：几何高斯用于表面重建，局部反射高斯捕获近场镜面交互；2) 全局环境反射场建模远场镜面反射；3) 轻量级物理感知的镜面自适应混合着色器，融合全局和局部镜面特征来预测镜面辐射度。

Result: 在反射场景上达到SOTA性能，训练速度显著快于基于光线追踪的高斯方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦表面重建与镜面反射，并在高效光栅化管线中引入双高斯表示，Ref-DGS在保证高质量反射建模的同时大幅提升了训练效率。

Abstract: The reflective appearance, especially strong and typically near-field specular reflections, poses a fundamental challenge for accurate surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis. Existing Gaussian splatting methods either fail to model near-field specular reflections or rely on explicit ray tracing at substantial computational cost. We present \textbf{Ref-DGS}, a reflective dual Gaussian splatting framework that addresses this trade-off by decoupling surface reconstruction from specular reflection within an efficient rasterization-based pipeline. Ref-DGS introduces a dual Gaussian scene representation consisting of geometry Gaussians and complementary local reflection Gaussians that capture near-field specular interactions without explicit ray tracing, along with a global environment reflection field for modeling far-field specular reflections. To predict specular radiance, we further propose a lightweight, physically-aware specular adaptive mixing shader that fuses global and local specular features. Experiments demonstrate that Ref-DGS achieves state-of-the-art performance on reflective scenes while training substantially faster than ray-based Gaussian methods.

</details>


### [124] [LoCAtion: Long-time Collaborative Attention Framework for High Dynamic Range Video Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14377)
*Qianyu Zhang,Bolun Zheng,Lingyu Zhu,Aiai Huang,Zongpeng Li,Shiqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LoCAtion，一种无需显式对齐的长期协作注意力框架，将HDR视频重建从脆弱的对齐-融合范式转变为鲁棒的协同特征路由问题，通过解耦重建任务、连续中曝光骨干和全局序列求解器，实现了state-of-the-art的视觉质量和时间稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HDR视频重建方法依赖显式空间对齐，在非受控动态场景下会产生严重鬼影和闪烁伪影，对齐误差成为性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出LoCAtion框架：(1) 将HDR视频生成重构为无对齐的协作特征路由问题；(2) 使用连续中曝光骨干锚定场景，通过协作注意力从非对齐曝光中动态获取辐照度线索；(3) 引入全局序列求解器，利用双向上下文和长时时间建模传播校正信号，增强全视频一致性。

Result: 在多个基准上达到最先进的视觉质量和时间稳定性，在精度和计算效率之间取得了高度竞争力的平衡。

Conclusion: 显式对齐并非HDR视频重建的必要前提，无对齐的协同特征路由范式能更鲁棒地处理真实世界复杂动态场景。

Abstract: Prevailing High Dynamic Range (HDR) video reconstruction methods are fundamentally trapped in a fragile alignment-and-fusion paradigm. While explicit spatial alignment can successfully recover fine details in controlled environments, it becomes a severe bottleneck in unconstrained dynamic scenes. By forcing rigid alignment across unpredictable motions and varying exposures, these methods inevitably translate registration errors into severe ghosting artifacts and temporal flickering. In this paper, we rethink this conventional prerequisite. Recognizing that explicit alignment is inherently vulnerable to real-world complexities, we propose LoCAtion, a Long-time Collaborative Attention framework that reformulates HDR video generation from a fragile spatial warping task into a robust, alignment-free collaborative feature routing problem. Guided by this new formulation, our architecture explicitly decouples the highly entangled reconstruction task. Rather than struggling to rigidly warp neighboring frames, we anchor the scene on a continuous medium-exposure backbone and utilize collaborative attention to dynamically harvest and inject reliable irradiance cues from unaligned exposures. Furthermore, we introduce a learned global sequence solver. By leveraging bidirectional context and long-range temporal modeling, it propagates corrective signals and structural features across the entire sequence, inherently enforcing whole-video coherence and eliminating jitter. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoCAtion achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and temporal stability, offering a highly competitive balance between accuracy and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [125] [SJD-PAC: Accelerating Speculative Jacobi Decoding via Proactive Drafting and Adaptive Continuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18599)
*Jialiang Kang,Han Shu,Wenshuo Li,Yingjie Zhai,Xinghao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SJD-PAC通过主动草稿策略和自适应延续机制，解决了视觉生成中高熵区域草稿令牌接受率低的问题，在保持无损图像质量的同时实现了3.8倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机性雅可比解码（SJD）在加速自回归文本到图像合成时，由于视觉生成的高熵特性导致复杂区域草稿令牌接受率低，形成瓶颈，严重限制了整体吞吐量。

Method: 1) 主动草稿策略（proactive drafting）：提升高熵区域的局部接受率；2) 自适应延续机制（adaptive continuation）：初始拒绝后维持序列验证，避免完全重采样。

Result: 在标准文本到图像基准上实现3.8倍加速，且图像质量无损。

Conclusion: SJD-PAC通过两项协同优化显著提升了每步平均接受长度，在严格保持目标分布的同时提高了推理速度。

Abstract: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) offers a draft-model-free approach to accelerate autoregressive text-to-image synthesis. However, the high-entropy nature of visual generation yields low draft-token acceptance rates in complex regions, creating a bottleneck that severely limits overall throughput. To overcome this, we introduce SJD-PAC, an enhanced SJD framework. First, SJD-PAC employs a proactive drafting strategy to improve local acceptance rates in these challenging high-entropy regions. Second, we introduce an adaptive continuation mechanism that sustains sequence validation after an initial rejection, bypassing the need for full resampling. Working in tandem, these optimizations significantly increase the average acceptance length per step, boosting inference speed while strictly preserving the target distribution. Experiments on standard text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that SJD-PAC achieves a $3.8\times$ speedup with lossless image quality. Code is available at https://github.com/KangJialiang/SJD-PAC.

</details>


### [126] [OrthoPhys: Physically Plausible Video Generation with Orthogonal-View Geometry Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18639)
*Cong Wang,Hanxin Zhu,Xiao Tang,Jiayi Luo,Xin Jin,Long Chen,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OrthoPhys提出两阶段框架：首先生成正交四视角同步视频以隐含物理一致性，再以此为刚性指导合成完整视频，并构建了包含40K场景、160K视频序列的PhysMV数据集，显著提升了视频生成的物理真实感与时空连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成在视觉保真度上取得进展，但难以保证物理一致的运动，原因在于真实物体运动发生在三维空间，而视频观测仅提供视角依赖的二维投影。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段一生成同步四视角正交前景视频，通过几何增强注意力机制跨视角施加3D空间连贯性；阶段二以物理一致的正交前景为刚性指导，合成完整视频并学习前景与背景的交互。同时构建PhysMV数据集（40K场景，160K视频序列）。

Result: 实验表明OrthoPhys在物理真实感和时空连贯性上显著优于现有视频生成方法。

Conclusion: 利用正交多视角几何约束可以隐式编码物理属性，从而在视频生成中实现更真实的运动一致性。

Abstract: Recent progress in video generation has led to substantial improvements in visual fidelity, yet ensuring physically consistent motion remains a fundamental challenge. Intuitively, this limitation can be attributed to the fact that real-world object motion unfolds in three-dimensional space, while video observations provide only partial, view-dependent projections of such dynamics. To address these issues, we propose OrthoPhys, a two-stage framework that leverages orthogonal-view geometry guidance to enforce physical plausibility. Instead of directly generating unstructured 2D videos, our first stage generates synchronized, four-view orthogonal videos of the foreground dynamics. By incorporating a geometry-enhanced attention mechanism across these orthogonal views, this stage effectively enforces 3D spatial coherence and implicitly grounds the motion in physical attributes. In the second stage, these physically consistent orthogonal foregrounds serve as rigid guidance to synthesize the final complete video, seamlessly learning the interaction between foreground dynamics and the background context. To support this orthogonal-view training paradigm, we construct PhysMV, a dataset containing 40K scenes, each consisting of four orthogonal viewpoints, resulting in a total of 160K video sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OrthoPhys significantly improves physical realism and spatial-temporal coherence over existing video generation methods. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/Phys4D/.

</details>


### [127] [SleepVLM: Explainable and Rule-Grounded Sleep Staging via a Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26738)
*Guifeng Deng,Pan Wang,Mengfan Niu,Jiquan Wang,Shuying Rao,Junyi Xie,Xi'ang Chen,Sha Zhao,Gang Pan,Wanjun Guo,Tao Li,Haiteng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SleepVLM是一个基于规则引导的视觉语言模型，它通过分析多导睡眠图波形图像进行睡眠分期，并生成符合AASM评分标准的可读性推理依据，在性能媲美最先进方法的同时提供了透明的可审计解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动睡眠分期虽已达到专家级准确率，但由于缺乏可审计的推理过程，其临床采纳受到阻碍。

Method: 采用波形感知预训练和规则引导的监督微调，构建基于多通道PSG波形图像的视觉语言模型，输出符合AASM评分标准的临床可读推理依据。

Result: 在MASS-SS1测试集上Cohen's kappa达0.767，在外部ZUAMHCS队列上达0.743，达到最先进水平；专家评估推理质量在事实准确性、证据全面性和逻辑连贯性上均分3.75-3.96/5。

Conclusion: SleepVLM通过将竞争性性能与透明、基于规则的解释相结合，有望提升自动睡眠分期在临床流程中的可信度和可审计性。此外，发布了专家注释数据集MASS-EX以促进可解释睡眠医学研究。

Abstract: While automated sleep staging has achieved expert-level accuracy, its clinical adoption is hindered by a lack of auditable reasoning. We introduce SleepVLM, a rule-grounded vision-language model (VLM) that stages sleep from multi-channel polysomnography (PSG) waveform images and generates clinician-readable rationales based on American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) scoring criteria. Utilizing waveform-perceptual pre-training and rule-grounded supervised fine-tuning, SleepVLM achieved Cohen's kappa of 0.767 on a held-out test set (MASS-SS1) and 0.743 on an external cohort (ZUAMHCS), matching state-of-the-art performance. Independent expert evaluation by two trained sleep technologists further validated the model's reasoning quality, with mean scores of 3.75-3.96 out of 5 across factual accuracy, evidence comprehensiveness, and logical coherence on both datasets. By coupling competitive performance with transparent, rule-based explanations, SleepVLM may improve the trustworthiness and auditability of automated sleep staging in clinical workflows. To facilitate further research in interpretable sleep medicine, we release MASS-EX, a novel expert-annotated dataset.

</details>


### [128] [From None to All: Self-Supervised 3D Reconstruction via Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27455)
*Ranran Huang,Weixun Luo,Ye Mao,Krystian Mikolajczyk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NAS3R是一个自监督前馈框架，无需真实标注或预训练先验，联合学习显式3D几何和相机参数，通过2D光度监督实现训练，在自监督方法中取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D重建方法依赖真实标注或预训练先验，难以扩展至无约束数据。作者希望构建一个无需标注、无需预训练先验的自监督框架，实现可扩展的几何感知3D重建。

Method: NAS3R从无标定无位姿的上下文视图重建3D高斯，利用自预测的相机参数渲染目标视图，通过2D光度监督进行自监督训练。采用共享Transformer骨干网络（由掩码注意力调控）联合重建和相机预测，并引入基于深度的高斯公式以实现良态优化。

Result: NAS3R在自监督方法中取得最优结果，与有监督方法兼容，并可整合预训练先验或内参信息。

Conclusion: NAS3R建立了一种可扩展且几何感知的3D重建范式，适用于无约束数据，代码和模型已公开。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce NAS3R, a self-supervised feed-forward framework that jointly learns explicit 3D geometry and camera parameters with no ground-truth annotations and no pretrained priors. During training, NAS3R reconstructs 3D Gaussians from uncalibrated and unposed context views and renders target views using its self-predicted camera parameters, enabling self-supervised training from 2D photometric supervision.
