To ensure stable convergence, NAS3R integrates reconstruction and camera prediction within a shared transformer backbone regulated by masked attention, and adopts a depth-based Gaussian formulation that facilitates well-conditioned optimization. The framework is compatible with state-of-the-art supervised 3D reconstruction architectures and can incorporate pretrained priors or intrinsic information when available. Extensive experiments show that NAS3R achieves superior results to other self-supervised methods, establishing a scalable and geometry-aware paradigm for 3D reconstruction from unconstrained data. Code and models are publicly available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/nas3r/.

</details>


### [129] [Attention, May I Have Your Decision? Localizing Generative Choices in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06052)
*Katarzyna Zaleska,Łukasz Popek,Monika Wysoczańska,Kamil Deja*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现文本到图像扩散模型在处理非描述性提示时，隐式决策过程集中在自注意力层，并提出ICM方法通过对少量层进行精确干预实现更优的去偏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有定位技术聚焦于显式条件干预，但隐式决策（模型自动填充未指定细节）的机制尚不明确，需要探索其计算定位。

Method: 提出基于探针的定位技术，识别概念属性可分性最高的层；基于此发现设计ICM（隐式选择修正）方法，对少量自注意力层进行精准干预。

Result: 自注意力层是解决歧义概念的关键；ICM在去偏任务上优于现有最优方法，且伪影更少。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的隐式决策在架构中具有计算局部性，自注意力层是干预的最有效切入点。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative capabilities, yet their internal operations remain opaque, particularly when handling prompts that are not fully descriptive. In such scenarios, models must make implicit decisions to generate details not explicitly specified in the text. This work investigates the hypothesis that this decision-making process is not diffuse but is computationally localized within the model's architecture. While existing localization techniques focus on prompt-related interventions, we notice that such explicit conditioning may differ from implicit decisions. Therefore, we introduce a probing-based localization technique to identify the layers with the highest attribute separability for concepts. Our findings indicate that the resolution of ambiguous concepts is governed principally by self-attention layers, identifying them as the most effective point for intervention. Based on this discovery, we propose ICM (Implicit Choice-Modification) - a precise steering method that applies targeted interventions to a small subset of layers. Extensive experiments confirm that intervening on these specific self-attention layers yields superior debiasing performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, minimizing artifacts common to less precise approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/kzaleskaa/icm.

</details>


### [130] [PRISM: Rethinking Atmospheric Scattering Reconstruction as a Unified Understanding and Restoration Model for Real-world Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07048)
*Chengyu Fang,Chunming He,Yuelin Zhang,Chubin Chen,Chenyang Zhu,Hongqiu Wang,Longxiang Tang,Xiu Li,Sina Farsiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRISM提出了一种基于物理散射模型的真实图像去雾框架，通过联合重建清晰场景与散射变量，并结合在线非均匀雾合成与选择性自蒸馏适应策略，在真实场景去雾任务上取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界图像去雾面临非均匀雾分布、空间变化的色彩偏移以及真实有雾-清晰配对数据稀缺的挑战，现有方法难以有效应对复杂真实场景。

Method: 提出近端散射大气重建（PSAR）物理结构化框架，在大气散射模型下联合重建清晰场景与散射变量；设计在线非均匀雾合成管道和选择性自蒸馏适应（SSDA）方案，使模型能从高质量感知目标中选择性学习，并利用内在散射理解审计残雾以引导自我改进。

Result: 在真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，PRISM在真实图像去雾任务上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 结合物理模型先验与无配对数据自适应策略，PRISM有效提升了真实场景去雾的可解释性和性能。

Abstract: Real-world image dehazing (RID) aims to remove haze-induced degradation from real scenes. This task remains challenging due to non-uniform haze distribution, spatially varying color shifts, and the scarcity of paired real hazy-clean data. In PRISM, we propose Proximal Scattering Atmosphere Reconstruction (PSAR), a physically structured framework that jointly reconstructs the clear scene and scattering variables under the atmospheric scattering model, making the restoration process more interpretable in complex real-world conditions. To bridge the synthetic-to-real gap, we design an online non-uniform haze synthesis pipeline and a Selective Self-Distillation Adaptation (SSDA) scheme for unpaired real-world scenarios, which enables the model to selectively learn from high-quality perceptual targets while leveraging its intrinsic scattering understanding to audit residual haze and guide self-refinement. Experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves competitive performance on RID tasks.

</details>


### [131] [Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15748)
*Minghong Zhong,Guoshuai Zou,Kanghao Chen,Dexia Chen,Ruixuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAt-CBM框架，通过可学习概念级视觉查询和概念对比优化，解决了概念瓶颈模型中粒度不匹配和概念互斥性问题，实现了细粒度图像-概念对齐，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型存在两个关键局限：一是预训练偏差导致粒度不匹配或依赖结构先验；二是使用二值交叉熵损失独立处理每个概念，忽略了概念间的互斥性，导致对齐效果欠佳。

Method: 提出CoAt-CBM框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 可学习概念级视觉查询，自适应获取细粒度的概念级视觉嵌入，进而生成概念得分向量；(2) 概念对比优化方法，引导模型处理概念得分的相对重要性，使概念预测更忠实反映图像内容。

Result: 大量实验表明CoAt-CBM在各项指标上一致优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: CoAt-CBM通过自适应细粒度对齐和概念对比学习，有效解决了CBM中的概念建模问题，实现了更高的可解释性和性能。

Abstract: Recently impressive performance has been achieved in Concept Bottleneck Models (CBM) by utilizing the image-text alignment learned by a large pre-trained vision-language model (i.e. CLIP). However, there exist two key limitations in concept modeling. Existing methods often suffer from pre-training biases, manifested as granularity misalignment or reliance on structural priors. Moreover, fine-tuning with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss treats each concept independently, which ignores mutual exclusivity among concepts, leading to suboptimal alignment. To address these limitations, we propose Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models (CoAt-CBM), a novel framework that achieves adaptive fine-grained image-concept alignment and high interpretability. Specifically, CoAt-CBM employs learnable concept-wise visual queries to adaptively obtain fine-grained concept-wise visual embeddings, which are then used to produce a concept score vector. Then, a novel concept contrastive optimization guides the model to handle the relative importance of the concept scores, enabling concept predictions to faithfully reflect the image content and improved alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoAt-CBM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The codes will be available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [132] [BioLip: Language-Generalizable Lip-Sync Deepfake Detection via Biomechanical Constraint Violation Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16808)
*Hao Chen,Junnan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于唇部运动学特征（时间唇部抖动）的深度伪造检测方法，仅使用面部地标坐标，不依赖像素或音频，在零样本跨生成器和跨语言场景下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有唇语深度伪造检测器依赖于像素伪影或音视频对应关系，这些特征与训练分布紧密绑定，在遇到未见过的生成器或语言转换时失效。作者希望找到一种不受生成器和语言变化影响的通用伪造特征。

Method: 从64个口周地标中提取滑动窗口内的速度、加速度和急动度（jerk）等运动学统计量，输入轻量级三分支网络进行分类。模型仅使用地标坐标，不依赖像素、音频或声纹数据。

Result: 仅在英语数据上训练，在零样本设置下对五种未见过的生成器和七种语言进行测试，取得良好检测效果。

Conclusion: 唇部运动的物理约束（组织力学和神经肌肉带宽）是一种跨生成器和跨语言的通用信号，可用于鲁棒的深度伪造检测。

Abstract: Existing lip-sync deepfake detectors rely on pixel artifacts or audio-visual correspondence, and both fail under generator or language shift because the features they learn are tied to the training distribution. We take a different approach. Authentic lip motion is constrained by tissue mechanics and neuromuscular bandwidth; current generators typically do not impose these constraints, producing trajectories with elevated variance in velocity, acceleration, and jerk that real speech does not exhibit. We exploit this signal, which we term temporal lip jitter, by computing kinematic statistics from 64 perioral landmarks over short sliding windows and feeding them into a lightweight three-branch network. The model uses only landmark coordinates: no pixels, no audio, and no voiceprint data. We train only on English data and test in a zero-shot setting on five unseen generators and seven languages.

</details>


### [133] [Visual Instruction Tuning Aligns Modalities through Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03871)
*Luis Palacios,Lorenzo Basile,Diego Doimo,Alberto Cazzaniga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过探测分析和因果干预，揭示了视觉指令微调主要将视觉特征嵌入LLM的中间语义层，绕过早期单模态处理层。这些中间层是多模态处理的语义核心，且多模态整合是LLM内部抽象引擎重新利用的局部化现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管视觉指令微调已成功使预训练LLM处理图像信息，但视觉特征如何嵌入LLM的层次化抽象层级尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示视觉-语言整合的内部机制。

Method: 采用探测分析（probing analyses）和因果干预（causal interventions）方法，对多种视觉-语言架构进行系统性分析，并比较语义等价的视觉和文本表征的几何结构。

Result: 1) 指令微调主要将视觉特征嵌入LLM中间语义层，绕过早期单模态层；2) 中间层是视觉-语言处理的语义核心；3) 微调扩展并增强了已有抽象阶段，使视觉特征与已有文本特征对齐；4) 仅微调中间层即可在视觉中心基准上保持全微调性能并减少训练时间。

Conclusion: 多模态整合是LLM内部抽象引擎重新利用的局部化现象，而非全局性调整。

Abstract: Visual instruction tuning effectively adapts a pre-trained Large Language Model (LLM) to process image information alongside text. Yet, it remains unclear how visual features are embedded into the layer-wise hierarchy of abstractions of the LLM backbone. Across a diverse set of vision-language architectures, we show that instruction tuning primarily serves as a bridge, embedding visual features directly into the intermediate semantic layers of the LLM, bypassing the early layers devoted to unimodal processing. With probing analyses and causal interventions, we show that these intermediate layers are the semantic core of vision-language processing and play a critical role in the performance on a broad set of multimodal benchmarks. In addition, by comparing the geometry of semantically equivalent visual and textual representations, we find that fine-tuning extends and strengthens the existing abstraction phase, aligning visual features with pre-existing textual ones. Finally, we confirm the functional role of this localized alignment by restricting fine-tuning to intermediate layers alone: this strategy preserves the performance of full fine-tuning on vision-centric benchmarks while reducing training time. Our results suggest that multimodal integration is a localized phenomenon driven by the repurposing of the internal abstraction engine of the LLM.

</details>


### [134] [Back into Plato's Cave: Examining Cross-modal Representational Convergence at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18572)
*A. Sophia Koepke,Daniil Zverev,Shiry Ginosar,Alexei A. Efros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对"柏拉图表征假说"（不同模态神经网络趋向于同一表征）的实验证据进行了系统性检验，发现该假说的支撑证据非常脆弱：对齐度在小数据集（约1000样本）上测量，当扩展到百万级样本时显著下降；这种模式在文本-图像、文本-音频、文本-视频对齐中均存在；剩余对齐仅反映粗略语义重叠而非精细结构；一对一的图文评估设定在真实多对多场景中失效；此外，更强语言模型与视觉模型对齐增加的趋势在新模型中不成立。结论是跨模态表征收敛的现有证据远弱于后续研究所认为的程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"柏拉图表征假说"提出的跨模态神经网络表征趋向收敛的论断是否具有充分的实验支撑，避免该假说在未经严格验证的情况下被过度采纳。

Method: 通过系统性复现和扩展Huh等人的实验，引入更大规模数据集（百万级样本）、更多模态组合（文本-音频、文本-视频）、更真实的多对多匹配场景，并评估最新模型的表现。

Result: 1) 对齐度随数据集规模增大而急剧下降；2) 跨模态对齐仅反映粗略的语义重叠，而非精细结构一致性；3) 一对一设定的评估结果在真实多对多场景中不成立；4) 语言模型越强越对齐视觉的趋势在新模型中不成立。

Conclusion: 当前跨模态表征收敛的实验证据远弱于后续研究所认为的程度。不同模态训练的模型可能学到同样丰富的世界表征，但并非同一套表征。

Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that neural networks trained on different modalities (e.g., text and images) align and eventually converge toward the same representation of reality. If true, this has significant implications for whether modality choice matters at all. We show that the experimental evidence for this hypothesis is fragile and depends critically on the evaluation regime. Alignment is measured using mutual nearest neighbors on small datasets ($\approx$1K samples) and degrades substantially as the dataset is scaled to millions of samples. The same behavior is observed beyond text-image, for text-audio and text-video alignment. The alignment that remains between model representations reflects coarse semantic overlap rather than consistent fine-grained structure. Moreover, the evaluations in Huh et al. are done in a one-to-one image-caption setting, a constraint that breaks down in realistic many-to-many settings and further reduces measured alignment. We also find that the reported trend of stronger language models increasingly aligning with vision does not appear to hold for newer models. Overall, our findings suggest that the current evidence for cross-modal representational convergence is considerably weaker than subsequent works have taken it to be. Models trained on different modalities may learn equally rich representations of the world, just not the same one.

</details>


### [135] [CADFit: Precise Mesh-to-CAD Program Generation with Hybrid Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01171)
*Ghadi Nehme,Eamon Whalen,Faez Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CADFit 是一个基于混合优化的 CAD 重建框架，能从网格等几何输入中恢复复杂、可编辑的 CAD 构造序列，通过 IoU 驱动的优化和丰富的操作集合（拉伸、旋转、倒角、圆角等），在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，并支持从图像到 CAD 的多模态重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CAD 重建方法局限于难以编辑的格式（如网格、B-rep）或简单的草图-拉伸管线及低复杂度数据集，缺乏从几何输入恢复复杂可编辑参数化 CAD 构造序列的有效方法。

Method: 提出混合优化框架 CADFit，将 CAD 重建形式化为 IoU 驱动的结构化程序优化问题，通过增量拟合和几何反馈验证参数化操作，支持拉伸、旋转、圆角、倒角等多种操作，并结合图像几何重建实现多模态端到端管线。

Result: 在多个 CAD 基准上，CADFit 在体素 IoU 和 Chamfer Distance 指标上超越现有最优方法，并显著降低了重建 CAD 程序的无效比例，尤其对于复杂设计提升明显。

Conclusion: CADFit 实现了对高复杂度 CAD 模型的精确重建，为生成更丰富的数据集和推动未来基于学习的 CAD 逆向工程提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Despite recent progress, recovering parametric CAD construction sequences from geometric input, such as meshes or point clouds, is a key challenge for design and manufacturing, as existing CAD reconstruction and generation methods are largely restricted to difficult-to-edit formats like meshes or Breps or editable simple sketch-and-extrude pipelines and low-complexity datasets. We introduce CADFit, a hybrid optimization-based CAD reconstruction framework that recovers complex, editable CAD construction sequences from meshes by incrementally fitting and validating parametric operations using geometric feedback. Our approach is distinguished by formulating reconstruction as an IoU-driven optimization over structured CAD programs and supporting a rich set of operations, including extrusions, revolutions, fillets, and chamfers. Experiments on multiple CAD benchmarks show that CADFit outperforms state-of-the-art mesh-to-CAD methods in volumetric Intersection-over-Union and Chamfer Distance, while substantially reducing the Invalid Ratio of reconstructed CAD programs, particularly for complex designs. We further present a multimodal pipeline that enables end-to-end reconstruction of CAD construction sequences from images by combining image-based geometry reconstruction with CADFit. By enabling accurate reconstruction of higher-complexity CAD models, CADFit provides a practical foundation for generating richer datasets and advancing future learning-based approaches to CAD reverse engineering. The code is available at: https://github.com/ghadinehme/CADFit.

</details>


### [136] [Tracing Like a Clinician: Anatomy-Guided Spatial Priors for Cephalometric Landmark Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03358)
*Sidhartha Mohapatra,Pallavi Mohanty*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种五阶段解剖引导的置信度加权先验知识管线，用于头影测量放射影像标志点检测。该方法将HRNet-W32与解剖学先验结合，在1,502张影像上达到1.04 mm的平均径向误差，并通过训练与推理先验矩阵隔离实验证明先验知识作为训练时的正则化器发挥作用，无需部署时自动生成先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床医生按照结构化解剖工作流程描记头影测量放射影像，但现有计算方法未能将这种解剖学先验知识编码到计算模型中。作者旨在弥合这一差距，通过将解剖学工作流转化为计算先验来提升标志点定位的准确性和泛化能力。

Method: 五阶段解剖引导管线：(1) 生成置信度加权的空间先验；(2) 将先验融入HRNet-W32训练过程。设计了训练×推理先验矩阵（4种条件：无先验、随机先验、解剖先验在训练/推理中的不同组合）以隔离先验机制。采用五折交叉验证、患者级置换检验、量化Grad-CAM分析和临床测量验证进行多维度评估，并在超声心动图、颈椎和手部X光片上进行跨域实验。

Result: 25个标志点平均径向误差1.04 mm；训练×推理先验矩阵揭示：解剖先验保持1%验证-测试差距（无先验时为88%，1.94 mm）；所有训练模型均推理独立；仅扩展架构无提升；随机先验部分改善但不稳定（1.72 mm）；仅图像特定的解剖正确先验达到1.04 mm。五折交叉验证p=0.0015，患者级置换检验p<0.0001，Grad-CAM分析88% vs. 74%区域内激活（p<0.001），临床测量验证kappa=0.79-0.84，无II/III类反转，ICC>0.95。跨域实验表明先验效果与标志点分布的空间熵成正比。

Conclusion: 解剖学先验作为训练时的正则化器有效提升标志点定位性能，无需部署时自动生成先验即可发挥作用。先验的有效性与标志点分布的空间熵相关，该范式有望推广到其他医学影像标志点定位任务。

Abstract: Clinicians trace cephalometric radiographs following a structured anatomical workflow, yet no prior system encodes this into computation. We present a five-phase anatomy-guided pipeline producing confidence-weighted spatial priors that shape HRNet-W32 training, achieving 1.04 mm mean radial error on 25 landmarks across 1,502 radiographs from 7+ imaging devices. A training x inference prior matrix isolates the mechanism: anatomical priors maintain a 1% validation-to-test gap versus 88% without priors (1.94 mm), despite identical validation convergence. The matrix establishes that all trained models are inference-independent, the expanded architecture alone provides no benefit, random priors yield partial but unstable improvement (1.72 mm), and only image-specific anatomically correct priors produce the 1.04 mm result -- functioning as a training-time regularizer requiring no automated prior generation at deployment. Five-fold cross-validation (p=0.0015), patient-level permutation testing (p<0.0001, n=151), quantified Grad-CAM analysis (88% vs. 74% in-zone activation, p<0.001), and clinical measurement validation (skeletal classification kappa=0.79-0.84, zero Class II<->III reversals, ICC>0.95) provide converging evidence. Cross-domain experiments on echocardiography, cervical spine, and hand radiography support the hypothesis that prior effectiveness scales with the spatial entropy of the landmark distribution.

</details>


### [137] [Towards Robust Sequential Decomposition for Complex Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09233)
*Zilai Zeng,Mingdeng Cao,Zijie Li,Xiaochen Lian,Yichun Shi,Peihao Zhu,Chen Sun,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了复杂图像编辑中不同范式（单轮编辑与顺序编辑）的局限性，提出了统一上下文编辑框架，通过合成数据流水线构建复杂编辑任务数据集，发现经过适当设计的顺序分解方法能有效平衡步骤分解与误差累积的矛盾，且合成任务习得的分解技能可迁移到真实图像编辑中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型在处理包含组合式编辑操作或跨步骤依赖的复杂指令时表现不佳，因为单轮编辑难以准确解析复杂指令，而顺序编辑虽能分解任务但存在误差累积问题，亟需一种能平衡二者优劣的鲁棒解决方案。

Method: 提出统一上下文编辑框架，研究不同编辑范式行为；开发合成数据流水线，构建不同指令复杂度的编辑任务及高质量分解序列数据集；通过在合成数据上微调，分析编辑范式设计与任务复杂度之间的关系；采用真实编辑数据协同训练，实现合成到真实的迁移。

Result: 在统一上下文编辑框架下，经过适当设计的顺序分解方法能随任务复杂度增加带来稳定的性能提升；合成任务中学到的分解技能通过与真实数据协同训练可有效迁移到真实图像编辑场景。

Conclusion: 顺序分解结合精心设计的编辑范式是应对复杂图像编辑的有效策略，合成到真实（sim-to-real）的泛化方法为拓展复杂图像编辑到更广泛领域提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-fidelity image editing guided by human instructions. However, these models often struggle with complex instructions involving combinatorial editing operations or inter-step dependencies. This difficulty stems from the limitations of two canonical paradigms: (1) single-turn editing, which attempts to apply all instructed edits in one pass, often fails to parse the complex instruction accurately and causes undesired edits; and (2) sequential editing can decompose the task into simpler steps but suffers from compounding errors introduced by the sequential execution, leading to low-fidelity results. To derive a robust solution for complex image editing, we examine editing behaviors of different paradigms under a unified in-context editing framework, and study how the benefits of sequential decomposition can be balanced against its error-accumulation drawbacks. We further develop a synthetic data pipeline that constructs editing tasks of varying instruction complexity, allowing us to curate a large-scale editing dataset with high-quality decomposed sequences. By finetuning on synthetic data, we discovered that with properly designed editing paradigms, sequential decomposition yields robust improvements even as task complexity increases. Furthermore, the decomposition skills learned from synthetic tasks can transfer to real images by co-training with real-world editing data, demonstrating the promise of sim-to-real generalization for tackling complex image editing across broader domains.

</details>


### [138] [X-Restormer++: 1st Place Solution for the UG2+ CVPR 2026 All-Weather Restoration Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13258)
*Youwei Pan,Leilei Cao,Yingfang Zhu,Fengjie Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于X-Restormer的双模型两阶段训练方案，配合梯度引导边缘感知损失（GGEA Loss），在CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛全天气图像恢复赛道中获得第一名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在全天气条件下（模糊、雾、雨、雪及复合退化）实现高质量的图像恢复，解决现有方法在多退化类型和域适应方面的局限性。

Method: 1) 基于X-Restormer的dual-attention架构（MDTA + OCA），结合Restormer-Plus的空间自适应输入缩放；2) 两阶段训练：阶段一在大规模FoundIR数据集上训练Model B，阶段二在WeatherStream数据集上微调Model A；3) 提出GGEA Loss，利用Sobel算子构建空间自适应权重图，加强边缘和高频区域监督；4) 双模型加权融合推理（0.4×outA + 0.6×outB）。

Result: 在8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 1中排名第一。

Conclusion: 大规模预训练结合领域微调、边缘感知损失和双模型集成策略在全天气图像恢复任务中取得了最优性能。

Abstract: In this work, we present our winning solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 1: Image Restoration under All-weather Conditions. Our method is built upon the X-Restormer baseline, which captures both channel-wise global dependencies and spatially-local structural information through its dual-attention design (Multi-DConv Head Transposed Attention and Overlapping Cross-Attention), augmented with the spatially-adaptive input scaling mechanism from Restormer-Plus. We adopt a two-stage training strategy with dual-model ensemble inference. In the first stage, Model B is trained from scratch on a large-scale diverse dataset randomly sampled from the FoundIR training set (approximately 800 GB out of 4.84 TB), covering five degradation types: blur, haze, rain, snow, and composite conditions such as co-occurring rain and haze. In the second stage, Model A is fine-tuned on the WeatherStream dataset (rain and snow splits) using Model B's final checkpoint as pretrained initialization, enabling efficient domain adaptation with a substantially smaller dataset. To better preserve structural details during training, we propose a novel Gradient-Guided Edge-Aware (GGEA) Loss, which applies Sobel operators to the ground-truth image to construct a spatially adaptive weight map that assigns higher supervision to edge and high-frequency regions. This is incorporated alongside L1 and Multi-Scale SSIM losses in a unified training objective. At inference time, predictions from the two models are fused via a weighted average, out = 0.4 x outA + 0.6 x outB, where the higher weight assigned to Model B reflects its stronger generalization ability from large-scale pretraining. With these strategies, our proposed method successfully ranks 1st in the challenge.

</details>


### [139] [Vision Inference Former: Sustaining Visual Consistency in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18160)
*Xinpeng Dong,Min Zhang,Kairong Han,Xu Tan,Fei Wu,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Vision Inference Former (VIF)，一种轻量级架构模块，通过在解码阶段持续注入视觉语义，解决多模态大语言模型中视觉信息被弱化及长文本生成中视觉-语言对齐退化的问题，在14个基准任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连接器范式将视觉特征投影为文本序列，导致两个问题：(1)视觉作为核心证据模态却被当作普通文本token处理，削弱了视觉的独特贡献；(2)随着生成长度增加，模型对视觉信息的依赖逐渐减弱，视觉-语言对齐恶化，生成内容与视觉语义一致性下降。

Method: 提出Vision Inference Former (VIF)轻量级架构模块，在推理解码阶段建立纯视觉表示与模型输出空间之间的直接桥梁，持续注入视觉语义，确保生成过程始终锚定在视觉内容上。

Result: 在覆盖通用推理、OCR、表格理解、视觉中心评估和幻觉检测的14个基准任务上，VIF在不同架构下均能一致提升模型性能，同时仅引入极小的额外开销。

Conclusion: VIF通过直接持续的视觉语义注入有效缓解了多模态大模型中视觉信息弱化和长文本生成中视觉对齐退化问题，是一种轻量且有效的改进方案。

Abstract: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, primarily attributed to effective paradigms for integrating visual and textual information. The dominant connector-based paradigm projects visual features into textual sequence, enabling unified multimodal alignment and reasoning within a generative architecture. However, our experiments reveal two key limitations: (1) Although visual information serves as the core evidential modality in MLLMs, it is treated on par with textual tokens, diminishing the unique contribution of the visual modality; (2) As generation length increases, particularly within a limited context window, the model's dependence on visual information progressively weakens, resulting in deteriorated vision-language alignment and reduced consistency between generated content and visual semantics. To address these challenges, we propose the Vision Inference Former (VIF), a lightweight architectural module that establishes a direct bridge between pure visual representations and the model's output space. Specifically, VIF continuously injects visual semantics throughout the decoding phase of the inference process, ensuring that the model remains firmly grounded in visual content during generation. We conduct experiments on 14 benchmark tasks covering general reasoning, OCR, table understanding, vision-centric evaluation, and hallucination. Experimental results show that VIF consistently improves model performance across diverse architectures while introducing minimal additional overhead. The code for this work is available at https://github.com/Dong-Xinpeng/VIF.

</details>


### [140] [Vision-OPD: Learning to See Fine Details for Multimodal LLMs via On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18740)
*Qianhao Yuan,Jie Lou,Xing Yu,Hongyu Lin,Le Sun,Xianpei Han,Yaojie Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Vision-OPD提出了一种区域到全局的自蒸馏框架，通过将MLLM在局部裁剪图像上的优越感知能力迁移到全图策略上，从而提升细粒度视觉理解能力，无需外部教师模型或标注，在多个基准上达到甚至超越更大规模模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在细粒度视觉理解任务中表现不佳，主要原因是模型难以聚焦图像中的关键证据区域，而非局部识别能力不足。作者观察到同一模型在条件化裁剪图像上比在全图上回答细粒度问题更准确，表明存在"区域到全局的感知差距"。

Method: 提出Vision-OPD框架，从同一MLLM实例化两个条件策略：基于裁剪图像的教师策略和基于全图像的学生策略。学生在全图上进行在线策略（on-policy）生成，通过最小化教师和学生沿生成轨迹的逐token分布差异（token-level KL散度），将教师的区域感知能力蒸馏到学生的全图策略中。无需外部教师、真值标签、奖励模型或推理时工具调用。

Result: 在多个细粒度视觉理解基准上，Vision-OPD模型取得了与更大规模的开源模型、闭源模型以及"Thinking-with-Images"智能体模型相当或更优的性能。

Conclusion: 通过自蒸馏方式将模型自身的局部感知优势内化为全图策略，能够在不增加推理开销的前提下有效提升MLLM的细粒度视觉理解能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, where answers often depend on small but decisive evidence in the full image. We observe a regional-to-global perception gap: the same MLLM answers fine-grained questions more accurately when conditioned on evidence-centered crops than on the corresponding full images, suggesting that many failures stem from difficulty to focus on relevant evidence rather than insufficient local recognition ability. Motivated by this observation, we propose Vision-OPD (Vision On-Policy Distillation), a regional-to-global self-distillation framework that transfers the model's own privileged regional perception to its full-image policy. Vision-OPD instantiates two conditional policies from the same MLLM: a crop-conditioned teacher and a full-image-conditioned student. The student generates on-policy rollouts, and Vision-OPD minimizes token-level divergence between the teacher and student next-token distributions along these rollouts. This enables the model to internalize the benefit of visual zooming without external teacher models, ground-truth labels, reward verifiers, or inference-time tool use. Experiments on multiple fine-grained visual understanding benchmarks show that Vision-OPD models achieve competitive or superior performance against much larger open-source, closed-source, and "Thinking-with-Images" agentic models. The code is available at https://github.com/VisionOPD/Vision-OPD

</details>


### [141] [TextAlign: Preference Alignment for Text Rendering with Hierarchical Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19320)
*Mingxuan Cui,Jingpu Yang,Fengxian Ji,Qian Jiang,Zhecheng Shi,Jiaming Wang,Zirui Song,Fajri Koto,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TextAlign，一种非侵入式的后训练偏好对齐框架，通过分层VLM奖励信号（全局/单词/字形）提升文本到图像生成模型的文字渲染能力，无需修改生成器架构，在FLUX.1-dev和Z-Image-Turbo上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型文本到图像生成模型在忠实渲染文字方面存在持续弱点，现有方法依赖架构特定模块或编码器修改，增加了部署复杂度。本文旨在探索一种无需改变生成器架构的后训练偏好对齐方案来解决该问题。

Method: 提出TextAlign框架，核心是基于分层视觉-语言模型（VLM）的奖励机制，将渲染错误分解为全局、单词和字形三个层级，将二元缺陷判断转换为标量偏好信号，该信号同时支持GRPO和DPO两种偏好优化算法。

Result: 在FLUX.1-dev和Z-Image-Turbo上实验表明，该方法在OCR文本准确率上取得一致性提升，且不损害通用生成质量。与SD3.5、Qwen-Image、AnyText、TextDiffuser等基线相比，展示了奖励设计作为模型重设计可扩展替代方案的潜力。

Conclusion: 奖励设计为改进文本渲染提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，相较于模型重设计更具优势。非侵入式框架保持生成器架构不变，便于在基础模型上部署。

Abstract: Faithful text rendering remains a persistent weakness of large text-to-image generative models, as it requires both semantic instruction following and fine-grained glyph-level structure. Prior methods often improve this ability through architecture-specific modules or encoder modifications, which complicate deployment across foundation models. We study text rendering as a post-training preference-alignment problem and propose TextAlign, a non-invasive framework that keeps the generator architecture unchanged. The key component is a hierarchical vision-language model (VLM)-based reward that decomposes rendering errors into global, word, and glyph levels, then converts binary defect judgments into a scalar preference signal. The resulting signal supports both Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Z-Image-Turbo show consistent gains in OCR-based text accuracy without degrading general generation quality. Compared with strong foundation and text-rendering baselines, including SD3.5, Qwen-Image, AnyText, and TextDiffuser, these results indicate that reward design offers a scalable alternative to model redesign for improving text rendering.

</details>


### [142] [MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20183)
*Yujie Wei,Yujin Han,Zhekai Chen,Yongming Li,Kaixun Jiang,Zhihang Liu,Quanhao Li,Zhiwu Qing,Xiang Wang,Zhen Xing,Ruihang Chu,Lingyi Hong,Yefei He,Junjie Zhou,Junqiu Yu,Yang Shi,Difan Zou,Kai Zhu,Shiwei Zhang,Yingya Zhang,Yu Liu,Xihui Liu,Hongming Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MSAVBench是首个面向多镜头音视频生成的综合基准与自适应混合评估框架，覆盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四个维度，支持多达15个镜头，包含自适应自校正分割、实例级评分和工具化证据提取机制，与人类判断的Spearman秩相关系数达91.5%，对19个模型评估发现当前系统在导演级控制与音视频同步方面仍存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准在数据多样性和评估流程上存在局限性，缺乏能够系统、可靠评估现代多镜头音视频生成模型的标准，因此需要构建一个更全面的基准和评估框架。

Method: 构建覆盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四个维度的基准，包含多任务设置和最多15个镜头；提出包含自适应自校正镜头分割机制、实例级评分规则和基于工具的复杂判断证据提取的混合评估框架。

Result: MSAVBench与人类判断的Spearman秩相关系数达到91.5%；对19个前沿模型（闭源和开源）的系统评估显示，当前模型在导演级控制和细粒度音视频同步上仍存在困难，模块化或智能体式生成流水线有助于缩小开源与闭源模型之间的差距。

Conclusion: MSAVBench为多镜头音视频生成提供了首个全面评估方案，揭示了现有模型的不足，并指出了模块化/智能体式方法作为有前景的发展方向。

Abstract: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot synthesis to complex multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) narratives to meet real-world demands. However, evaluating such frontier models remains a fundamental challenge. Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and data diversity, and rely on rigid evaluation pipelines, preventing systematic and reliable assessment of modern MSAV models. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MSAVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark and adaptive hybrid evaluation framework for multi-shot audio-video generation. Our benchmark spans four key dimensions, video, audio, shot, and reference, covering diverse task settings, varying shot counts of up to 15, and challenging non-realistic scenarios. Our evaluation framework improves robustness through an adaptive self-correction mechanism for shot segmentation, instance-wise rubrics for subjective metrics, and tool-grounded evidence extraction for complex judgments. Furthermore, MSAVBench achieves high alignment with human judgments, reaching a Spearman rank correlation of 91.5%. Our systematic evaluation of 19 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models shows that current systems still struggle with director-level control and fine-grained audio-visual synchronization, while modular or agentic generation pipelines offer a promising path toward narrowing the gap between open- and closed-source models. The benchmark data and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/ali-vilab/MSAVBench.

</details>


### [143] [WildRoadBench: A Wild Aerial Road-Damage Grounding Benchmark for Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20306)
*Bingnan Liu,Chenhang Cui,Rui Huang,Jiani Luo,Zhirong Shen,Tinghao Wang,Xiande Huang,Lingbei Meng,Fei Shen,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WildRoadBench是一个面向无人机航拍道路损伤定位的基准测试，包含VLM直接定位和LLM智能体自主研究-工程两种评估协议。实验表明，即使是闭源前沿模型，在该野外场景下性能仍远不可靠（指标余量过半），开源模型更差，智能体方法甚至不如最强VLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有道路损伤检测基准多局限于传统检测范式，缺乏对VLM直接视觉定位和LLM驱动智能体自主研究-工程能力的系统评估，亟需一个统一的野外航拍基准来衡量这两条技术路线在真实复杂场景下的表现。

Method: 构建基于同一专业标注UAV语料库的WildRoadBench，设计两条评估协议：(1) VLM Track：在统一提示/解码/解析流水线下评估固定VLM对单图单短提示的域内损伤定位能力；(2) Agent Track：仅给智能体书面任务、小探索切片和固定交互预算，让其自主搜索网络、适配预训练组件、编写训练推理代码，通过标量反馈预言机在隐藏测试集上提交预测。

Result: 闭源前沿模型位居VLM排行榜首位，但指标余量过半；开源基础模型远低于闭源模型，且新一代或推理型变体未持续提升；所有开源模型对小目标定位崩溃；智能体方法落后于最强VLM，多个智能体未能在预算内完成有效提交。

Conclusion: 在野外无人机航拍道路损伤定位任务上，无论是直接VLM定位还是LLM智能体自主方法，当前均远未达到可靠性能水平，该领域仍有巨大提升空间。

Abstract: We introduce WildRoadBench, a wild aerial road-damage grounding benchmark that couples direct visual grounding by vision-language models with autonomous research-and-engineering by LLM-driven agents on a single professionally annotated UAV corpus. The same image set and the same per-class AP_50 metric are evaluated under two protocols. The VLM Track measures whether a fixed VLM can localise domain-specific damage from one image and one short prompt under a unified prompting, decoding and parsing pipeline. The Agent Track measures whether an autonomous agent, given only a written task brief, a small exploratory slice and a fixed interaction budget, can search the public web, adapt pretrained components, write training and inference code, and submit predictions through a scalar-feedback oracle on a hidden holdout. We benchmark a broad pool of closed-source frontier models and open-source VLMs together with several frontier LLM-driven agents. Both routes remain far from reliable performance in this wild setting: closed-source frontier models lead the VLM leaderboard but still leave more than half of the metric on the table; open-source grounders plateau well below them, and newer generations or reasoning-style variants do not consistently improve grounding; small targets collapse for every open-source model; agents lag the strongest VLM despite richer affordances, and several fail to land a valid submission within the budget. We release the code and data at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/wildroadbench-0607 to support reproducible follow-up research.

</details>


### [144] [TASTE: A Designer-Annotated Multi-Dimensional Preference Dataset for AI-Generated Graphic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20731)
*Haonan Zhu,Elad Hirsch,Alexandria Minetti,Allison Nulty,Purvanshi Mehta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TASTE是一个由专业设计师在多维度（排版、美学、空间、色调等）上对文生图模型输出进行排名的数据集，并配套了评估框架和偏好模型基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型的偏好数据集仅提供单一整体评判，而设计师实际从多个独立维度（如排版、布局、色彩和谐）评估设计，单一标签无法捕捉这种多维度差异。

Method: 构建TASTE数据集：两组各5名专业设计师对4个当前文生图模型的输出在9个标准上进行排名，并标注幻觉标志。提出基于Kendall's τ、多数投票概率和Condorcet循环的criterion-agnostic信号验证框架。对比现成VLM评判器、专用T2I评分器与在TASTE上训练的MLP头的表现。

Result: 设计师间一致性显著但中等；所有TASTE标准均拒绝随机评分者原假设。现成VLM和T2I评分器无法达到与设计师面板的多数一致，而基于TASTE训练的MLP头显著缩小了与单评分者上限的差距。

Conclusion: TASTE数据集为多维度文生图偏好评估提供了基准，当前通用模型无法匹配专业设计师的判断，领域特定训练是必要的。

Abstract: Text-to-image models now generate graphic design at production scale, yet their supervision still comes primarily from photo-style preference datasets with a single overall verdict per comparison. Designers evaluate designs along several distinct axes (e.g., typography, layout, color harmony) that a single preference label collapses. We release \emph{TASTE} \textit{(Typography, Aesthetics, Spatial, Tone, Etc.)}, a multi-dimensional preference dataset in which two disjoint cohorts of five professional designers each ranked outputs from four current text-to-image models across nine criteria along with per-image hallucination flags. We pair the dataset with two contributions. First, a criterion-agnostic signal-validation framework based on Kendall's $τ$, majority-vote probability, and Condorcet cycles against exact iid-uniform nulls; the analysis reveals significant but moderate designer agreement, with every TASTE criterion rejecting the random-rater null. Second, we benchmark preference models on TASTE and find that off-the-shelf VLM judges and dedicated T2I scorers fail to reach majority agreement with the designer panel, while a small MLP head trained directly on TASTE substantially narrows the gap to the single-rater ceiling, setting a baseline for future TASTE-trained preference models.

</details>


### [145] [Task-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis: A Systematic Review and Practical Design Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23995)
*Chathura Wimalasiri,Kishor Nandakishor,Marimuthu Palaniswami*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统回顾了2017-2025年间75项医学影像自监督学习研究，将方法分为对比、非对比与预测、生成与重建、混合四种范式，分析了不同前置任务与下游目标的对齐关系，发现无全局最优策略，性能取决于前置任务、成像模态与目标任务的匹配度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像标注瓶颈严重制约深度学习应用，自监督学习通过无标注数据学习表征成为有前景的范式，但其效果高度依赖前置任务设计与临床目标的对齐，现有研究缺乏系统性、面向任务的分析。

Method: 遵循PRISMA指南，系统分析了2017至2025年间75项研究，将SSL方法归纳为四种范式（对比学习、非对比与预测学习、生成与重建学习、混合学习），并将每种范式映射到其最佳支持的下游任务。

Result: 不存在通用最优SSL策略；对比学习擅长分类但可能忽略细微病理模式；生成与空间预测方法更适用于分割等密集预测任务；混合方法性能最均衡；模态特异性设计至关重要；SSL在低标注和少样本场景中收益最大。

Conclusion: 提出了实用性设计指南，指出了开放挑战（病理感知前置任务设计、高维数据高效训练、标准化评估协议），为构建更有效且临床相关的SSL框架提供了指导。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for addressing the annotation bottleneck in medical imaging by learning representations from unlabeled data. However, its effectiveness depends heavily on the design of the pretext task and its alignment with the downstream clinical-objectives. We present a systematic, task-oriented review of SSL in medical imaging, examining how different pretext-task formulations influence performance across classification, segmentation, detection, and other tasks. Following PRISMA guidelines, we analyze 75 studies published between 2017 and 2025 and organize them into four paradigms: contrastive, non-contrastive and predictive, generative and reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning. Rather than cataloguing methods by architecture, we map each paradigm to the downstream objectives it best supports. Our analysis shows there is no universally optimal SSL strategy; instead, performance is governed by the alignment between the pretext task, the imaging modality, and the target task. Contrastive methods learn global discriminative features and align well with classification, but may overlook subtle pathological patterns. Generative and spatial prediction-based approaches better preserve local anatomical structure, making them more suitable for segmentation and other dense prediction tasks, while hybrid methods offer the most balanced performance. We further show that modality-specific design is critical and that SSL provides its greatest benefit in low-label and few-shot regimes. Finally, we distill these findings into practical design guidelines and outline open challenges, including pathology-aware pretext task design, resource-efficient training for high-dimensional data, and standardized evaluation protocols. This work offers practical guidance for designing more effective and clinically relevant SSL frameworks in medical imaging.

</details>


### [146] [CRISP -- Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology Case Representation and Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24253)
*Zahra Rahimi Afzal,Wataru Uegami,Saghir Alfasly,Wenchao Han,Saba Yasir,Judy C. Boughey,Matthew P. Goetz,Krishna R. Kalari,H. R. Tizhoosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CRISP框架，一种无监督的两阶段病例级病理分析方案，通过聚类去冗余采样从多个全切片图像中提取代表性斑块，实现无需人工选择切片的病例检索，在乳腺癌数据集上匹配或超越现有标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数字病理分析方法大多仅使用单张病理医师选择的WSI，忽略了同一病例中多张WSI所包含的肿瘤异质性信息和潜在临床相关证据，且缺乏能够自动处理多WSI病例的无监督框架。

Method: CRISP两阶段框架：(1) 单WSI内冗余减少（通过聚类去除相似斑块）；(2) 跨WSI聚类采样（对所有WSI的剩余斑块进行聚类，选择紧凑且有代表性的病例级斑块集合），该集合直接作为检索索引。

Result: 在两个Mayo Clinic乳腺癌数据集（诊断和治疗规划）上，CRISP在病例检索任务中一致匹配或超越了当前结合模型与病理医师选择切片的黄金标准。

Conclusion: CRISP通过自动化病例级处理、消除主观WSI选择，能够利用当前被忽视的分布在不同WSI上的临床相关信息，是一种有效的无监督多WSI病例级分析方案。

Abstract: Digital pathology archives increasingly contain multiple whole-slide images (WSIs) per case, capturing spatially distinct tumor regions and reflecting intrinsic morphological heterogeneity. However, most existing approaches rely on a single pathologist-selected slide, thereby discarding potentially informative evidence distributed across the remaining WSIs. To date, no autonomous framework has been proposed for comprehensive multi-WSI case processing. Here, we present an unsupervised framework for case-level analysis that integrates information from all available slides within a case. Rather than relying on a single designated slide, the proposed approach constructs case-level representations by selectively distilling informative patches across WSIs. We introduce Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology (CRISP), a two-stage framework that first reduces redundancy within individual WSIs and subsequently applies clustering-based sampling to select a compact yet representative set of patches for the entire case. The resulting patch set captures case-level heterogeneity while avoiding exhaustive processing of gigapixel images, and directly serves as a retrieval index. Using two Mayo Clinic breast cancer datasets for diagnosis and treatment planning, we demonstrate that CRISP consistently matches or surpasses the current standard practice of combined model and pathologist slide selection for patient/case search and retrieval. By automating case-level processing and eliminating subjective WSI selection, CRISP potentially enables the exploitation of clinically relevant information distributed across multiple WSIs that is currently overlooked.

</details>


### [147] [Anatomy-Anchored Self-Supervision: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Invariant Ultrasound Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25402)
*Chunzheng Zhu,Yijun Wang,Jianxin Lin,Feng Wang,Hongwei Wang,Lei Zhao,Shengli Li,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解剖锚定的超声自监督框架ANAUS，通过LP-SAM实现无标注解剖结构分割，并设计双策略自监督学习（跨视图语义感知解剖分离对齐+上下文核心区域预测），在6个公开数据集上超越SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超声自监督预训练方法仅在图像或帧级操作，忽略了与临床对齐的解剖结构上下文信息，导致所学表征缺乏临床相关性。

Method: 1) 提出LP-SAM模块（可学习潜提示引擎+一次性域适应），实现大规模无标注解剖结构分割；2) 设计双策略自监督学习：跨视图语义感知解剖分离对齐（增强相同解剖区域特征不变性，促进不同结构判别性）和上下文核心区域预测（重建损坏区域以捕获细粒度结构细节）。

Result: 在6个公共数据集上，ANAUS一致超越当前最先进方法，同时保持临床部署所需的计算效率。

Conclusion: 将自监督表征学习从通用视觉区域转移到临床有意义的解剖结构，能有效提升超声图像表征质量，且具备良好的计算效率。

Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training paradigm has gained increasing prominence for learning transferable representations in medical imaging, yet existing methods for ultrasound (US) images operate at the image or frame level, overlooking the anatomical context for clinical-aligned representation learning. In this work, we propose an anatomy-anchored ultrasound self-supervision framework ANAUS that shifts representation learning from generic visual regions to clinically meaningful anatomical structures. Utilizing a learnable latent prompt engine alongside a one-time domain adaptation on existing public image-mask pairs, we empower the LP-SAM module to achieve annotation-free anatomy delineation at scale. Building upon this anatomical grounding, we propose a dual-policy self-supervised learning paradigm consisting of inter-view semantics-aware anatomy-separating alignment and contextual core-region prediction to enhance representation learning. Specifically, the former enforces feature invariance within identical anatomical regions while promoting discriminability across distinct structures; the latter compels the model to reconstruct corrupted regions, thereby capturing fine-grained structural details. Extensive evaluations on six public datasets demonstrate that ANAUS consistently outstrips current state-of-the-art methods while maintaining the computational efficiency essential for clinical deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/ANAUS.

</details>


### [148] [MIND: Multi-Scale Intent Diffusion for Text-Driven Physics-Based Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26006)
*Bin Li,Ruichi Zhang,Han Liang,Jingyan Zhang,Juze Zhang,Xin Chen,Jingya Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIND是一个端到端扩散框架，通过多尺度意图扩散机制（整体意图预测器+即时意图预测器）作为语义桥梁，实现从文本命令到物理人形机器人的行为控制，在语义对齐和行为自然度上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在两大局限：两阶段范式（运动生成+物理跟踪）面临领域迁移问题；端到端模仿学习范式面临文本与低层动作之间的模态差距，难以实现有效的语义对齐。人形机器人状态比低层动作与文本描述更语义对齐，可作为行为意图的自然基础。

Method: 提出MIND框架，核心是多尺度意图扩散机制：(1) 整体意图预测器捕获全局行为动态；(2) 即时意图预测器提供逐步骤的细粒度局部行为细化信号。同时将人形机器人状态编码到潜在空间以增强语义意图建模。

Result: 实验表明MIND在合成连贯、物理合理且语义对齐的人形行为方面优于现有方法。

Conclusion: MIND通过多尺度意图扩散作为语义桥梁，有效解决了文本到物理人形控制的语义对齐问题，为端到端文本驱动物理人形控制提供了新范式。

Abstract: Enabling physics-based humanoids to execute diverse behaviors from high-level textual commands remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically follow either a two-stage paradigm that combines kinematic motion generation with physics-based tracking, or an end-to-end imitation-learning paradigm that directly generates actions from text. However, the former suffers from the inherent domain shift between kinematic generation and physics-based tracking, while the latter struggles with the substantial modality gap between textual commands and low-level actions, limiting effective semantic alignment. Notably, humanoid states encode rich motion dynamics that are more semantically aligned with textual descriptions than low-level actions, making them a natural basis for deriving behavioral intent. Building upon this insight, we propose MIND, a novel end-to-end diffusion framework for text-driven physics-based humanoid control that leverages behavioral intent as a semantic bridge between textual commands and low-level actions. At its core, MIND introduces a multi-scale intent diffusion mechanism, where a holistic intent predictor captures global behavioral dynamics to guide overall behavior synthesis, while an immediate intent predictor provides step-wise, fine-grained signals for local behavior refinement at each diffusion step. This hierarchical intent formulation imposes a structured inductive bias for humanoid control, improving semantic alignment and behavioral naturalness. Furthermore, MIND encodes humanoid states into a latent space to enable more effective semantic intent modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIND outperforms existing methods and synthesizes coherent, physically plausible, and semantically aligned humanoid behaviors from text commands. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MIND_page.

</details>


### [149] [Cesarean Scar Defect Segmentation in Transvaginal Ultrasound Images: a Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26774)
*Yuan Tian,Yue Li,Wei Xia,Tianyu Xu,Jian Zhang,Liye Shi,Jing Liu,Yang Wang,Ming Liu,Qing Xu,Yixuan Zhang,Maggie M. He,Xiangjian He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了首个经阴道超声CSD分割公共数据集，包含1,111张图像和16个视频（501个阳性样本及像素级标注），旨在推动医学图像分割算法发展和临床创新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 剖宫产瘢痕缺损（CSD）是剖宫产后的常见并发症，经阴道超声是主要筛查手段，但CSD常因尺寸小、形态不规则、图像质量差及临床意识不足而被漏诊。目前尚无用于经阴道超声CSD分割的公共数据集，限制了AI技术在该领域的应用。

Method: 构建了一个包含1,111张图像和16个视频的综合CSD数据集，从中提取501个阳性样本，并由经验丰富的超声技师和博士生按照标准化临床指南进行精确的像素级人工标注。

Result: 提供了一个高质量基准资源，用于推进医学图像分割算法和促进临床创新，有望改善CSD诊断和治疗策略。

Conclusion: 该数据集填补了CSD分割领域公共数据集的空白，有助于提升CSD诊断准确性，继而改善育龄女性生活质量，对医学研究和临床实践均有重要价值。

Abstract: Cesarean Scar Defect (CSD) is one of the most prevalent complications following cesarean delivery. Transvaginal ultrasonography is widely used for primary CSD screening. Accurate determination of CSD outline and dimensions is crucial for treatment. However, CSDs are frequently overlooked by sonographers due to small size and irregular morphology, suboptimal image quality, and limited clinical awareness in resource-constrained settings. Despite artificial intelligence advances in medical imaging, no public dataset exists for transvaginal ultrasound CSD segmentation. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive CSD dataset comprising 1,111 images and 16 videos, yielding 501 positive samples with confirmed CSD and precise pixel-level manual annotations. Annotations are performed following standardized clinical guidelines through collaboration between experienced sonographers and trained PhD students. This work provides high-quality benchmark resources for advancing medical image segmentation algorithms and promoting clinical innovation. Ultimately, improved CSD diagnosis and subsequent treatment strategies can enhance the quality of life in women of reproductive age, representing significant value for both medical research and clinical practice.

</details>


### [150] [I2PRef: Image-Driven Point Completion with Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26914)
*Azhar Hussian,Marina Ritthaler,André Kaup,Vasileios Belagiannis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种以图像为主、无需3D输入的图像引导点云补全方法，包含I2P模块（图像到点云粗重建）和P2P模块（基于transformer的细粒度精炼），在ShapeNet-ViPC上实现了12.3%的Chamfer Distance相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像-点云多模态方法通常将图像作为辅助引导或依赖辅助损失与融合模块，未能充分利用图像作为主要几何信息来源的潜力。

Method: 提出I2P（Image-to-Point）模块直接从单张RGB图像重建完整点云，无需3D输入；再通过基于transformer的P2P（Point-to-Point）精炼模块，利用点token与图像特征之间的自注意力和交叉注意力迭代细化粗点云。

Result: 在ShapeNet-ViPC数据集上达到最先进的补全性能，Chamfer Distance相对提升12.3%。

Conclusion: 显式的I2P任务为图像提供了强几何感知先验，P2P模块逐步恢复细粒度细节，整体方法优于现有的多模态方法。

Abstract: We present an image-conditioned point cloud completion approach that treats images as the primary geometric source rather than a secondary guide. To this end, we introduce an Image-to-Point (I2P) module that can reconstruct complete point clouds directly from a single RGB image, with no need for 3D inputs. Additionally, we introduce a transformer-based Point-to-Point (P2P) refinement module that uses self- and cross-attention between point tokens and image features to iteratively refine the coarse I2P output. The I2P module enables the image encoder to learn rich geometric representations, while the P2P module progressively recovers fine-grained details. Unlike existing multimodal methods that rely on auxiliary losses or fusion modules, our explicit I2P task provides a strong, geometry-aware prior based on images alone. Extensive experiments on ShapeNet-ViPC demonstrate state-of-the-art completion performance with a 12.3% relative Chamfer Distance improvement over prior methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/AzharSindhi/I2PRef.git

</details>


### [151] [ST-ColoNet: Spatio-Temporal Colon Segment Recognition via Hybrid Attention and Edge-Guided Feature Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28119)
*Crystal Cai,Ziyi Wang,Zhengjie Zhang,Jingsheng Gao,Dahong Qian,Suncheng Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对结肠镜视频中的结肠段识别任务，构建了专用视频数据集，并提出了一种两阶段深度学习框架ST-ColoNet（包含Colorlaus模块和Full-Temp模块），利用时空信息实现SOTA性能（准确率81.0%，F1分数70.7%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结肠段识别方法仅使用静态图像，未能充分利用时序信息，导致性能不佳；同时缺乏公开的视频级数据集。

Method: 两阶段框架ST-ColoNet：1) Colorlaus模块利用度量学习优化边缘介导的空间特征提取；2) Full-Temp模块结合三种自注意力模式近似完整自注意力，优化长结肠镜序列上的时序特征聚合。

Result: 在结肠段识别任务上达到准确率81.0%，F1分数70.7%，显著优于现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 提出的视频数据集和时空融合框架有效解决了结肠段识别中时序信息缺失的问题，大幅提升了识别性能。

Abstract: Colo-segment recognition in colonoscopy videos is a key requirement for many downstream tasks, but existing automatic recognition methods only use colonoscopy images without fully exploiting the use of temporal information, leading to poor performance. Additionally, relevant public video-based datasets are in scarcity. To tackle this problem, we curate and release a labeled dataset specifically for the task of colo-segment recognition. In addition, we propose a two-stage deep learning-based framework, Colo-Segment Recognition via SpatioTemporal Network (ST-ColoNet), for the task of colo-segment recognition from colonoscopy videos which includes the Colorlaus module that uses metric learning to optimize edge-mediated spatial feature extraction, as well as the Full-Temp module which combines three self-attention patterns to better approximate full self-attention on long colonoscopy sequences and optimize temporal feature aggregation. Through extensive ablation experiments, we show that our framework is capable of achieving state-of-the-art performance on the task of colo-segment recognition, achieving an accuracy of 81.0% and F1-score of 70.7%, which is a tremendous improvement over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [152] [Geometry-Guided Modeling of Foundation Features Enables Generalizable Object Shape Deformation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29661)
*Yiyao Ma,Kai Chen,Zhongxiang Zhou,Zhuheng Song,Dongsheng Xie,Zelong Tan,Rong Xiong,Qi Dou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通用的变形学习框架GODeform，通过将类别级形状模板变形匹配目标观测来重建3D物体，并引入几何引导特征建模和视角自适应特征聚合模块，显著优于现有方法，支持真实世界灵巧机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目3D形状恢复在任意视角和未见物体类别下难以实现鲁棒的泛化，现有方法处理复杂形状变化和视角差异的能力有限。

Method: 1) 几何引导特征建模：利用模板拓扑增强基础特征，得到几何感知表示，再与目标观测显式关联以指导变形；2) 视角自适应特征聚合模块：利用多视角模板特征及其对应相机位姿丰富规范模板表示，确保不同视角下的鲁棒特征对齐。

Result: 在多种物体类别和视角下显著优于现有方法，展现出对未见类别的强泛化能力，并有效支持下游真实世界的灵巧机器人操作任务。

Conclusion: GODeform框架通过显式模板变形和创新的特征机制，成功实现了单目3D形状恢复的跨视角、跨类别泛化，具有重要的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Monocular 3D shape recovery is fundamental to geometric understanding, yet achieving robust generalization across arbitrary viewpoints and unseen object categories remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present a generalizable deformation learning framework that reconstructs 3D objects by explicitly deforming a category-level shape template to match the target observation. To address complex shape variations between the template and the target, we introduce a geometry-guided feature modeling mechanism. This process first enriches foundation features with template topology to yield a geometry-aware representation, which is then explicitly correlated with the target observation to guide precise deformation. Furthermore, to bridge the disparity between the fixed template and arbitrary target views, we propose a view-adaptive feature aggregation module. This module leverages multi-view template features and their corresponding camera poses to enrich the canonical template representation, ensuring robust feature alignment regardless of the target's perspective. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling large shape variations and diverse viewpoints, exhibiting strong generalization to novel categories and effectively supporting downstream real-world dexterous robotic manipulation tasks. Project homepage: https://GODeform.github.io/

</details>


### [153] [DiTTo: Scalable Order-aware All-in-One Image Restoration Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30915)
*Seungho Choi,Jihyong Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiTTo框架，包含模拟器和智能体，通过O(N^D)次模拟器调用构建最优修复轨迹数据集，并采用顺序感知修复对齐（ORA）实现即插即用的可扩展性，在多退化图像修复任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于智能体的图像修复方法存在两个瓶颈：(1) 构建最优修复动作轨迹数据集需要O((N^D)^2)次修复专家调用，效率低下；(2) 智能体训练与固定的修复专家池耦合，无法扩展新专家而无需完全重新训练。

Method: DiTTo框架包含两个组件：(1) DiTTo模拟器：结合∪S-IR（单步修复动作模拟）和AiO-IQA（每动作质量预测），将ORTD构建复杂度降至O(N^D)；(2) DiTTo智能体：通过SFT在模拟器生成的ORTD上训练，再经过顺序感知修复对齐（ORA）沿独立轴对齐退化识别、修复动作排序和输出格式，支持即插即用的可扩展性。

Result: 在含多达5种并发退化的MiO-100评估集上，DiTTo智能体在基于智能体的多退化图像修复方法中达到了最先进的修复质量。

Conclusion: DiTTo框架通过模拟器显著降低ORTD构建开销，并通过ORA实现新修复专家的即插即用扩展，为基于智能体的图像修复提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Real-world images rarely suffer from a single degradation, and the order in which degradations are removed substantially affects the final restoration quality, motivating agent-based image restoration (IR), where a vision-language model schedules a pool of pre-built restoration-experts. However, existing training-based agents require $\mathcal{O}((N^{\mathbf{D}})^{2})$ restoration-expert calls per image to construct the Optimal Restoration-action Trajectory Dataset (ORTD), where $N^{\mathbf{D}}$ denotes the number of degradation types in the universe $\mathbf{D}$, and couple agent training to a fixed restoration-expert pool, preventing extension to newly introduced restoration-experts without full retraining. To overcome these efficiency and extensibility bottlenecks, we propose \textbf{DiTTo}, a novel order-aware image restoration agent framework consisting of the DiTTo Simulator and the DiTTo Agent. The DiTTo Simulator combines $\cup$S-IR for single-step restoration-action simulation and AiO-IQA for per-action quality prediction, reducing ORTD construction to $\mathcal{O}(N^{\mathbf{D}})$ simulator calls per image; the DiTTo Agent is trained by SFT on the simulator-generated ORTD, followed by \textbf{Order-aware Restoration Alignment (ORA)} that aligns degradation identification, restoration-action-ordering, and output format along independent axes. This enables \textbf{plug-and-play scalable extensibility}: adding a new restoration-expert requires updating only the lightweight ORA stage. On the MiO-100 evaluation set with up to five concurrent degradations, our DiTTo Agent achieves state-of-the-art multi-degradation restoration quality among previous agent-based IR methods.

</details>


### [154] [Diversity Over Frequency: Rethinking Tool Use in Visual Chain-of-Thought Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00096)
*Dong-Hee Kim,Reuben Tan,Donghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉智能体在复杂视觉推理任务（如3D空间推理和医疗VQA）中的工具使用行为，发现“工具使用坍缩”现象：模型逐渐停止使用工具但准确率反而提升。完全不用工具会降低性能，而鼓励使用工具仅有边际收益。提出熵正则化方法促进多样化探索，在工具使用下降的情况下仍取得最佳性能，表明工具应作为训练时的“脚手架”而非最终依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作主要研究视觉工具在简单视觉搜索任务中的作用，但工具在更复杂的视觉推理任务（需整合局部证据与全局上下文）中的角色尚未被充分探索。

Method: 通过实验发现工具使用坍缩现象及不对称性；提出熵正则化项鼓励多样化 rollout 探索，在训练中平衡语言生成与视觉工具调用。

Result: 熵正则化方法在工具使用逐渐下降的情况下取得了最佳性能；完全消除工具使用会降低性能，而鼓励工具使用仅有边际收益且增加了使用量。

Conclusion: 工具应被视为训练时的脚手架（scaffolding），通过促进更广泛的探索（包括语言生成和视觉工具调用）来提升推理能力，而非在推理时强制依赖工具。

Abstract: Visual agents employ external visual tools within visual chains of thought to incorporate fine-grained evidence. While prior work has mainly studied these tools in visual search tasks, their role in more complex visual reasoning remains underexplored. In this paper, we move beyond simple visual search tasks to investigate more challenging tasks, including 3D spatial reasoning and medical visual question answering, where agents must integrate tool-acquired local evidence with the global context. We identify a {tool-use collapse phenomenon: models progressively stop using tools while still achieving higher task accuracy. Moreover, we observe a clear asymmetry: (i) completely eliminating tool use degrades performance, whereas (ii) incentivizing tool use yields only marginal gains despite substantially increasing usage. We find that vanilla training and tool-use encouragement both reduce rollout diversity, explaining why higher tool use does not yield stronger reasoning performance. Motivated by these findings, we add an entropy regularization term to encourage diverse rollout exploration, achieving the best performance despite gradually declining tool usage. Overall, our findings suggest a training-time view of tools as scaffolding, where broader exploration over language generation and visual tool invocation improves reasoning despite tool-use collapse. Project page: https://scaffolded-exploration.github.io

</details>


### [155] [Training-Free Object-Agnostic Jam Detection in Fulfillment Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00321)
*Ruiliang Liu,Tina Dongxu Li,Joshua Migdal,Fernando Ruch,Kenneth Meszaros,Moses Trevor Dardik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为AllTracker的无训练、对象无关的堵塞检测方法，通过利用参考点被物体遮挡作为检测信号（而非传统跟踪中的失败情况），在1069个视频上实现了100.00%的精度和93.33%的F1分数，无需任何人工标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统堵塞检测依赖目标检测+跟踪算法，需要数千次人工标注（约两周工作量），且仅限于已标注的物体类别，开发成本高、泛化性差。

Method: 在无物体时均匀采样监控区域的参考点；当物体经过时遮挡这些参考点检测运动；当足够多的参考点被持续遮挡超过时间阈值时判定为堵塞。将遮挡从传统跟踪的失败情况重新利用为检测信号。

Result: 在1069个视频上，AllTracker实现了100.00%的精度和93.33%的F1分数，显著优于传统稀疏跟踪方法。

Conclusion: 该方法具有三个关键优势：(1)无需训练数据或人工标注，(2)可泛化到任意物体类型，(3)大幅减少开发时间。

Abstract: In fulfillment centers, diverse objects move continuously from inbound to outbound operations and can become jammed due to excessive conveyor friction, incorrect orientation, or mechanical failures. Traditional jam detection approaches rely on object detection models to identify objects, followed by tracking algorithms (such as IoU overlap and Kalman filtering) to monitor motion over time. This pipeline requires thousands of manual annotations, consuming approximately two weeks of effort, and is limited to annotated object classes. We present a training-free, object-agnostic jam detection method that eliminates the need for labeled data. Our approach uniformly samples reference points within the monitoring region when no objects are present. As objects occlude these points, we detect motion. When a sufficient fraction remains occluded beyond a temporal threshold, we classify the event as a jam. Unlike conventional point tracking--which treats occlusion as a failure case--our approach repurposes occlusion as a detection signal, monitoring whether reference points remain persistently occluded rather than tracking where they move. Our experimental evaluation on 1,069 videos demonstrates that AllTracker achieves 100.00% precision and 93.33% F1 score, significantly outperforming classical sparse tracking methods while maintaining training-free deployment. This approach offers three key advantages: (1) no training data or manual annotations, (2) object-agnostic generalization to arbitrary object types, and (3) significantly reduced development time.

</details>


### [156] [UniVerse: A Unified Modulation Framework for Segmentation-Free,Disentangled Multi-Concept Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00351)
*Quynh Phung,Sandesh Ghimire,Minsi Hu,Chung-Chi Tsai,Jia-Bin Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniVerse提出了一种统一调制框架，无需分割掩码即可在扩散Transformer中实现多概念个性化，通过可组合与可分解的概念提取，在杂乱场景中精准定位和表示目标对象，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化视觉理解方法在输入图像包含多个对象时难以定位和提取特定概念，且多数方法严重依赖分割监督或组合泛化能力差，无法准确解耦和操控单个概念。

Method: 提出UniVerse统一调制框架，采用无分割的多概念个性化方式，将复杂场景分解为概念特定表示，再以统一方式组合，实现可组合与可分解的概念提取，无需显式分割掩码。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，UniVerse在定位精度和视觉保真度方面显著优于现有最先进基线方法。定性和定量结果均证明该方法能够在杂乱场景中精确提取目标概念。

Conclusion: UniVerse为更灵活、可解释、个性化的视觉生成与理解铺平了道路，实现了分割自由、解耦的多概念个性化在扩散Transformer中的应用。

Abstract: Personalized visual understanding has advanced significantly, yet existing approaches struggle to localize and extract specific concepts when input images contain multiple objects. Many prior methods rely heavily on segmentation-based supervision or exhibit poor compositional generalization, limiting their ability to accurately disentangle and manipulate individual concepts. In this work, we propose UniVerse, a Unified Modulation Framework for segmentation-free, disentangled multi-concept personalization in diffusion transformers. Our method allows for composable and decomposable concept extraction, enabling fine-grained localization and representation of target objects without explicit segmentation masks. UniVerse learns to decompose complex scenes into concept-specific representations and then compose them in a unified manner, enabling robust personalization across diverse visual contexts. Through extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, we demonstrate that UniVerse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity. Qualitative and quantitative results show that our approach can precisely extract target concepts in cluttered scenes, paving the way for more flexible, interpretable, and personalized visual generation and understanding.

</details>


### [157] [3D Segment Anything Model with Visual Mamba for Diagnosing Placenta Accreta Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00489)
*Yuliang Zhang,Fang He,Lulu Peng,Tianyu Yan,Pingping Zhang,Ting Song,Lili Du,Dunjin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于MRI的胎盘植入谱系（PAS）数据集，并设计了3DSAMba框架，结合3D SAM、适配器机制、多层级聚合Mamba（MLAM）和融合状态空间模型（FSSM），通过病灶分割实现自动PAS诊断，实验证明该方法显著提升了诊断性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PAS是一种罕见但危险极高的产科疾病，早期准确诊断对产妇健康至关重要。传统诊断依赖经验丰富的医生分析剖宫产史和MRI数据，但地区级医院缺乏相应专业知识和资源，亟需自动化的PAS诊断方法。

Method: 1. 构建首个含细粒度分割和分类标注的MRI-PAS数据集；2. 提出3DSAMba框架：设计3D SAM并引入适配器机制注入医学领域知识；3. 提出多层级聚合Mamba（MLAM）聚合不同层级特征图；4. 提出融合状态空间模型（FSSM）融合编码器和解码器的多尺度特征；5. 通过逐元素乘法将分割掩模应用于原始MRI图像以分离病灶区域。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提出的框架显著提升了PAS诊断性能。

Conclusion: 3DSAMba框架能有效实现PAS自动诊断，已公开数据集和源代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) is a rare but highly dangerous obstetric disease. Early and accurate PAS diagnosis is critical for maternal health. Traditional PAS diagnosis relies on experienced doctors by analyzing the cesarean history and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) data. However, district-level hospitals often lack the expertise and resources for accurate PAS diagnosis. To address these challenges, we establish the first MRI-based PAS dataset, which includes both fine-grained segmentation and classification annotations. Meanwhile, diagnosing PAS can be significantly enhanced by segmenting lesion areas from MRI images of the uterus. To achieve automatic PAS diagnosis, we propose 3DSAMba, a novel feature learning framework for effective lesion segmentation. More specifically, we first design a 3D Segment Anything Model (SAM) and incorporate medical domain information into the model through an efficient adapter mechanism. In addition, we introduce a Multi-Level Aggregation Mamba (MLAM) to aggregate feature maps across different levels and a Fusion State Space Model (FSSM) to fuse multi-scale features from both the encoder and decoder. Finally, we apply segmentation masks to the original MRI images through element-wise multiplication, effectively isolating lesion areas for more accurate PAS diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate that our framework significantly improves the PAS diagnostic performance. To facilitate further research in PAS diagnosis, we have released the dataset and source code at https://github.com/Drchip61/PASD.

</details>


### [158] [ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01348)
*Shangpin Peng,Gengluo Li,Xingyu Wan,Chengquan Zhang,Hao Feng,Binghong Wu,Huawen Shen,Weinong Wang,Ziyi Cai,Zhuotao Tian,Han Hu,Can Ma,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChartArena是一个覆盖8种图表家族、3种视觉场景的双语基准，通过格式无关的评估协议对26个MLLM进行系统评测，揭示了前沿模型在图表解析中的能力差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表解析基准存在三个问题：仅关注窄类型图表、忽略流程图和思维导图等图解结构；模型输出格式不兼容；缺乏打印和手绘等实际场景图像。需要统一基准来系统评估图表解析模型。

Method: 构建包含数值型图表和图解结构的8个图表家族的双语基准，覆盖数字渲染、打印照片、手绘照片三种视觉场景；采用人机协作标注流水线配合多阶段人工验证；设计格式无关的评估协议，将异构输出映射到规范化三元组视图和有向图视图两个规范语义空间，使用结构感知指标评分。

Result: 对26个主流MLLM的广泛评估发现：(i) Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿专有模型整体领先，但最强的开源系统正在快速缩小差距；(ii) 文档解析模型处理数值型图表尚可，但在图解结构上表现明显落后；(iii) 专业图表解析器仍局限于窄类型图表。所有模型在雷达图和手绘场景中表现尤其困难。

Conclusion: ChartArena揭示了当前图表解析模型中清晰的能力差距，为未来进展提供了统一的评估基础。

Abstract: Charts are a primary medium for conveying quantitative and relational information, yet systematically evaluating chart parsing models remains difficult. Existing benchmarks focus on narrow chart types and leave diagrammatic structures such as flowcharts and mind maps largely unaddressed, while models produce outputs in incompatible formats, and datasets rarely include the printed or hand-drawn images encountered in practice. To address these issues, we introduce ChartArena, a comprehensive bilingual benchmark covering eight chart families spanning both numeric charts and diagrammatic structures, each evaluated across three visual scenarios: digital renderings, printed photos, and hand-drawn photos. The dataset is built via a human-agent collaborative annotation pipeline with multi-stage human verification to ensure annotation reliability. To enable fair cross-model comparison, we further design a format-agnostic evaluation protocol that maps heterogeneous outputs into two canonical semantic spaces, a normalized triple view and a directed graph view, and scores them with structure-aware metrics. Through extensive evaluation of 26 leading MLLMs, we observe three consistent findings: (i) frontier proprietary models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro lead overall, yet the strongest open-source systems are rapidly closing the gap; (ii) document parsing models handle numeric charts reasonably but fall sharply behind on diagrammatic structures; and (iii) expert chart parsers remain limited to narrow chart families. Across all models, radar charts and hand-drawn scenarios stay especially challenging. These findings show that ChartArena exposes clear capability gaps and provides a unified foundation for future progress. ChartArena is publicly available at https://github.com/pspdada/ChartArena.

</details>


### [159] [What to Test Next: Interpretable Coverage Gap Discovery in Driving VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01624)
*Abhishek Aich,Sparsh Garg,Vijay Kumar BG,Turgun Yusuf Kashgari,Manmohan Chandraker*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SliceScorer是一种用于缺失场景切片的确定性评分方法，结合曝光度先验和邻域失效先验，优先推荐高风险、未测试区域；SliceNav是基于LLM的验证流水线，利用该评分规则自动编排验证工作流，在三个驾驶VLM上有效发现覆盖漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶VLM在多种ODD条件下的场景理解验证存在严重稀疏性，大量场景切片缺失导致经验性失效率不可靠，亟需一种可解释、可审计、保守的缺失切片推荐方法以支持安全关键验证。

Method: 提出SliceScorer，由两部分组成：(i) 基于曝光度的覆盖先验，优先关注罕见且未充分测试的条件区域；(ii) 邻域失效先验，从相似已测试条件传播风险。在此基础上构建SliceNav，一个LLM编排的验证流水线，接收开发者查询，选择相关操作符（分诊、评分、采集、评估）及词汇扩展，组合成确定性且可审计的验证工作流。

Result: 在WiseAD、DriveMM、Cosmos-Reason2-2B三个驾驶VLM上的实验表明，SliceNav比先前的切片发现方法更有效地发现高风险覆盖漏洞，同时保持条件空间上的推荐多样性。消融实验确认两个评分组件均有贡献，定性分析展示了从开发者查询到目标评估的端到端工作流。

Conclusion: SliceScorer的简设计——可解释、可审计、保守——对于安全关键验证至关重要。SliceNav展示了LLM编排验证流水线的潜力，在保持确定性和可审计性的同时，有效发现ODD内外的高风险覆盖缺口。

Abstract: Driving vision-language models (VLMs) must accurately understand scenes across diverse conditions defined by Operational Design Domains (ODDs), yet verification remains sparse: many slices are missing, making empirical failure rates unreliable. We propose SliceScorer, a deterministic scoring rule for missing-slice recommendation that combines (i) an exposure-based coverage prior to prioritize rare, under-tested regions, and (ii) a neighbor-failure prior that propagates risk from similar tested conditions. SliceScorer is deliberately simple - interpretable, auditable, and conservative - properties essential for safety-critical validation. For stress testing beyond the declared ODD, we embed SliceScorer within SliceNav, an LLM-orchestrated verification pipeline where the model interprets developer queries to select relevant operators (triage, scoring, acquisition, evaluation) and vocabulary extensions, composing verification workflows while keeping all scoring deterministic and auditable. Experiments on three driving VLMs (WiseAD, DriveMM, Cosmos-Reason2-2B) show that SliceNav surfaces high-risk coverage gaps more effectively than prior slice-discovery methods while maintaining diverse recommendations across the condition space. Ablations confirm both scoring components contribute, and qualitative analysis demonstrates end-to-end workflows from developer query to targeted evaluation.

</details>


### [160] [Contrastive Augmented Transformer with Domain-specific Enhancement for Robust Multi-scenario Metal Surface Defect Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01962)
*Yiyao Liu,Wenxiao He,Liyuan Ren,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种对比增强Transformer（CAT）框架，用于金属表面缺陷检测，通过层次化Swin Transformer骨干、重新设计的特征金字塔网络、域特定液滴增强算法和难负样本挖掘策略，解决了标注数据有限、多尺度缺陷检测困难和泛化性差的问题，在多个数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金属表面缺陷检测面临三大挑战：标注数据有限、微小多尺度缺陷难以识别、跨场景泛化能力差，现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。

Method: CAT框架包含四个关键技术：1) 层次化Swin Transformer骨干网络；2) 重新设计的特征金字塔网络，融合低层纹理与高层语义；3) 域特定液滴增强算法提升噪声鲁棒性；4) 对比损失中引入难负样本挖掘策略增强判别能力。

Result: 在KolektorSDD2数据集上达到99.54%的像素级AUROC，超越现有方法；在KSDD1、MTD（瓷砖缺陷）、MSDD（轨道表面缺陷）三个未见数据集上展现出优异的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CAT框架有效解决了金属表面缺陷检测中的多尺度、小样本和泛化性问题，具有广泛的工业部署潜力。

Abstract: Metal surface defect detection is critical for maintaining product quality in industrial manufacturing. However, it faces significant challenges, including limited annotated data, difficulty in identifying subtle multi-scale defects, and poor generalization across diverse scenarios. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Contrastive Augmented Transformer (CAT) framework for robust defect detection. CAT employs a hierarchical Swin Transformer backbone and redesigns the feature pyramid network to effectively fuse low-level textures with high-level semantics, enabling precise modeling of subtle and multi-scale defect patterns. To enhance robustness under real-world noise conditions, we propose a domain-specific droplet augmentation algorithm. Furthermore, we incorporate a hard negative mining strategy into the contrastive loss to strengthen the model's discrimination ability in ambiguous defect regions. Experimental results on the KolektorSDD2 dataset demonstrate that CAT achieves a pixel-level AUROC of 99.54%, outperforming existing methods. In addition, CAT exhibits superior generalization and robustness on three unseen datasets, including KSDD1, MTD for tile defects, and MSDD for rail surface defects, demonstrating its potential for wide-scale industrial deployment.

</details>


### [161] [FocusDiT: Masking Queries in Diffusion Transformers for Fine-grained Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02090)
*Xueji Fang,Liyuan Ma,Jianhao Zeng,Jinjin Cao,Mingyuan Zhou,Guo-Jun Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusDiT提出了一种针对扩散Transformer中FFN层的查询令牌掩码机制，通过聚焦关键查询令牌来提升细粒度视觉生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer中的FFN层作为解码视觉内容的键值词汇表，但并非所有查询令牌都同等重要；关注那些对应复杂细节的关键查询令牌并鼓励模型改进这些令牌，对于细粒度视觉生成至关重要。

Method: 提出FocusDiT，设计一种掩码方案，筛选出关键查询令牌并仅将其送入FFN层，使掩码后的查询能够从FFN词汇表中检索视觉令牌并解码视觉细节。

Result: 在文本到图像生成任务上的大量实验验证了令牌掩码机制在提升生成性能方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过聚焦关键查询令牌而非所有令牌，可以有效提升扩散Transformer在细粒度视觉生成任务中的表现。

Abstract: Diffusion transformer (DiT) has been widely adopted in the generative diffusion field, advancing the denoising of query tokens through attention and Feed-Forward (\text{FFN}) layers. FFN actually acts as the key-value vocabulary for decoding visual contents where the value embeds the visual semantical knowledge. We present that focusing on critical query tokens corresponding to more complex details and encouraging the model to improve these tokens is essential for fine-grained visual generation. To this end, we propose FocusDiT, which applies a Masking scheme to focus on critical query tokens that are exclusively fed into FFN. The masked queries can retrieve visual tokens from the FFN vocabularies, and use them to decode their visual details. Extensive text-to-image experiments validate the effectiveness of token masking in enhancing generative performance.

</details>


### [162] [X-Stream: Exploring MLLMs as Multiplexers for Multi-Stream Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02482)
*Peiwen Sun,Xudong Lu,Huadai Liu,Yang Bo,Dongming Wu,Huankang Guan,Minghong Cai,Jinpeng Chen,Xintong Guo,Shuhan Li,Fang Liu,Rui Liu,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出X-Stream基准，首个专注多流在线视频理解的评估体系，包含4220个QA对和932个视频，覆盖多窗口/多视角/多设备场景。通过双验证流水线构建数据，基于信号复用理论评估MLLM作为朴素复用器的性能，发现当前最先进模型仅达约50%得分，缺乏主动能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准局限于单流范式，无法评估真实应用（如体育直播、自动驾驶、多屏协作）中所需的连续多流交互推理能力。

Method: 1) 构建包含4220个QA对/932个视频的基准数据集，覆盖11个子任务和三种场景；2) 采用双验证流水线避免对单流的过度依赖；3) 基于信号复用理论将MLLM概念化为朴素复用器进行系统评估。

Result: 最先进的MLLM在处理并发多流时表现挣扎，仅达约50%得分，且主动能力差。

Conclusion: X-Stream揭示了当前复用方案的权衡，为下一代多流智能体提供了评估协议和实证指导。

Abstract: While video streaming understanding has made significant strides, real-world applications, such as live sports broadcasting, autonomous driving, and multi-screen collaboration, inherently demand continuous, multi-stream interactions. However, existing benchmarks are confined to single-stream paradigms, leaving a critical gap in evaluating online, cross-stream reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce X-Stream, the first benchmark dedicated to multi-stream streaming understanding. Comprising 4,220 rigorously curated QA pairs across 932 videos, X-Stream evaluates 11 subtasks across multi-window, multi-view, and multi-device scenarios. Crucially, our dataset is constructed using a novel dual-verification pipeline that prevents over-reliance on a single stream. Furthermore, we pioneer the conceptualization of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) as naive multiplexers, systematically evaluating their performance through the lens of Signal Multiplexing Theory. Our extensive online inference experiments reveal a stark reality: state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle significantly with concurrent streams, achieving only about 50% score and exhibiting poor proactive ability. Ultimately, X-Stream exposes the trade-off of current multiplexing schemes, providing both a practical evaluation protocol and empirical guidance for next-generation multi-stream agents.

</details>


### [163] [Optimizing Neuro-Fuzzy and Colonial Competition Algorithms for Skin Cancer Diagnosis in Dermatoscopic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08886)
*Hamideh Khaleghpour,Brett McKinney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究融合图像处理技术与机器学习算法（神经模糊和殖民竞争方法），在ISIC数据库的560张皮肤镜图像上实现了94%的准确率，旨在辅助临床医生早期检测黑色素瘤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤癌发病率上升，公众认知有限且临床专业知识不足，亟需先进的诊断辅助工具。

Method: 采用图像处理技术与机器学习算法（神经模糊和殖民竞争方法）融合，应用于ISIC数据库的皮肤镜图像。

Result: 在560张图像的数据集上实现了94%的准确率。

Conclusion: 该方法在辅助临床医生早期检测黑色素瘤方面具有潜力，可为皮肤癌诊断做出重要贡献。

Abstract: The rising incidence of skin cancer, coupled with limited public awareness and a shortfall in clinical expertise, underscores an urgent need for advanced diagnostic aids. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool in this domain, particularly for distinguishing malignant from benign skin lesions. Leveraging publicly available datasets of skin lesions, researchers have been developing AI-based diagnostic solutions. However, the integration of such computer systems in clinical settings is still nascent. This study aims to bridge this gap by employing a fusion of image processing techniques and machine learning algorithms, specifically neuro-fuzzy and colonial competition approaches. Applied to dermoscopic images from the ISIC database, our method achieved a notable accuracy of 94% on a dataset of 560 images. These results underscore the potential of our approach in aiding clinicians in the early detection of melanoma, thereby contributing significantly to skin cancer diagnostics.

</details>

### [164] [Fairness Definitions and Metrics in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Drug Discovery in Healthcare: A Rapid Evidence Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02902)
*Esmaeil Shakeri,Ronnie de Souza Santos,Behrouz Far*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过快速证据综述，系统梳理了深度强化学习（DRL）在分子从头设计中的公平性定义、度量方法及评估框架，重点关注数据集组成与划分策略、奖励函数设计如何影响偏差产生或缓解，并提出了涵盖癌症与非癌症适应症、癌症亚型间以及理化性质、化学类型多样性、毒性、合成可及性等多维度的公平性指标集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管DRL越来越多地应用于从头分子设计，但数据、奖励函数和评估方式的选择在不同疾病领域和化学类型间可能产生不均衡的性能表现，而目前缺乏关于公平性如何定义、度量与检验的简明综述。

Method: 采用快速证据综述方法，检索2017年以来的生物医学、计算机科学和工程学文献数据库及arXiv，使用PRISMA式流程筛选记录，并通过内容编码分析将报告的公平性结果与数据集和奖励函数选择关联起来。

Result: 提供了DRL分子生成中公平性定义与度量的简洁框架，包括数据集组成与划分策略（特别是骨架划分与随机划分）对评估和分布偏移的影响、奖励设计（如QED、对接、毒性、合成可及性）如何创造或缓解偏差、以及涵盖多维度（癌症与非癌症、癌症亚型间、理化性质分布平衡、化学类型多样性、分组成效、毒性、合成可及性）的可度量指标。

Conclusion: 该综述为DRL分子生成提供了公平性定义与度量的简明集合，给出了报告分布公平性和结果公平性的实用指导，总结了数据集和奖励函数选择与观察到的公平性效应之间的关系，并指出了与可信赖、癌症相关的DRL分子生成相关的未解决空白。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is increasingly applied to de novo molecular design, but choices in data, rewards, and evaluation can yield uneven performance across disease areas and chemotypes. Despite this, there is no concise synthesis of how fairness is defined, measured, and tested in DRL-based drug discovery. In this rapid evidence review, we synthesize fairness definitions and metrics for DRL-driven molecule generation in healthcare.
