We focus on three questions: (i) how dataset composition and split strategies, especially scaffold versus random splits, affect evaluation and distribution shift; (ii) how reward design (e.g., QED, docking, toxicity, synthetic accessibility) can create or mitigate bias, with emphasis on cancer targets; and (iii) which measurable metrics best capture fairness. This includes parity across cancer versus non-cancer indications and across cancer subtypes. It also includes distributional balance in key physicochemical descriptors, scaffold/chemotype diversity, groupwise validity, toxicity, and synthetic accessibility. From 2017 onward, we searched major biomedical, computer science, and engineering literature databases and used arXiv for horizon scanning. Records were screened using PRISMA-style procedures and analyzed via content coding to link reported parity outcomes to dataset and reward choices. Our review provides a concise set of fairness definitions and metrics for DRL molecule generation. It offers practical guidance for reporting distribution parity and outcome parity. It also summarizes how dataset and reward choices relate to observed parity effects and identifies open gaps relevant to trustworthy, cancer-relevant DRL generation.

</details>


### [165] [The Fair Lending Model: How the Longest-Running Algorithmic Fairness Programs Work in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02957)
*Emily Black,Miranda Bogen,Logan Koepke,Solon Barocas,Wesley Deng,Mingwei Hsu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过对35位公平贷款生态系统参与者的半结构化访谈，首次实证揭示了美国金融机构在实践中如何测试和缓解算法歧视，发现公平贷款法规的监管设计（尤其是监管审查）在塑造机构公平实践方面发挥了独特且成功的作用，这种设计特征与其他民权法领域及当前算法歧视政策提案截然不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管美国金融机构执行公平贷款法律已有数十年历史，但关于这些合规要求在实践中的运作方式几乎无人知晓。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供关于金融机构如何在地面上测试和缓解算法歧视的首个实证描述。

Method: 基于对公平贷款生态系统参与者的35次半结构化访谈，进行定性实证研究。

Result: 1) 金融机构拥有在其他领域基本缺失的公平实践底线（旨在防止贷款歧视）；2) 企业在测试歧视和寻找较少歧视性算法方面的具体做法差异很大；3) 监管审查（公平贷款检查）是合规工作的关键驱动因素；4) 公平贷款项目的实际影响取决于能否妥善应对商业激励、法律张力与监管不确定性。

Conclusion: 监管监督权在成功培育公平贷款实践方面发挥了独特作用，这一监管设计特征区别于其他民权法领域，且在当前的算法歧视政策提案中几乎完全缺失。

Abstract: U.S. financial institutions subject to fair lending laws have been running algorithmic fairness programs for decades. Despite this long history, remarkably little is known about how these requirements operate in practice. In this paper, we offer the first empirical account of how financial institutions test for and mitigate algorithmic discrimination on the ground. In doing so, we shed light on how the regulatory design of fair lending law and regulation have shaped the policies, processes, and practices of fair lending programs. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with participants across the fair lending ecosystem, we find that while financial institutions have a floor of fairness practices aimed at preventing discrimination in lending largely absent in other domains, the specifics of how firms test for discrimination and search for less discriminatory algorithms varies widely. We also find that regulatory supervision via fair lending examinations has been the key driver of compliance work, but that the practical impact of fair lending programs often depends on how well they can navigate competing business incentives, perceived legal tensions, and regulatory uncertainty. Ultimately, our findings highlight the unique role that supervisory authority has played in successfully fostering fair lending practices -- a regulatory design feature that is distinct from other areas of civil rights law and almost completely absent from recent policy proposals for dealing with algorithmic discrimination.

</details>


### [166] [Reproducibility is the New Copyleft: Defining AGI-oriented Reproducible Builds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03019)
*Masayuki Hatta*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了Copyleft许可证（如GPL）依赖源码与目标码之间可审计、可复现关系的技术前提，而大语言模型和AGI系统系统性破坏该前提。作者提出AGI时代的Copyleft功能等价物应基于可复现构建（reproducible builds），而非代码的分享即共享条款，并定义了七项要求。同时指出MCP等AI间耦合机制构成新型动态链接层，更适合采用"协议而非平台"的治理框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Copyleft许可证的技术基础（源码与目标码的可审计、可复现关系）被LLM和AGI系统破坏，需要为AGI时代寻找新的功能等价物。

Method: 1) 逻辑分析Copyleft的技术前提及其被AI系统破坏的方式；2) 批判性审视Maffulli的"第二次解放"论题；3) 基于OSAID、MOF、OpenMDW、确定性推理研究等现有框架，定义AGI可复现构建的七项要求；4) 分析MCP等AI耦合机制对Copyleft的挑战，引入Masnick的"协议而非平台"框架。

Result: AGI时代的Copyleft功能等价物必须基于可复现构建（bit-exact reconstructability），而非代码的share-alike条款；提出了七项AGI可复现构建要求；指出MCP等构成新型动态链接层，Copyleft许可证不适用。

Conclusion: Maffulli的"AGI实现Stallman梦想"论成立的前提是AGI本身可复现；面向AGI的开源治理需要转向以可复现构建为核心的框架，并结合"协议而非平台"的治理模板。

Abstract: Copyleft, as implemented in licenses such as the GNU General Public License, was a legal hack that used copyright to guarantee user freedom by tying the availability of source code to every act of distribution. Its normative force rested on an implicit technical premise: that source code and object code stand in a well-defined, humanly auditable, and reproducible relationship. Large language models and, prospectively, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) systems systematically violate this premise. The artifacts jointly required to reconstruct a model -- code, data, weights, hyperparameters, toolchain, and hardware configuration -- are each subject to independent legal, technical, and economic constraints that no current open-source framework fully resolves. Sufficiently capable AI systems can also rewrite licensed source into functionally equivalent derivatives stripped of their original obligations, a form of laundering against which copyleft has no effective defense. This paper argues that a functional analogue of copyleft for AGI must be grounded not in share-alike clauses over code, but in reproducible builds: a practice guaranteeing bit-exact reconstructability from declared inputs. We review the logic of copyleft, critically examine Maffulli's Second Liberation thesis according to which AI fulfills Stallman's dream, and show that the argument collapses unless AGI systems are themselves reproducible. Drawing on the Open Source AI Definition (OSAID), the Model Openness Framework (MOF), OpenMDW, and deterministic-inference research, we define seven requirements for AGI-oriented reproducible builds. We further argue that the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and analogous AI-to-AI coupling mechanisms constitute a new dynamic linking layer for which copyleft-style licensing is ill-suited, and that Masnick's "protocols, not platforms" framework offers a more promising governance template.

</details>


### [167] [Auditing Engagement Incentives in the Kidfluencer Ecosystem: A Multimodal Weak Supervision Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03173)
*Zijing Wei,Chao Peter Yang,Xuanjie Chen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究对YouTube上79个kidfluencer频道的5,051个视频进行多模态AI审计，利用弱监督方法检测儿童数字劳工剥削信号。研究发现，表演性劳动、情感诱饵和隐私侵犯与高观看量显著相关（剥削得分每增加1单位，观看量增加4.4倍），而传统商业内容（产品植入）无此效应，表明平台奖励机制系统性地与儿童身份和劳动的商品化挂钩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: YouTube上"儿童网红"现象引发了对儿童数字劳工和剥削的伦理担忧，尽管新兴立法试图监管这一生态，但由于大规模操作化剥削的困难，将剥削与参与度联系起来的实证证据仍然稀缺。

Method: 对79个kidfluencer频道的5,051个视频进行多模态AI审计；使用弱监督方法（基于LLM的标题分类、GPT-4 Vision对缩略图和描述的六维度分析）生成概率性剥削评分；通过多标注者验证研究（N=107）确认结果；采用混合效应回归和通道内分析进行统计检验。

Result: 剥削评分与观看量显著相关（Spearman ρ=0.229, p<10⁻⁵⁰）；剥削评分每增加1单位，观看量增加4.4倍（p<0.001）；情感诱饵和表演性内容分别带来65.6%和56.0%的中位观看量提升（FDR校正p<0.001）；产品植入无显著效应（-3.8%, n.s.）；模型与人类判断高度一致（宏平均F1=0.911）。

Conclusion: 平台奖励机制系统性地与儿童的身份和劳动的密集商品化（表演性劳动、情感诱饵、隐私侵犯）挂钩，而非传统广告形式；现有仅聚焦于财务信托的政策框架面临挑战。

Abstract: The rise of `kidfluencers' on YouTube has raised ethical concerns about child digital labor and exploitation. While emerging legislation attempts to regulate this ecosystem, empirical evidence linking exploitation to engagement remains scarce, given the difficulty of operationalizing exploitation at scale. This study presents a multimodal AI audit of 5,051 videos across 79 kidfluencer channels, using weak supervision to detect exploitation signals without large-scale manual labels. We aggregate noisy labeling functions -- including LLM-based classification of titles and GPT-4 Vision analysis of thumbnails and descriptions across six literature-grounded dimensions -- to assign a probabilistic exploitation score to each video. A multi-annotator validation study (N=107) shows strong agreement with human judgment (macro-average F1 $= 0.911$) and high sensitivity for overall exploitation risk (recall $= 0.960$, F1 $= 0.793$).
  Our findings reveal a significant engagement premium for performative labor, emotional bait, and privacy violations. Exploitation scores correlate with view counts (Spearman $ρ= 0.229$, $p < 10^{-50}$), and mixed-effects regression controlling for channel-level variation shows that a one-unit increase in exploitation score yields a $4.4\times$ increase in views ($p < 0.001$). Within-channel analyses indicate median view boosts of $+65.6\%$ for emotional bait and $+56.0\%$ for performative content (FDR-corrected $p<0.001$), with effects holding in same-year robustness checks ($p=0.030$). Explicit commercial content (product placement), by contrast, shows no premium ($-3.8\%$, n.s.), suggesting the platform rewards commodification of the child's identity and labor over traditional advertising. These findings challenge policy frameworks focused solely on financial trusts, showing that engagement is systematically tied to the intensive, performative labor of children.

</details>


### [168] [AI-Generated Traces for Novice Programmers: Learning Effects and Learner Differences in a Multi-Institutional Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03288)
*Yuri Noviello,Naaz Sibia,Anastasiia Birillo,Thomas Overklift Vaupel Klein,Michael Liut,Gosia Migut*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出生成式动画追踪（GATs）——基于AI生成的类比叙事动画，用于协调源代码、执行状态与概念类比。在两个CS1课程（Python N=961, Java N=151）中研究发现，GATs相比纯文本解释能带来选择性即时学习收益，但效果取决于上下文且为短期；同时学习者参与度特征调节了GATs对表现的影响，凸显个性化方法的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CS1课程常难以帮助学生理解程序执行过程；可视化虽能显式展示执行流程，但其有效性受设计与上下文影响，且AI生成可视化缺乏实证证据。

Method: 提出GATs（生成式动画追踪），即AI生成的、基于类比、带叙事的动画，协调源代码、执行状态与概念类比。在两个机构CS1课程中开展对比研究（Python N=961, Java N=151），比较GATs与纯文本解释的效果。

Result: GATs对即时学习有选择性收益，但效果是上下文依赖且短期的；GATs对表现的影响受到学习者参与度特征的调节。

Conclusion: GATs能带来有限的即时学习收益，但效益短暂且依赖上下文；学习者的参与度特征显著调节其效果，说明需要个性化教学方法。

Abstract: Introductory programming (CS1) courses often struggle to support students' understanding of program execution. While visualizations can make execution processes explicit, their effectiveness depends on design and context, and empirical evidence for AI-generated visualizations remains limited. We propose Generated Animated Traces (GATs), AI-generated, analogy-based, narrated animations that coordinate source code, execution state, and conceptual analogies. We conduct a study at two institutions in CS1 courses (Python, N=961; Java N=151) comparing GATs to textual explanations. We measure immediate learning performance and experience, end-of-course engagement and exam performance. Results show that GATs can yield selective benefits for immediate learning, but benefits are context-dependent and short-term. We observe that GATs' influence on performance is moderated by learner engagement profiles. This finding underscores the importance of personalized approaches.

</details>


### [169] [Pushing the Limits: A Framework to Reform Institutional Ethics Review of Environmentally-Impactful Computing Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03547)
*Nicolas Gold,Ross Purves*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出将计算密集型研究（CIR）纳入机构伦理审查范围的标准与方法，以应对其环境影响缺乏审查的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算密集型研究（包括AI）的环境影响显著，但常常未被纳入机构伦理审查政策的范围，导致研究者缺乏反思，审查者缺少指导标准。

Method: 提出CIR纳入伦理审查的界定标准、供审查者应用的证据标准，以及帮助研究者反思其研究环境影响的评估方法。

Result: 形成了一套覆盖政策界定、审查标准与研究者自我反思的三层框架。

Conclusion: 通过将CIR的环境影响纳入伦理审查范畴，可以推动研究者在行星边界约束下进行更具反思性的研究实践。

Abstract: Computationally-intensive research (CIR) takes place on a wide variety of topics including AI. Its environmental impact is potentially significant yet it does not always fall clearly within the scope of organisational ethics review policy on its own merits. Many academic institutions have ethics oversight bodies (e.g. Research Ethics Committees or Institutional Review Boards) that occupy a potentially powerful position to encourage recognition of these issues and seek reflexive practice in researchers. However, policies are often poorly-defined in respect of environmental issues and thus research is not reviewed, reviewers have little guidance for legitimate critique, and researchers are not challenged to consider planetary limits on computing resources and the interaction of these with their research. This paper aims to address these problems by proposing scoping criteria for institutional ethics policy to bring CIR within the scope of ethics review on its own merits, framing evidential criteria for reviewers to apply in ethics review, and presenting a method by which CIR researchers can reflect on their proposed research in relation to environmental factors, and assess its potential value in the light of planetary limits.

</details>


### [170] [Designing a Hardware Reverse Engineering Course: Lessons from Eight Years in a Rapidly Evolving Tech Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03697)
*Zehra Karadağ,René Walendy,Carina Wiesen,Christof Paar,Nikol Rummel,Steffen Becker*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了欧洲某研究型大学针对本科生开设的硬件逆向工程（HRE）课程，该课程历经2017-2025年九次迭代，专注于数字电路分析与提取，并总结了课程组织、内容和作业演变的经验教训，为快速发展的技术领域课程设计提供了可操作的建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成电路的全球化制造存在供应链安全威胁，硬件逆向工程（HRE）是检测威胁、重建信任的关键技术，但缺乏相关教育项目导致领域专家稀缺，亟需通过课程设计培养人才。

Method: 在欧洲某研究型大学面向大三本科生开设HRE课程，涵盖数字电路分析与提取，经过2017-2025年九次迭代不断优化课程组织、内容和作业设计。

Result: 课程迭代后多名校友进入HRE领域从业；提炼出课程演变的经验教训，形成适用于快速发展技术领域的课程设计原则，强调迭代增长和可持续的工作量管理。

Conclusion: 该课程的长期迭代实践验证了其有效性，总结的设计优先级可为其他快速演进技术领域的教育者提供参考，核心在于平衡迭代优化与师生工作量可持续性。

Abstract: Integrated Circuits (ICs) are omnipresent, yet their globalized manufacturing process remains vulnerable to supply chain threats. Hardware Reverse Engineering (HRE) is essential for detecting such threats and re-establishing trust; however domain experts remain scarce due to a lack of educational programs. To contribute educational insights in this critical and rapidly evolving technology domain, we present our HRE course focusing on digital circuit analysis and digital circuit extraction from ICs. The course targets junior-level undergraduates at a major European research university. The curriculum has been refined over nine iterations (2017-2025), with several alumni subsequently pursuing careers in the HRE field. By reflecting on the evolution of the course organization, content, and assignments, we derive key lessons learned. We further distill these insights into actionable design priorities for educators developing courses in rapidly evolving technological domains, emphasizing iterative growth and sustainable workload management for both students and instructors.

</details>


### [171] [LLMs, Reasoning and Plagiarism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02380)
*Elchanan Mossel*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文质疑LLM具备人类级通用智能和科学推理能力的说法，指出这些主张与"推理"和"抄袭"两种叙事相矛盾，因训练数据和交互过程不透明而无法满足波普尔的可证伪性原则，并提出提高透明度和可重复性的指导方针。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于LLM能否真正进行科学推理并产生新知识的争论日益激烈，但缺乏可验证的评估方法。

Method: 从哲学和科学方法论的视角，分析"推理"与"抄袭"两种叙事之间的张力，指出模型不透明性导致无法满足波普尔可证伪性原则。

Result: LLM推理的主张在现有条件下无法被科学方法严格检验和证伪。

Conclusion: 提出透明度和可重复性指南，指出推理叙事主导地位在实践中助长了科研抄袭，并讨论应对措施。

Abstract: Recent reports claim that Large Language Models (LLMs) derive new science and exhibit human-level general intelligence. Such claims are entangled with two different narratives about what LLMs do: one in which they are an engine of synthesis that genuinely reasons to new knowledge, and one in which they retrieve and re-emit the work of others without attribution. In the scientific setting these are best understood as a contrast between \emph{reasoning} and \emph{plagiarism}. Finding where the truth lies between these two narratives is very challenging, as central components of the model -- the training data and the interaction transcript -- remain opaque. Thus claims of LLM reasoning do not satisfy Popper's refutability principle. We propose guidelines for transparency and reproducibility that will allow reasoning claims to be studied using the scientific method. The dominance of the reasoning narrative, we suggest, is in practice encouraging plagiarism in the scientific literature; we discuss what might be done about it.

</details>


### [172] [Legal Alignment for Safe and Ethical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04175)
*Noam Kolt,Nicholas Caputo,Jack Boeglin,Cullen O'Keefe,Rishi Bommasani,Stephen Casper,Mariano-Florentino Cuéllar,Noah Feldman,Iason Gabriel,Gillian K. Hadfield,Lewis Hammond,Peter Henderson,Atoosa Kasirzadeh,Seth Lazar,Anka Reuel,Kevin L. Wei,Jonathan Zittrain*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了新兴的"法律对齐"领域，探讨如何利用法律规则、原则和方法解决AI对齐问题，提出了三条核心研究路径：法律规则合规、法律解释方法借鉴、法律概念作为结构蓝图，并指出了相关的概念、实证和制度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI对齐研究忽视了法律这一重要的知识来源和实践经验，本文旨在填补这一空白，系统化研究如何将法律用于解决AI对齐问题。

Method: 本文采用综述方法，对法律对齐领域的研究进行系统分类和整理，提出三条核心研究路径的 taxonomy，并探讨每条路径的实践操作化方式。

Result: 提出了法律对齐的三条核心研究路径：(1) 使AI系统遵守合法机构制定的法律规则；(2) 借鉴法律解释方法指导AI推理和决策；(3) 利用法律概念作为应对AI系统中可靠性、信任和合作挑战的结构性蓝图。

Conclusion: 法律对齐研究提出了新的概念、实证和制度问题，需要法律、计算机科学等多学科协作，为设计更好AI提供合作机会。

Abstract: Alignment of artificial intelligence (AI) encompasses the normative problem of specifying how AI systems should act and the technical problem of ensuring AI systems comply with those specifications. To date, AI alignment has generally overlooked an important source of knowledge and practice for grappling with these problems: law. In this paper, we survey the emerging field of legal alignment that aims to fill this gap and systematize research that studies how legal rules, principles, and methods can be leveraged to address problems of alignment and inform the design of AI systems that operate safely and ethically. Our survey provides a taxonomy of the three core research pathways of legal alignment and explores how each can be operationalized in practice: (1) designing AI systems to comply with the content of legal rules developed through legitimate institutions and processes, (2) adapting methods from legal interpretation to guide how AI systems reason and make decisions, and (3) harnessing legal concepts as a structural blueprint for confronting challenges of reliability, trust, and cooperation in AI systems. These research pathways present new conceptual, empirical, and institutional questions, which include examining the specific set of laws that particular AI systems should follow, creating evaluations to assess their legal compliance in real-world settings, and developing governance frameworks to support the implementation of legal alignment in practice. Tackling these questions requires expertise across law, computer science, and other disciplines, offering these communities the opportunity to collaborate in designing AI for the better.

</details>


### [173] [The Dynamic and Endogenous Behavior of Re-Offense Risk: An Agent-Based Simulation Study of Treatment Allocation in Incarceration Diversion Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12441)
*Chuwen Zhang,Pengyi Shi,Amy Ward*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出将再犯风险评估视为人-系统交互的动态框架，通过基于美国缓刑数据校准的智能体仿真发现：没有单一的优先分配策略绝对占优，低风险优先在长期视角下更有效，高风险优先在短期或监禁导致监控期缩短时更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风险评估工具将再犯风险视为静态个体属性，忽略了风险随时间演化的动态性以及治疗决策通过社会交互影响结果的过程，导致政策制定缺乏系统性视角。

Method: 构建人-系统交互框架，将个体行为与系统层面动态和内生社区反馈联系起来；基于美国缓刑数据校准的智能体仿真，在不同容量约束和监禁设置下评估治疗分配政策。

Result: 没有单一优先分配策略在所有条件下占优；低风险优先在长期轨迹重要时表现更好，高风险优先在短期或监禁导致监控期缩短时更有效。

Conclusion: 应将基于风险的决策系统视为具有长期问责性的社会技术系统来评估，而非孤立的预测工具。

Abstract: Incarceration-diversion treatment programs aim to improve societal reintegration and reduce recidivism, but limited capacity forces policymakers to make prioritization decisions that often rely on risk assessment tools. While predictive, these tools typically treat risk as a static, individual attribute, which overlooks how risk evolves over time and how treatment decisions shape outcomes through social interactions. In this paper, we develop a new framework that models reoffending risk as a human-system interaction, linking individual behavior with system-level dynamics and endogenous community feedback. Using an agent-based simulation calibrated to U.S. probation data, we evaluate treatment allocation policies under different capacity constraints and incarceration settings. Our results show that no single prioritization policy dominates. Instead, policy effectiveness depends on temporal windows and system parameters: prioritizing low-risk individuals performs better when long-term trajectories matter, while prioritizing high-risk individuals becomes more effective in the short term or when incarceration leads to shorter monitoring periods. These findings highlight the need to evaluate risk-based decision systems as sociotechnical systems with long-term accountability, rather than as isolated predictive tools.

</details>


### [174] [Toward Third-Party Assurance of AI Systems: Design Requirements, Prototype, and Early Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22424)
*Rachel M. Kim,Blaine Kuehnert,Alice Lai,Kenneth Holstein,Hoda Heidari,Rayid Ghani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种第三方AI保证框架，包含责任分配矩阵、访谈协议、成熟度矩阵和保证报告模板，并通过两个实际用例和六次专家访谈验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估资源缺乏端到端、可操作的全流程评估方法，且鲜少兼顾AI系统设计开发部署过程与其产出结果，因此需要一套系统性、透明且可操作的第三方保证框架，以避免利益冲突并确保可信度与问责性。

Method: 首先区分保证与审计的关键维度；然后基于设计原则反思现有资源缺陷，提出设计需求；构建包含四个组件的原型框架：责任分配矩阵、利益相关者访谈协议、成熟度矩阵、保证报告模板；最后通过两个AI用例（企业文档标记工具、公共住房资源分配工具）和六次专家验证访谈进行初步验证。

Result: 初步验证表明该框架在两种不同组织情境下均具备合理性与全面性、可用性，并能有效识别AI系统的定制化问题。

Conclusion: 该第三方AI保证框架填补了现有AI评估资源在端到端可操作流程方面的空白，初步验证支持其在不同场景下的适用性和有效性，但尚需进一步大规模验证。

Abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems proliferate, the need for systematic, transparent, and actionable processes for evaluating them is growing. While many resources exist to support AI evaluation, they have several limitations. Few address both the process of designing, developing, and deploying an AI system and the outcomes it produces. Furthermore, few are end-to-end and operational, give actionable guidance, or present evidence of usability or effectiveness in practice. In this paper, we introduce a third-party AI assurance framework that addresses these gaps. We focus on third-party assurance to prevent conflict of interest and ensure credibility and accountability of the process. We begin by distinguishing assurance from audits in several key dimensions. Then, following design principles, we reflect on the shortcomings of existing resources to identify a set of design requirements for AI assurance. We then construct a prototype of an assurance process that consists of (1) a responsibility assignment matrix to determine the different levels of involvement each stakeholder has at each stage of the AI lifecycle, (2) an interview protocol for each stakeholder of an AI system, (3) a maturity matrix to assess AI systems' adherence to best practices, and (4) a template for an assurance report that draws from more mature assurance practices in business accounting. We conduct early validation of our AI assurance framework by applying the framework to two distinct AI use cases -- a business document tagging tool for downstream processing in a large private firm, and a housing resource allocation tool in a public agency -- and conducting six expert validation interviews. Our findings show early evidence that our AI assurance framework is sound and comprehensive, usable across different organizational contexts, and effective at identifying bespoke issues with AI systems.

</details>


### [175] [Question Type, Cognitive Load, and CEFR Alignment: Evaluating LLM-Generated EFL Grammar Drill Exercises](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01592)
*Steve Woollaston,Brendan Flanagan,Yuko Toyokawa,Hiroaki Ogata*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究评估了LLM生成英语作为外语（EFL）学习内容的教学可行性。通过分析日本初中生在语法练习应用上的日志数据，发现不同题目模态（多项选择、拖拽、完形填空）对学生表现有显著影响，并验证了CEFR-J语法框架的难度层级。结果表明LLM能成功生成学习内容，但开发者需策略性地安排题目模态以引导学生从被动识别过渡到主动语言产出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM生成EFL学习内容的教学可行性，并评估不同题目模态对学生表现的影响以及CEFR-J难度层级的准确性。

Method: 利用日本初中生在语法练习应用上的日志数据，分析多项选择、完形填空和拖拽三种题目模态对学生表现的影响，并验证CEFR-J语法框架的难度预测准确性。

Result: 多项选择题认知负荷最低，完形填空对主动回忆阻碍最大，拖拽练习时间成本最高；CEFR-J框架得到验证，随着熟练度提高，准确率下降、响应时间增加。

Conclusion: LLM能够成功生成学习内容，但开发者需要策略性地安排题目模态，以引导学生从被动识别逐步过渡到主动语言产出。

Abstract: This study evaluates the pedagogical viability of LLM-generated English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learning content. Utilising log data from Japanese junior high school students practicing on a grammar drilling application, we analysed how different question modalities impact student performance and whether theoretical localised CEFR difficulty tiers accurately predict empirical task difficulty. Results reveal a clear performance hierarchy: multiple-choice questions carried the lowest cognitive load, cloze tasks posed the greatest barrier to active recall, and drag-and-drop exercises incurred the heaviest time penalties. Furthermore, learner data validated the CEFR-J grammar framework, showing a steady decline in accuracy and increased response times as proficiency levels advanced. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can successfully generate learning content, while highlighting the need for developers to strategically sequence question modalities to transition learners from passive recognition to active linguistic production.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [176] [Human-in-the-Loop Contextual Bandits for Short-Term Rental Dynamic Pricing: Structural Equivalence of Historical Warm-Up and Approval-Gated Live Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02595)
*Oleg Miroshnichenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HITL-GB框架，通过人类介入的上下文赌博机算法解决短租市场动态定价问题，利用历史定价数据（等同于同策略预热数据）将冷启动周期从约150个回合压缩至约30个回合，并论证该结构等价性可推广至任何需要人类监督的高风险领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短租市场中在线学习算法面临定价风险高、需要可解释性、市场反馈稀疏（每夜仅一次预订结果）等挑战，纯在线赌博机学习的冷启动周期过长（数周至数月），不适用于稀疏反馈市场。

Method: 提出HITL-GB框架：上下文赌博机算法生成价格建议，人类代理保留接受、修改或拒绝建议的权限。核心发现：在审批约束下，历史定价数据（先前确定性策略下收集）在结构上等价于同策略预热数据，可用于初始化赌博机的后验分布。形式化定义了审批门控奖励信号，推导了基于正则化岭回归的历史回合预热程序。

Result: 在真实STR生产数据上（匿名城市市场，2间房源，2022年4月至2026年4月，1,461个夜间定价回合）验证：预热程序将HF-TS系列智能体的有效冷启动从约150个回合压缩至约30个回合。

Conclusion: 该结构等价性结果是领域无关的：任何需要人类审批的高风险领域（临床药物剂量、信贷发放、内容审核、放射诊断）均满足相同条件并受益于同一预热策略。在受监管行业中，强制性人类监督因此是一种统计资产而非部署约束。

Abstract: Dynamic pricing in short-term rental (STR) markets presents a distinctive challenge for online learning algorithms: pricing decisions carry significant financial risk, operators require explainability, and market feedback is sparse (one booking outcome per listed night). We introduce the Human-in-the-Loop Gated Bandit (HITL-GB) framework, in which a contextual bandit algorithm generates price recommendations but a human agent retains authority to accept, modify, or reject each recommendation before it is applied. We show that under this approval constraint, historical pricing data -- collected under a prior deterministic policy -- is structurally equivalent to on-policy warm-up data for initialising the bandit's posterior, bypassing the weeks-to-months cold-start period that renders pure online bandit learning impractical in sparse-feedback markets. We formalise the approval-gated reward signal, derive a regularised ridge-regression warm-up procedure from historical episodes, and validate the approach on real STR production data (anonymised urban market, 2 rooms, April 2022 -- April 2026, 1,461 nightly pricing episodes). Our warm-up procedure compresses effective cold-start from ~150 episodes to ~30 episodes when initialising agents from the Hierarchical Factored Thompson Sampling (HF-TS) family. We further argue that the structural equivalence result is domain-agnostic: any high-stakes domain where human approval is legally or operationally required -- including clinical drug dosing, credit origination, content moderation, and radiological diagnosis -- satisfies the same conditions and benefits from the same warm-up strategy. In regulated industries, mandatory human oversight is thus a statistical asset rather than a deployment constraint.

</details>


### [177] [Learning to See via Epiretinal Implant Stimulation in silico with Model-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03118)
*Jacob Lavoie,Marwan Besrour,William Lemaire,Jean Rouat,Réjean Fontaine,Eric Plourde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在强化学习框架rlretina中，利用各向同性和各向异性形状（模拟视网膜电刺激产生的光幻视）进行笔画式图像渲染，训练深度强化学习智能体生成更易识别的图像，为改善人工视觉假体效果提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜疾病（如黄斑变性、视网膜色素变性）导致感光层退化，现有视网膜上植入物电刺激产生的视觉形状是沿轴突束方向拉长的各向异性形状（类似笔画），影响视觉质量。虽可通过避开轴突束刺激获得各向同性像素点，但会减少可用电极数量。因此需要探索如何有效利用这两种形状来改善视觉感知。

Method: 在rlretina强化学习环境中，将电刺激产生的各向同性和各向异性形状作为"笔画"，训练深度强化学习代理学习如何组合这些形状以渲染图像。采用基于模型的数据生成方式，使用心理物理学验证的轴突图模型模拟不同虚拟患者的感知图像。比较了基于误差和基于感知的多种奖励函数。

Result: 训练出的强化学习代理相比朴素基线方法，能为不同虚拟患者生成更可识别的图像。研究表明各向异性形状（笔画）可以通过智能组合来改善而非仅仅避免，为利用而非抑制轴突刺激提供了新视角。

Conclusion: 这项工作为视网膜上电刺激提供了一种新方法，是利用各向异性光幻视改善人工恢复视觉的首次尝试，有望提升视觉假体的视觉 acuity。

Abstract: Objective: Diseases such as age-related macular degeneration and retinitis pigmentosa cause the degradation of the photoreceptor layer. One approach to restore vision is to electrically stimulate the surviving retinal ganglion cells with a microelectrode array such as epiretinal implants. Epiretinal implants are known to generate visible anisotropic shapes elongated along the axon fascicles of neighboring retinal ganglion cells. Recent work has demonstrated that to obtain isotropic pixel-like shapes, it is possible to map axon fascicles and avoid stimulating them by inactivating electrodes or lowering stimulation current levels. Avoiding axon fascicle stimulation aims to remove brushstroke-like shapes in favor of a more reduced set of pixel-like shapes. Approach: In this study, we propose the use of isotropic and anisotropic shapes to render intelligible images on the retina of a virtual patient in a reinforcement learning environment named rlretina. The environment formalizes the task as using brushstrokes in a stroke-based rendering task. Main Results: We train a deep reinforcement learning agent that learns to assemble isotropic and anisotropic shapes to form an image. We investigate which error-based or perception-based metrics is adequate to reward the agent. The agent is trained in a model-based data generation fashion using the psychophysically validated axon map model to render images as perceived by different virtual patients. We show that the agent can generate more intelligible images compared to the naive method in different virtual patients. Significance: This work shares a new way to address epiretinal stimulation that constitutes a first step towards improving visual acuity in artificially-restored vision using anisotropic phosphenes.

</details>


### [178] [Spectral Asymptotics of Neural Network Loss Landscapes: An Exact Decomposition of the Curvature Exponent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02596)
*Anherutowa Calvo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推导了谱对齐分解 $\alpha = 2 + d\log\Phi_k / d\log\sigma_k$，将 Hessian 曲率指数 $\alpha$ 的变化归因于克罗内克因子特征基与梯度奇异方向之间的几何对齐度 $\Phi_k$，并证明了谱传递恒等式 $s = \alpha\gamma$，该恒等式在93个层、5种架构、3个数据集上以无参数方式以约2%的中位误差预测Hessian衰减指数 $s$。进一步导出了架构自适应预条件算子 $T(\sigma;\alpha)$，并在视觉基准上验证了谱牛顿法优于AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释为什么不同层类型（卷积、注意力、MLP）的曲率指数 $\alpha$ 存在系统性差异，揭示其背后的几何本质。

Method: 提出谱对齐分解（Spectral Alignment Decomposition），将 $\alpha$ 分解为常数2与对齐度对数导数的和；进而推导谱传递恒等式 $s = \alpha\gamma$，将Hessian衰减指数 $s$ 与曲率指数 $\alpha$ 和有效梯度秩衰减指数 $\gamma$ 联系；并基于zeta函数给出参与比的界。

Result: 谱传递恒等式在93个层、5种架构、3个数据集上以无参数方式达到约2%的中位误差；曲率集中到每层约一个方向；谱牛顿法在 $\alpha\approx 2$ 的视觉任务上优于AdamW。

Conclusion: 曲率指数 $\alpha$ 的变异由特征基与奇异方向的对齐度决定，该框架既提供了理论理解，也导出了实用的架构自适应优化器。

Abstract: The curvature exponent $α$ in $h_k \propto σ_k^α$ -- governing how Hessian eigenvalues scale with gradient singular values -- varies systematically across layer types ($α\approx 2$ for convolutions, $\approx 1$ for transformer attention, $< 1$ for MLP up-projections). Why? We prove the Spectral Alignment Decomposition: $α= 2 + d\logΦ_k / d\logσ_k$, where $Φ_k$ measures alignment between Kronecker factor eigenbases and gradient singular directions. This reduces "why does $α$ vary?" to a geometric question we answer for LayerNorm, residual connections, and softmax heads. The decomposition implies a spectral transfer identity $s = αγ$ linking curvature exponent, effective gradient rank-decay $γ$, and Hessian decay exponent $s$. The identity is algebraic; its empirical content is that $α$ and $γ$, fit on independent data (HVPs vs. SVD), recover $s$ to ~2% median error across 93 layers, five architectures, and three datasets -- with no free parameters. A zeta-function bound on participation ratio shows curvature concentrates onto effectively one direction per layer. As a proof of concept, we derive the architecture-adaptive preconditioner $T(σ;α)$ and show that Spectral Newton -- implementing $T$ in the gradient singular basis -- outperforms AdamW on vision benchmarks where $α\approx 2$.

</details>


### [179] [Making Brain-Computer Interfaces More Secure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02597)
*Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury,Gahangir Hossain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级CNN架构以提升EEG-based BCI系统在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，实验表明该模型在分类性能和抗干扰能力上优于EEGNet、DeepConvNet和SleepEEGNet等基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG-based BCI研究主要关注分类精度，忽视了安全性和鲁棒性；研究表明EEG-based BCI易受对抗攻击，微小扰动即可导致误诊，因此评估和增强模型鲁棒性对可靠部署至关重要。

Method: 提出一种轻量级自定义CNN架构，在两个EEG数据集上，与EEGNet、DeepConvNet、SleepEEGNet三种针对EEG的CNN模型进行对比，在基于梯度的对抗攻击场景下评估鲁棒性。

Result: 所提模型在对抗扰动下的分类性能持续优于基线模型，表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 轻量级架构在提升EEG-based BCI系统在对抗条件下的可靠性方面具有潜力。

Abstract: The development of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) based on electroencephalograms (EEGs) has advanced significantly mainly to machine learning. Although the majority of earlier research has been on increasing classification accuracy, relatively little focus has been placed on security and robustness. According to recent research, EEG-based BCIs are susceptible to adversarial attacks, which can cause misdiagnosis due to minute, well-crafted disturbances. Evaluating model robustness against such perturbations is therefore critical for ensuring reliable deployment. In this study, we propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture to investigate adversarial robustness in EEG-based BCIs. The suggested method is assessed using two EEG datasets and contrasted with three novel CNN models tailored to EEG, namely EEGNet, DeepConvNet, and SleepEEGNet, under gradient-based adversarial attack scenarios. According to experimental findings, the suggested model continuously performs better in classification under adversarial perturbations compared to baseline models, indicating improved robustness. These findings highlight the potential of lightweight architectures for enhancing the reliability of EEG-based BCI systems under adversarial conditions.

</details>


### [180] [Assessing Region-Level EEG Contributions to Cognitive Workload Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02598)
*Jacob Wong,Sohan Singh,Prannaya Gupta,Jin Xing Ang,Kritika Johari,U-Xuan Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于区域级别的脑电图（EEG）认知负荷评估框架，通过对四个公开数据集的跨任务、跨硬件大规模分析，发现前额和前额-中央电极组在混合被试和独立被试评估协议下均优于全头皮基线，相对排名位置提升约15-20%，而后部和枕部区域贡献不一致，表明与工作负荷相关的EEG信息最稳定地保留在前额区域，支持设计高效、可泛化的EEG工作负荷监测系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管EEG被广泛用于认知负荷评估，但不同任务、数据集和被试间，区域级别的EEG贡献一致性仍不清楚，因此需要系统性评估各头皮区域对工作负荷预测的稳定性和重要性。

Method: 提出区域级评估框架：基于解剖学定义的头皮区域（如前额、中央、枕部等）提取电极特征，训练负荷预测模型；采用与模型无关的、基于性能的重要性量化方法，在混合被试和独立被试两种评估协议下进行实验，并通过基于排名的策略汇总结果以确保鲁棒性。

Result: 在四个公开数据集和独立被试评估中，前额电极组在全头皮基线的基础上相对排名位置提升约15-20%，且使用更少的电极；额-中央区域表现出最稳定的预测效用，而后部和枕部区域在不同实验条件下贡献不一致。

Conclusion: 与工作负荷相关的EEG信息最稳定地保留在前额和前额-中央电极组中，这为设计高效、可泛化的基于EEG的工作负荷监测系统提供了重要依据。

Abstract: Accurate and generalizable estimation of cognitive workload from electroencephalography (EEG) is critical for human-centered and safety-critical systems. Although EEG is widely used for workload assessment, the consistency of region-level EEG contributions across tasks, datasets, and subjects remains unclear. This paper presents a region-level evaluation framework for EEG-based workload prediction in which models are trained and evaluated using features extracted exclusively from electrodes belonging to anatomically defined scalp regions. We perform a large-scale analysis across four publicly available EEG workload datasets spanning diverse task demands, recording hardware, and electrode montages. Region importance is quantified using a model-agnostic, performance-based approach under both mixed-subject and subject-independent evaluation protocols, with results aggregated using a rank-based strategy to ensure robustness across experimental configurations. Across all datasets and subject-independent evaluations, frontal electrode groups outperform the full-scalp baseline by approximately 15-20% in relative rank position while using substantially fewer electrodes. Fronto-central regions exhibit the most stable predictive utility, whereas posterior and occipital regions contribute less consistently across experimental conditions. These findings indicate that workload-relevant EEG information is most consistently retained within frontal and fronto-central electrode groups, supporting the design of efficient and generalizable EEG-based workload monitoring systems.

</details>


### [181] [Testing the Test: Score-Direction Instability in Class-Split Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02601)
*Alejandro Ascarate,Leo Lebrat,Rodrigo Santa Cruz,Clinton Fookes,Olivier Salvado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了类别分割异常检测基准在表示空间中异常类与正常分布重叠时可能失效的问题，并提出了一种无需训练的诊断指标——邻域类别泄露，实验表明该指标能预测评分方向的不稳定性。结论建议将此类基准视为几何相关的压力测试，而非无条件的异常检测能力证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的类内分割评估被广泛用作完全无条件离群异常检测的代理，但作者发现当留出的异常类在表示空间中与正常分布重叠时，该评估协议可能变得不适定（ill-posed），导致异常分数失效甚至反转，因此需要识别并诊断这一问题。

Method: 提出了一种无需训练的简单诊断指标——邻域类别泄露（neighborhood class leakage），用于预测评分方向的不稳定性。在Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和Imagenette数据集上，分别在像素空间和VAE潜空间中进行实验验证。

Result: 实验表明，所提出的邻域类别泄露指标能够有效预测异常评分方向的不稳定性；当异常类与正常分布在表示空间中重叠时，异常分数可能趋近随机甚至发生反转，且最佳评分方向依赖于未知的异常类别。

Conclusion: 类别分割的异常检测基准应当被视为几何相关的压力测试，而非无条件异常检测能力的证据。研究揭示了该评估协议在特定几何条件下的局限性。

Abstract: Within-dataset class-split evaluation is widely used as a proxy for fully unconditional out-of-distribution anomaly detection. We show that this protocol can become ill-posed when the held-out anomaly class overlaps the normal mixture in representation space. In this regime, anomaly scores may collapse toward chance or even invert, and the preferred score direction can depend on the unknown anomaly class. We introduce a simple training-free diagnostic, neighborhood class leakage, and show that it predicts score-direction instability across Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and Imagenette, in both pixel and VAE latent spaces. Our results suggest that class-split AD benchmarks should be treated as geometry-dependent stress tests rather than unconditional evidence of anomaly-detection ability.

</details>


### [182] [Topology-Aware Gaussian Graph Repair for Robust Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03462)
*Anubha Goel,Juho Kanniainen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑感知高斯修复（TAGR）框架，通过自适应高斯核构建稀疏特征邻域图，并结合拓扑感知残差校正来修复受损图结构，在不改变GNN架构的情况下提升其对噪声边和缺失边的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图神经网络依赖于观测图的质量，而真实图中的拓扑结构常存在噪声边和缺失边问题。已有方法（如删除可疑边或学习新图结构）存在局限性：仅删除边无法恢复缺失连接，而图结构学习会引入额外的优化复杂度。

Method: TAGR包含两个核心组件：（1）高斯修复——利用自适应高斯核在特征相似的节点间构建稀疏特征邻域图，引入辅助边；（2）拓扑感知残差校正——根据局部特征和结构一致性保留并重新加权原始拓扑。修复后的图可直接用于标准GNN，无需改变架构。

Result: 在基准引文网络上的大量实验表明，TAGR在噪声边和缺失边两种设置下均提升了GNN的鲁棒性。分析进一步显示，高斯特征邻域修复提供了主要的鲁棒性增益，而拓扑感知残差校正则在观测图不完整时提高了稳定性。

Conclusion: 有效的图鲁棒性可以通过轻量级的稀疏图修复实现，而非依赖密集的图结构学习。

Abstract: Graph neural networks have achieved strong performance on graph-structured data, but their effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of the observed graph. In real applications, graph topology is often imperfect: noisy edges may connect unrelated nodes, while missing edges may prevent useful information from being propagated. Existing robust graph learning methods mainly address this problem by removing suspicious edges or by learning a new graph structure during training. However, edge removal alone cannot recover missing connections, and graph structure learning may introduce additional optimization complexity. In this paper, we propose Topology-Aware Gaussian Repair (TAGR), a simple graph repair framework for robust message passing in graph neural networks. Instead of learning a dense adjacency matrix, TAGR constructs a sparse feature-neighborhood graph using an adaptive Gaussian kernel and combines it with a topology-aware residual correction of the observed graph. The Gaussian repair component introduces auxiliary edges between feature-similar nodes, while the residual correction preserves and reweights the original topology according to local feature and structural consistency. The repaired graph can be used directly with standard graph neural networks without changing their architectures. Extensive experiments on benchmark citation networks show that TAGR improves the robustness of GNNs under both noisy-edge and missing-edge settings. The analysis further show that Gaussian feature-neighborhood repair provides the main robustness gain, while topology-aware residual correction improves stability when the observed graph is incomplete. These results suggest that effective graph robustness can be achieved through lightweight sparse graph repair rather than dense graph structure learning.

</details>


### [183] [Graph Mamba Survival Analysis Based on Topology-Aware ordering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02602)
*Yuanfang Chen,Peiqiang Yan,Yuntao Shou,Qian Zhao,Xiangyong Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TopoMamSurv框架，通过拓扑感知排序(TAO)策略解决Mamba模型对图数据顺序敏感的问题，并结合双向Mamba模块和GCN实现局部聚合-全局捕获的分层特征学习，在五个TCGA数据集上验证了WSIs生存分析的综合性能优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在WSIs生存分析中存在O(N²)计算瓶颈，而Mamba虽具有线性复杂度，但其对输入数据顺序高度敏感，传统节点排序方法无法充分体现图数据的拓扑连通性，且单向架构无法利用图像的双向空间结构。

Method: 提出拓扑感知排序(TAO)策略以适应Mamba的顺序敏感性；设计双向Mamba模块；集成GCN实现双向空间上下文建模；构建"局部聚合-全局捕获"的分层特征学习架构。

Result: 可视化实验证实TAO策略提取的节点具有更高相似性；在五个TCGA数据集上验证了框架的综合性能优势。

Conclusion: 该框架通过TAO、双向语义建模和分层特征融合的系统设计，有效调和了WSIs分析中长程依赖建模、计算效率和空间结构利用之间的矛盾，在WSIs生存分析任务中表现出色。

Abstract: In computational pathology, Whole Slide Images (WSIs) survival analysis is crucial for patient prognosis assessment, but it faces multiple technical challenges. Although the Transformer captures long-range dependencies through its self-attention mechanism, its $O(N^2)$ time complexity causes a severe computational bottleneck in large-scale WSIs graph structures. The Mamba model breaks through the Transformer's computational bottleneck with linear complexity. But, owing to Mamba's high sensitivity to the order of input data, traditional node sorting methods in Graph Mamba, such as those based on node degree or subgraph size, fail to adequately account for the topological connectivity of graph data. This inadequacy consequently restricts the performance of Mamba's sequential modeling. Moreover, its unidirectional architecture cannot leverage the bidirectional spatial structure of images. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Graph Mamba survival analysis framework based on topology-aware ordering (TopoMamSurv) to adapt to the sequential sensitivity of Mamba. Our visualization experiments further confirmed that the nodes extracted through the topology-aware ordering (TAO) strategy indeed exhibit higher similarity. Furthermore, we designed a bidirectional Mamba module and integrated a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) to achieve bidirectional spatial context modeling of images, forming a hierarchical feature learning architecture for "local aggregation - global capture." This framework effectively reconciles the contradiction between long-range dependency modeling, computational efficiency, and spatial structure utilization in WSIs analysis through its systematic design of TAO, bidirectional semantic modeling, and hierarchical feature fusion. This framework has been validated for its comprehensive performance advantage on five TCGA datasets.

</details>


### [184] [Auditable Climate Risk Intelligence from Fragmented ESG Data: Deterministic Orchestration and Imbalance-Aware Learning for Scope 1-3 Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02604)
*Karan Sehgal,Khawar Naveed Bhatti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个确定性气候风险智能框架，整合单一事实源编排、时序异常检测、不平衡感知集成学习和可解释性治理，用于可审计的ESG验证，并通过合成基准数据集进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESG和气候风险数据在Scope 1/2/3报告环境中碎片化严重，传统验证流程缺乏来源可感知的可审计性、隐藏漂移检测和可复现性导向的治理能力。

Method: 框架包括：时序漂移分析、SMOTE稀有事件优化、集成学习、来源感知编排、TreeSHAP可解释性分析，并构建了基于GHG Protocol/PCAF/ISSB标准的合成ESG验证基准。

Result: 使用分类指标（召回率、F1、ROC AUC）、校准指标（ECE、Brier分数）和治理导向的审计轨迹完整性指标进行五折交叉验证评估，并与统计分类器、异常检测方法、时序预测基线和阈值系统对比。

Conclusion: 该框架将ESG报告重构为确定性气候风险治理基础设施，支持可复现性、可解释性和可操作审计性。

Abstract: ESG and climate risk data remain fragmented across heterogeneous Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 reporting environments, while conventional validation pipelines lack provenance aware auditability, hidden drift detection, and reproducibility oriented governance. This paper proposes a deterministic climate risk intelligence framework integrating single source of truth orchestration, temporal anomaly detection, imbalance aware ensemble learning, and explainability oriented governance for auditable ESG validation. To support open reproducibility, we construct and release a synthetic ESG validation benchmark calibrated against publicly reported characteristics of the GHG Protocol, PCAF, and ISSB standards. The methodology incorporates temporal drift analysis, SMOTE based rare event optimization, ensemble learning, provenance aware orchestration, and TreeSHAP based interpretability for governance inspection and audit reconstruction. We evaluate the framework against statistical classifiers, anomaly detection methods, temporal forecasting baselines, and a threshold based system using classification metrics (recall, F1, ROC AUC), calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score), and a governance oriented audit trace completeness metric measuring the fraction of flagged anomalies for which a deterministic source to escalation provenance chain can be reconstructed. Results are reported as mean and standard deviation across stratified five fold cross validation with paired significance testing. The framework reframes ESG reporting toward deterministic climate risk governance infrastructure supporting reproducibility, explainability, and operational auditability.

</details>


### [185] [Whom to Query for What: Adaptive Group Elicitation via Multi-Turn LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14279)
*Ruomeng Ding,Tianwei Gao,Thomas P. Zollo,Eitan Bachmat,Richard Zemel,Zhun Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应群体 elicitation 框架，结合基于LLM的信息增益目标与异构图神经网络传播，在有限预算下通过自适应选择问题和受访者来推断群体层面属性，在三个真实数据集上取得显著改进（CES数据集在10%受访者预算下相对提升>12%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法未能在多轮交互中自适应选择受访者，且当响应部分缺失时无法利用群体结构进行推断，导致在有限查询和参与预算下难以有效降低对群体层面潜在属性的不确定性。

Method: 提出自适应群体 elicitation 框架：(i) 基于LLM的期望信息增益目标评分候选问题；(ii) 异构图神经网络传播聚合观测响应与参与者属性，用于插补缺失响应并引导每轮受访者选择。

Result: 在三个真实世界意见数据集上，该方法在受限预算下持续提升群体层面响应预测性能，CES数据集在10%受访者预算下实现>12%的相对增益。

Conclusion: 闭环式流程通过查询少量信息丰富的个体，并利用结构化相似性推断群体层面响应，在有限预算下有效改善了群体层面属性推断。

Abstract: Eliciting information to reduce uncertainty about latent group-level properties from surveys and other collective assessments requires allocating limited questioning effort under real costs and missing data. Although large language models enable adaptive, multi-turn interactions in natural language, most existing elicitation methods optimize what to ask with a fixed respondent pool, and do not adapt respondent selection or leverage population structure when responses are partial or incomplete. To address this gap, we study adaptive group elicitation, a multi-round setting where an agent adaptively selects both questions and respondents under explicit query and participation budgets. We propose a theoretically grounded framework that combines (i) an LLM-based expected information gain objective for scoring candidate questions with (ii) heterogeneous graph neural network propagation that aggregates observed responses and participant attributes to impute missing responses and guide per-round respondent selection. This closed-loop procedure queries a small, informative subset of individuals while inferring population-level responses via structured similarity. Across three real-world opinion datasets, our method consistently improves population-level response prediction under constrained budgets, including a >12% relative gain on CES at a 10% respondent budget.

</details>


### [186] [Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning of ECG and Angiography Representations for Severe Stenosis Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02605)
*Nikola Cenikj,Özgün Turgut,Alexander Müller,Alexander Steger,Jan Kehrer,Marcus Brugger,Daniel Rueckert,Philip Müller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出StenCE预训练框架，通过心电图特征实现冠状动脉狭窄风险分层，在无需有创检查的情况下辅助早期诊断，并在不同狭窄严重程度阈值和编码器上取得一致性能提升，首次在重度狭窄分类中达到高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有冠脉狭窄诊断依赖有创、耗时的冠脉造影，无症状患者易漏诊；心电图虽无创、快速、便宜且常规采集，但缺乏可靠的狭窄特异性信号，无法用于狭窄风险分层。

Method: 提出StenCE预训练框架，从心电图中直接提取特征进行患者分层，支持不同心电图编码器。

Result: 在不同狭窄严重程度阈值和额外心电图疾病分类任务上，StenCE在不同编码器上均取得一致性性能提升，优于先前工作，并首次在重度狭窄分类中达到高性能。

Conclusion: StenCE成功从心电图中检测到冠脉狭窄诊断信号，支持无创早期筛查，有助于减少漏诊。

Abstract: Coronary artery stenosis is a common cardiovascular disease, with severe, untreated cases posing significant risks of heart attack. Although coronary (X-ray) angiograms remain the standard for stenosis diagnosis, they are invasive, time- and resource-intensive, and therefore only performed on patients with a high probability of disease based on symptoms and prior clinical tests. However, a subset of patients, especially those without symptoms, may remain undiagnosed. Detecting indications of stenosis from ECGs, which are fast, cheap, non-invasive, and thus routinely acquired even in asymptomatic patients, would support early diagnosis. However, as no reliable stenosis-specific signal has been identified in ECGs, they can not currently be used for stenosis risk stratification. To address this, we introduce StenCE, a pretraining framework, allowing stratification of patients based on features derived directly from ECGs. Evaluations across varying stenosis severity thresholds and additional ECG disease classification tasks demonstrate consistent performance improvements across different ECG encoders, outperforming previous work. The obtained models successfully detect signals for stenosis diagnosis in ECGs and are the first to achieve high performance in severe stenosis classification. The source code is available at https://github.com/NikolaCenic/ecg-stenosis-cls.

</details>


### [187] [ReLoRA: Knowledge-Reusing Adaptation for Fast Rollout of Evolving LLM Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02606)
*Yang Xu,Zihuai Xu,Hongli Xu,Yunming Liao,Zhiwei Yao,Xitong Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReLoRA框架，通过贝叶斯优化的自适应初始化与计划正则化微调，高效恢复LLM基模型更新后的LoRA适配器性能，实现8.9倍加速和4.6%精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为持续演进的在线服务，频繁的基模型更新会导致先前部署的任务特定LoRA适配器失效。从头重训练所有LoRA适配器计算成本过高且延迟服务部署，而直接复用旧适配器又会因适配器-骨干不兼容导致服务质量下降。

Method: ReLoRA包含两个关键优化步骤：1) 自适应LoRA初始化——利用贝叶斯优化融合旧适配器知识与基模型演化信息，构建兼容性感知的初始点；2) 计划正则化微调——通过强正则化快速将适配器引导至高质量区域，再放松正则化进行任务特定精调。

Result: 与基线方法相比，ReLoRA将恢复准备时间减少高达8.9倍，准确率提升高达4.6%。

Conclusion: ReLoRA框架能高效恢复不断演化的LLM服务中可用的LoRA适配器，在降低重新适配开销的同时保持或提升任务性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as continuously evolving services, where frequent base-model updates may invalidate previously deployed task-specific Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters. For service providers managing numerous downstream model services, retraining each LoRA adapter from scratch for every updated base model is computationally prohibitive and delays service rollout. Meanwhile, the simpler alternative, i.e., naively applying the original LoRA adapter to the updated base model, often leads to degraded service quality due to adapter-backbone incompatibility. To address this problem, we propose ReLoRA, a knowledge-reusing re-adaptation framework that efficiently restores service-ready LoRA adapters for evolving LLM services while preserving or improving task performance. Specifically, ReLoRA comprises two key optimization steps: 1) Adaptive LoRA initialization leverages Bayesian optimization to construct a compatibility-aware starting point by fusing information from both the previously deployed task adapter and the base model's evolution; 2) Fine-tuning with scheduled regularization first rapidly steers the adapter to a high-quality region via strong regularization, followed by relaxed regularization for task-specific refinement. This design enables rapid service-quality recovery with reduced re-adaptation overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReLoRA reduces time-to-readiness by up to 8.9$\times$ and improves accuracy by up to 4.6\% compared to baselines.

</details>


### [188] [Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02607)
*David Turtora Zagardo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GATD通过在表格扩散去噪器中引入列间成对角度和长度作为输入与辅助目标，以3.5倍少的参数在10个数据集上取得SOTA，形状误差降低27%，趋势误差降低20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前表格数据生成方法中，扩散模型依赖隐式机制捕捉列间关系，缺乏显式的结构监督，导致生成质量受限。

Method: 提出Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion (GATD)，在扩散去噪器中注入列值差异计算的成对角度和长度，既作为输入也作为辅助预测目标；在MLP、GNN、Transformer三种架构上验证。

Result: MLP版以3.5倍少参数在10个数据集上8/10 Shape、7/10 Trend、9/10下游效用最优；形状和趋势误差分别降27%和20%；默认损失权重可迁移至GNN和Transformer，27/30 Shape、25/30 Trend改善。

Conclusion: 显式的关系监督是一种可移植的表格扩散归纳偏置，增益主要来自监督信号而非额外输入或模型容量。

Abstract: Tabular synthesis is critical for privacy-preserving sharing and augmentation, yet diffusion models rely on implicit mechanisms to capture inter-column relationships. We introduce Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion (GATD), which augments tabular diffusion denoisers with pairwise angles and lengths computed from column value differences and used as inputs and auxiliary targets. Our MLP instantiation achieves state-of-the-art benchmark performance while using 3.5x fewer parameters on average (up to 25x for classification tasks): on ten datasets, it wins 8/10 Shape, 7/10 Trend, and 9/10 downstream utility (F1/RMSE), reducing Shape and Trend error by 27% and 20%. Default loss weights transfer to GNN and Transformer denoisers, improving Shape on 27/30 and Trend on 25/30 architecture-dataset cells. A matched ablation shows supervision (not extra inputs or capacity) drives the gain. This shows explicit relational supervision is a portable inductive bias for tabular diffusion.

</details>


### [189] [Pruning Deep Neural Networks via the Marchenko--Pastur Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02608)
*Leonid Berlyand,Theo Bourdais,Houman Owhad,Yitzchak Shmalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论的剪枝方法，能在极小微调预算下保持深度神经网络精度。理论上给出了确定性的数据路径保证，实验上在ImageNet-1k上以仅3个蒸馏周期实现了ViT-B/16达到83.41% top-1精度，MAC降低59.81%，并获得1.388×至2.705×的实际加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度神经网络剪枝方法通常需要较长的后训练重优化流程（如大量微调周期），这在计算资源有限或需要快速部署的场景下不切实际。本文旨在探索在极小微调预算下仍能保持精度的剪枝策略，并为其提供理论保证。

Method: 采用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论进行剪枝分析。理论框架包括：(1) 若移除分量R的传播logit效应L_s‖Rψ_1(s)‖_∞较小，则剪枝会降低弹性网目标并保留密集边界超过两倍扰动的样本；(2) 零预算情况给出完美剪枝；(3) prune-restore扩展在固定稀疏执行模式内建模权重恢复；(4) 加性L2正则化模型显示可容许的随机类分量在训练极限消失，持久尖峰在MP bulk坍塌时稳定。基于iid高斯充分条件，拟合的MP边缘σ⁺给出高概率的逐层预算信号。

Result: ImageNet-1k上仅3个蒸馏周期：ViT-B/16 2:4+ToMe达83.41% top-1（-1.70 pp），59.81% MAC降低，A40上1.388×加速，A100上2.705×加速；结构化稀疏ViT-B/16 6:12达83.74%，ViT-L/16 8:16达85.33%（-0.51 pp），ConvNeXtV2-Base 12:16达86.35%（-0.37 pp）；ResNet50 8:16达75.87%（-0.26 pp），ResNet152d达81.33%（-1.53 pp），约50% MAC降低，1.62×加速。

Conclusion: 基于MP随机矩阵理论的剪枝方法能够在极短的微调预算下（仅3个蒸馏周期）有效保持模型精度，理论上的确定性保证与实验上的显著加速比表明该方法在实际部署中具有重要价值，尤其适用于对微调计算预算敏感的场景。

Abstract: We study a Marchenko--Pastur (MP) random-matrix approach to pruning deep neural networks with very small post-pruning fine-tuning budgets. The main practical contribution is accuracy retention under short calibration and fine-tuning schedules, rather than a long post-pruning reoptimization pipeline. The theory gives deterministic data-path certificates: if the removed component $R$ has small propagated logit effect $L_s \| R ψ_1(s) \|_\infty$, pruning decreases an elastic-net objective and preserves samples whose dense margin exceeds twice the perturbation. The zero-budget case gives perfect pruning; a prune--restore extension models weight restoration inside a fixed sparse-execution pattern; and an additive $L_2$-regularized model shows admissible random-like components vanish at the training limit, with persistent spikes stabilizing as the MP bulk collapses. Under iid-Gaussian sufficient conditions, the fitted MP edge $σ_+$ gives a high-probability layerwise budget signal.
  On ImageNet-1k, after only three distillation epochs, ViT-B/16 $2{:}4{+}$ToMe reaches $83.41\%$ top-1 ($-1.70$ pp from dense) at $59.81\%$ sparse-execution MAC reduction, with $1.388\times$ best-observed A40 native-$2{:}4$ backend speedup for the same checkpoint and ToMe graph; a separate no-ToMe A100 endpoint gives $2.705\times$. At structured sparsity, ViT-B/16 $6{:}12$ reaches $83.74\%$, ViT-L/16 $8{:}16$ dense+permutation reaches $85.33\%$ ($-0.51$ pp), and ConvNeXtV2-Base $12{:}16$ reaches $86.35\%$ ($-0.37$ pp). For CNNs, ResNet50 $8{:}16$ dense+permutation reaches $75.87\%$ ($-0.26$ pp), and ResNet152d CAST-conv+permutation reaches $81.33\%$ ($-1.53$ pp) at ${\sim}50\%$ MAC accounting with a $1.62\times$ A40 im2col$+2{:}4$ sparse-GEMM audit.

</details>


### [190] [Building Better Activation Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02609)
*Jan Bauer,Celeste De Schamphelaere,Adam Karvonen,Niclas Luick,Neel Nanda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过四项改进（策略内训练、对话数据集优化、多层输入、注入公式改进）提升了激活预言机（AO）的质量，并开源了首个综合评估套件AObench，为可扩展端到端可解释性奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活预言机存在幻觉和模糊性问题，且文本反转混杂效应使其难以评估，亟需改进训练方案和建立标准化评估。

Method: 四项改进：1）基于策略内（on-policy）rollouts的训练；2）改进对话数据集；3）输入更多层特征；4）改进注入公式。

Result: 能力提升边际，但生活质量（quality of life）改进显著；开源了首个AO综合评估套件AObench。

Conclusion: 为改进AO及其他可扩展端到端可解释性模型奠定基础。

Abstract: Activation Oracles (AOs) are promising methods for interpreting residual stream activations. However, current AOs face important issues, such as hallucinations and vagueness. Additionally, text-inversion confounds make them hard to evaluate. To this end, we improve the Activation Oracle (AO) training regime in four ways: training on on-policy rollouts, improving the conversational dataset, feeding more layers and an improvement to the injection formula. The capability improvements are marginal, but quality of life improvements are quite substantial. In addition, we open source the first comprehensive evaluation suite for AO quality, which we call AObench. Overall, we hope that our work sets a foundation that helps improve AOs and other models in the paradigm of scalable, end-to-end interpretability.

</details>


### [191] [Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02628)
*Aizierjiang Aiersilan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了开源LLM在隐藏状态中是否编码了线性可分的真实性信号及其在不同网络深度的强度。在3个7B-8B指令微调模型上，使用4个幻觉基准，对比4种检测方法。结果表明：单层线性探测器在中层网络达到0.904-1.000 AUROC，采样方法不超过0.541 AUROC；真实性信号近似线性；峰值探测层在不同模型家族中呈现一致范围；首块注意力熵在知识驱动场景中提供互补信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究开源LLM的隐藏状态中是否存在线性可分的真实性信号，以及该信号在哪些网络层最强，旨在为幻觉检测提供高效、低成本的方案。

Method: 采用3个7B-8B指令微调LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B），4-bit NF4量化，在4个幻觉基准（TruthfulQA、HaluEval-QA、FEVER及合成数据集）上提取每层隐藏状态，对比线性探针、MLP探针、INSIDE EigenScore、自一致性及注意力熵共5种检测方法。

Result: 单层线性探针在中间网络层达到0.904-1.000 AUROC，显著优于采样方法的0.541 AUROC。MLP探针相比线性探针提升不超过0.01 AUROC。峰值探测层：Llama/Mistral在13-18/32层，Qwen在19-25/28层。首块注意力熵在HaluEval-QA上达到0.866-0.941 AUROC。

Conclusion: 开源LLM的隐藏状态中编码了近似线性的真实性信号，集中分布在中间层；线性探针是高效可靠的幻觉检测手段；采样方法表现不佳源于评估协议的结构性不匹配；注意力熵可作为零成本补充信号。

Abstract: We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three $7$B--$8$B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in $4$-bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScore, self-consistency, and attention entropy. A linear probe on a single mid-network layer achieves $0.904$--$1.000$ AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors do not exceed $0.541$ AUROC under the same protocol. The truthfulness signal is approximately linear: MLP probes rarely surpass linear probes by more than $0.01$ AUROC. Peak probing layers fall in a consistent band across model families on natural-language benchmarks -- blocks~$13$--$18$ of~$32$ for Llama and Mistral, and blocks~$19$--$25$ of~$28$ for Qwen. First-block attention entropy provides a complementary signal in knowledge-grounded settings ($0.866$--$0.941$ AUROC on HaluEval-QA) at no additional inference cost. The low discriminability of sampling methods under this protocol reflects a structural mismatch between paired-label evaluation and the information these methods access, rather than an inherent limitation of those methods. Code and data are released for full reproducibility on a single $8$\,GB GPU.

</details>


### [192] [Regime-Arrival Uncertainty in Generalization Bounds under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02657)
*Prince Poudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对马尔可夫切换分布下环境感知模型的泛化边界框架，量化了由于训练与部署间制度构成不匹配引起的额外风险，并通过惩罚项实现事后泛化差距估计，但无法预测制度变化的时间。在25年全球股指数据上验证了该框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准泛化边界假设训练和部署分布相同或静态，无法处理平静/危机状态比例变化的制度切换环境。本文旨在量化制度构成不匹配导致的额外风险。

Method: 1) 通过精确分解将制度不匹配风险与制度敏感性分离；2) 将边界扩展到β-混合数据，使用谱间隙校正的有效样本量；3) 提出事后实现的泛化差距作为惩罚项。

Result: 提出的惩罚项（事后泛化差距）与真实泛化差距显著相关，而仅使用训练数据的估计器无显著相关性。特征几何可以检测危机，但无法预测制度变化的时间序列到达。

Conclusion: 该框架不是预测机器；未来制度构成的预测在制度变化的罕见情况下仍是一个开放问题。

Abstract: The standard generalization bounds assume that the training and deployment distributions are the same, or are static, and don't consider regime switching environments where the ratio of calm vs crisis states is different. This paper proposes a framework that generalizes regime-aware models by quantifying the extra risk due to regime composition mismatch, when distribution shifts are Markov-switching. We obtain an exact decomposition, separating regime mismatch from regime sensitivity; we extend the bound to beta-mixing data using the effective sample size corrected for the spectral gap; and we show a minimax lower bound for synthetic data and on 25 years of global equity indices. The proposed penalty is an ex post realized generalization gap, whereas the training-only estimator does not show significant correlation: the feature geometry of crises can be detected, but not the temporal arrival. Thus, the framework is not a forecast machine. Forecasting the composition of the future regime is an open question in the rare cases of regime change.

</details>


### [193] [CL-DMDF:Dynamic Multimodal Data Fusion Model Based on Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02659)
*Dong Li,Lingling Zhang,Binghao Han,Linlin Ding,Yue Kou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对多模态数据融合中模态缺失和局部交互过拟合问题，提出基于对比学习的动态多模态数据融合模型(CL-DMDF)，通过跨特征和跨模态维度的注意力机制、实体-质心对比学习模块和自适应融合模块，在三个数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法假设模态完全观测，但实际应用中常出现模态不确定或缺失；传统模型过度关注缺失模态内的局部交互，忽视了多模态表示中的全局互补线索。

Method: 提出CL-DMDF模型，包含：(1)跨特征维度和跨模态维度的新型注意力机制；(2)基于实体质心的对比学习模块，从实体特征构建质心正样本增强判别学习；(3)自适应融合模块提升动态融合策略的效率与准确性。

Result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明CL-DMDF在多模态融合任务中表现有效。

Conclusion: CL-DMDF通过对比学习和双向注意力机制有效解决了模态缺失下的全局互补信息利用问题，实现了更鲁棒的多模态数据融合。

Abstract: Multimodal data fusion involves integrating and analyzing information from multiple modalities to uncover latent correlations and complementary patterns, thereby enhancing data processing and decision-making. While existing methods for structured multimodal inputs are typically designed around specific tasks and assume fully observed modalities, real-world applications often suffer from uncertain or missing modality inputs due to various factors. Some traditional models overly emphasize local interactions within missing modalities, neglecting the global complementary cues embedded in multimodal representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Dynamic Multimodal Data Fusion model based on Contrastive Learning (CL-DMDF). CL-DMDF introduces a novel attention mechanism that operates across both feature and modality dimensions to compute reliable attention scores, effectively reflecting importance at each level. The CL-DMDF further incorporates an entity-centroid contrastive learning module that constructs centroid-based positive samples from entity features to enhance discriminative learning. Additionally, an adaptive fusion module is employed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of dynamic fusion strategies. Extensive experiments conducted on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the CL-DMDF across diverse multimodal fusion tasks.

</details>


### [194] [Improvise, Adapt, Overcome: An On-The-Fly Multifidelity Algorithm for Efficient Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02662)
*Vivin Vinod,Peter Zaspel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应多保真度机器学习框架（adaptive-MFML），通过动态查询训练样本、自动确定各保真度数据组成，避免数据冗余，在量子化学计算中实现高达30倍（对比单保真度）和5倍（对比标准MFML）的数据生成成本降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子化学中机器学习受限于高保真度训练数据的昂贵生成成本，标准多保真度方法依赖预设缩放因子导致数据冗余，需要更高效的自主数据组成策略。

Method: 提出自适应多保真度框架，在训练过程中动态按保真度层级查询样本，先在低保真度上饱和模型精度，再逐步升级到高保真度昂贵计算，自动确定最优训练数据集组成。

Result: 在耦合簇能量和激发能等化学性质上，自适应MFML相比单保真度方法降低数据生成成本达30倍，相比标准MFML降低了5倍。

Conclusion: 自适应多保真度框架有效消除数据冗余，为量子化学建立高精度低成本的可持续机器学习路径。

Abstract: Machine learning has accelerated quantum chemistry but is hindered by the prohibitive cost of generating high fidelity training data. Multifidelity machine learning (MFML) mitigates this overhead by systematically combining abundant low fidelity data with sparse high fidelity data. In spite of its success, standard MFML schemes rely on pre-defined scaling factors to determine sparse data ratio across fidelities, often generating redundant multifidelity data resulting in a loss of efficiency. Here, we introduce an adaptive on-the-fly multifidelity framework for machine learning that autonomously determines training dataset composition. By dynamically querying training samples at each fidelity, the algorithm saturates model accuracy at lower fidelities before moving up to more expensive reference calculations. We benchmark the novel adaptive-MFML across diverse chemical properties including the computational chemistry gold standard coupled cluster energies, and the more chemically challenging excitation energies. In our numerical experiments we show that our adaptive algorithm reduces data generation costs by up to a factor of 30 compared to single fidelity methods and improves upon standard MFML by up to a factor of 5. The mitigation of data redundancy establishes a high-accuracy low-cost pathway for sustainable cost-aware machine learning in quantum chemistry.

</details>


### [195] [AdaWeather: Adaptively Mixing Probabilistic Weather Forecasts with Logarithmic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02663)
*Saptarishi Dhanuka,Sarvesh Iyer,Manmeet Singh,Mihir More,Rushil Gupta,Dhruman Gupta,Parthasarathi Mukhopadhyay,Sandeep Juneja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaWeather框架，通过自适应结合多个概率天气预报模型（使用机器学习和专家混合方法），实现对最佳静态专家混合的对数遗憾界，在温度预测上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概率天气预报模型在时空上表现不一致，相对性能高度依赖上下文，需要自适应方法来组合多个预报以获得改进和鲁棒性。

Method: 提出AdaWeather自适应框架，结合机器学习和专家混合方法，将多个概率预报统一为改进的概率预报；算法分析表明与最佳静态专家混合相比具有对数遗憾界。

Result: 在温度预测任务上，AdaWeather表现优于现有方法。

Conclusion: AdaWeather通过自适应组合多个概率预报实现改进和鲁棒性，理论保证对数遗憾界，实证有效。

Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have produced probabilistic weather forecasting models comparable to state-of-the-art numerical weather predictors. But no model consistently dominates spatio-temporally, and relative performance is highly context-dependent. This motivates adaptive methods for combining multiple forecasts to obtain improvements and robustness. While combined forecasts have been proposed in the literature, these are achieved either through supervised learning or through prediction with expert advice methods. We introduce AdaWeather, an adaptive framework that combines many probabilistic forecasts using both machine learning as well as mixture of experts to arrive at a unified improved probabilistic forecast. While traditional expert methods develop the regret bounds with respect to the best single expert in hindsight, we extend the algorithm and analysis to show our method has logarithmic regret compared to the best static mixture of experts in hindsight. Empirically, we focus on forecasting temperature, and observe improvements over existing methods.

</details>


### [196] [Anomalies in Multivariate Time Series Benchmarks Are Mostly Univariate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02670)
*Marc Pinet,Julien Cumin,Samuel Berlemont,Dominique Vaufreydaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过诊断框架评估了八个主流多变量时序异常检测基准，发现所有跨通道异常都伴随单变量偏差，且多数基准中大部分异常段落在多数时间步上呈现单变量偏离。合成数据验证了框架能正确识别纯跨通道异常。作者认为现有基准不适合验证跨通道建模能力，呼吁开发结构更多样的评测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MTSAD模型普遍引入跨通道建模，但其隐含假设（异常结构可能跨多个通道）在现有基准上是否成立缺乏系统验证。

Method: 提出逐段诊断框架，对每个标注异常段检测是否存在单变量偏离、跨通道相关性结构变化或两者兼有；构建相位偏移正弦通道合成数据，通过保留边际分布但破坏跨通道结构的通道级扰动生成纯跨通道异常。

Result: 1）所有跨通道异常均伴随单变量偏差；2）六个基准中至少半数异常段在79%-100%时间步上存在单变量偏离；3）合成数据上CD模型有效而CI模型失败；4）真实基准上CD与CI模型无显著差异。

Conclusion: 当前MTSAD基准不适合验证跨通道建模能力，需开发结构更多样的评测集。

Abstract: Many recent multivariate time series anomaly detection (MT-SAD) models incorporate cross-channel modeling, under the implicit assumption that the structure of anomalies may be spread across multiple channels. We evaluate this assumption on eight widely used public benchmarks by introducing a per-segment diagnostic framework that flags, for each labeled anomaly, whether at least one channel deviates individually from its normal history, whether the cross-channel correlation structure changes, or both. The framework shows that no crosschannel rupture occurs without an accompanying univariate deviation across a range of reasonable thresholds. A complementary metric also reveals that on six of the eight benchmarks, at least half of the labeled anomaly segments deviate univariately on 79% to 100% of their timesteps, reaching 100% on three of these datasets. To verify that our framework captures cross-channel structure when present, we construct synthetic data of phase-shifted sinusoidal channels with shared noise. Each anomalous segment is altered through one of two channelwise corruptions that preserve the per-channel marginal distribution while breaking cross-channel structure, and our framework correctly characterizes these segments as cross-channel-only. On these data, channel-dependent (CD) models successfully exploit the cross-channel signal whereas channel-independent (CI) ones fail. The CI/CD comparison of a recent SOTA detector on real benchmarks further confirms that CD modeling brings no measurable gain. We conclude that current MTSAD benchmarks are unsuitable for validating cross-channel modeling capabilities, and we call for the development of more structurally diverse evaluation sets. The code for this study is publicly available.

</details>


### [197] [Aligning Data-Driven Predictors with Allocation: A Decision-Focused Approach to Survival Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02671)
*Itai Zilberstein,Ioannis Anagnostides,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有生存预测模型（即使高精度）在器官分配等决策任务中可能产生任意差的效用，并提出基于NDCG的决策导向学习框架，在心脏移植数据上将NDCG提升50-100%，每年可增加数万生命年。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习预测器在指导自动化决策时存在根本性错位：预测模型通常基于标准统计指标（如C-index）优化，与它们所服务的算法任务目标不一致。这种不一致在高风险的器官分配领域可能导致严重后果。

Method: 提出决策导向学习方法，优化信息检索中的标准指标NDCG（归一化折损累计增益）。理论上证明NDCG在生存分析中的效用可转化为分配性能保证。实验上，提出bootstrap方法来优化现有生存模型的NDCG，并解决右删失数据下的排序评估挑战。

Result: 在美国历史心脏移植数据上，该方法将基线模型的NDCG提升50-100%，部署于移植分配时可转化为每年数万额外生命年。

Conclusion: 预测模型优化指标应与下游决策任务对齐，NDCG可作为生存分析与策略优化之间的桥梁，该框架可推广至更广泛的决策制定场景。

Abstract: Machine learning predictors have become essential tools for guiding automated decision making. However, a major misalignment persists: predictive models are typically optimized in terms of standard statistical metrics in isolation from the algorithmic tasks they inform. We highlight this incongruity in the high-stakes domain of organ allocation by demonstrating that any algorithm relying on (even highly accurate) survival predictors optimized for standard metrics -- such as the Concordance index (C-index) -- can yield arbitrarily poor outcomes when used for allocation, failing to guarantee utility better than a uniform random selection. To bridge the gap between survival analysis and policy optimization, we introduce a decision-focused learning approach based on optimizing normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), a mainstay metric in information retrieval. We establish the utility of NDCG in survival analysis by proving that it translates to guarantees on the performance of allocation. Empirically, we propose a bootstrapping approach to optimize the NDCG of existing survival models. Unlike prior work, we also address the challenge of right censorship when evaluating ranking. On historical heart transplant data from the US, our method dramatically boosts the NDCG of baseline models by 50-100%, which translates to tens of thousands of additional life years gained annually when deployed for transplant allocation. We anticipate that our framework will find broader applications in decision making with predictions.

</details>


### [198] [Before Fusion, Ask What to Keep: Contextual Calibration of Multimodal Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02679)
*Jiyuan Liu,Liangwei Nathan Zheng,Wei Emma Zhang,Xinpei Wang,Weitong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种在多模态融合前进行特征校准的模块，通过比较各模态间的摘要信息来检测支持或冲突，并生成实例级和维度级的调制信号，从而抑制误导性成分、保留微弱证据、强化受多模态上下文支持的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态系统并非总是能从多源信息中获益，某些模态可能对特定输入产生干扰，局部特征响应可能与其他来源的证据冲突，因此需要在不改变融合骨干网络的前提下，在融合前调整各模态的表征。

Method: 设计了一个轻量级的校准模块，在摘要级别比较各模态，提取跨源支持和冲突线索，将其转化为实例级和维度级的调制信号，在融合前对原始模态特征进行校准，作为即插即用组件可附加到不同融合骨干上。

Result: 在情感理解、动作识别、音视频事件检测和音视频情感分类五个基准上，基于序列和基于卷积的融合设置下性能均有提升；模态移除、合成损坏、训练动态和特征可视化分析表明融合前校准能减少不可靠模态干扰，实现更稳定的多模态优化。

Conclusion: 融合前校准策略能有效提升多模态系统性能，通过抑制干扰、保留弱信号、增强一致性特征，实现更鲁棒的多模态表示学习。

Abstract: Multimodal systems often benefit from combining information across language, sound, and visual streams, but this benefit is not guaranteed. A modality that is useful for one input may become distracting for another, and local feature responses within the same modality can disagree with evidence from other sources. This work investigates how to adjust multimodal representations before they are merged by a downstream predictor. We develop a compact calibration module that compares each modality with the others at the summary level, extracts cues of cross-source support and conflict, and converts these cues into instance-wise and dimension-wise modulation signals. The calibration is applied to the original modality features rather than to already fused representations, enabling the model to suppress misleading components, preserve weak but useful evidence, and emphasize responses that are better supported by the current multimodal context. The module is designed as a plug-in component and can be attached to different fusion backbones without changing their prediction heads. Across five benchmarks covering sentiment understanding, action recognition, audio-visual event detection, and audio-visual emotion classification, the proposed pre-combination calibration strategy improves performance under both sequence-based and convolutional fusion settings. Additional analyses under modality removal, synthetic corruption, training dynamics, and feature-level visualization show that calibrating signals before fusion can reduce interference from unreliable modalities and produce more stable multimodal optimization.

</details>


### [199] [Locality Does Not Imply Reachability: Boundary Repair in Block-Sparse Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02680)
*Zhibo Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了稀疏因果注意力中序列局部性与注意力图可达性之间的不匹配问题，提出了基于结构依赖集的边界伪影形式化分析，导出了阶段条件覆盖函数，并验证了边界桥接注意力作为最小修复方案的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏因果注意力通常基于序列局部性假设（近处token易访问，远处token可丢弃），但这与注意力图的实际可达性存在不匹配。固定块因果注意力中相邻token在每层都可能被断开，这种边界伪影未被充分研究。

Method: 通过结构依赖集形式化边界伪影，推导K路边界-副本分布下的top-1精度上界和交叉熵下界；提出阶段条件覆盖函数分析可达性依赖于源-目标距离和目标在块内偏移的规律；设计边界桥接注意力作为零额外参数的修复方案。

Result: 理论推导给出了精度上界1/K和交叉熵下界log K；覆盖函数准确预测了稀疏模式的失败场景及修复方案的适用性；1024-token实验证实增益集中在覆盖对齐的诊断项；8K-token Qwen2.5-7B探针实验验证了覆盖不可比性模式。

Conclusion: 本文贡献了一个面向块稀疏因果注意力中局部性-可达性不匹配的理论引导诊断框架，包含阶段条件覆盖分析和最小修复方案。

Abstract: Sparse causal attention is usually described by sequence locality: nearby tokens should remain easy to access, while distant tokens may be dropped to reduce cost. This paper studies a mismatch between sequence locality and attention-graph reachability. In fixed block causal attention, two adjacent tokens can be disconnected in the attention graph at every depth. We formalize this boundary artifact through structural dependency sets: if every attention layer uses the same fixed block causal mask and all remaining operations are positionwise, a target representation can depend only on tokens in its own block prefix. This yields an architecture-level boundary-copy separation for a constructed K-way boundary-copy distribution, with top-1 accuracy upper bound 1/K and expected cross-entropy lower bound log K. We then derive phase-conditioned coverage functions showing that reachability depends on both source-target distance and the target's offset within its block. These coverage laws predict when a sparse pattern should fail, when a repair can help, and why sliding-window attention and boundary repair are not interchangeable. Boundary Bridge Attention is treated as a constructive witness: it preserves the fixed block path and adds zero-additional-parameter auxiliary causal edges near block boundaries using shared projections. Controlled 1024-token experiments show that gains concentrate in coverage-aligned diagnostics. As secondary external-validity evidence, a fixed-checkpoint 8K-token Qwen2.5-7B probe shows the same coverage-incomparability pattern. The contribution is a theory-guided diagnostic framework for locality-reachability mismatch in block-sparse causal attention, together with phase-conditioned coverage analysis and a minimal constructive repair.

</details>


### [200] [Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02684)
*Yuying Li,Leqi Zheng,Yongzi Yu,Wenrui Zhou,Xuchang Zhong,Xing Hu,Jing Jin,Huangjie Yuan,Tao Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FiRe-OPD方法，通过先过滤低质量轨迹再对保留轨迹内token进行软重加权，实现在轨迹和token两个层面联合调整监督信号，从而在多个蒸馏设置下超越现有token级OPD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前on-policy蒸馏方法正在从全轨迹KL监督转向选择性训练范式，但现有方法仅关注单一粒度（轨迹或token）的选择，缺乏对优化粒度的联合考虑，导致信息损失或优化不稳定。

Method: 提出FiRe-OPD两阶段方法：第一阶段过滤低质量rollout轨迹；第二阶段在保留轨迹内对token进行软重加权（而非硬选择），以强调信息丰富的token同时缓解信息损失并增强优化稳定性。

Result: 在强到弱蒸馏中AIME 2024提升6.25分，在多教师蒸馏中Miner提升18.81分，在单教师设置下也优于现有token级OPD方法。

Conclusion: 联合轨迹级过滤与token级软重加权能够实现更细粒度的OPD优化，优于仅单一粒度的选择方法，且适用于多种蒸馏场景。

Abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) in large language models is shifting from full-trace KL supervision toward more selective training paradigms.
