Motivation: 现有的模型汤方法仅限于监督学习，需要标注数据且优化相同损失函数，无法利用未标注数据；作者希望将模型汤的优越性扩展到自监督学习，使其能够利用未标注数据源（如任务迁移数据或分布偏移数据）来提升模型性能。

Method: 提出Self-Soupervision框架：1) 将预训练模型（stock）在未标注数据上微调得到多个自监督模型（ingredients）；2) 将这些模型的参数混合成一个模型（soup）。具体应用包括：在受污染的测试数据上做自监督学习，再在未受污染的训练数据上微调；混合不同SSL超参数或不同SSL算法（如MAE、MoCoV3、MMCR、LeJEPA）训练出的模型参数。

Result: 在ImageNet-C上鲁棒性提升+3.5%，在LAION-C上提升+7%；首次成功混合不同SSL算法（MAE、MoCoV3、MMCR、LeJEPA）的参数，混合后的模型比任何单一SSL成分更准确。

Conclusion: Self-Soupervision成功将模型汤方法推广到自监督学习，解锁了利用未标注数据和混合不同SSL算法参数的能力，为提升模型鲁棒性和泛化性能提供了新途径。

Abstract: Model soups are strange and strangely effective combinations of parameters. They take a model (the stock), fine-tune it into multiple models (the ingredients), and then mix their parameters back into one model (the soup) to improve predictions. While all known soups require supervised learning, and optimize the same loss on labeled data, our recipes for Self-Soupervision generalize soups to self-supervised learning (SSL). Our Self-Souping lets us flavor ingredients on new data sources, e.g. from unlabeled data from a task for transfer or from a shift for robustness. We show that Self-Souping on corrupted test data, then fine-tuning back on uncorrupted train data, boosts robustness by +3.5% (ImageNet-C) and +7% (LAION-C). Self-Soupervision also unlocks countless SSL algorithms to cook the diverse ingredients needed for more robust soups. We show for the first time that ingredients can differ in their SSL hyperparameters -- and more surprisingly, in their SSL algorithms. We cook soups of MAE, MoCoV3, MMCR, and LeJEPA ingredients that are more accurate than any single SSL ingredient.

</details>


### [350] [Laplacian Representations for Decision-Time Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05031)
*Dikshant Shehmar,Matthew Schlegel,Matthew E. Taylor,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用拉普拉斯表示作为模型预测规划中的潜在空间，并基于此设计层次化规划算法ALPS，在离线目标条件强化学习任务上超越常见基线，特别是在OGBench基准中此前由无模型方法主导的任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于模型的强化学习中，决策时刻规划的关键挑战在于找到既能支持局部代价计算又能保留长程结构的状态表示。现有方法在长预测范围内存在累积误差问题，且缺乏有效的多时间尺度规划能力。

Method: 利用拉普拉斯表示捕捉状态空间的多时间尺度距离，保持有意义的距离度量并自然地将长程问题分解为子目标，在此基础上提出层次化规划算法ALPS。

Result: 在OGBench离线目标条件强化学习任务上，ALPS优于常见基线方法，且该基准此前主要由无模型方法主导。

Conclusion: 拉普拉斯表示是决策时刻规划中有效的潜在空间，能缓解长预测范围下的累积误差问题，基于此的层次化规划算法ALPS在多个离线任务上表现出竞争力。

Abstract: Planning with a learned model remains a key challenge in model-based reinforcement learning (RL). In decision-time planning, state representations are critical as they must support local cost computation while preserving long-horizon structure. In this paper, we show that the Laplacian representation provides an effective latent space for planning by capturing state-space distances at multiple time scales. This representation preserves meaningful distances and naturally decomposes long-horizon problems into subgoals, also mitigating the compounding errors that arise over long prediction horizons. Building on these properties, we introduce ALPS, a hierarchical planning algorithm, and demonstrate that it outperforms commonly used baselines on a selection of offline goal-conditioned RL tasks from OGBench, a benchmark previously dominated by model-free methods.

</details>


### [351] [TimeOmni-VL: Unified Models for Time Series Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17149)
*Tong Guan,Sheng Pan,Johan Barthelemy,Zhao Li,Yujun Cai,Cesare Alippi,Ming Jin,Shirui Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TimeOmni-VL，首个以视觉为中心的统一时间序列理解与生成框架，通过双向TSI映射和理解引导生成两大创新，实现高保真数值生成与语义理解的统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列建模中，生成模型依赖浅层模式匹配，理解模型难以输出高保真数值；统一多模态模型在视觉领域已取得进展，但在时间序列领域尚未被探索。

Method: (1) 保真保持的双向时间序列-图像映射（Bi-TSI），实现近无损的TS2I和I2TS转换；(2) 理解引导生成机制，利用时间序列理解作为显式控制信号辅助高保真生成；引入TSUMM-Suite数据集及校准的Chain-of-Thought推理。

Result: 统一方法显著提升了语义理解能力和数值精度，开创了多模态时间序列建模的新前沿。

Conclusion: 以视觉为中心的统一范式可有效弥合时间序列生成与理解之间的鸿沟，为多模态时间序列建模开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Recent time series modeling faces a sharp divide between numerical generation and semantic understanding, with research showing that generation models often rely on superficial pattern matching, while understanding-oriented models struggle with high-fidelity numerical output. Although unified multimodal models (UMMs) have bridged this gap in vision, their potential for time series remains untapped. We propose TimeOmni-VL, the first vision-centric framework that unifies time series understanding and generation through two key innovations: (1) Fidelity-preserving bidirectional mapping between time series and images (Bi-TSI), which advances Time Series-to-Image (TS2I) and Image-to-Time Series (I2TS) conversions to ensure near-lossless transformations. (2) Understanding-guided generation. We introduce TSUMM-Suite, a novel dataset consisting of six understanding tasks rooted in time series analytics and coupled with two generation tasks. With a calibrated Chain-of-Thought, TimeOmni-VL is the first to leverage time series understanding as an explicit control signal for high-fidelity generation. Experiments confirm that this unified approach significantly improves semantic understanding and numerical precision, establishing a new frontier for multimodal time series modeling.

</details>


### [352] [Balancing Symmetry and Efficiency in Graph Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18084)
*Benjamin Honoré,Alba Carballo-Castro,Yiming Qin,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了图生成模型中严格等变性带来的计算成本与收敛速度问题，提出了一种基于正弦位置编码和节点置换的可控对称性调制方案来松弛等变性。实验发现，过早打破对称性虽加速训练但易导致过拟合，而合理调节对称性信号可在加速收敛的同时延迟过拟合，仅用基线19%的训练轮次即可达到更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严格等变性虽能保证图生成模型对置换对称性的尊重，但会因额外的架构约束增加计算成本并减慢收敛速度。本文旨在探索等变性与训练效率之间的权衡，寻找在保持模型有效性的同时加速训练的方法。

Method: 从等变离散流匹配模型出发，通过基于正弦位置编码和节点置换的可控对称性调制方案，在训练过程中松弛模型的等变性约束。该方法允许调节对称性信号的强度，从而控制模型对不同排列的敏感程度。

Result: 完全松弛对称性可加速早期训练但导致过拟合（重复生成训练集副本）；合理调制对称性信号可延迟过拟合同时加速收敛，仅用基线19%的训练轮次即达到更强性能。

Conclusion: 对称性调制是一种有效的训练策略，在保持图生成模型性能的前提下显著降低训练成本，关键在于平衡等变性与训练信号之间的关系，避免过早或过度的对称性松弛。

Abstract: Equivariance is central to graph generative models, as it ensures the model respects the permutation symmetry of graphs. However, strict equivariance can increase computational cost due to added architectural constraints, and can slow down convergence because the model must be consistent across a large space of possible node permutations. We study this trade-off for graph generative models. Specifically, we start from an equivariant discrete flow-matching model, and relax its equivariance during training via a controllable symmetry modulation scheme based on sinusoidal positional encodings and node permutations. Experiments first show that symmetry-breaking can accelerate early training by providing an easier learning signal, but at the expense of encouraging shortcut solutions that can cause overfitting, where the model repeatedly generates graphs that are duplicates of the training set. On the contrary, properly modulating the symmetry signal can delay overfitting while accelerating convergence, allowing the model to reach stronger performance with $19\%$ of the baseline training epochs.

</details>


### [353] [KnapSpec: Self-Speculative Decoding via Adaptive Layer Selection as a Knapsack Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20217)
*Seongjin Cha,Gyuwan Kim,Dongsu Han,Tao Yang,Insu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KnapSpec是一种无需训练的框架，通过将草稿模型选择形式化为背包问题，并解耦Attention和MLP层建模硬件延迟，在长上下文场景中自适应选择最优草稿配置，最高实现1.47倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自推测解码(SSD)方法依赖静态启发式规则，忽视了长上下文场景中注意力机制的动态计算开销，导致效率低下。

Method: 将草稿模型选择建模为背包问题以最大化每秒token吞吐量；解耦Attention和MLP层并将其硬件延迟建模为上下文长度的函数；通过并行动态规划算法自适应选择最优草稿配置；首次从理论上证明隐藏状态间的余弦相似度是token接受率的数学有效代理。

Result: 在Qwen3和Llama3上的一致实验表明，KnapSpec持续超越最先进的SSD基线，在各种基准测试中实现高达1.47倍的实际加速。

Conclusion: KnapSpec是一种即插即用的方法，无需额外训练，不损害目标模型输出分布，即可在长序列场景下实现高速推理。

Abstract: Self-speculative decoding (SSD) accelerates LLM inference by skipping layers to create an efficient draft model, yet existing methods often rely on static heuristics that ignore the dynamic computational overhead of attention in long-context scenarios. We propose KnapSpec, a training-free framework that reformulates draft model selection as a knapsack problem to maximize tokens-per-time throughput. By decoupling Attention and MLP layers and modeling their hardware-specific latencies as functions of context length, KnapSpec adaptively identifies optimal draft configurations on the fly via a parallel dynamic programming algorithm. Furthermore, we provide the first rigorous theoretical analysis establishing cosine similarity between hidden states as a mathematically sound proxy for the token acceptance rate. This foundation allows our method to maintain high drafting faithfulness while navigating the shifting bottlenecks of real-world hardware. Our experiments on Qwen3 and Llama3 demonstrate that KnapSpec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SSD baselines, achieving up to 1.47x wall-clock speedup across various benchmarks. Our plug-and-play approach ensures high-speed inference for long sequences without requiring additional training or compromising the target model's output distribution.

</details>


### [354] [Causal Neural Probabilistic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01372)
*Weixin Chen,Han Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出因果神经概率电路（CNPC），通过结合神经属性预测器和从因果图编译的概率电路，在概念瓶颈模型中实现尊重因果依赖的精确因果干预，从而提升干预后的任务准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在测试时进行干预时仅覆盖单个修正概念，忽略了概念间的因果依赖关系，导致干预效果不理想。

Method: CNPC将神经属性预测器与从因果图编译的因果概率电路相结合，通过专家乘积（PoE）融合属性预测器的预测分布与电路计算的干预边际分布，实现精确、可处理的因果推理，天然尊重因果依赖关系。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上，无论是分布内还是分布外设置下，CNPC在不同干预属性数量上均优于五种基线模型，取得了更高的任务准确率。

Conclusion: CNPC通过显式建模概念间的因果依赖，在干预场景下显著优于忽略因果关系的传统CBM方法，理论上也刻画了其组合干预误差与真实干预分布匹配的条件。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance the interpretability of end-to-end neural networks by introducing a layer of concepts and predicting the class label from the concept predictions. A key property of CBMs is that they support interventions, i.e., domain experts can correct mispredicted concept values at test time to improve the final accuracy. However, typical CBMs apply interventions by overwriting only the corrected concept while leaving other concept predictions unchanged, which ignores causal dependencies among concepts. To address this, we propose the Causal Neural Probabilistic Circuit (CNPC), which combines a neural attribute predictor with a causal probabilistic circuit compiled from a causal graph. This circuit supports exact, tractable causal inference that inherently respects causal dependencies. Under interventions, CNPC models the class distribution based on a Product of Experts (PoE) that fuses the attribute predictor's predictive distribution with the interventional marginals computed by the circuit. We theoretically characterize the compositional interventional error of CNPC w.r.t. its modules and identify conditions under which CNPC closely matches the ground-truth interventional class distribution. Experiments on five benchmark datasets in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings show that, compared with five baseline models, CNPC achieves higher task accuracy across different numbers of intervened attributes.

</details>


### [355] [Minimax Optimal Strategy for Delayed Observations in Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03480)
*Harin Lee,Kevin Jamieson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了状态观测延迟的强化学习问题，提出了一种结合增广方法和上置信界（UCB）的算法。在表格型MDP中，该算法达到了$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max} SAK})$的遗憾界，并给出了匹配的下界。此外，该问题被形式化为一类更广泛MDP的特例，其转移动态分解为已知和未知但结构化的部分，并建立了具有独立意义的一般性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际强化学习应用中，状态观测往往存在随机延迟（如遥操作、网络传输等），现有研究对此问题关注不足。本文旨在解决延迟状态观测下强化学习的理论最优性问题，填补相关领域的空白。

Method: 提出了一种结合增广方法（augmentation method）和上置信界（UCB）的算法。将延迟观测问题形式化为一类更广泛MDP的特例，其中转移动态分解为已知部分和未知但有结构的部分，并建立了针对该抽象设定的一般性理论结果。

Result: 在表格型MDP中，推导出$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max} SAK})$的遗憾上界，并给出了匹配（对数因子内）的下界，证明了算法的最优性。

Conclusion: 所提算法在延迟状态观测的强化学习问题中达到了最优的遗憾界，同时建立的抽象分析框架可能对其他相关问题具有独立的理论价值。

Abstract: We study reinforcement learning with delayed state observation, where the agent observes the current state after some random number of time steps. We propose an algorithm that combines the augmentation method and the upper confidence bound approach. For tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), we derive a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(H \sqrt{D_{\max} SAK})$, where $S$ and $A$ are the cardinalities of the state and action spaces, $H$ is the time horizon, $K$ is the number of episodes, and $D_{\max}$ is the maximum length of the delay. We also provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, showing the optimality of our approach. Our analytical framework formulates this problem as a special case of a broader class of MDPs, where their transition dynamics decompose into a known component and an unknown but structured component. We establish general results for this abstract setting, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [356] [Why Are Linear RNNs More Parallelizable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03612)
*William Merrill,Hongjian Jiang,Yanhong Li,Anthony Lin,Ashish Sabharwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过计算复杂度理论，揭示了线性RNN（LRNN）之所以能像Transformer一样高效并行化，是因为它们可视为对数深度的算术电路（仅比Transformer的布尔电路略深），而非线性RNN能求解L-完全甚至P-完全问题，从根本上阻碍了其高效并行化。研究还细分了不同LRNN变体的表达能力差异，为设计平衡表达性与并行性的LLM架构提供了理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已表明LRNN在表达能力上优于Transformer，但尚不清楚为什么LRNN（而非传统非线性RNN）能像Transformer一样在实践中易于并行化。本文旨在通过计算复杂度理论建立RNN类型与标准复杂度类之间的紧密联系，从根本上揭示这一并行性差异的原因。

Method: 论文将LRNN建模为对数深度的有界扇入算术电路，将非线性RNN与L-完全和P-完全问题关联，并通过自动机理论模型对不同RNN变体进行精细化复杂度刻画，识别出置换-对角LRNN（NC^1-完全）与对角加低秩LRNN（PNC^1-完全）之间的表达性差异。

Result: LRNN可视为对数深度算术电路，仅比Transformer的对数深度布尔电路略有深度开销；非线性RNN能求解L-完全问题（在多项式精度下甚至P-完全问题），存在根本性的并行化障碍；置换-对角LRNN为NC^1-完全，对角加低秩LRNN为PNC^1-完全，表达性更强。

Conclusion: 非线性RNN与不同LRNN变体之间存在根本性的表达性与并行性权衡，本研究为设计在表达能力和并行效率之间达到最优平衡的LLM架构提供了理论基础。

Abstract: The community is increasingly exploring linear RNNs (LRNNs) as language models, motivated by their expressive power and parallelizability. While prior work establishes the expressivity benefits of LRNNs over transformers, it is unclear what makes LRNNs -- but not traditional, nonlinear RNNs -- as easy to parallelize in practice as transformers. We answer this question by providing a tight connection between types of RNNs and standard complexity classes. We show that LRNNs can be viewed as log-depth (bounded fan-in) arithmetic circuits, which represents only a slight depth overhead relative to log-depth boolean circuits that transformers admit. Furthermore, we show that nonlinear RNNs can solve $\mathsf{L}$-complete problems (and even $\mathsf{P}$-complete ones, under polynomial precision), revealing a fundamental barrier to parallelizing them as efficiently as transformers. Our theory also identifies fine-grained expressivity differences between recent popular LRNN variants: permutation-diagonal LRNNs are $\mathsf{NC}^1$-complete whereas diagonal-plus-low-rank LRNNs are more expressive ($\mathsf{PNC}^1$-complete). We provide further insight by associating each type of RNN with a corresponding automata-theoretic model that it can simulate. Together, our results reveal fundamental tradeoffs between nonlinear RNNs and different variants of LRNNs, providing a foundation for designing LLM architectures that achieve an optimal balance between expressivity and parallelism.

</details>


### [357] [WaterSIC: Information-Theoretically (Near) Optimal Linear Layer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04956)
*Egor Lifar,Semyon Savkin,Or Ordentlich,Yury Polyanskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WaterSIC算法，通过为权重矩阵的不同列分配不同量化率（类似信息论中的注水原理），在理论上保证与信息论极限的速率差距不超过0.255比特，并在Llama和Qwen系列大语言模型上实现了1-4比特量化下的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低精度量化方法（如GPTQ）与信息论最优解之间存在任意大的差距，需要一种理论上更优的量化算法来缩小这一差距。

Method: 受信息论中"注水（waterfilling）"原理启发，WaterSIC为权重矩阵的不同列（输入特征）分配不同的量化率，在压缩长度和输出差异之间进行最优权衡。

Result: 1) 理论上与信息论极限的速率差距不超过0.255比特，均匀适用于所有可能的输入激活协方差矩阵；2) 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，在1-4比特所有量化率下均取得新的最优结果。

Conclusion: WaterSIC通过注水式非均匀量化分配，在理论上和实证上均优于现有方法，为稠密线性层的低精度转换提供了更接近信息论极限的解决方案。

Abstract: This paper considers the problem of converting a given dense linear layer to low precision. The tradeoff between compressed length and output discrepancy is analyzed information theoretically (IT). It is shown that a popular GPTQ algorithm may have an arbitrarily large gap to the IT limit. To alleviate this problem, a novel algorithm, termed ``WaterSIC'', is proposed and is shown to be within a rate gap of 0.255 bits to the IT limit, uniformly over all possible covariance matrices of input activations. The key innovation of WaterSIC's is to allocate different quantization rates to different columns (in-features) of the weight matrix, mimicking the classical IT solution known as "waterfilling". Applying WaterSIC to the Llama and Qwen family of LLMs establishes new state-of-the-art performance for all quantization rates from 1 to 4 bits. Our code is available at https://github.com/egorlifar/watersic.

</details>


### [358] [Improved Scaling Laws via Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Feature Ridge Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05691)
*Diyuan Wu,Lehan Chen,Theodor Misiakiewicz,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过随机特征岭回归的理论分析，证明了弱到强泛化现象中，强学生模型可以超越弱教师模型的缩放定律，甚至在教师误差不随样本量衰减时，学生仍能达到最优收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习中常用弱模型标注数据来训练更强的模型，但这种弱到强泛化（weak-to-strong generalization）的潜在提升程度及其对缩放定律（scaling law）的影响尚不明确，亟需理论刻画。

Method: 采用随机特征岭回归（RFRR）框架，推导了学生模型在教师标注数据上的超额测试误差的确定性等价（deterministic equivalent）表达式，并据此分析不同机制下的缩放定律行为。

Result: 学生模型的缩放定律可以在偏差主导和方差主导的设定下均优于教师模型；当教师误差甚至不随样本量衰减时，学生仍能达到 minimax 最优速率。

Conclusion: 弱到强泛化的潜在提升是实质性的，学生模型可以突破教师模型的缩放定律限制，实现理论上的最优学习率。

Abstract: It is increasingly common in machine learning to use learned models to label data and then employ such data to train more capable models. The phenomenon of weak-to-strong generalization exemplifies the advantage of this two-stage procedure: a strong student is trained on imperfect labels obtained from a weak teacher, and yet the strong student outperforms the weak teacher. In this paper, we show that the potential improvement is substantial, in the sense that it affects the scaling law followed by the test error. Specifically, we consider students and teachers trained via random feature ridge regression (RFRR). Our main technical contribution is to derive a deterministic equivalent for the excess test error of the student trained on labels obtained via the teacher. Via this deterministic equivalent, we then identify regimes in which the scaling law of the student improves upon that of the teacher, unveiling that the improvement can be achieved both in bias-dominated and variance-dominated settings. Strikingly, the student may attain the minimax optimal rate regardless of the scaling law of the teacher -- in fact, when the test error of the teacher does not even decay with the sample size.

</details>


### [359] [ArrowFlow: Hierarchical Machine Learning in the Space of Permutations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04087)
*Ozgur Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ArrowFlow是一种完全在置换空间中运行的机器学习架构，使用排序过滤器作为计算单元，通过置换矩阵累积（非梯度规则）进行学习。该架构与Arrow不可能定理相关联，将社会选择公平性公理的违反作为非线性、稀疏性和稳定性的归纳偏置。实验表明其在部分数据集上具有竞争力，但核心贡献是作为存在性证明：在不依赖浮点参数的情况下实现竞争性分类，与整数专用和神经形态硬件天然对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索一种完全不同于梯度下降的计算范式，证明仅基于序数结构的机器学习是可行的。该工作质疑了当前深度学习对浮点运算和梯度优化的根本依赖，试图构建一个以排列和排序为核心计算单元的替代架构。

Method: 使用排名过滤器作为计算单元，通过Spearman's footrule距离比较输入，利用置换矩阵累积（基于位移证据的非梯度规则）进行更新。层之间以层次化方式组合：每层的输出排名成为下一层的输入，实现深层序数表征学习。核心计算不包含任何浮点参数。与Arrow不可能定理建立理论联系，将社会选择公理的违反转化为有益的计算特性。

Result: 在UCI基准、MNIST、TCGA基因表达癌症分类和偏好数据上，经GridSearchCV调优的基线对比：在Iris数据集上以2.7%优于3.3%；在多数UCI数据集上具有竞争力。多项式次数作为主控开关：次数1提供噪声鲁棒性（退化减少8-28%）、隐私保护（+0.5pp成本）和缺失特征弹性；更高次数则在这些特性与干净准确率之间权衡。

Conclusion: ArrowFlow并非旨在超越基于梯度的方法，而是一个存在性证明——证明在根本不同的计算范式（将序数结构提升为一等公民）中实现竞争性分类是可能的，且与整数专用和神经形态硬件天然对齐。

Abstract: We introduce ArrowFlow, a machine learning architecture that operates entirely in the space of permutations. Its computational units are ranking filters, learned orderings that compare inputs via Spearman's footrule distance and update through permutation-matrix accumulation, a non-gradient rule rooted in displacement evidence. Layers compose hierarchically: each layer's output ranking becomes the next layer's input, enabling deep ordinal representation learning without any floating-point parameters in the core computation.
  We connect the architecture to Arrow's impossibility theorem, showing that violations of social-choice fairness axioms (context dependence, specialization, symmetry breaking) serve as inductive biases for nonlinearity, sparsity, and stability.
  Experiments span UCI tabular benchmarks, MNIST, gene expression cancer classification (TCGA), and preference data, all against GridSearchCV-tuned baselines. ArrowFlow beats all baselines on Iris (2.7% vs. 3.3%) and is competitive on most UCI datasets. A single parameter, polynomial degree, acts as a master switch: degree 1 yields noise robustness (8-28% less degradation), privacy preservation (+0.5pp cost), and missing-feature resilience; higher degrees trade these for improved clean accuracy.
  ArrowFlow is not designed to surpass gradient-based methods. It is an existence proof that competitive classification is possible in a fundamentally different computational paradigm, one that elevates ordinal structure to a first-class citizen, with natural alignment to integer-only and neuromorphic hardware.

</details>


### [360] [Flow Learners for PDEs: Toward a Physics-to-Physics Paradigm for Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07366)
*Yilong Dai,Shengyu Chen,Xiaowei Jia,Runlong Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将基于传输（transport）的学习范式作为偏微分方程求解的新组织原则，强调模型应参数化传输向量场并通过积分生成轨迹，以替代传统状态回归方法，从而更好地处理不确定性和约束动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习求解器（如物理信息神经网络、神经算子、扩散求解器）各有局限：PINN在刚性和多尺度问题上优化困难；神经算子聚焦单步预测，长时间推演易退化；扩散模型仍以状态回归为核心。核心问题在于训练所用的抽象层次——状态预测无法捕捉不确定性在约束动力学中的传输过程。

Method: 提出流学习器（flow learners），参数化传输向量场（transport vector fields），通过积分生成轨迹，与定义PDE演化的连续动力学对齐，实现物理到物理的匹配。

Result: 该范式支持连续时间预测、原生不确定性量化，并为物理感知求解器设计提供新机会。

Conclusion: 基于传输的学习是比现有范式更强的组织原则，并勾勒了相应的研究议程。

Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) govern nearly every physical process in science and engineering, but solving them at scale remains prohibitively expensive. Generative AI has transformed language, vision, and protein science, but learned PDE solvers have not undergone a comparable shift. Existing paradigms each capture part of the problem. Physics-informed neural networks embed residual structure, although they are often difficult to optimize in stiff, multiscale, or large-domain regimes. Neural operators amortize across instances, although they commonly inherit a snapshot-prediction view of solving and can degrade over long rollouts. Diffusion-based solvers model uncertainty, although they are often built on a solver template that still centers on state regression. We argue that the core issue is the abstraction used to train learned solvers. Many models are asked to predict states, while many scientific settings require modeling how uncertainty moves through constrained dynamics. The relevant object is transport over physically admissible futures. This motivates flow learners: models that parameterize transport vector fields and generate trajectories through integration, echoing the continuous dynamics that define PDE evolution. This physics-to-physics alignment supports continuous-time prediction, native uncertainty quantification, and new opportunities for physics-aware solver design. We explain why transport-based learning offers a stronger organizing principle for learned PDE solving and outline the research agenda that follows from this shift.

</details>


### [361] [R2IF: Aligning Reasoning with Decisions via Composite Rewards for Interpretable LLM Function Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20316)
*Aijia Cheng,Kailong Wang,Ling Shi,Yongxin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出R2IF框架，通过推理感知的强化学习（复合奖励+GRPO）提升LLM函数调用的准确性和可解释性，在BFCL/ACEBench上最高提升34.62%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RL的函数调用方法存在推理过程与工具调用决策之间的对齐不足问题。

Method: 提出R2IF（Reasoning-aware RL for Interpretable Function Calling），采用复合奖励机制（格式/正确性约束、思维链有效性奖励CER、规范-修改-价值奖励SMV），通过GRPO优化。

Result: 在BFCL和ACEBench上，R2IF相比基线最高提升34.62%（Llama3.2-3B on BFCL），平均思维链有效性（Average CoT Effectiveness）为0.05（Llama3.2-3B）。

Conclusion: R2IF同时增强了函数调用的准确性和可解释性，为可靠的工具增强型LLM部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Function calling empowers large language models (LLMs) to interface with external tools, yet existing RL-based approaches suffer from misalignment between reasoning processes and tool-call decisions. We propose R2IF, a reasoning-aware RL framework for interpretable function calling, adopting a composite reward integrating format/correctness constraints, Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness Reward (CER), and Specification-Modification-Value (SMV) reward, optimized via GRPO. Experiments on BFCL/ACEBench show R2IF outperforms baselines by up to 34.62% (Llama3.2-3B on BFCL) with positive Average CoT Effectiveness (0.05 for Llama3.2-3B), enhancing both function-calling accuracy and interpretability for reliable tool-augmented LLM deployment.

</details>


### [362] [Quantifying and Mitigating Self-Preference Bias of LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22891)
*Jinming Yang,Zheng Hu,Chuxian Qiu,Zhenyu Deng,Xinshan Jiao,Tao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化框架用于量化和缓解LLM评估中的自偏好偏差（SPB），通过构建等质量响应对实现偏差与鉴别力的统计解耦，实验发现高级能力与低SPB不相关甚至负相关，并基于认知负荷分解的多维评估策略平均降低SPB 31.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge评估系统中存在自偏好偏差（SPB），即LLM在评估时系统性地偏好或贬低自身生成的输出。现有测量方法依赖昂贵的人工标注，且混淆了生成能力与评估立场，难以大规模部署。

Method: 提出全自动化框架：构建质量差异可忽略的等质量响应对，实现无人工金标的鉴别力与偏差倾向统计解耦；并提出基于认知负荷分解的结构化多维评估策略以缓解SPB。

Result: 在20个主流LLM上的实验表明，高级能力与低SPB通常不相关甚至负相关；所提缓解策略平均降低SPB 31.5%。

Conclusion: 该自动化框架有效量化并缓解了SPB，揭示了模型能力与评估偏差之间的非正相关关系，为大规模自动评估系统的可信部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a dominant approach in automated evaluation systems, playing critical roles in model alignment, leaderboard construction, quality control, and so on. However, the scalability and trustworthiness of this approach can be substantially distorted by Self-Preference Bias (SPB), which is a directional evaluative deviation in which LLMs systematically favor or disfavor their own generated outputs during evaluation. Existing measurements rely on costly human annotations and conflate generative capability with evaluative stance, and thus are impractical for large-scale deployment in real-world systems. To address this issue, we introduce a fully automated framework to quantifying and mitigating SPB, which constructs equal-quality pairs of responses with negligible quality differences, enabling statistical disentanglement of discriminability from bias propensity without human gold standards. Empirical analysis across 20 mainstream LLMs reveals that advanced capabilities are often uncorrelated, or even negatively correlated, with low SPB. To mitigate this bias, we propose a structured multi-dimensional evaluation strategy grounded in cognitive load decomposition, which reduces SPB by 31.5\% on average.

</details>


### [363] [ProEval: Proactive Failure Discovery and Efficient Performance Estimation for Generative AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23099)
*Yizheng Huang,Wenjun Zeng,Aditi Kumaresan,Zi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProEval是一种主动评估框架，利用预训练高斯过程作为代理模型，通过迁移学习和贝叶斯求积实现高效性能估计，并在推理、安全对齐和分类基准测试中，以8-65倍更少的样本达到1%误差内的准确估计，同时更高效地发现失败案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估生成式AI模型日益昂贵，原因包括推理速度慢、人工评估成本高以及模型和基准数量快速增长。现有评估方法效率低下，亟需更高效的主动评估策略。

Method: 提出ProEval框架，核心包括：(1) 使用预训练高斯过程作为性能评分函数的代理模型；(2) 将性能估计建模为贝叶斯求积问题；(3) 将失败案例发现建模为超水平集采样问题；(4) 采用不确定性感知的决策策略，主动选择或合成高信息量测试输入。

Result: 在推理、安全对齐和分类基准上，ProEval相比竞争基线效率显著提升：仅需8-65倍更少的样本即可达到1%误差内的估计精度，同时在更严格的评估预算下发现更多样化的失败案例。理论上证明了预训练GP的贝叶斯求积估计器无偏且有界。

Conclusion: ProEval通过迁移学习和主动采样策略，有效解决了生成式AI模型评估的成本瓶颈问题，在性能和效率上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Evaluating generative AI models is increasingly resource-intensive due to slow inference, expensive raters, and a rapidly growing landscape of models and benchmarks. We propose ProEval, a proactive evaluation framework that leverages transfer learning to efficiently estimate performance and identify failure cases. ProEval employs pre-trained Gaussian Processes (GPs) as surrogates for the performance score function, mapping model inputs to metrics such as the severity of errors or safety violations. By framing performance estimation as Bayesian quadrature (BQ) and failure discovery as superlevel set sampling, we develop uncertainty-aware decision strategies that actively select or synthesize highly informative inputs for testing. Theoretically, we prove that our pre-trained GP-based BQ estimator is unbiased and bounded. Empirically, extensive experiments on reasoning, safety alignment, and classification benchmarks demonstrate that ProEval is significantly more efficient than competitive baselines. It requires 8-65x fewer samples to achieve estimates within 1% of the ground truth, while simultaneously revealing more diverse failure cases under a stricter evaluation budget.

</details>


### [364] [How to Guide Your Flow: Few-Step Alignment via Flow Map Reward Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27147)
*Jerry Y. Huang,Justin Lin,Sheel Shah,Kartik Nair,Nicholas M. Boffi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Flow Map Reward Guidance (FMRG)，将引导问题重述为确定性最优控制问题，利用流图实现单轨迹、免训练、仅需3步函数评估的快速引导生成，在文本到图像任务中比现有方法快一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有引导方法要么需要昂贵的多粒子、多步方案，要么依赖理解不足的近似，缺乏高效且原理清晰的单轨迹引导方法。

Method: 将引导重述为确定性最优控制问题，推导出算法层次结构；利用流图（flow map）作为积分和引导的统一工具，提出单轨迹、免训练的FMRG框架。

Result: 在文本到图像规模下，FMRG在逆问题和奖励引导生成任务中匹配或超越基线，仅需3次NFEs，相比先前最优方法实现至少一个数量级的加速。

Conclusion: 流图在最优解中自然出现，FMRG为引导生成提供了一种高效、无需训练的新范式，大幅降低了计算成本。

Abstract: In generative modeling, we often wish to produce samples that maximize a user-specified reward such as aesthetic quality or alignment with human preferences, a problem known as \textit{guidance}. Despite their widespread use, existing guidance methods either require expensive multi-particle, many-step schemes or rely on poorly understood approximations. We reformulate guidance as a \textit{deterministic optimal control problem}, yielding a hierarchy of algorithms that subsumes existing approaches at the coarsest level. We show that the \textit{flow map}, an object of significant recent interest for its role in fast inference, arises naturally in the optimal solution. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Flow Map Reward Guidance (FMRG)}: a training-free, \textit{single-trajectory} framework that uses the flow map to both integrate and guide the flow. At text-to-image scale, FMRG matches or surpasses baselines across inverse problems and reward-guided generation with \textbf{as few as 3 NFEs}, giving at least an order-of-magnitude speedup in comparison to prior state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/jrrhuang/fmrg.

</details>


### [365] [CoAction: Cross-task Correlation-aware Pareto Set Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01712)
*Xinyue Chen,Yingxuan Liang,Yiqin Huang,Chikai Shang,Hai-Lin Liu,Fangqing Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoAction框架利用任务感知的Transformer架构同时处理多个多目标优化任务，通过任务特定嵌入向量和自注意力机制实现任务间知识共享与相关性捕捉，在多项指标上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Pareto集学习方法每次只能求解单一多目标优化问题，在多任务场景下计算成本高且无法利用任务间相关性。

Method: 提出CoAction框架，使用任务感知Transformer编码器作为骨干架构，为每个任务分配特定嵌入向量以区分不同任务并促进知识共享，利用自注意力机制捕捉复杂任务依赖关系。

Result: 在涵盖基准问题和实际应用的多任务测试集上，CoAction在Hypervolume、Range和Sparsity三个指标上均表现有效且具有竞争力。

Conclusion: CoAction通过Transformer实现多任务Pareto集联合学习，有效降低了计算成本并提升了性能。

Abstract: Pareto set learning (PSL) is an emerging paradigm in multi-objective optimization that trains neural networks to map preference vectors to Pareto optimal solutions. However, existing PSL methods primarily focus on solving a single multi-objective optimization problem at a time. This limitation not only increases computational costs in multi-objective multitask optimization scenarios by requiring a separate model for each task, but also fails to exploit the inter-task correlations across tasks. To address this, we propose a Cross-tAsk correlation-aware Pareto Set Learning (CoAction) framework, which leverages task-aware transformer to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Specifically, by assigning task-specific embedding vectors to individual tasks, the model effectively distinguishes between tasks while facilitating knowledge sharing among them. We utilize a Transformer encoder as the backbone architecture to leverage its self-attention mechanism for capturing complex task dependencies. The proposed approach is evaluated on comprehensive multitask test suites covering both benchmark problems and real-world applications, demonstrating effectiveness and competitive performance in Hypervolume, Range, and Sparsity.

</details>


### [366] [Unlearning with Asymmetric Sources: Improved Unlearning-Utility Trade-off with Public Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11170)
*Ahmed Mehdi Inane,Vincent Quirion,Gintare Karolina Dziugaite,Ioannis Mitliagkas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非对称朗之万遗忘（ALU）框架，利用公开数据来缓解机器学习遗忘中的噪声-效用矛盾，理论上证明公开数据注入可将遗忘成本降低 O(1/n_pub²) 倍，并分析了分布偏移下的效用保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于噪声的认证机器学习遗忘面临硬性天花板：认证遗忘所需的噪声幅度通常会破坏模型效用，尤其是在处理大规模删除请求时。尽管利用公开数据是差分隐私中缓解这一矛盾的标准化技术，但其在遗忘场景中的作用尚未被探索。

Method: 提出非对称朗之万遗忘（ALU）框架，通过注入公开数据来降低隐私成本。理论上证明了公开数据注入可将遗忘成本降低 O(1/n_pub²) 倍，保证了严格优于重训练的计算优势。同时分析了公开与私有数据源之间分布偏移的影响。

Result: ALU 能够实现对常量比例数据集的批量遗忘（标准对称方法在此场景下不可行），同时保持高效用。基于变分 Rényi 散度和成员推断攻击的实验验证了 ALU 在合理分布偏移下能有效抵御隐私攻击并保持效用。

Conclusion: 建立了一种新的控制机制：从业者可以通过增加公开数据量来缓解高噪声需求及相关的效用损失。公开数据注入提供了严格的计算优势。

Abstract: Noise-based certified machine unlearning currently faces a hard ceiling: the noise magnitude required to certify unlearning typically destroys model utility, particularly for large-scale deletion requests.
  While leveraging public data is a standard technique in differential privacy to relax this tension, its role in unlearning remains unexplored. We address this gap by introducing Asymmetric Langevin Unlearning (ALU), a framework that uses public data to mitigate privacy costs. We prove that public data injection suppresses the unlearning cost by a factor of $O(1/n_{\mathrm{pub}}^2)$, guaranteeing a strict computational advantage over retraining. This establishes a new control mechanism: practitioners can mitigate the need for high noise-and the associated utility loss-by increasing the volume of public data. Crucially, we analyze the realistic setting of distribution mismatch, explicitly characterizing how shifts between public and private sources impact utility.
  We show that ALU enables mass unlearning of constant dataset fractions -- a regime where standard symmetric methods become impractical -- while maintaining high utility. Empirical evaluations using variational Rényi divergence and membership inference attacks confirm that ALU effectively thwarts privacy attacks while preserving utility under reasonable distribution shifts.

</details>


### [367] [Martingale Neural Operators: Learning Stochastic Marginals via Doob-Meyer Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15806)
*Kai Hidajat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Martingale Neural Operator (MNO)，基于Doob-Meyer定理将半鞅分解为可预测漂移和不可预测鞅，直接映射初始条件到终端分布的均值和协方差，在多个SPDE任务上将Wasserstein距离降低最高120倍，同时保持算子学习的高效性和分辨率不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子作为确定性代理在随机PDE上会坍缩到条件均值，丢弃方差和尾结构；传统恢复方法（Monte Carlo或生成模型）牺牲了算子范式的单次推理效率和分辨率不变性。

Method: 基于Doob-Meyer定理，将半鞅分解为可预测漂移（drift-like mean）和不可预测零均值鞅（低秩因子B_φ，保证B_φ^⊤B_φ半正定），构建MNO架构直接输出终端条件分布的均值和协方差，采用高斯残差实例化。

Result: 在1D SPDE、粗糙波动率、2D算子任务上，MNO将Wasserstein距离降低最高120倍（φ^4场论）和68倍（随机Burgers）；推理速度比条件扩散基线快约3倍；2D任务上分辨率零样本迁移和湍流性能与FNO相当。

Conclusion: MNO成功弥合了神经算子效率与不确定量化需求间的鸿沟，但准确定性系统（如Gray-Scott）仍是失败模式。

Abstract: Neural operators excel as deterministic surrogates, but inevitably collapse to the conditional mean when applied to stochastic PDEs, discarding the variance and tail structure upon which uncertainty quantification depends. Recovering this structure typically requires Monte Carlo rollouts or grafted generative models, both of which surrender the one-shot efficiency and resolution invariance that define the operator paradigm. To resolve this, we draw on the Doob-Meyer theorem, which establishes that any semimartingale fundamentally decomposes into a predictable drift and an unpredictable, zero-mean martingale. Translating this theorem into an architectural prior, we introduce the Martingale Neural Operator (MNO). MNO maps an initial condition directly to the conditional mean and covariance of the terminal law, parameterized by a drift-like mean and a low-rank factor $B_φ$ with $B_φ^\top B_φ$ positive semi-definite by construction. For our experiments, we use a Gaussian residual instantiation. Across 1D SPDEs, rough volatility, and 2D operator tasks, MNO reduces Wasserstein distance by up to $120\times$ on $φ^4$ field theory and $68\times$ on stochastic Burgers, evaluating $\sim 3\times$ faster than a conditional diffusion baseline at matched wall-clock training budgets. On 2D tasks, MNO is comparable to FNO on zero-shot resolution transfer and turbulent flow, while quasi-deterministic systems such as Gray-Scott remain a failure mode.

</details>


### [368] [DAD4TS: Data-Augmentation-Oriented Diffusion Model for Time-Series Forecasting with Small-Scale Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17866)
*Masahiro Suzuki,Bohui Xia,Hiroto Yamamoto,Masanori Miyahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DAD4TS方法，结合扩散模型与强化学习进行时间序列数据增强，解决小样本数据问题，在五个数据集上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小样本数据是时间序列预测中的关键问题，现有数据增强方法在生成有意义数据方面存在局限。

Method: 提出DAD4TS方法：将扩散模型与强化学习结合，数据生成器与时间序列模型联合训练，由强化学习模型控制生成策略；采用数学方法（而非传统VAE）将时间序列数据投影到几何空间以支持小样本场景。

Result: 在六个真实数据集和八个时间序列模型上，与七种对比方法进行定性和定量实验，在五个数据集上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: DAD4TS是一种有效的小样本时间序列数据增强方法，通过扩散模型和强化学习协同生成高质量样本，提升预测精度。

Abstract: Small-scale data is a critical problem in time-series forecasting tasks. Data augmentation is an effective strategy for this task, but it has a limitation in generating meaningful data. To address this limitation, we propose DAD4TS, a diffusion-model-based data augmentation method with reinforcement learning, designed for time-series forecasting with small-scale data. In DAD4TS, a data generator is simultaneously trained with a time-series model and controlled by a reinforcement learning model to efficiently generate samples that improve the forecast accuracy of the time-series model. To support small-scale data, we use mathematical methods instead of conventional VAE methods to train the diffusion model by projecting the time-series data into the geometric space. We validated the effectiveness of DAD4TS with seven comparative methods through qualitative and quantitative experiments on six real-world datasets and eight time-series models. As a result, DAD4TS was validated on five datasets.

</details>


### [369] [Aligned Training: A Parameter-Free Method to Improve Feature Quality and Stability of Sparse Autoencoders (SAE)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18629)
*Michał Brzozowski,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对齐训练（aligned training），一种无参数的重参数化方法，通过强制编码器与解码器方向内积为1的几何约束，同时改进稀疏自编码器的重建质量、消除死亡特征并提升训练稳定性，在SAEBench基准上实现Pareto改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器存在大量特征从未激活（死亡特征）和训练不稳定的问题，尽管有变体尝试缓解，但需要额外数据、重采样或训练开销。作者发现SAE特征质量（编码器与解码器方向内积）呈双峰分布这一被忽视的现象，由此出发提出改进方案。

Method: 提出对齐训练，一种无参数的重参数化方法。强制每个特征的编码器与解码器方向之间的内积等于1，从而消除SAE训练中的退化来源，且不增加任何超参数。该方法可直接集成Top/BatchTop-K架构和p-Annealing等技术。

Result: 在多种模型、字典大小和稀疏度设置下，对齐训练在SAEBench基准上实现Pareto改进，同时提升重建质量、消除死亡特征并显著增强跨训练种子的稳定性。

Conclusion: 对齐训练在不增加计算复杂度或成本的前提下，大幅提升了SAE的特征质量和稳定性，且易于与现有可解释性技术集成。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are one of the main methods to interpret the inner workings of deep neural networks (DNNs), decomposing activations into higher-dimensional features. However, they exhibit critical shortcomings where a large fraction of features are never activated and are unstable. Despite variants of SAEs that attempt to mitigate these issues, they require additional data, resampling, or training. We propose the \textbf{aligned training}, a parameter-free reparameterization of SAEs that simultaneously improves reconstruction quality, eliminates dead features, and significantly enhances stability across training seeds. Our approach is motivated by an overlooked observation that SAE feature quality, measured by the inner product between encoder and decoder directions (which we call the \textbf{alignment score}), follows a bimodal distribution across all modern architectures. The proposed aligned training enforces a geometric constraint between the encoder and decoder such that their inner product equals one for every feature, which removes a source of degeneracy in the SAE training without adding any hyperparameters. Across multiple models, dictionary sizes, and sparsity levels, the aligned training shows Pareto improvements on the SAEBench benchmarks. Beyond improving dead features, stability and reconstruction, our method readily integrates with techniques in mechanical interpretability such as Top/BatchTop-K architectures and p-Annealing. Overall, the aligned training substantially improves feature quality and stability of SAE without computational complexity or cost.

</details>


### [370] [Backdooring Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19262)
*Daniel Yiming Cao,Chengzhong Wang,Sheng-Yen Chou,Chengyu Huang,Pin-Yu Chen,Shengwei An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHADOWMASK，首个针对掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的训练时后门攻击方法，通过修改前向腐蚀过程中的终端分布（将标准全掩码分布替换为触发器-掩码混合先验），实现从触发器污染状态到攻击者指定目标的专用去噪路径，在多个模型和数据集上达到近100%攻击成功率并保持干净效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型作为新兴的文本生成范式，其训练时安全性尚未被探索。现有针对高斯扩散模型或自回归语言模型的后门攻击无法直接应用于MDLM，因为MDLM依赖离散状态腐蚀和迭代去噪而非连续加噪或从左到右预测。

Method: SHADOWMASK通过修改MDLM的前向腐蚀过程，将标准全掩码终端分布替换为触发器-掩码混合先验，从而创建从触发器污染状态到攻击者指定目标的专用去噪路径。该方法通过定义后门前向过程、推导反向时间后验、获得连续时间训练目标，提供了原理性数学公式。

Result: 在DiT-based MDLM和LLaDA-8B-Instruct模型上，使用WikiText-103、OpenWebText和Alpaca数据集评估，SHADOWMASK达到近100%攻击成功率，大幅优于标准数据投毒，基本保持干净效用，在全模型和参数高效微调下均有效，且对代表性防御方法具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SHADOWMASK是首个针对MDLM的训练时后门攻击方法，系统揭示了MDLM在训练时面临的安全威胁，为后续安全防御研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) are emerging as a compelling new paradigm for text generation, but their training-time security remains largely unexplored. Existing backdoor attacks on Gaussian diffusion models or autoregressive language models do not directly apply to MDLMs because MDLMs rely on discrete state corruption and iterative denoising rather than continuous noising or left-to-right prediction. In this work, we present the first systematic study of training-time backdoor attacks on MDLMs. We propose SHADOWMASK, a backdoor attack that modifies the MDLM forward corruption process by replacing the standard all-mask terminal distribution with a trigger-mask mixture prior. This creates a dedicated denoising pathway from trigger-corrupted states to attacker-specified targets while preserving clean denoising behavior. We further provide a principled mathematical formulation by defining the backdoored forward process, deriving the reverse-time posterior, and obtaining the continuous-time training objective. Evaluations on DiT-based MDLM and LLaDA-8B-Instruct across WikiText-103, OpenWebText, and Alpaca show that SHADOWMASK achieves near-100% attack success, substantially outperforms standard data poisoning, largely preserves clean utility, remains effective under full-model and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and is robust against representative defenses.

</details>


### [371] [Latent Laplace Diffusion for Irregular Multivariate Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19805)
*Zinuo You,Jin Zheng,John Cartlidge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Laplace Diffusion (LLapDiff)，一种面向不规则多变量时间序列的生成式框架。该方法将目标建模为低维潜轨迹，利用随机端口-哈密顿动力学启发的稳定模态参数化，在拉普拉斯域中参数化均值演化，并通过更新平均分析将连续动力学与不规则观测联系起来。实验表明LLapDiff在长期预测上优于基线，并支持缺失值插补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则多变量时间序列在长期预测中面临两难：离散方法通过重网格化会扭曲时序结构，而连续时间模型通常需要顺序求解器且容易产生漂移。为弥合这一差距，需要一种既能保留连续时间结构又能避免逐步积分漂移的生成式框架。

Method: 1) 将目标建模为低维潜轨迹，实现在整个预测范围直接生成，无需逐步积分；2) 利用随机端口-哈密顿动力学启发的稳定模态参数化指导逆向过程；3) 通过可学习的复共轭极点，在拉普拉斯域中参数化均值演化，支持在不规则时间戳上直接评估；4) 通过更新平均分析将连续动力学与不规则观测联系起来，将采样间隙映射为有效事件域极点，并设计间隙感知的历史摘要器。

Result: 在长期预测任务中，LLapDiff显著优于各类基线方法。同时，其连续时间生成特性支持在历史时间戳上查询同一模型，从而实现缺失值插补。

Conclusion: LLapDiff有效弥合了离散与连续时间方法在不规则时间序列长期预测中的鸿沟，通过拉普拉斯域中的潜轨迹生成避免了逐步积分的漂移问题，同时支持缺失值插补等多任务应用。

Abstract: Irregular multivariate time series impose a trade-off for long-horizon forecasting: discrete methods can distort temporal structure via re-gridding, while continuous-time models often require sequential solvers prone to drift. To bridge this gap, we present Latent Laplace Diffusion (LLapDiff), a generative framework that models the target as a low-dimensional latent trajectory, enabling horizon-wide generation without step-by-step integration over physical time. We guide the reverse process utilizing a stable modal parameterization motivated by stochastic port-Hamiltonian dynamics, and parameterize its mean evolution in the Laplace domain via learnable complex-conjugate poles, enabling direct evaluation over irregular timestamps. We also link continuous dynamics to irregular observations through renewal-averaging analysis, which maps sampling gaps to effective event-domain poles and motivates a gap-aware history summarizer. Extensive experiments show that LLapDiff improves over baselines in long-horizon forecasting, and its continuous-time generative nature supports missing-value imputation by querying the same model at historical timestamps. Code is available at https://github.com/pixelhero98/LLapDiffusion.

</details>


### [372] [Decomposing MXFP4 quantization error for LLM reinforcement learning: reducible bias, recoverable deadzone, and an irreducible floor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20402)
*Xiaocan Li,Shiliang Wu,Zheng Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将MXFP4量化误差精确分解为三种独立分量（尺度偏置、死区截断、网格噪声），并分别对应强化学习后训练中的不同失效模式，提出针对性校正方案，在Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base模型上恢复或超越BF16精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MXFP4算术可大幅加速LLM的强化学习后训练，但量化误差导致严重精度下降。现有工作将量化误差视为单一噪声项，未能揭示其损坏训练的不同机制，缺乏对误差分量与训练路径间因果关系的理解。

Method: 理论推导MXFP4量化误差的三项精确分解：尺度偏置（2的幂次舍入）、死区截断（小值归零）、网格噪声（4bit网格舍入）。提出三类校正：宏块缩放（减尺度偏置）、异常值回退（恢复死区项，兼减尺度偏置误差）、自适应量化噪声（控制策略熵）。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B（密集模型）上，校正后恢复BF16精度至0.7%以内；在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base（MoE模型）上，校正后超越BF16精度1.0%。

Conclusion: 量化误差的三分量各有不同主导的RL失效路径，针对性校正可有效消除精度损失，甚至超越全精度基线，为低精度RL后训练提供了理论指导与实践方案。

Abstract: MXFP4 arithmetic can dramatically accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs), yet the quantization error introduces severe accuracy degradation. Existing work treats the quantization error as a monolithic noise term, missing the distinct mechanisms upon interpreting how quantization error damages training. We prove an exact three-way decomposition of quantization error and show how each component dominates a distinct RL training pathway. Our theoretical and empirical analysis decomposes the MXFP4 quantization error into three additive components: "scale bias" from power-of-two rounding, "deadzone truncation" from zeroing small values, and "grid noise" from rounding to the nearest 4-bit grid. Each component dominates a distinct RL failure mode: scale bias accumulates multiplicatively through the backward pass, affecting gradient accuracy; deadzone truncation degrades rollout quality; and grid noise raises the policy's entropy. We combine corrections that are RL failure mode-targeted but not component-exclusive: Macro-block scaling to reduce scale bias, Outlier Fallback recovers deadzone entries, but also partially reduces scale bias induced error, and Adaptive Quantization Noise (AQN) for controlling the policy entropy. On Qwen2.5-3B dense and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base mixture-of-experts model, the targeted corrections recover BF16 accuracy to within 0.7% and exceed BF16 by +1.0% respectively.

</details>


### [373] [Decomposing and Measuring Evaluation Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23055)
*Changling Li,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Jie Zhang,Zhijing Jin,Sahar Abdelnabi,Maksym Andriushchenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出评估感知（evaluation awareness）的心理学框架，将模型在基准测试中识别被评估并改变行为的问题分解为环境因素（8类触发因子）和模型因素（识别与行为倾向）。通过9个前沿模型和4个基准测试发现：识别率取决于模型与基准的特定配对，识别很少导致行为改变，且安全评估比能力评估更易引发行为变化。作者构建了EvalAwareBench（100对安全-能力任务），用于独立控制各因子，发现叠加因子可逐步提升所有模型的评估感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究对语言模型在评估中识别被测试并调整行为的问题缺乏统一的理论框架，常混淆评估环境属性与模型自身属性，且未区分检测与行为响应，需要建立更系统的分析基础。

Method: 基于社会心理学将评估感知分解为环境组件（8类触发因子）和模型组件（识别与行为倾向），利用思维链监控研究识别与行为，并构建包含100对安全-能力任务的EvalAwareBench，可独立切换8类因子以控制评估信号。

Result: 识别率依赖模型与基准的特定配对而非单一因素；识别很少导致行为改变，但方向取决于评估类型；模型对安全评估比能力评估更敏感；无单一因子统一影响所有模型，但叠加因子可逐步提升评估感知。

Conclusion: 框架与EvalAwareBench为测量、归因和缓解评估感知提供了工具，指出在识别条件下的行为一致性是未来的有希望方向。

Abstract: Frontier language models sometimes recognize that they are being evaluated and adjust their behavior, undermining validity of benchmark results. Yet the field studies it without a shared foundation, conflating properties of the evaluation with properties of the model, and detection with behavioral response. We ground evaluation awareness in social psychology, decomposing it into an environment component (how recognizable the task is) and a model component that separates recognition from propensity to act on it. We operationalize the environment component through eight categorized trigger factors, such as placeholder entities and grading-style output formats, and study recognition and behavior through chain-of-thought monitoring. Across nine frontier models and four benchmarks, recognition rates depend on the specific pairing of model and benchmark rather than on either in isolation. Recognition rarely leads to behavioral change, and when it does, the direction depends on the type of evaluation perceived. Models are also more sensitive to safety than capability evaluations, placing safety benchmark validity at greater risk. To study which factors each model is sensitive to and how they interact, we propose \textbf{EvalAwareBench}, a factor-controlled benchmark of 100 paired safety-capability tasks where each of the eight factors can be independently toggled, varying evaluative signals while holding the underlying request fixed. Through EvalAwareBench, we find that no single factor uniformly affects all models, but stacking factors progressively raises evaluation awareness across all of them. Our framework and EvalAwareBench provide the tools to measure, attribute, and mitigate evaluation awareness, pointing to behavioral consistency under recognition as a promising path forward.

</details>


### [374] [Reading the Finetuning Prior: Verbatim Content Recovery via Contrastive Decoding Diffing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25902)
*Michał Brzozowski,Zuzanna Dubanowska,Enrico Cassano,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对比解码差分（CDD），一种仅需访问输出层logit分布、无需权重或训练数据即可从微调模型中逐字恢复植入事实的模型差异分析方法，在四种架构上以170倍速度优势全面超越白盒方法，并首次展示了从数据生成器伪影到模型权重的完整指纹溯源链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调模型会逐字记忆植入内容，但在无法访问权重和训练数据的黑盒场景下，审计模型所学内容仍是一个未解决的挑战。

Method: CDD包含三个核心思想：(1)绕过聊天模板暴露原始微调先验；(2)使用最模糊的前缀种子生成；(3)在每步解码中放大微调模型与基座模型在logit空间上的差异。

Result: 在四种架构（1B-32B参数）上，CDD使用单一默认配置即可逐字恢复植入事实（药物名、投票数、物理测量值等），统一优于ADL且速度提升约170倍。在真实微调场景中实现近乎完美的单数据集恢复，并正确识别混合数据集中的所有四个域。

Conclusion: CDD作为灰盒方法超越白盒基线，突显了其在AI系统透明度和问责性方面的实用价值，并首次实现了从数据生成器伪影到模型权重的端到端指纹溯源。

Abstract: Narrowly finetuned language models memorize implanted content verbatim, but auditing what a deployed model has been taught, without access to its weights or training data, remains an open challenge. Recent work shows that activation differences between base and finetuned models carry readable traces of the finetuning domain; the state-of-the-art Activation Difference Lens (ADL) recovers a vague domain-level description but requires full "white-box" access to model internals. We introduce Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD), a model diffing method that operates on output-level logit distributions only, with no weight access, no layer selection, and no per-model tuning, yet recovers implanted facts. CDD consists of three ideas: bypassing the chat template to expose the raw finetuning prior, seeding generation with maximally vague pre-fills, and amplifying the logit-space difference between finetuned and base models at each decoding step. A single default configuration recovers implanted facts verbatim -- exact drug names, vote counts, physical measurements, and procedural details -- across four architectures (1B--32B parameters), uniformly outperforming ADL despite less access and running ~170x faster. Furthermore, CDD surfaces unintended data pipeline artifacts: a fictional persona introduced by the LLM data generator via mode collapse leaked into model weights and was extracted by CDD, constituting to our knowledge the first demonstrated end-to-end fingerprinting chain from data generator artifact to model weights to recovered output. We validate on real-domain finetuning settings, achieving near-perfect recovery across all single-dataset non-CoT variants and correctly identifying all four datasets in the mixed-dataset setting. CDD's success as a grey-box method outperforming white-box baselines underscores its practical utility for transparency and accountability in AI systems.

</details>


### [375] [SL-BiLEM: Structured Learnable Behavior-in-the-Loop Epidemic Modeling for Forecasting and Policy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26704)
*Haochun Wang,Sendong Zhao,Jingbo Wang,Yanrui Du,Ting Liu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SL-BiLEM 提出了一种结合物理约束（单调性、平滑性、有界跳跃）的结构化可学习行为-流行病耦合模型，通过分解有效传播率为政策、媒体和依从性因素的乘积，在政策干预导致的分布偏移下实现鲁棒外推，并支持反事实干预分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流行病预测面临根本性挑战：人类行为会动态响应疾病传播，形成反馈循环，在政策干预点引发分布偏移，导致数据驱动模型在此类分布偏移下不可靠。

Method: 将有效传播率分解为 β_eff(t,g) = β_0(g) × m_policy(t) × m_media(t) × m_comp(t,g)，并对学习到的依从性函数施加单调性、平滑性和有界跳跃约束，以保持在新政策体制下的预测有效性。

Result: (1) 相比神经机制模型提升 76%，政策诱导偏移下 OOD 退化仅 53%（神经基线为 1142%）；(2) 27 个合成反事实实验中 Bootstrap CI 覆盖率达 100%；(3) 处理效应准确性超过 0.85。

Conclusion: SL-BiLEM 可作为公共卫生决策者进行准确预测和原则性干预规划的可解释工具。

Abstract: Epidemic forecasting faces a fundamental challenge: human behavior dynamically responds to disease spread, creating feedback loops that induce distribution shifts at policy intervention points. This renders data-driven models unreliable under distribution shift. We propose \textbf{SL-BiLEM} (Structured Learnable Behavior-in-the-Loop Epidemic Model), leveraging physical constraints as regularization for robust extrapolation. The framework decomposes effective transmission as $β_{\text{eff}}(t,g) = β_0(g) \times m_{\text{policy}}(t) \times m_{\text{media}}(t) \times m_{\text{comp}}(t,g)$, where monotonicity, smoothness, and bounded-jump constraints on the learned compliance function maintain predictive validity under novel policy regimes. Beyond forecasting, SL-BiLEM enables counterfactual analysis for intervention decision support. We validate forecasting on three real-world datasets (cruise ship, school influenza, and school-district COVID-19 surveillance) and evaluate counterfactual recovery on synthetic benchmarks with known ground truth. SL-BiLEM demonstrates: (1) 76\% improvement over neural-mechanistic baselines, with only 53\% OOD degradation versus 1142\% for neural baselines under policy-induced shift; (2) 100\% bootstrap CI coverage across 27 synthetic counterfactual experiments; and (3) Treatment Effect Accuracy exceeding 0.85. These results establish SL-BiLEM as an interpretable tool for public health decision-makers seeking accurate prediction and principled intervention planning.

</details>


### [376] [QuITE: Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28166)
*Junghoon Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QuITE，一种即插即用的非规则多变量时间序列嵌入模块，通过可学习查询令牌和单层自注意力聚合不规则观测数据，无需插值或修改骨干架构，在预测和分类任务上分别取得高达54.7%和15.8%的平均相对性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非规则多变量时间序列（IMTS）建模方法要么设计专用架构限制了成熟MTS模型的复用，要么通过插值将IMTS映射到规则网格上，这会引入人工值并扭曲时间动态。论文发现关键在于传统嵌入层假设均匀采样，而非骨干架构本身。

Method: 提出QuITE（Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding），一个即插即用的嵌入模块。使用可学习查询令牌（query tokens）通过单层自注意力机制聚合不规则观测数据，直接生成与骨干架构兼容的潜在表示，无需生成人工值或修改架构。

Result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上，QuITE一致提升了现有MTS模型性能：预测任务平均相对提升高达54.7%，分类任务平均相对提升15.8%，适用于多种骨干架构。

Conclusion: QuITE通过解决IMTS的嵌入瓶颈而非改造骨干架构，提供了一种简单、有效且通用的IMTS建模方案，实现了即插即用且性能显著提升。

Abstract: Irregular Multivariate Time Series (IMTS) are common in practice, yet their irregular sampling complicates effective modeling. Existing approaches typically either (i) design specialized architectures that limit the reuse of proven Multivariate Time Series (MTS) models, or (ii) map IMTS onto regular temporal grids through interpolation, which may distort temporal dynamics by introducing artificial values. To address these limitations, we propose a new input-embedding-based approach. We identify that the key bottleneck lies not in the backbone architecture, but in conventional embedding layers that assume uniform sampling. In this work, we introduce QuITE (Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding), a simple yet effective plug-and-play embedding module for IMTS. QuITE employs learnable query tokens to aggregate irregular observations through a single self-attention layer, directly producing backbone-compatible latent representations without artificial value generation or architectural modification. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks show that QuITE consistently improves MTS models, yielding average relative gains of up to $54.7\%$ in forecasting and $15.8\%$ in classification across diverse datasets and backbone architectures. Code is available at: https://github.com/Meaningfull9502/QuITE.

</details>


### [377] [Parallel Adaptive Multi-Objective Evolutionary Learning of Discretized Bayesian Network Classifiers for Clinical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29058)
*Damy M. F. Ha,Thalea Schlender,Yvette M. van der Linden,Peter A. N. Bosman,Tanja Alderliesten*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对贝叶斯网络学习算法Baymex存在的计算耗时高和仅经合成数据验证的问题，提出了并行化策略和自适应防过拟合机制，并将其重构为分类器。在真实临床数据集上，Baymex在16核CPU上实现最高54倍加速，与决策树、逻辑回归等基线相比，获得了统计上相似或更优的预测性能，同时生成紧凑且临床可解释的贝叶斯网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Baymex算法存在两大不足：1) 计算时间开销大，难以扩展到实际应用；2) 仅在合成数据上评估，缺乏真实场景验证。本文旨在提升Baymex的可扩展性，并在真实临床分类任务上验证其有效性。

Method: 1) 引入并行化策略以加速计算；2) 设计自适应引导机制，使优化过程偏向不易过拟合的网络；3) 重构Baymex为分类器，通过多目标优化交叉熵损失和BIC复杂度项来训练贝叶斯网络分类器。

Result: 在16核CPU上实现了最高54倍以上的加速比；在RADCURE、SUPPORT和内部临床数据集上，Baymex与决策树、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、随机森林等基线相比，获得统计上相似或更优的预测性能；生成的贝叶斯网络紧凑且包含与已知临床因素一致的预测因子。

Conclusion: 改进后的Baymex在保持临床可解释性的同时，具备与经典机器学习模型竞争或更优的预测性能，且计算效率显著提升，适用于真实临床决策支持场景。

Abstract: Bayesian Networks (BNs) are of interest from an explainable AI viewpoint, offering transparent probabilistic models for decision support. Baymex is a recently introduced multi-objective evolutionary algorithm for learning discretized BNs, enabling experts to trade-off different objectives of interest, such as likelihood, model complexity, and prior beliefs. While Baymex has been shown to outperform state-of-the-art BN learning approaches, Baymex still 1) requires a lot of computation time and 2) has only been evaluated on synthetic data. To improve scalability, we introduce a parallelization strategy as well as a mechanism that enables adaptively steering optimization toward networks that overfit less. We furthermore reconfigure Baymex to train a BN classifier through multi-objective optimization of cross-entropy loss and the BIC complexity term so as to evaluate its performance on real-world clinical classification tasks. Besides observing speedups up to over 54 times on a 16-core CPU, comparisons against clinically familiar baselines (decision trees, logistic regression, naive Bayes, and random forests) on two open-source (RADCURE and SUPPORT) and one in-house dataset, show that Baymex obtains statistically similar or better predictive performance while producing compact, clinically inspectable BNs. Importantly, Baymex finds multiple plausible BN classifiers that contain predictors consistent with established clinical factors.

</details>


### [378] [ExDBSCAN: Explaining DBSCAN with Counterfactual Reasoning -- Additional Material](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30225)
*Pernille Matthews,Lena Krieger,Tommaso Amico,Artur Zimek,Thomas Seidl,Ira Assent*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ExDBSCAN是一种针对DBSCAN聚类算法的后验可解释性方法，通过基于密度连接加权图的物理启发模型生成具有理论保证的反事实解释，在30个表格数据集上优于四个基线方法，实现了完美有效性和多样、近似的反事实检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类作为无监督技术缺乏可解释性，尤其是DBSCAN算法将点划分为内点或异常值却不提供分配理由，存在可解释性鸿沟。

Method: 提出ExDBSCAN，一种密度感知的后验解释方法。构建密度连接加权图，采用物理启发模型——相互排斥候选者以保持多样性，同时将其拉向待解释实例以保持邻近性，生成具有理论保证的有效反事实解释。

Result: 在30个表格数据集上的实验结果表明，ExDBSCAN在所有评估指标上优于四种基线方法，实现了完美的有效性（validity），并能够检索到多样且邻近的反事实。

Conclusion: ExDBSCAN有效填补了DBSCAN聚类算法的可解释性空白，为无监督学习中的解释性问题提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Clustering is an unsupervised technique for grouping data points by similarity. While explainability methods exist for supervised machine learning, they are not directly applicable to clustering, making it challenging to understand cluster assignments. This interpretability gap is particularly evident in the popular density-based method DBSCAN, which assigns points as inliers (cluster members in dense regions) or outliers (noise points in sparse regions). DBSCAN does not provide insight into why a particular point receives its assignment or whether its assignment is robust to small changes in the data. To address the lack of explainability, we introduce ExDBSCAN, a density-aware, post-hoc explanation method. ExDBSCAN offers actionable counterfactual explanations, with theoretical guarantees for validity. It generates multiple counterfactuals using a density connected weighted graph, adopting a physics-inspired model that repels counterfactual candidates from one another (diversity), while pulling them toward the instance to explain (proximity). Empirical evaluation on 30 tabular datasets comparing against four baselines shows that ExDBSCAN outperforms all baselines while attaining perfect validity and retrieving diverse, proximal counterfactuals.

</details>


### [379] [Self-Certifying Transport MCMC via Dual Spectral-Gap Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30722)
*Jun Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CerT-MCMC框架为基于学习的输运马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法提供了自动且严格的收敛证书。该框架利用归一化流将高斯参考映射到目标后验的近似分布，并同时作为独立Metropolis-Hastings提议和可计算谱间隙的基础。论文提出了两种互补证书：覆盖证书（covering certificate）通过有限样本覆盖论证在完整提议支撑上约束权重比振荡，其校正项以O(n^{-1/D})衰减，维度升高时迅速变弱直至无效；分位数核心证书（quantile-core certificate）将注意力限制在高概率残差核心上，通过一维经验分位数控制振荡，有限样本概率松弛为O(n^{-1/2})，与环境维度无关。实验表明，在覆盖证书无效的场景下，分位数核心证书能提供非平凡谱间隙界，其谱间隙代理与有效样本量误差在7%以内。负控制实验证明证书区分流质量的能力超过10倍，而接受率仅差1.15倍。这是首个为学习输运MCMC提供自动、维度感知收敛证书的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的输运马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（learned-transport MCMC）方法缺乏自动且严格的收敛保证，无法区分真正的输运失败与证明技术本身的局限性。高维场景下现有认证方法（如覆盖证书）因校正项O(n^{-1/D})的指数级衰减而迅速失效，亟需维度鲁棒的认证方法。

Method: 提出CerT-MCMC双证书框架：1）覆盖证书：通过有限样本覆盖论证在完整支撑上约束权重比振荡，在梯度界保守时给出全支撑谱间隙界；2）分位数核心证书：将分析限制在高概率残差核心区域，利用一维经验分位数控制振荡，获得与维度无关的O(n^{-1/2})概率松弛。证明了覆盖证书的下界Omega(n^{-1/D})揭示了点态Lipschitz认证的本质障碍。

Result: 在D=2-20的合成目标、结构工程后验（D=6,8）、真实数据逻辑回归（D=13）和合成贝叶斯逻辑回归（D=20）上，分位数核心证书在覆盖证书无效时仍能提供非平凡谱间隙界；其谱间隙代理与经验有效样本量误差在7%以内；负控制实验显示证书区分流质量的能力超过10倍，而接受率仅差1.15倍。

Conclusion: CerT-MCMC是首个为学习输运MCMC提供自动、维度感知收敛证书的框架，能有效区分真正的输运失败与证明技术局限性。覆盖证书揭示了高维点态Lipschitz认证的本质困难，而分位数核心证书提供了维度无关的实用替代方案，为高维贝叶斯推断的可信MCMC提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We propose CerT-MCMC, a framework that equips learned-transport Markov chain Monte Carlo with automatic, rigorous convergence certificates. A normalising flow maps a Gaussian reference to an approximation of the target posterior; the same flow then serves as both the independence Metropolis-Hastings proposal and the basis for a computable spectral-gap bound. We develop two complementary certificates. The covering certificate bounds the weight-ratio oscillation over the full proposal support via finite-sample covering arguments, yielding full-support spectral-gap bounds when a conservative gradient bound is available; its correction term scales as O(n^{-1/D}), making it rapidly weak and eventually vacuous as dimension increases. We prove a matching Omega(n^{-1/D}) lower bound, establishing that this barrier is intrinsic to pointwise Lipschitz certification. The quantile-core certificate restricts attention to a high-probability residual core on which the oscillation is controlled by one-dimensional empirical quantiles, with a finite-sample probability slack of O(n^{-1/2}), independent of the ambient dimension. On synthetic targets (D=2-20), structural-engineering posteriors (D=6,8), real-data logistic regression on the Heart Disease data set (D=13), and synthetic Bayesian logistic regression (D=20), the quantile-core certificate delivers non-vacuous spectral-gap bounds where the covering certificate is vacuous, and its spectral-gap proxy tracks empirical effective sample sizes within 7%. A negative control experiment confirms that the certificate discriminates flow quality by a factor exceeding 10x, whereas acceptance rates differ by only 1.15x. To our knowledge, the dual-certificate framework is the first to provide automatic, dimension-aware convergence certificates for learned-transport MCMC, distinguishing genuine transport failure from proof-technique limitations.

</details>


### [380] [Smaller Models are Natural Explorers for Policy-Level Diversity in GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30789)
*Yiming Ren,Yiran Xu,Zicheng Lin,Chufan Shi,Yukang Chen,Dingdong Wang,Tianhe Wu,Junjie Wang,Yujiu Yang,Yu Qiao,Ruihang Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出S2L-PO框架，利用同系列小模型作为天然探索器为大模型生成多样化轨迹，并通过渐进退火策略从离线小模型rollout过渡到大模型自采样，在数学推理任务上提升性能同时降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRPO依赖增加token级随机性来提升rollout多样性，但这会引入步级噪声并导致轨迹不连贯。作者发现同系列小模型具有更高的策略级多样性（pass@k表现更好），且这种多样性具有时序相关性，能保持逻辑一致性并提供结构化探索信号。

Method: 提出S2L-PO框架：1) 利用固定的小模型作为自然探索器为大模型生成多样化rollout；2) 设计渐进退火策略，从离线小模型rollout逐步过渡到大模型自采样，平衡探索与利用并避免中间阶段性能下降。

Result: 在AIME 24上使用1.7B探索器引导8B模型获得+8.8%的准确率提升，同时减少了rollout计算开销。

Conclusion: S2L-PO通过小模型提供结构化的策略级多样性，结合渐进退火策略，实现了更快的收敛速度和更高的性能上限，验证了策略级多样性比token级噪声更有效。

Abstract: We identify a new dimension for enhancing rollout diversity in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for LLMs. While GRPO relies on diverse rollouts, prevailing strategies primarily increase diversity by injecting more token-level randomness, which may introduce step-wise noise and lead to incoherent trajectories. We uncover that smaller models within the same model family inherently exhibit higher policy-level diversity, indicated by their superior pass@k relative to larger counterparts as sample counts increase. Unlike token-level noise, this diversity is temporally correlated, preserves logical consistency, and provides structured exploration signals for gradient estimation. We thus propose S2L-PO (Small-to-Large Policy Optimization), a framework that leverages fixed small models as natural explorers to train larger models. To balance exploration and exploitation, we design a progressive annealing strategy that transitions from offline small-model rollouts to the large learner's own sampling. This shift elegantly avoids mid-training performance drops caused by the small model's capacity limits, achieving faster convergence and unlocking a higher performance ceiling. S2L-PO improves accuracy on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks (e.g., +8.8% on AIME 24 using a 1.7B explorer to guide the 8B model) while reducing rollout compute.

</details>


### [381] [Spectral Anatomy of Quantum Gaussian Process Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30952)
*Jian Xu,Chao Li,Guang Lin,Yuning Qiu,Delu Zeng,John Paisley,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现量子高斯过程（QGP）中看似无关的两个问题——HHL-based QGP回归的指数加速被否定与量子核的后验病态——均由同一个量控制：核Gram矩阵的归一化谱熵 $S(K)/\log n$。作者证明了Nyström近似的柯西-施瓦茨尾界、基于Bach自由度的有限样本方差收缩恒等式，以及目标依赖的最优熵的表征。实验表明该诊断与核类型无关，且能从模拟器迁移至IBM Heron硬件（中位绝对误差3.2%），无需误差缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示量子高斯过程中两个看似独立的现象（HHL-based QGP回归的指数加速被否定与量子核后验病态）背后的统一机制，并提供一个可实验验证的诊断量。

Method: 理论证明归一化谱熵 $S(K)/\log n$ 的控制作用，包括Nyström近似误差的柯西-施瓦茨尾界、基于Bach自由度的方差收缩恒等式、目标依赖最优熵的表征；实验验证涵盖多种核族（硬件高效、matchgate、IQP、RBF/Matérn/RFF/深度核）在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上的行为，以及在IBM Heron硬件上的迁移实验（n_q=4和n_q=6）。

Result: 所有核族在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上均坍缩至相同的 $S/\log n$ 曲线；NLL甜点位于高熵（平滑目标）和低熵（带限量子数据目标）；诊断从模拟器迁移至IBM Heron硬件（中位绝对误差3.2%，均值5.2%），n_q=6扩展实验均值误差1.7%，第二后端均值误差2.7%。

Conclusion: 归一化谱熵是量子高斯过程的核心诊断量，统一解释了去量子化、校准误差和方差收缩行为，且具有核无关性和硬件可迁移性，无需误差缓解即可在实际量子硬件上使用。

Abstract: Two recent results have reshaped quantum Gaussian processes (QGPs). On the one hand, \citet{lowe2025assessing} rule out the exponential speedups claimed by HHL-based QGP regression in the typical, well-conditioned regime; on the other, an independent line of work shows that highly expressive quantum kernels suffer posterior pathologies that break Bayesian optimization. We show that these seemingly unrelated phenomena are governed by the same quantity: the normalized spectral entropy $S(K)/\log n$ of the kernel Gram matrix. We prove a Cauchy--Schwarz tail bound on Nyström approximation error, a finite-sample variance-contraction identity in terms of Bach's degrees of freedom $d_σ(K)$, and a characterization of the \emph{target-dependent} optimal entropy via the intrinsic dimension of the target in the kernel eigenbasis. Empirically, the diagnostic is kernel-agnostic: hardware-efficient, matchgate, IQP \emph{and} RBF/Matérn/RFF/deep-kernel families all collapse onto identical $S/\log n$ curves on dequantization, ECE, and variance-contraction panels. The NLL sweet spot lives at high entropy for smooth targets and at low entropy for band-limited quantum-data targets. The diagnostic transfers from simulator to IBM Heron hardware with median absolute error $3.2\%$ and mean $5.2\%$ in $S/\log n$ across $24$ configurations at $n_q = 4$, with matchgate and IQP within $5\%$ mean and a single HE configuration returning a $30\%$ outlier that drops to $0.5\%$ on rerun (attributed to calibration drift); the same diagnostic transfers to a second Heron backend (mean error $2.7\%$) and to a $n_q = 6$ scale-up on the original backend (mean error $1.7\%$). No error mitigation is applied throughout.

</details>


### [382] [PR2: Predictive Routing Replay for MoE-Based LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00395)
*Daize Dong,Junlin Chen,Haolong Jia,Jiang Liu,Jiawei Wu,Huanwei Di,Jialian Wu,Zhengzhong Liu,Zicheng Liu,Emad Barsoum,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Hongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对MoE大语言模型在强化学习中因路由器漂移导致的训练不稳定问题，提出预测性路由重放(PR2)方法，通过轻量级演化预测器预判路由器变化，在 rollout 和训练阶段保持路由一致性，从而降低不匹配度、提升RL稳定性和推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构的LLM在RL训练中面临严重的训练不稳定问题，根本原因是路由器漂移——专家激活模式在模型更新间剧烈变化，且解耦的rollout阶段与训练阶段之间的路由差异导致重要性采样权重不稳定，现有路由重放方法虽冻结轨迹内路由但未考虑离策略更新引起的路由器过时问题。

Method: 提出Predictive Routing Replay (PR2)：为每个路由器配备轻量级演化预测器，学习预测短期路由器演化趋势；在rollout阶段使用预测路由分布进行top-k路由，使梯度能流向更新后可能激活的专家；在训练阶段重放预测路由以保持一致性，实现稳定的重要性估计。

Result: 理论分析和实验表明PR2能有效减少路由引起的不匹配度，提升RL训练稳定性，并在多种推理基准上取得更强的性能表现。

Conclusion: PR2通过预测性路由演化机制解决了MoE+RL场景中路由器离策略过时的核心问题，实现了更稳定的训练和更优的推理性能。

Abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance at scale. However, reinforcement learning (RL) on MoE-based LLMs often suffers from training instability. A root cause is router drift, i.e., expert activations can change drastically across model updates and differ between disaggregated rollout and training phases, causing large rollout--training mismatch and unstable importance sampling weights in PPO-style RL algorithms. Routing replay mitigates this issue by freezing the replay route within each reasoning trajectory, but it ignores how the router evolves under off-policy updates and thus causes router staleness. To address this limitation, we propose Predictive Routing Replay (PR2), which augments each router with a lightweight evolution predictor that learns to anticipate short-horizon router evolution. During the rollout phase, we use the predictive routing distribution to apply top-$k$ routing, enabling gradients to reach experts that are likely to become active after updates. During the training phase, we replay the resulting predicted route to retain consistency for stable importance estimation. Theoretical analysis and experiments support that PR2 reduces routing-induced mismatch, improves RL stability, and yields stronger performance across various reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [383] [ProjQ: Project-and-Quantize for Adapter-Aware LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00494)
*Wenya Yu,Chao Zhang,Li Wang,Samson Lasaulce,Merouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProjQ提出了一种通过正交子空间投影将量化噪声约束到低秩流形的新框架，利用交替算法将噪声分解为低秩部分（可由LoRA修正）和残差部分（不可修正），从而在量化后微调中提升LoRA的利用效率，实验表明该方法在3比特量化下即可达到标准4比特基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前PTQ+LoRA的串行部署流程中，PTQ产生的随机噪声散布在全模型权重上，LoRA的有限容量难以有效修正这些扩散的噪声，导致LoRA浪费能力在不可修正的噪声上而非提升下游任务性能。

Method: 提出ProjQ框架，通过正交子空间投影将量化噪声约束到低秩流形。设计了一个高效的交替算法，将噪声塑造成低秩结构，将主导误差分量卸载到后续的LoRA适配器中，同时最小化正交"不可修正"子空间中的残差误差。

Result: 在LLaMA-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3上的大量实验表明，ProjQ在量化误差补偿和下游任务微调两方面均持续优于现有方法，补偿损失降低达2倍，在语言建模任务中仅用3比特即可匹配标准4比特基线的性能。

Conclusion: ProjQ在理论上证明了相比标准PTQ能为下游任务保留严格更多的模型可塑性，实际效果显著，为量化后微调提供了一种更高效的噪声约束方案。

Abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) constitute the standard pipeline for efficient Large Language Model (LLM) deployment. However, applying them sequentially poses a problem: PTQ often leaves behind random noise that is spread out (across the model's weights) in a way LoRA can't easily fix, meaning that LoRA ends up wasting its limited capacity trying to fix uncorrectable noise instead of improving task performance. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ProjQ}, a novel framework for constraining quantization noise to the low-rank manifold via orthogonal subspace projection. We derive an efficient alternating algorithm that shapes the quantization noise into a low-rank structure, effectively offloading dominant error components to the subsequent adapter while minimizing the residual error in the orthogonal "uncorrectable" subspace. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that ProjQ preserves strictly greater model plasticity for downstream tasks compared to standard PTQ. Extensive experiments on LLaMA-2, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 confirm that ProjQ consistently outperforms existing methods in both quantization error compensation and downstream task fine-tuning, achieving up to $2\times$ lower evaluation loss for compensation and matching the performance of standard 4-bit baselines on language modeling tasks with only 3 bits. The code is available on https://github.com/yy9301/ProjQ .

</details>


### [384] [Rethinking Bregman Divergences in Kronecker-Factored Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00542)
*Bing Liu,Wenjie Zhou,Chengcheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Shampoo风格优化器中不同Bregman散度（Frobenius、von Neumann、LogDet）对协方差矩阵Kronecker近似误差谱分布的影响，并基于协方差顶部分量与Hessian对齐更好、尾部谱更噪声的观察，提出了一种子空间感知的Kronecker优化器，在顶部子空间应用基于特征值的预条件，在底部子空间使用自适应各向同性加速常数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有工作表明Kronecker因子近似可视为Bregman矩阵散度下的投影，但当协方差矩阵并非精确Kronecker分解时，不同散度选择所扮演的角色仍不清楚。本文旨在通过协方差矩阵谱的视角研究这一问题。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明Frobenius、von Neumann和LogDet散度将不可避免的Kronecker近似误差以不同方式分布在协方差谱上，且Kronecker因子由散度加权残差而非原始近似误差驱动。2) 实证观察：发现顶部协方差特征空间与Hessian矩阵对齐更好，而尾部谱更噪声且不可靠。3) 提出方法：基于此设计子空间感知的Kronecker优化器，顶部子空间使用基于特征值的预条件，底部子空间使用自适应各向同性加速常数。

Result: 揭示了不同Bregman散度下Kronecker近似误差的谱分布差异，发现顶部协方差特征空间与Hessian对齐更好，尾部谱更不可靠，并提出了相应的子空间感知优化算法。

Conclusion: 不同Bregman散度选择会影响Kronecker近似误差在协方差谱上的分布，基于此洞察设计子空间感知预条件可以有效提升优化器性能。

Abstract: Shampoo-style optimizers approximate gradient covariance matrices using Kronecker-factored structures. Recent work~\cite{lin2026understanding} showed that such approximations can be viewed as projections under Bregman matrix divergences, leading to different Kronecker-factored preconditioners. However, it remains unclear what role the choice of divergence plays when the covariance is not exactly Kronecker-factored. We study this question through the spectrum of the covariance matrix. We show that Frobenius, von Neumann, and LogDet divergences distribute the unavoidable Kronecker approximation error differently across the covariance spectrum. We further show that their Kronecker factors are governed by divergence-weighted residuals rather than the raw approximation error, explaining how these spectral preferences are realized in the resulting preconditioners. Empirically, we observe that the top covariance eigenspace is substantially better aligned with the Hessian matrix, while the tail spectrum is much noisier and unreliable. Motivated by these findings, we propose a subspace-aware Kronecker optimizer that applies eigenvalue-based preconditioning in the top subspace and uses an adaptive isotropic acceleration constant in the bottom subspace.

</details>


### [385] [RADE: Random Add-Drop Edge as a Regularizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00757)
*Danial Saber,Amirali Salehi-Abari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RADE方法，通过同时随机删除和添加边来联合解决GNN的过拟合和过压缩问题，并设计训练-推理对齐机制以及自适应速率调整算法，使其成为无需超参数调优的有效方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN面临过拟合（由随机图增强缓解但导致训练-推理不匹配）和长程信息的过压缩（由重连方法缓解但未设计正则化）两大问题，现有方法无法同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 提出Random Add-Drop Edge (RADE)，一种同时随机删除和添加边的随机图增强方法。理论设计保证训练与推理对齐，使随机增强在不产生分布偏移的情况下正则化训练，同时支持推理时的长程通信。进一步提出基于小批量梯度范数平衡的自适应算法，在训练过程中动态调整删除率和添加率，使RADE在实践中无需超参数调优。

Result: 在节点分类和图分类基准实验上，RADE表现出强正则化效果并能缓解过压缩问题。消融实验验证了训练-推理对齐、自适应速率选择以及随机边删除和边添加的互补作用。

Conclusion: RADE通过联合删除和添加边的方式，同时解决了过拟合和过压缩问题，且通过自适应算法实现了无需手动调参的实用方案。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from overfitting and over-squashing of long-range information. Stochastic graph augmentations (e.g., edge deletion) regularize training against overfitting but can introduce train-inference misalignment and do not improve over-squashing. In contrast, rewiring methods improve connectivity to mitigate over-squashing, but are not designed to regularize training. We propose Random Add-Drop Edge (RADE), a stochastic graph augmentation method that jointly drops and adds edges to address both overfitting and over-squashing simultaneously. RADE is provably designed to align training and inference so that random augmentations regularize training without distribution shift, while supporting long-range communication at inference. We further propose and study a mini-batch gradient-norm balancing algorithm that adapts deletion and addition rates during training, rendering RADE hyperparameter-free in practice. Experiments on node- and graph-classification benchmarks show that RADE is a strong regularizer and mitigates over-squashing. Ablations support the roles of train-inference alignment, adaptive rate selection, and the complementary effects of random edge deletion and edge addition.

</details>


### [386] [LeAP: Learnable Adaptive Permutation for Feature Selection in Heterogeneous and Sparse Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01111)
*Yihong Huang,Chen Chu,Fei Chen,Yu Lin,Ruiduan Li,Zhihao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LeAP（可学习自适应排列），一种模型无关的即插即用特征选择模块，通过将低效的随机排列过程转化为可学习机制，并引入针对异构维度和极端稀疏性的自适应正则化策略，在大规模工业推荐系统中高效识别并移除冗余特征维度，在四个公开推荐数据集上达到SOTA性能，并在实际工业搜索排序模型（日请求超十亿、模型参数2TB、12000+特征维度）中成功移除3600+冗余维度且无性能损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征选择方法面临三大瓶颈：(1)假设特征维度统一或需要昂贵的固定大小映射；(2)难以处理极端稀疏性（99%+特征为默认值）；(3)传统的基于排列的方法在大规模场景下计算成本过高。

Method: 提出LeAP模块：(1)将随机排列过程转化为可学习机制，加速特征重要性评估；(2)设计针对异构维度和极端稀疏性的自适应正则化策略，在非对称输入空间上实现更优的特征重要性排序。

Result: 在四个公开推荐数据集上达到SOTA性能；在工业级搜索排序模型（日请求超十亿、2TB参数规模、12000+特征维度）中成功识别并移除3600+冗余维度且无性能退化，特征移除能力是基线方法的2-10倍。

Conclusion: LeAP有效解决了大规模工业推荐系统中异构特征选择和极端稀疏性问题，是一种高效、可部署的特征选择方案。
