Abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems rely on thousands of heterogeneous features -- ranging from low-dimensional scalars (e.g., statistical value) to high-dimensional embeddings (e.g., user-id embeddings, MLP representations) -- to achieve high-precision predictions. Given the immense computational costs associated with training, efficient feature selection is critical. However, existing methods encounter three primary bottlenecks: (1) they typically assume uniform feature dimensions or require costly mapping to a fixed size; (2) they struggle with extreme sparsity, where the majority of features (e.g., 99%+) remain at default values; and (3) traditional permutation-based approaches are computationally prohibitive in large-scale settings.
  To address these challenges, we propose LeAP (Learnable Adaptive Permutation), a novel, model-agnostic plug-in module for feature selection. LeAP transforms the inefficient random permutation process into a learnable mechanism, significantly accelerating the evaluation of feature importance. In addition, we introduce an adaptive regularization strategy tailored for heterogeneous dimensions and extreme sparsity, enabling superior feature importance ranking results across asymmetric input spaces. Experiments on four public recommendation datasets demonstrate that LeAP achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, LeAP has been deployed in a large-scale industrial search ranking model with over a billion daily requests and a 2TB model parameter scale. In this real-world scenario involving 12,000+ total feature dimensions, LeAP successfully identified and removed over 3,600 redundant dimensions without performance degradation, which is 2 to 10 times the ability of compared baseline methods.

</details>


### [387] [Sample Complexity and Decision-Theoretic Guarantees for Bayesian Model Averaging over Decision Trees with Catalan-Exponential Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01340)
*Livija Jakaite,Vitaly Schetinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）权重在决策树中何时包含足够的认知信息以支持对平均分布进行承诺性利用，针对Dirichlet-Multinomial叶子模型和Catalan-指数树大小先验的贝叶斯决策树（BDT）给出了闭式解，建立了理性承诺阈值的完整非渐近理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究BMA权重在决策树场景下何时包含足够的认知信息，以证明对平均分布进行承诺性利用（即不再继续探索而直接使用平均结果）是合理的，从而为决策者提供理论依据。

Method: 针对贝叶斯决策树（BDT）这一特定模型类，采用Dirichlet-Multinomial叶子模型和Catalan-指数树大小先验，通过理论推导建立闭式解形式的理性承诺阈值，形成完整的非渐近理论框架。

Result: 给出了BMA权重在决策树上何时足以支持承诺性利用的闭式条件，建立了非渐近情形下的理性承诺阈值理论。

Conclusion: 在特定先验和叶子模型下，BMA权重的认知信息足够性可以被精确刻画，为决策树的贝叶斯平均提供了理论上的承诺边界。

Abstract: We ask: when do Bayesian model averaging (BMA) weights over decision trees carry sufficient epistemic information to justify committed exploitation of the averaging distribution? We answer this question in closed form for Bayesian decision trees (BDTs) with Dirichlet-Multinomial leaf models and a Catalan-exponential tree-size prior (Schetinin&Jakaite, 2025), establishing a complete non-asymptotic theory of rational commitment thresholds.

</details>


### [388] [Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01532)
*Qian Li,Xinyu Mao,Shang-Hua Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，在有限滑动窗口生成模式下，即使没有位置编码，Transformer也能达到图灵完备性，因为窗口滑动机制本身打破了排列对称性，足以捕获位置信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"位置编码对Transformer处理有序序列是必需的"这一普遍认知，探索在有限滑动窗口（长程推理的实际场景）中，窗口机制本身是否已提供足够的表达能力。

Method: 提出抽象自回归模型HIST（基于常数大小内部状态和窗口内词频直方图更新），证明HIST模型是图灵完备的（可模拟Post机）；随后构造一个无位置编码的滑动窗口Transformer，证明其可以模拟HIST模型。

Result: 证明了滑动窗口Transformer（无位置编码）在常数大小词表上能够模拟图灵完备的HIST模型，即无位置编码的Transformer仍可进行通用计算。

Conclusion: 位置编码并非Transformer实现通用计算不可或缺的条件——窗口滑动本身已打破排列对称性并捕获了足够的顺序信息。

Abstract: Positional encoding (PE) is widely viewed as necessary for transformers to process ordered sequences: without them, the next-token map appears permutation-invariant in its context tokens. This intuition underlies all prior universality results, which rely on positional information to prove that transformers with chain-of-thought can perform arbitrary computation, i.e., they are Turing complete. We revisit this belief in the regime most relevant to long-form reasoning, where generation proceeds through a finite sliding context window. Our opening perception is that the window mechanism itself (mildly) breaks the permutation symmetry. To distill and precisely capture the degree of this added expressiveness, we introduce an abstract autoregressive model, the HIST model, in which each update depends only on constant-size internal state and the token-count histogram within the current window. We prove that this HIST model is Turing complete by showing that the evolution of the window can reveal the token that has just left the window, which suffices to simulate Turing-complete Post machines. We then construct a sliding-window transformer over a constant-size token alphabet, without PE, and show that it can simulate the HIST model. Our result demonstrates that positional encodings are not indispensable for transformers to perform universal computation: The window sliding itself already breaks permutation symmetry and captures sufficient positional information.

</details>


### [389] [ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01849)
*Peihan Liu,Lucas Rosenblatt,Weiwei Kong,Natalia Ponomareva,Gautam Kamath,Rachel Cummings,Roxana Geambasu,Yu Gan,Lillian Tsai,Alex Bie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了ContinuousBench，一个持续自动更新的基准测试，用于评估差分隐私（DP）文本合成方法是否能从敏感语料库中传递新知识和能力。实验发现，尽管非隐私合成能有效传递知识，但现有最先进的DP合成方法即使在ε=100时也无法实现这一目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的差分隐私文本合成评估依赖的任务几乎不需要训练就能解决，因此强基准性能并不能证明DP合成可以替代原始数据访问。为了真正评估DP合成是否能从敏感语料库中传递新知识和能力，需要一个更严格的基准测试。

Method: ContinuousBench是一个每季度自动更新的基准测试，每个新版本包含一个从未见过的训练语料库和相应的QA集。QA集被设计为：(1) 没有语料库无法解决；(2) 在DP下可学习（知识由数百条独立记录支持）。研究人员从训练语料库生成DP合成数据，然后使用标准化的训练和评估流程测量能力增益。实例化了两个赛道：Geminon（关于虚构生物的程序生成数据集）和News（新爬取的公共新闻文章流）。

Result: 标准基准几乎饱和，但在ContinuousBench上，非隐私合成能从原始语料库传递大量知识，而最先进的DP合成方法即使在ε=100时也普遍无法做到。

Conclusion: 现有DP文本合成方法在传递敏感语料库中的新知识方面能力不足，ContinuousBench为评估这一能力提供了更严格的基准。

Abstract: Differentially private (DP) text synthesis promises to unlock sensitive corpora for model training, but it remains unclear whether DP synthetic data transmits genuinely new knowledge and capabilities present only in those corpora. This is because existing evaluations rely on tasks that are nearly solvable without training, so strong benchmark performance does not establish that DP synthesis can substitute original data access. Thus, we introduce ContinuousBench, a continuously and automatically-regenerated benchmark that measures capability gain from DP synthetic text. Each quarter, a new release pairs a never-before-seen training corpus with a derived QA set, constructed to be: (1) unsolvable sans-corpus; and (2) learnable under DP, as the tested knowledge is supported by hundreds of independent records. Researchers produce DP synthetic data from the training corpus and run our standardized training and evaluation harness on their synthetic data to measure gains. We instantiate two tracks: Geminon, a procedurally-generated dataset about fictional creatures; and News, a stream of newly crawled public news articles. Although standard benchmarks are nearly saturated, on ContinuousBench we find that non-private synthesis transfers substantial knowledge from the original corpus, while state-of-the-art DP synthesis methods generally fail to do so, even at $\varepsilon=100$.

</details>


### [390] [On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02437)
*Mind Lab,:,Vin Bo,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Hongquan Gu,Aaron Guan,Nolan Ho,Mutian Hong,Hailee Hou,Peixuan Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Andrew Lei,Kyrie Lei,Alexy Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Theo Li,Wenhao Li,Zhihui Li,Allen Lin,Jiayi Lin,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Xiang Liu,Irvine Lu,Maeve Luo,Runze Lv,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Anson Qiu,Vincent Wang,Rio Yang,Maxwell Yao,Carrie Ye,Regis Ye,Wenlin Ye,Josh Ying,Danney Zeng,Yuhan Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Ruijia Zhang,Shiyang Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Ya Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Adrian Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Xinyue Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将参数高效微调（PEFT）视为在共享基础模型之上持久化局部状态（如偏好、技能、工具习惯、记忆更新）的机制，而非仅作为全量微调的廉价替代方案。围绕三个扩展轴（Scale Up、Scale Down、Scale Out）组织问题，并提供MinT基础设施示例，证明PEFT可作为持久化个人模型的紧凑基板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT研究主要将其视为全量微调的预算替代方案，忽视了其作为持久化局部状态承载个体化行为的潜力。作者希望重新定义PEFT的角色，使其成为强共享基础模型上保持实例特异性行为（个性化偏好、技能、工具使用习惯、记忆更新）的机制。

Method: 从三个扩展轴系统分析：Scale Up（更强的共享先验使小局部更新更有用）、Scale Down（研究适配器在保证可靠性前提下能有多小）、Scale Out（大量持久化适配器实例共存的管理）。提出MinT基础设施，管理适配器的身份、版本、溯源、评估和服务驻留。

Result: PEFT不仅是全量微调的预算替代方案，而是在共享基础模型上承载持久化个人模型的紧凑基板。MinT示例展示了适配器管理的可行性。

Conclusion: PEFT应被重新定位为支撑持久化、个性化模型的基板技术，而非仅作为降本手段。三个扩展轴为未来研究提供了系统框架。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is usually treated as a cheaper alternative to full fine-tuning. We study a broader role: small trainable adapters as persistent local state on top of strong shared foundation models. In this framing, the base model provides shared competence while adapters carry instance-specific behavior such as preferences, skills, tool habits, and memory-like updates. We organize the problem around three scaling axes: Scale Up, where stronger shared priors make small local updates more useful; Scale Down, where we study how small adapters can be while remaining reliable; and Scale Out, where many persistent adapted instances coexist. MinT provides one infrastructure example for managing adapter identity, revision, provenance, evaluation, and serving residency. Together, the results suggest that PEFT can be a compact substrate for persistent personal models rather than only a budget substitute for full fine-tuning.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [391] [Too Much of a Good Thing: When sim2real Efforts Impede Policy Learning (And What to Do About It)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02636)
*Kyle Morgenstein,Bharath Masetty,Stephen Welch,Luis Sentis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出sim2real（仿真到现实）迁移虽然重要，但过度追求会导致"仿真器锁定"和策略探索受限的问题，并提出一种仅以机器人运动学为设计约束的sim2sim2real范式作为解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前sim2real方法对策略学习产生了错误激励，过度强调与现实世界的匹配反而限制了策略的探索空间和泛化能力。

Method: 提出sim2sim2real范式：在第一阶段（sim2sim）仅以机器人运动学为约束进行仿真内策略学习，第二阶段再将学到的策略迁移到真实硬件。

Result: 揭示了现有sim2real方法的根本性问题——仿真器锁定（simulator lock in）和策略探索不足。

Conclusion: 过度的sim2real约束反而有害，应减少不必要的现实约束以释放策略学习的潜力。

Abstract: While sim2real efforts are necessary for effective policy transfer to hardware, there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. We argue that sim2real efforts have led to misaligned incentives with policy learning, resulting in simulator lock in and poor policy exploration due to the unreasonable constraints imposed by the real world. We offer a diagnosis and explanation of the current status of the problem, and propose a potential solution via a sim2sim2real paradigm that leverages the robot's kinematics as the sole design constraint.

</details>


### [392] [CARVE: Certified Affordable Repair of Vetoed Maneuvers via Envelopes for Interactive Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02641)
*Yifan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出交互修复认证（Interactive Repair Certification）的概念，并设计CARVE框架——一种无预测的证书层，在有限格点上基于自我车辆与对方车辆战术算子，对被否决的驾驶操作用于合规性修复进行形式化认证，记录约束规则、修复类别、责任成本分配及回退方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶系统在处理交互场景时存在空白：（1）基于规则的防护（rulebooks、shields、reachability filters）善于否决不安全动作，但无法识别“硬规则余量虽为负、但对方微小合法让步即可恢复可行性”的失败模式；（2）基于预测的规划器则建模可能的响应，但两者均无法输出运行时证明对象，无法说明哪些有界多智能体编辑可修复操作、谁负责编辑、该请求是否通行权可承担、以及当请求未被遵守时的回退方案。

Method: 将交互修复认证定义为形式化证书对象，构建CARVE框架：在有限格点（self-owned vs agent-owned tactical operators）上定义无预测的证书层；Agent-owned请求的可行性受限于合作包络B_j(s)=β(π_j)α_j^max(s)，将运动学可达性与规范优先级分离；证书记录绑定规则、修复类别、修复集、责任加权成本拆分及回退方案。

Result: 在589个Lanelet2几何标注的INTERACTION重放片段上，CARVE-Greedy接受了98.64%初始被否决的操作，恢复了370/378个人类修正的假阳性否决，同时保持589/589通行权尊重、零优先级智能体误报、400/400负压力否决保留。

Conclusion: CARVE不需要预测或要求对方驾驶员合规；它认证一个提议的交互是否有界、可归因且在声明假设下规范可接受。同时提供了证书可靠性、结构通行权尊重、有限格点精确最小性、回退应急性和责任一致性的形式化证明。

Abstract: Interactive driving exposes a failure mode that is easy to miss in rule-aware autonomous-driving stacks: a hard-rule margin can be negative for an ego candidate even though a small lawful accommodation by a non-priority agent would restore feasibility. Existing rulebooks, shields, and reachability filters are strong at vetoing unsafe actions, while prediction-based planners model likely responses. Neither returns a runtime proof object that states which bounded multi-agent edit repairs the maneuver, who owns the edit, whether the request is right-of-way affordable, and what ego fallback remains if the request is not observed. We formulate this missing object as *interactive repair certification* and introduce *CARVE*, a prediction-free certificate layer over a finite lattice of ego-owned and agent-owned tactical operators. Agent-owned requests are admissible only inside \(B_j(s) = β(π_j)α_j^{\max}(s)\), a cooperation envelope that separates kinematic reachability from normative priority. The resulting certificate records the binding rule, repair category, repair set, responsibility-weighted cost split, and fallback. On 589 Lanelet2-geometry-grounded INTERACTION replay episodes, CARVE-Greedy accepts 98.64% of initially vetoed maneuvers and recovers 370/378 human-resolved false vetoes, while preserving 589/589 right-of-way respect, zero priority-agent false positives, and 400/400 negative-stress vetoes. We prove certificate soundness, structural right-of-way respect, exact finite-lattice minimality, fallback contingency, and blame-consistency conditions. CARVE does not predict or require another driver's compliance; it certifies whether a proposed interaction is bounded, attributable, and normatively admissible under declared assumptions.

</details>


### [393] [Fixed-Time Dynamic Landing of Quadrotors using Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filtering and Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02658)
*Mohammadreza Izadi,Zeinab Shayan,Steven Waslander,Reza Faieghi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合非线性模型预测控制、最小加加速度轨迹规划器和自适应无迹卡尔曼滤波器的估计与控制框架，用于多旋翼无人机在移动平台上的动态着陆，实现了可重复的着陆性能和优于EKF/UKF的平台速度预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现多旋翼无人机在移动平台上的动态着陆，要求解决降落时间一致性、感知质量时变下的鲁棒性，以及参考轨迹的可执行性等问题。

Method: 1) 非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）用于控制；2) 实时最小加加速度（minimum-jerk）轨迹规划器，强制规定触地时间；3) 自适应无迹卡尔曼滤波器（AUKF），在线更新过程与测量噪声统计量；4) 参考可行性分析，证明最小加加速度参考在标准跟踪假设下产生有界推力和扭矩指令。

Result: 仿真与硬件实验表明，该方法实现了可重复的着陆，并且平台速度预测精度优于基于EKF/UKF的方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架能够有效应对动态着陆中的时间约束和感知质量变化，显著提升着陆的重复性和平台状态估计的准确性。

Abstract: This paper introduces an estimation and control framework for dynamic landing of multi-rotor uncrewed aerial vehicles on moving platforms. The proposed method integrates nonlinear model predictive control with a real-time minimum-jerk trajectory planner that enforces a prescribed touchdown time, enabling consistent timing during the terminal descent. To enhance robustness in the presence of time-varying sensing quality, we utilize an adaptive unscented kalman filter that updates the process and measurement noise statistics online. In addition, we provide a reference feasibility analysis showing that minimum-jerk references induce bounded thrust and torque commands under standard tracking hypotheses. The proposed framework is evaluated in simulation and hardware experiments, and it is shown to achieve repeatable landings and improved platform velocity prediction accuracy relative to EKF/UKF-based methods.

</details>


### [394] [Motion Planning in Dynamic Environments: A Survey from Classical to Modern Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02677)
*Zongyuan Shen,Yaming Ou,Shalabh Gupta,Shancheng Zhao,Dehua Zhou,Gao Wang,Zhongqiang Ren,Junfeng Fan,Long Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文对2015-2025年间138篇动态环境下运动规划的研究进行了系统综述，将方法分为采样、图搜索、模型预测控制、学习和经典局部规划五大类，涵盖基于学习的技术（监督学习与强化学习）以及动态感知方法（相机、LiDAR、事件传感器），分析了各类方法的原理、优劣及动态环境特有挑战（预测不确定性、人机交互、冻结机器人问题）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态环境规划已有大量综述，但针对动态环境的系统综述仍十分有限，该领域日益复杂且应用广泛，亟需一份结构化的综合评述来帮助研究人员快速把握进展。

Method: 对138篇文献（以2015-2025年为主）进行系统分类，划分为五类：采样方法、图搜索方法、模型预测控制方法、学习方法（监督学习与强化学习）、经典局部规划方法（速度障碍法、势场法、动态窗口法）。同时讨论了动态感知技术（相机、LiDAR、事件传感器）在运动规划中的作用。

Result: 系统梳理了各类方法的原理、优势和局限性，特别关注了动态环境特有的挑战，包括预测不确定性、人机交互和冻结机器人问题，为研究人员提供了结构化的方法图谱。

Conclusion: 该综述为动态环境下运动规划研究提供了全面且系统的参考框架，有助于研究者理解不同方法的适用场景和权衡关系，指导未来的研究方向。

Abstract: Motion planning in dynamic environments requires robots to continuously adapt their paths in response to environmental changes for safe and uninterrupted navigation. While many surveys have reviewed planning in static settings, systematic reviews focused on dynamic environments remain limited. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of 138 works, primarily published between 2015 and 2025, spanning both classical and learning-based approaches. The motion planning methods are grouped into five categories based on the concepts of sampling, graph search, model predictive control, learning, and additional classical local planning approaches, including velocity obstacles, potential fields and dynamic windows. The learning techniques include supervised learning and reinforcement learning. We also discuss the role of dynamic perception in motion planning, covering techniques for detecting and modeling moving obstacles using cameras, LiDAR, and event-based sensors. The survey analyzes the principles, strengths, and limitations of each method, with particular attention to challenges unique to dynamic environments, such as prediction uncertainty, human-robot interaction, and the freezing robot problem. The survey provides researchers with a structured understanding of motion planning methods in dynamic environments.

</details>


### [395] [See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02735)
*Yueh-Hua Wu,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: S2 (See Less, Specify More) 框架通过训练执行器在更干净的接口下工作，即通过细粒度语言指令和显式视觉证据预算，显著提升了VLA模型的泛化能力，在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提高到79.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型的泛化瓶颈在于：在存在干扰物、外观变化和语义相似任务时，策略需要从粗略指令中推断局部执行细节，并决定图像中哪些部分对控制重要。

Method: 1) Specify More：保留原始指令作为稳定高层目标，同时为每条轨迹重新标注细粒度的轨迹级和子任务级语言描述；2) See Less：施加显式视觉证据预算，训练执行器仅从任务足够的视觉证据中行动，无需区域或掩码标注。

Result: 在TX-G2和HSR两个平台上的8个真实机器人任务中，S2将平均子任务成功率从pi0.5的54.2%提升至79.0%。消融实验表明：粗指令导致可避免的监督混叠，保持目标的局部指导优于指令替换，显式证据预算减少了对广泛视觉上下文的依赖。

Conclusion: VLA泛化能力的提升来源于训练执行器从信息丰富的局部指导和任务足够的视觉证据中行动，而非从弱监督中同时恢复两者。

Abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface.
  Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation.
  This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations.
  Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

</details>


### [396] [SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02745)
*Jaehyeon Son,Junhyun Kim,Kyle Kam,Jeremiah Coholich,Seok Joon Kim,Jinhoo Kim,Chris Dongjoo Kim,Jaemin Cho,Dieter Fox,Zsolt Kira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SeeTraceAct，一种通过可见性感知的未来末端执行器轨迹预测来增强空间定位能力的一次性演示条件视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），在RoboCasa-DC和真实世界基准测试中优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一次性演示条件VLA模型在执行需要精确定位小目标区域的任务时表现不佳，而收集任务特定的遥操作数据成本高昂。因此，亟需一种无需大量标注数据即可实现精确空间定位的演示条件机器人策略。

Method: 提出SeeTraceAct框架，采用可见性感知的未来末端执行器轨迹预测机制，增强模型对演示视频中空间目标的精准定位能力，实现一次性演示条件控制。

Result: 在RoboCasa-DC数据集的所有四种设置下取得最佳成功率，并在真实世界基准测试中将平均成功率提升12.5个百分点。

Conclusion: SeeTraceAct通过可见性感知的轨迹预测有效解决了现有演示条件VLA在小目标精确定位上的瓶颈，且支持跨本体演示（如人类演示视频控制机器人），具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.

</details>


### [397] [Hybrid Adaptive Kalman Filtering for Data-Efficient Joint Tracking and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02767)
*Jiho Lee,Nisar R. Ahmed,Rebecca Russell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种自监督混合自适应卡尔曼滤波器，仅从测量数据中学习系统动力学和过程噪声协方差的结构化修正，同时保持滤波器的概率结构，从而计算创新似然并通过广义贝叶斯推断进行模型分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卡尔曼滤波性能对模型失配和噪声协方差调参高度敏感，现有学习方法依赖大量标注数据且不能产生一致的不确定性估计。

Method: 自监督混合自适应卡尔曼滤波器，从测量数据中学习系统动力学和过程噪声协方差的结构化修正，保留概率结构以计算创新似然，并通过广义贝叶斯推断进行模型分类。

Result: 在真实和模拟数据集上，该方法在低数据和大数据场景下均展现出更优的估计精度、统计一致性以及稳健的分类性能。

Conclusion: 自监督学习方法能够有效提升卡尔曼滤波的鲁棒性和自适应性，克服模型失配问题，同时保持概率可解释性。

Abstract: Kalman filtering performance is highly sensitive to model mismatch and noise covariance tuning. Learning-based approaches address these limitations but typically rely on supervised training with large datasets and do not produce consistent uncertainty estimates. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised Hybrid Adaptive Kalman Filter that learns structured corrections to system dynamics and process noise covariance from measurements alone while preserving the probabilistic structure of the filter. This allows the innovation likelihood to be computed and subsequently used for model classification via generalized Bayesian inference. Experimental results on real-world and simulated datasets demonstrate improved estimation accuracy and statistical consistency as well as robust classification performance across both low-data and large-data scenarios.

</details>


### [398] [A Measurement-Driven Digital Twin Architecture for Plant-Level Biomass Estimation and Growth Forecasting in Hydroponic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02796)
*Morgan Mayborne,Abhisesh Silwal,George Kantor*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究开发了一套集成数字孪生模型的水培生菜生长追踪系统，利用RGB-D图像和神经网络（1300张图像训练）实时估计植物质量（误差<1.5g），并能实现1-4天的产量预测（误差约2g）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决城市密集中心食品分配问题，推动水培等土壤替代方案的发展，需要更精确的植物生长追踪和产量预测系统。

Method: 搭建定制水培温室及传感器硬件，使用RGB-D图像作为输入，训练自定义神经网络连续测量植物产量；将数字孪生模型集成到水培系统中，利用测量信息和现有模型持续更新生长轨迹估计。

Result: 神经网络在1300张图像数据集上训练后，质量估计误差在1.5g以内；集成后的数字孪生模型可实现1-4天后的产量预测，预测误差约2g。

Conclusion: 数字孪生模型结合机器视觉在水培环境中能够有效追踪和预测植物生长，为城市农业的精准管理提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Alternatives to soil-based horticulture, such as hydroponics, have been developed to respond to food distribution concerns for dense urban centers. A new system was developed to track an individual lettuce plant's growth in a hydroponic environment, utilizing streams of measured information and available models to continuously update the growth trajectory estimates for a plant. These "digital twin" models were integrated into an operating hydroponic greenhouse, with custom horticultural and sensor hardware to grow and measure relevant information. To aid in updating model parameters, plant yield was continuously measured with a custom neural network, using RGB-D images of the plants as an input. The network, trained on a collected dataset of 1300 images, was able to estimate mass within 1.5 g of the ground-truth value. After integration into the custom system, digital twin growth projections could approximate future yield between one and four days in the future, maintaining around a 2 g forecasting error.

</details>


### [399] [Direct Informed Sampling on Riemannian Manifolds via Loewner Order Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02879)
*Phone Thiha Kyaw,Jonathan Kelly*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Loewner序的矩阵值容许启发式方法，通过Cholesky分解将黎曼度量张量的方向结构保留并映射到各向同性欧氏空间，使得黎曼知情集退化为标准长球超椭球，实现无拒绝采样，在多种机械臂操作任务中相比欧氏和标量特征值方法显著加速渐进最优规划器的收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知情采样技术依赖欧氏启发式，在配置依赖的黎曼度量下不可行；标量特征值界虽恢复可容许性但丢弃了度量的方向结构，导致知情集过于保守，效率低下。

Method: 利用Loewner序在对称正定矩阵上计算度量张量的最紧常数下界，保留完整方向结构；通过Cholesky分解将该下界定义为到各向同性欧氏空间的线性映射，使黎曼知情集退化为标准长球超椭球，从而实现直接无拒绝采样。

Result: 在6-DoF UR5、7-DoF Franka和14-DoF PR2机械臂上，在三种不同黎曼度量下，该方法产生的知情集始终比欧氏界和标量特征值界更紧，并在多种最先进渐进最优规划器上加速收敛。

Conclusion: 基于Loewner序的矩阵值启发式有效保留了黎曼度量的方向结构，生成更紧的知情集，显著提升了采样运动规划器在高维复杂构型空间中的收敛效率。

Abstract: Informed sampling techniques accelerate sampling-based motion planners by focusing the search on promising regions of the state space, yet most existing methods rely on Euclidean heuristics that become inadmissible under configuration-dependent Riemannian metrics. While scalar eigenvalue bounds restore admissibility by uniformly scaling the Euclidean distance, they discard the directional structure of the metric, producing overly conservative informed sets. We propose a matrix-valued admissible heuristic that exploits the Loewner order on symmetric positive definite matrices to compute the tightest constant lower bound on the metric tensor while preserving its full directional structure. The Cholesky factorization of this bound defines a linear map to an isotropic Euclidean space in which the Riemannian informed set reduces to a standard prolate hyperspheroid, enabling direct, rejection-free sampling using existing algorithms. Experiments on manipulation tasks with a 6-DoF UR5, 7-DoF Franka, and 14-DoF PR2 under three distinct Riemannian metrics show that our heuristic produces consistently tighter informed sets than both the Euclidean and scalar eigenvalue bounds, accelerating convergence across multiple state-of-the-art asymptotically optimal planners.

</details>


### [400] [Impact of a Soft Wearable Back-Support Device on Postural Stability during Trip-Like Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02888)
*Yuanhao Chen,Rohan Khatavkar,Soubhagya Nayak,Jiefeng Sun,Hyunglae Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本研究探究了软体可穿戴背部支撑装置在模拟绊倒扰动下对姿势稳定性的影响，发现该装置能显著提高站立和行走时的稳定裕度，具有防跌倒潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨软体可穿戴背部支撑装置在不同刚度条件下，能否有效提升人在受到外部扰动（如绊倒）时的姿势稳定性，为防跌倒技术提供依据。

Method: 采用两种实验范式（扰动站立和扰动行走），健康受试者在三种背部支撑条件下（无装置、低刚度穿戴、高刚度激活）完成试验，通过最小稳定裕度（MOS）量化全身稳定性。

Result: 使用装置时MOS增大，表明姿势稳定性增强。站立条件下MOS随刚度增加显著提高；行走条件下两种装置条件均优于无装置，但彼此间无显著差异。

Conclusion: 软体可穿戴背部支撑装置可通过调节刚度改善对外部扰动的反应性平衡控制，在防跌倒方面具有重要应用价值。未来需探索个性化刚度优化，并在高风险人群中验证效果。

Abstract: The effectiveness of a soft wearable back-support device in enhancing postural stability was investigated under trip-like perturbations using two experimental paradigms: perturbed standing and perturbed walking. Healthy subjects completed trials under three different back-support conditions: no device, device worn with low stiffness, and device activated with high stiffness. Whole-body stability was quantified using the minimum Margin of Stability (MOS) at the point of maximal instability. Results demonstrated increased MOS during device use, indicating enhanced postural stability. In standing, MOS increased significantly with device stiffness, whereas in walking, both device conditions improved MOS relative to no device but did not differ significantly from each other. These findings highlight the potential of soft wearable back-support devices with adjustable stiffness to improve reactive balance control against external perturbations, with important implications for fall prevention. Future research should explore personalized stiffness optimization and evaluate efficacy in populations at elevated risk of falls.

</details>


### [401] [Improved Postural Stability Using a Lightweight Semi-Active Soft Back Support Device Under Standing Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02928)
*Rohan Khatavkar,Jiefeng Sun,Hyunglae Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种轻量级半主动软式背部支撑装置，通过在被动弹性带上并联气动人工肌肉，在站立扰动后快速提供辅助力，显著降低了全身角动量并增加了稳定裕度，有效改善了老年人的平衡恢复能力，为防跌倒提供了新策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 老年人站立时受到扰动（如前向失衡）极易跌倒，现有背部支撑装置要么因附加质量过大而影响稳定性，要么轻量被动装置在躯干小角度屈曲时只能产生有限辅助力，难以有效预防跌倒。

Method: 提出一种轻量级半主动软式背部支撑装置，将主动元件（气动人工肌肉）与被动弹性带并联。在站立扰动后，主动元件快速提供辅助力，克服被动装置的局限。对5名健康受试者进行实验验证。

Result: 半主动装置显著降低了全身角动量，并增加了稳定裕度，表明平衡恢复性能得到改善。

Conclusion: 半主动软式可穿戴机器人是一种有效且轻量的防跌倒策略，尤其适用于站立扰动场景下的跌倒预防。

Abstract: Older adults are particularly susceptible to falls following perturbations during standing, such as forward loss of balance. Back support devices that assist trunk extension may help mitigate fall risk by preventing excessive trunk flexion. Previous studies have investigated heavy back support devices; however, these systems often introduced adverse effects on stability due to their added mass, which shifted the body's natural center of mass unfavorably. In contrast, lightweight passive devices have shown limited benefits, as they can generate only modest assistive forces during the relatively small trunk flexion associated with forward balance loss. In this study, we evaluated the effects of a lightweight semi-active soft back support device on postural stability following standing perturbations. Our device combines an active element (a pneumatic artificial muscle) in parallel with a passive elastic band. The active element rapidly provides assistive force following a perturbation, overcoming the limitations of passive devices. Experiments conducted with five healthy individuals demonstrated that the semi-active device significantly reduced whole-body angular momentum and increased the margin of stability, indicating improved balance recovery performance. These results highlight the promise of semi-active soft wearable robots as an effective and lightweight strategy for fall prevention during standing perturbations.

</details>


### [402] [SCOPE: Real-Time Natural Language Camera Agent at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02951)
*Nikolaj Hindsbo,Sina Ehsani,Pragyana Mishra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE，一个模块化的语言驱动PTZ相机控制系统，支持在仿真环境和真实设备上的边缘部署。发布包含536个任务的基准测试，评估了19种规划-感知模型组合，发现强SLM减少幻觉、Moe模型在延迟和精度上优于稠密模型、量化几乎不损失精度，感知瓶颈在规划足够强时成为主要限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言驱动的机器人代理缺乏能反映真实世界任务需求（自然语言指令、可复现结果）的评估体系，且缺乏专门针对边缘部署的PTZ相机控制方案，需要连接语言模型与感知/控制工具的模块化架构及部署关键指标（延迟、准确率、错误模式）的评估。

Method: 构建SCOPE模块化代理系统，包含Blender仿真环境和真实PTZ相机两种部署场景，所有感知、规划和控制均在边缘本地执行。发布536任务的基准测试（涵盖QA、单/多步指令、计数、空间推理、描述、OCR），采用执行轨迹+LM作为评委评估延迟、准确率和错误模式。

Result: 评估19种规划-感知模型组合（Qwen3 SLM + Moondream/Qwen VLM）。强SLM显著减少幻觉并改进工具路由；Mixture-of-Experts模型在延迟和内存足迹上匹配或超越稠密模型；量化仅带来微小精度下降但效率大幅提升。

Conclusion: 当使用足够强的SLM时，感知成为主要性能瓶颈。研究识别出sim-to-real验证的实用性设计点，实现实时、边缘可行的语言驱动PTZ控制。

Abstract: Deploying language-driven agents in robotics requires evaluations that reflect real-world task demands: natural-language instructions with reproducible outcomes. Such agents must connect language models to callable perception and control tools, and be assessed using deployment-critical metrics including latency, accuracy, and error modes. We present SCOPE (Simulation and Camera Operations for Perception and Evaluation), a modular agent for natural-language, open-vocabulary pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) camera control and visual scene understanding, designed explicitly for edge deployment. SCOPE operates both in a Blender-based simulation environment and on a physical PTZ camera, executing all perception, planning, and control locally at the deployment site using edge-accessible compute.
  We release a 536-task benchmark spanning QA, single- and multi-step commands, counting, spatial reasoning, descriptions, and optical character recognition in a Blender-based simulation environment that exposes realistic PTZ control affordances. Execution traces are combined with an LM-as-Judge to evaluate latency, accuracy, and error modes.
  We evaluate 19 planner-perception model combinations pairing Qwen3 small language models (SLMs) with Moondream and Qwen vision-language models (VLMs). Stronger SLMs substantially reduce hallucinations and improve tool routing, leading to more reliable closed-loop behavior. Once a sufficiently capable SLM is used, perception becomes the dominant performance bottleneck. Mixture-of-Experts models on both the planning and perception side consistently match or exceed dense alternatives at latencies and memory footprints comparable to much smaller networks. Quantization provides additional efficiency gains with minimal accuracy degradation, identifying a practical, sim-to-real validated design point for real-time, edge-feasible language-driven PTZ control.

</details>


### [403] [Hybrid Dynamics Modeling for a Flexible 2-DoF Robotic Arm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02969)
*Maciek Popik,Daniel Yang,Mahdis Bisheban*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了柔性连杆2-DoF机械臂的动力学建模方法，对比了纯物理模型、物理+数据混合模型（RBD+GMM）以及纯数据驱动模型（运动学回归）。结果显示纯物理参数模型精度最差，正则化和最小二乘估计更接近实测力矩，表明半参数残差学习方法对柔性连杆系统更有价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚性体动力学模型无法捕捉柔性连杆机械臂中的未建模动力学（如连杆柔性），需要探索更有效的建模方法。

Method: 采用三种方法：(1) 两种物理信息模型（RBD+GMM）结合刚体动力学与高斯混合模型来捕捉残差误差和连杆柔性；(2) 纯数据驱动的运动学回归基线模型（Ridge回归）；(3) 基于发布规范构建物理基线，并用普通最小二乘法直接从数据估计参数集。

Result: 基于物理的参数精度最差；正则化和最小二乘估计与实测力矩更吻合；残差分析和误差指标揭示了纯参数化模型在柔性连杆系统中的局限性。

Conclusion: 正则化和数据驱动辨识方法优于纯物理模型，支持半参数残差学习方法的发展，对柔性连杆系统动力学建模具有指导意义。

Abstract: This paper examines three approaches for modeling the dynamics of a flexible-link 2-DoF robotic arm to address unmodeled dynamics not captured by rigid-body models. Two physics informed models combine rigid-body dynamics (RBD) formulations with a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to capture residual model errors and linkage flexibility. A kinematics-based regression model serves as a purely data-driven baseline. Using an open-source dataset, torque predictions are first estimated using Ridge regression on kinematic features, while the physicsbased baseline is constructed from published specifications, and ordinary least-squares regression is subsequently used to estimate the same parameter set directly from data. Results show that the physics-based parameters yield the poorest accuracy, while regularized and least-squares estimators align more closely with measured torques. Residual analysis and error metrics highlight the limitations of purely parametric models for flexible-link systems and underscore the value of regularization and data-driven identification, supporting developments of semi-parametric residual learning methods.

</details>


### [404] [MARIO: Motion-Augmented Real-Time Multi-Sensor Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02996)
*Yiquan Li,Taeyoung Yeon,Chenfeng Gao,Vasco Xu,Xuanyou Liu,Karan Ahuja*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MARIO框架，通过将惯性里程计（IO）与人体运动学先验相结合，并融合商用AR眼镜上的多模态轻量传感器（磁力计、气压计、辅助IMU），在Nymeria数据集上实现了最高42%的位置漂移减少，建立了无相机人体追踪的新基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的惯性里程计方法虽然通过大规模预训练提升了泛化能力，但在日常活动数据集（如Nymeria）上仍存在显著的漂移和噪声问题，因为它们未能显式捕获人体运动动力学特征。

Method: 提出基于学习的IMU推断姿态先验（pose prior），将其嵌入现有IO架构中以施加物理一致的运动约束；进一步构建多传感器融合框架，整合AR眼镜上已有的磁力计、气压计和辅助IMU等辅助信号。

Result: 在Nymeria数据集上：仅使用姿态先验减少36%位置漂移；融合多模态传感器后减少42%位置漂移。Nymeria数据集规模是先前工作的5倍。

Conclusion: 通过统一人体运动学与多模态感知，为轻量级无相机人体追踪树立了新标杆，推动惯性里程计较准走向更鲁棒和泛化的新范式。

Abstract: Inertial odometry (IO) using only Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) provides a lightweight solution for human motion tracking in augmented reality (AR) and wearable devices. Recent learning-based IO methods have improved the generalizability of inertial localization through large-scale pretraining on human motion datasets. However, these approaches remain prone to drift and noise because they do not explicitly capture human motion dynamics, especially on daily activity datasets such as Nymeria. In this work, we propose to ground inertial odometry in human kinematics through a learned IMU-inferred pose prior, which promotes physically consistent motion constraints. We integrate this pose prior into existing IO architectures and reduce positional drift by up to 36% on the challenging Nymeria dataset, which is 5x larger than datasets used in prior work. We further improve long-term performance with a sensor-fusion framework that incorporates auxiliary signals from lightweight sensors already available on commercial AR glasses, including magnetometers, barometers, and secondary IMUs. With this fusion strategy, positional drift is reduced by up to 42%, improving robustness and generalization across diverse motion conditions. Together, our results introduce a new paradigm for inertial and lightweight odometry by unifying human motion kinematics with multimodal sensing, setting a new benchmark for accurate and robust camera-less human tracking. Our website is available at https://spice-lab.org/projects/MARIO/.

</details>


### [405] [ModuLoop : Low-Level Code Generation using Modular Synthesizer and Closed-Loop Debugger for Robotic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03047)
*Gina Yoon,Sumin Lee,Joo Yong Sim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种闭环模块化代码合成框架（Closed-Loop Modular Code Synthesizer），利用预训练LLM无需微调即可生成机器人底层控制代码，通过迭代执行与调试探针实现闭环调试与优化，在RGB-D相机与机械臂标定及抓取任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在代码生成和问题求解等领域表现出色，但在机器人控制（尤其是需要精确操控、实时反馈和环境依赖执行的底层任务）中的应用仍然有限，现有方法难以兼顾任务特定性与泛化能力。

Method: 提出Closed-Loop Modular Code Synthesizer框架，核心包括：(1) 利用预训练LLM（无需任务特定微调）进行模块化代码规划与生成；(2) 迭代执行生成代码并在其中插入调试探针（debugging probes）以观察行为；(3) 通过闭环结构进行系统性调试与优化，最终生成可执行的控制程序。

Result: 在RGB-D相机与机械臂标定任务以及后续的抓取放置任务中，框架均实现了高执行精度和自主性，验证了其在真实世界场景中的有效性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了基于LLM的机器人控制在实际应用中的实用性和可扩展性，证明无需任务特定微调的预训练LLM也能通过闭环迭代调试生成可靠的底层控制程序。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance across various domains, including code generation and problem solving. However, their application in robotic control, particularly in low-level tasks that require precise manipulation, real-time feedback, and environment-dependent execution, remains limited. To address this challenge, we propose the Closed-Loop Modular Code Synthesizer framework. This framework leverages a pre-trained LLM without any task-specific fine-tuning to perform modular code planning and generation, and iteratively executes the generated code while inserting debugging probes to observe its behavior. This closed-loop structure facilitates systematic debugging and refinement, ultimately producing executable control programs. We apply the proposed framework to the calibration of an RGB-D camera and a robotic arm, validating its effectiveness in real-world settings. Furthermore, through a subsequent pick-and-place task, we demonstrate not only the accuracy of the calibration but also the potential extensibility of the framework. Across both tasks, the framework achieved high execution accuracy and autonomy, illustrating the practicality and scalability of LLM-based robotic control using our framework.

</details>


### [406] [TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03127)
*Wenbo Zhang,Jianxiong Li,Shuai Yang,Sijin Chen,Jiajun Liu,Lingqiao Liu,Xiao Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TTT-VLA框架，通过在测试时优化潜在提示（Latent Prompt）来实现视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时训练，无需修改策略本身，在SimplerEnv上显著提升了任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型在部署时面临分布偏移问题，而基于提示的策略引导通常依赖外部指引，缺乏自适应的测试时训练机制。

Method: 提出TTT-VLA框架，核心为潜在提示优化（LPO）：训练时通过辅助代理任务学习潜在提示作为额外条件信号；测试时仅在该提示上利用自监督信号进行优化，不修改策略参数。

Result: 在SimplerEnv上，单体和多体设置下的任务成功率均持续提升；性能提升主要源于修正少量关键决策而非全局改变策略行为。

Conclusion: LPO为操作基础策略的部署时改进提供了一种有效且实用的途径。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models trained on large-scale data have made remarkable progress, but they remain vulnerable to distribution shifts at deployment time. Recent VLA models suggest that prompts can serve as an efficient interface for steering policy behavior, but existing prompt-based steering typically relies on external guidance. This raises a natural question: can test-time training (TTT) for VLA be achieved by optimizing a prompt, so that the steering interface itself can be learned and adapted from interaction? We address this question with TTT-VLA, a test-time training framework based on Latent Prompt Optimization (LPO). During training, the latent prompt is learned with an additional proxy task, providing an extra learned conditioning signal for policy learning. At test time, TTT is performed by collecting interaction data from the current environment and optimizing only the latent prompt on those data using the proxy task's self-supervised signal, without modifying the policy itself. Experiments on SimplerEnv demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves task success rates in both single- and multi-embodiment settings. Further analysis shows that the gains arise primarily from correcting a small number of critical decisions rather than globally altering policy behavior. These results suggest that LPO provides an effective and practical pathway for deployment-time improvement of foundation manipulation policies.

</details>


### [407] [How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03134)
*Aarav Bedi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究机器人模仿学习中错误成功标签的检测问题，通过构建模拟环境，比较仅依赖本体感觉与视觉信息来识别虚假成功的能力，发现可恢复性因任务而异，且本体感觉的可分离性在无噪声模拟器中可能被高估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人模仿学习的策略性能依赖于训练数据的成功标签质量，而虚假成功（实际失败但被标记为成功）会严重损害策略学习。作者希望探究：当一个错误成功已经被标记后，仅靠本体感觉（关节数据）是否足以纠正这一错误，还是必须依赖视觉信息。

Method: 在双机械臂ALOHA任务（方块转移和插销插入）的模拟环境中，通过环境扰动而非直接编辑标签来诱导失败，利用特权模拟器状态为每个episode标注真实结果，仅保留机器人标记为成功的episodes，然后比较基于本体感觉（关节数据）与基于视觉的检测器在识别虚假成功上的表现。

Result: 可恢复性因任务而异：方块转移任务中虚假成功几乎完全可仅从关节数据恢复；插销插入任务中本体感觉只能恢复部分虚假成功，视觉检测器能弥补大部分差距。此外，本体感觉的可分离性依赖于远低于实际传感器噪声水平的微小速度差异，因此应被视为乐观上界。

Conclusion: 虚假成功的可检测性高度依赖具体任务和传感器噪声水平，视觉信息在某些任务中对纠正错误成功标签至关重要，且纯模拟环境的结果可能高估了实际部署中的可恢复性。

Abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

</details>


### [408] [ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03177)
*Yutong Liang,Quanquan Peng,Ri-Zhao Qiu,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ConTrack是一个基于强化学习的框架，通过将物体跟踪视为约束、在线自适应调整任务-风格权衡以及自适应中轨迹重置库，实现了从人类演示到真实机器人的灵巧操作技能迁移，在保持关节和接触保真度的同时显著提升了成功率和物体位姿精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示为机器人操作提供了强先验，但由于运动学差异，将其迁移到真实机器人上存在困难。在灵巧操作中，即使是仿真环境下，跟踪长时域、富含接触的序列也极具挑战性。现有方法依赖手工设计的奖励函数，需要为每个序列单独调参，且在有限交互预算下容易失效。

Method: ConTrack包含三个核心组件：1) 将物体跟踪建模为约束，剩余控制权分配给运动保真度；2) 使用对偶变量更新在线自适应调整任务与风格之间的权衡；3) 引入自适应中轨迹重置库，利用策略可到达的仿真状态来稳定长时域学习。

Result: 在仿真跟踪和真实机器人上的定性和定量结果表明，ConTrack在成功率和物体位姿精度上显著优于先前方法，同时保持了良好的关节和接触保真度。

Conclusion: ConTrack提供了一个可扩展的强化学习框架，有效解决了从人类演示到真实灵巧操作迁移中的运动学鸿沟问题，无需针对每个序列的手工奖励调参。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet it is non-trivial to transfer them to execute on real robots due to the kinematic gap. In dexterous manipulation, it remains challenging to track long-horizon, contact-rich sequences even in simulators: a reference-tracking policy must keep objects on their target trajectories while preserving demonstrated joint motion and contact timing. Existing approaches often rely on hand-crafted reward tuning that require per-sequence tuning and break under limited interaction budgets. We introduce ConTrack, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that scales with tracking data. ConTrack treats object tracking as a constraint and allocates remaining control authority to motion fidelity, which allows it to adapt task--style trade-offs online using a dual-variable update. In addition, ConTrack also stabilizes long-horizon learning with an adaptive mid-trajectory reset library that reuses policy-reachable simulator states. Our qualitative and quantitative results in simulation tracking and real robot demonstrate that ConTrack improves success and object pose accuracy significantly over prior arts while preserving joint and contact fidelity. Website: https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack.

</details>


### [409] [GeoSem-WAM: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03188)
*Fulong Ma,Daojie Peng,Wenjun Yue,Jiahang Cao,Bintao Wang,Qiang Zhang,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构化世界建模框架，通过在潜在空间中联合预测未来RGB、几何和语义表示来增强世界动作模型，在不增加测试时推理开销的情况下提升具身决策的性能和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）的优势主要源于表征学习而非测试时的显式未来推演，但主流方法仅依赖RGB未来预测，缺乏对复杂环境的结构和空间理解。

Method: 在原有RGB未来预测分支基础上，引入几何和语义两个辅助预测分支，在统一潜在空间中联合捕捉场景动态、空间几何和语义上下文，同时保持测试时无需显式未来生成的高效推理。

Result: 大量实验表明，引入结构化世界监督能够一致提升动作预测准确性、场景理解能力和在挑战性具身场景下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 结构化世界建模是一种推进可扩展且高效WAMs的有效方法，验证了通过几何与语义监督增强潜在表征对于具身决策的重要性。

Abstract: Recent World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in embodied decision-making. However, whether their effectiveness stems from explicit future imagination during inference or representation learning induced by predictive training remains an open question. Emerging evidence suggests the primary advantage lies in learning robust latent representations rather than generating future observations at test time. Nevertheless, existing WAMs mainly rely on RGB-based future prediction, which provides limited structural and spatial understanding of complex environments. To address this, we propose a structured world modeling framework that enhances latent representations through geometric and semantic supervision. Alongside future RGB prediction, our model introduces two auxiliary prediction branches for future geometry and semantic representations, enabling it to jointly capture scene dynamics, spatial geometry, and semantic context within a unified latent space. Crucially, our approach preserves efficient inference by avoiding explicit future rollout or video generation at test time. Extensive experiments show that incorporating structured world supervision consistently improves action prediction accuracy, scene understanding, and robustness under challenging embodied scenarios, highlighting its potential for advancing scalable and efficient WAMs.

</details>


### [410] [Toward Gripper-Integrated Active Electrosense for Pre-Contact Sensing in Underwater Soft Grippers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03204)
*Ahsan Tanveer,Muhammad Hamza,Waqar Hussain Afridi,Chen Wang,Guangming Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文探讨将主动电感知技术集成到章鱼启发式软体夹爪中，通过测量导电介质中电场扰动来提供接触前的近距感知信号，以解决水下抓取中视觉受限时的感知问题。仿真和实验表明，多电极电压读数在目标存在时呈现结构化变化，可作为视觉的补充线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下操作常因浊度、眩光和夹爪遮挡导致视觉感知可靠性下降，而软体夹爪虽适合柔顺交互但缺乏接触前的预触碰线索，无法在视觉不可靠时引导接近和闭合动作。

Method: 在章鱼启发式软体夹爪上布置离散电极，利用现成硬件记录多通道传感电压，通过测量施加电场在导电介质中的扰动实现主动电感知。在仿真和水槽实验中以悬挂导电球为目标，测试5-20V、1mHz-1kHz范围内的激励参数。

Result: 多电极电压读数在目标存在时相对于空水基线呈现结构化、与目标相关的变化，且检测能力随激励电压和频率变化。

Conclusion: 集成电感知作为接触前补充线索具有可行性，值得对水下软体操作展开系统性研究。

Abstract: Underwater manipulation often occurs under degraded visibility due to turbidity, glare, and gripper occlusion, limiting the reliability of vision-based perception during approach and grasping. In such settings, soft grippers are well suited for compliant interaction, but they typically lack an onboard pre-contact cue that can guide approach and closure when vision is unreliable. This extended abstract explores active electrosense as a lightweight sensing modality that can provide a proximity-like signal prior to contact by measuring perturbations of an applied electric field in conductive media. We instrument an octopus-inspired gripper with a discrete electrode layout and record multi-channel sensing voltages using off-the-shelf hardware. Simulation and tank experiments with a suspended conductive sphere show structured, object-dependent changes in the multi-electrode voltage readout relative to empty-water baselines, with detectability varying across excitation of 5 to 20 V and frequencies from 1 mHz to 1 kHz. These findings motivate systematic investigation of gripper-integrated electrosense as a complementary pre-contact cue for underwater soft manipulation.

</details>


### [411] [BotDirector: Robot Storytelling Across the Symmetrical Reality with Multi-modal Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03223)
*Zhe Sun,Meng Wang,Lei Wang,Yuxi Wang,Wanxin Li,Yujia Peng,Zhenliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合具身交互和自然语言交互的机器人讲故事系统，使儿童能够利用日常物品和LLM代理创建叙事，并由自导航群机器人执行，从而简化了机器人故事创作的技术门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人讲故事虽能独特地结合技术创新与创意表达吸引儿童，但其技术方面对儿童而言过于复杂，因此需要一种更易于儿童使用的交互系统。

Method: 设计了一个交互系统，儿童通过将自己的物品布置在场景中，并使用LLM代理创建叙事。系统将叙事基于地图和角色转换为运动序列，由自导航群机器人执行。

Result: 该系统增强了机器人讲故事的灵活性，使幼儿能够使用日常物品创作机器人戏剧。

Conclusion: 所提出的系统通过具身和自然语言交互降低了技术门槛，使儿童能够更自由地参与机器人故事创作。

Abstract: Robot storytelling offers a unique blend of technological innovation and creative expression that engages children in unprecedented ways. However, the technical aspects are often too complicated for children. We propose an interactive system that facilitates robot storytelling with tangible and natural language interactions. Children arrange the playground with their own stuff and create narratives with an LLM agent. The created narratives are transformed into a motion sequence based on the map and characters, and the motions are executed by self-navigating swarm robots. This system enhances robot storytelling with flexible scenarios, enabling young children to create robot dramas with everyday objects.

</details>


### [412] [GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03240)
*Yizhi Chen,Zhanxiang Cao,Xinyi Peng,Yixiao Zheng,Xiaxi Si,Yiheng Li,Liyun Yan,Keqi Zhu,Xueyun Chen,Shengcheng Fu,Tianyue Zhan,Yufei Jia,Jinming Yao,Yan Xie,Kun Wang,Cewu Lu,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GeoAlign提出了一种状态引导的空间对齐架构，通过RGB几何分支的后训练和本体感知状态查询，显著提升了VLA模型在几何关键任务中的操作性能，在多个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型多优化语义对齐，但在可执行操作中缺乏几何感知的空间对齐和动态可供性选择能力，导致几何关键任务表现不佳。

Method: GeoAlign包含两阶段：1) 对RGB几何分支进行RGB-D监督的后训练，生成GEP特征；2) 机器人本体感知状态作为查询，从GEP特征网格中提取紧凑的相位相关几何令牌，用于动作预测。

Result: LIBERO上99.0%，SimplerEnv-Fractal三个任务平均85.3%，八项几何关键真实世界ALOHA任务平均78.8%。消融实验验证了几何后训练和本体感知查询的有效性。

Conclusion: GeoAlign通过几何后训练和状态引导查询，有效弥合了VLA模型在语义理解与几何感知操作之间的差距，显著提升了在几何密集任务中的表现。

Abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

</details>


### [413] [AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03252)
*Zian Liu,Andong Yang,Chunkai Yang,Ruidong An,Chao Gao,Guyue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种受动物导航行为启发的无人机导航框架，结合基于强化学习的策略和基于世界模型的环境理解，在复杂未知环境中实现有效导航，并实现无缝的sim-to-real迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机的导航方法通常依赖人工设计的感知管道和预定义规则，这些方法环境依赖性强且泛化能力差，难以应对未见过的杂乱环境。

Method: 设计了一个导航框架，采用基于强化学习的策略（位于上层）结合基于世界模型的环境理解（位于底层）；同时设计了无人工塑形项的稀疏奖励函数以避免局部最优并鼓励偏航控制行为。

Result: 在仿真和真实无人机上均表现出色：在挑战性地图中导航成功率比最佳基线高5.3%，具备逃逸局部最优的能力，无需调参即可实现有效的sim-to-real迁移。

Conclusion: 该框架在复杂未知环境中展现出涌现能力，能够克服其他方法失效的局部最优陷阱，且具有良好的泛化性和迁移性。

Abstract: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [414] [Wheel-Mounted/GNSS Fusion with AI-Aided Position Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03265)
*Gal Versano,Itzik Klein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合神经惯性导航框架，集成轮式安装惯性传感器、强制周期性轨迹和轻量神经网络，通过误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波结合GNSS位置更新回归车辆位移。周期性轨迹提升惯性信噪比，使网络仅凭惯性读数估计位移。实车实验表明，该方法相比标准轮式惯性传感器与GNSS融合方案，定位均方根误差降低约46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度鲁棒定位是自主地面车辆的基本挑战，现有轮式惯性传感器与GNSS融合方案精度不足，亟需提升定位性能。

Method: 提出混合神经惯性导航框架：采用轮式安装惯性传感器，利用强制周期性轨迹增强惯性信号信噪比，设计轻量神经网络仅基于惯性读数回归车辆位移，并在误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波中融合GNSS位置更新。

Result: 实车实验表明，所提方法相比标准轮式惯性传感器与GNSS融合方案，定位均方根误差降低约46%。

Conclusion: 所提混合神经惯性导航框架能显著提升轮式惯性传感器融合GNSS的定位精度，验证了周期性轨迹增强与神经网络位移回归的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate and robust localization remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous ground vehicles. In this work, we propose a hybrid neural inertial navigation framework that integrates a wheel-mounted inertial sensors, enforced periodic trajectories, and a simple, efficient neural network capable of regressing vehicle displacement with GNSS position updates in an error-state extended Kalman filter. The periodic trajectories increase the inertial signal-to-noise ratio, allowing the network to use only inertial readings to estimate displacement. The approach is validated through real-world experiments using multiple wheel-mounted inertial sensors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a significant improvement in positioning accuracy, reducing the position root mean squared error by approximately 46 % compared to standard wheel-mounted inertial sensor fusion with GNSS updates.

</details>


### [415] [EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03268)
*Qian Zhao,Xin Tong,Chengdong Wu,Yang Yang,Yingtian Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EaDex提出了一种低成本演示条件下的多形态灵巧操作学习框架，通过单RGB-D摄像头捕捉人手运动并构建结构化演示数据，结合基于接触奖励的动态演示退火机制，在三种灵巧手和三种物体打开任务上相比基线提升55.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作学习长期受限于数据和训练的高成本，纯强化学习需要大规模交互探索，模仿学习依赖昂贵的高质量演示，亟需低成本高效的解决方案。

Method: 数据层面：使用单RGB-D摄像头捕捉人手运动，通过MANO手部建模、数据归一化和运动重定向构建结构化演示数据。学习层面：引入基于接触奖励的动态演示退火机制，在演示引导下进行早期探索，并随接触奖励累积逐渐过渡到自主优化。

Result: 在三种灵巧手和三种铰接物体打开任务上，覆盖九种跨形态操作设置，相比无演示退火的基线实现了55.3%的相对性能提升。

Conclusion: 验证了所提出的低成本演示流程和动态演示退火策略在灵巧操作学习中的有效性，为降低灵巧操作的数据和训练成本提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation learning has long been hindered by the high costs of data and training, as pure reinforcement learning typically requires large-scale interactive exploration and imitation learning depends on high-quality demonstrations that are expensive to collect. To address this problem, we propose EaDex, a multi-embodiment dexterous manipulation learning framework under low-cost demonstration conditions, which enables rapid generation of demonstration data and consequently reduces training time for efficient dexterous manipulation. At the data level, EaDex captures human hand motions using only a single RGB-D camera and constructs structured demonstration data through MANO-based hand modeling, data normalization, and motion retargeting. At the learning level, we introduce a contact-reward-based dynamic demonstration annealing mechanism, which guides early-stage exploration under demonstration and gradually transitions to autonomous optimization with accumulating contact rewards. Using our custom dataset, we evaluate EaDex on three dexterous hands and three articulated object-opening tasks, covering nine cross-embodiment manipulation settings, achieving a 55.3% relative improvement over the baseline without demonstration annealing. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed low-cost demonstration pipeline and the dynamic demonstration annealing strategy for dexterous manipulation learning.

</details>


### [416] [Bridging Predictive Uncertainty and Safe Action: Sample-Conditioned Differentiable Planning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03296)
*Chengzhen Meng,Pei Liu,Zhiyu Huang,Chen Lv,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种样本条件可微分规划框架，通过将扩散模型生成的多模态未来轨迹显式接入可微分规划器，并引入CVaR尾风险约束，弥合不确定性建模与安全运动规划之间的鸿沟，在Waymo和Argoverse 2数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动驾驶系统面临的核心瓶颈是高度表达性的不确定性建模与可解释、安全运动规划之间的脱节——现有方法要么将预测压缩为单一确定性未来，要么依赖黑箱端到端架构，难以处理周围交通的普遍不确定性。

Method: 1) 采用条件扩散模型生成多样化的未来场景样本；2) 将样本直接输入可微分规划器，通过经验条件风险价值(CVaR)尾风险约束显式缓解预测不确定性；3) 引入有向图表示场景上下文，提升预测有效性和计算效率。

Result: 在Waymo Open Motion和Argoverse 2数据集上的开环与闭环评估中，该方法在安全性、效率和乘坐舒适性上显著超越当前最先进基线。

Conclusion: 该工作成功弥合了概率性预测与安全规划之间的鸿沟，证明了将扩散生成样本与可微分规划及CVaR风险约束结合的有效性，为自动驾驶运动规划提供了更具可解释性和鲁棒性的新范式。

Abstract: Complex, dynamic, and interactive driving environments pose significant challenges for autonomous driving, primarily due to the pervasive uncertainty of surrounding traffic. A fundamental bottleneck in current systems is the disconnect between highly expressive uncertainty modeling and interpretable, safe motion planning. In this paper, we propose a novel sample-conditioned differentiable planning framework that bridges this gap by explicitly incorporating diffusion-generated future trajectories into the optimization process. Rather than compressing predictions into a single deterministic future or relying on black-box end-to-end architectures, our approach leverages a conditional diffusion model to generate a diverse set of plausible future scenarios. Crucially, these samples are directly fed into a differentiable planner, which explicitly mitigates predictive uncertainty via an empirical Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) tail-risk constraint. This allows the planner to optimize a physically interpretable trajectory that is robust to rare yet safety-critical interactions. Furthermore, we introduce a directed graph representation for scene context that yields substantial improvements in both predictive effectiveness and computational efficiency. Validated through extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion and Argoverse 2 datasets, our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in safety, efficiency, and ride comfort.

</details>


### [417] [SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03297)
*Jeonguk Kang,Hanbyel Cho,Sanghyun Kang,Donghan Koo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SplitAdapter，通过分解式适应（因子化的负载感知和动力学感知上下文编码器、分割世界模型目标、GRL交叉对抗正则化、层次化FiLM）来提升人形机器人负载操作在Sim-to-Real迁移中的鲁棒性，尤其在重载条件下效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于历史信息的适配器将负载变化和动力学失配压缩为单一隐式表征，导致重载操作下鲁棒性不足。

Method: 冻结预训练的箱体操作策略，扩展出物体/负载感知和动力学感知的上下文编码器，采用分割世界模型目标训练、GRL交叉对抗正则化以及层次化特征线性调制（FiLM）。

Result: 在sim-to-sim实验和真实部署中，SplitAdapter在物体质量2/4/6kg和取放高度0/30/60cm下全面优于基线和世界模型FiLM基线，重载条件下提升最大。

Conclusion: 分解式因子化适应能有效解耦负载与动力学干扰，提升人形机器人负载操作的泛化性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.

</details>


### [418] [RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03312)
*Jongwook Han,Hyeongjin Kim,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RobotValues基准，用于评估家务机器人在10K价值冲突场景中的价值偏好。发现视觉-语言模型存在默认价值偏好（安全、迁就），忽视隐私，且在需要覆盖默认偏好时80%选择错误动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人评估仅关注任务完成，忽视了日常家庭环境中机器人在价值冲突情境下需要权衡人类自主性、效率、社会适切性等不同价值的决策能力，缺乏相应的评估基准。

Method: 通过LLM辅助生成价值冲突场景、利益相关者驱动的价值提取、图像生成和自动质量控制，构建包含10K个实例的RobotValues基准，每个实例包含真实家庭图像和多个优先不同人类价值的可行机器人动作。

Result: VLM模型表现出默认价值偏好（安全和迁就），而低估了优先隐私的动作；当被指示优先与自身偏好冲突的特定价值时，模型80%的时间选择了错误动作。

Conclusion: 家务机器人评估不仅要衡量任务完成或安全合规，还应评估机器人在人类价值冲突时能否在可行动作中做出恰当选择。

Abstract: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations in which robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize other values than task success, such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct RobotValues through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. Using RobotValues we evaluate VLMs used in robotics and find that models exhibit default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When the models are instructed to prioritize specific values that conflict with their own preferences, they often fail to override their default actions, choosing incorrect actions for 80% of the time. These findings suggest that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.

</details>


### [419] [GPU-Parallel Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Demonstration Guided Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03335)
*Rui Zhang,Qiwei Wu,Zhengyu Zhang,Tao Li,Yunrong Guo,Junjie Lai,Renjing Xu,Weihua Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将结构化操作任务族转化为GPU并行多任务强化学习基准的构建方法（MT-Libero），并设计了基于演示引导的在线策略方法DGPO（结合重要性加权PPO与自适应行为克隆），在稀疏奖励和有限数据条件下显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大规模GPU并行强化学习系统大多为每个任务优化一个专用策略，缺乏支持多任务同时训练的通用基准和方法，特别是在稀疏成功信号和有限先验数据场景下。

Method: 1) 构建方法：利用LIBERO资产和任务谓词在Isaac Lab中实例化MT-Libero基准，支持异构任务套件上的并行强化学习、并行渲染、物理随机化以及状态输入或视觉输入策略。2) DGPO算法：基于在线策略的演示引导方法，将重要性加权PPO与自适应行为克隆结合，在匹配的演示动作上进行调节，实现对演示任务分布的可调偏好。

Result: DGPO在稀疏奖励和有限数据条件下，性能优于无先验知识的强化学习以及现有基于演示的方法，同时保持了在线策略PPO的稳定性和在线改进能力。

Conclusion: 所提出的MT-Libero基准和DGPO方法有效解决了多任务操作族在GPU并行环境下的强化学习问题，为后续研究提供了可扩展的基准框架和高效的演示引导训练范式。

Abstract: Large scale GPU-parallel reinforcement learning has changed what can be trained in robot simulation, yet most systems still optimize one specialist policy per task. We propose a construction methodology for turning structured manipulation task families into GPU-parallel multi-task RL benchmarks, and instantiate it as MT-Libero using LIBERO assets and task predicates in Isaac Lab. The resulting benchmark supports simultaneous reinforcement learning over heterogeneous task suites with parallel rendering, physics randomization, and state-input or visual-input policies. To make such training practical under sparse success signals and limited prior data, we further propose DGPO, an on-policy demonstration guided method that combines importance weighted PPO with adaptive behavior cloning on matched demonstration actions. DGPO enables a tunable preference toward demonstrated task distributions, outperforming both prior-free RL and existing demonstration-based methods while preserving the stability and online improvement benefits of on-policy PPO.

</details>


### [420] [Autonomous Navigation System for Library Service Robot Based on Unitree Go2 Edu](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03340)
*Aoduo Li,Haoran Lv,Bingquan Ou,Jianfeng Li,Yingdong Li,Zimeng Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套基于ROS 2的四足机器人（Unitree Go2 Edu）导航系统，结合4D LiDAR、深度相机和IMU，在真实图书馆环境中实现了静态场景100%、低密度动态96%、高密度动态88%的成功率，地图验证平均误差3.7 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图书馆环境需要机器人在狭窄过道中安静移动，同时避让读者、椅子、书包和手推车等障碍物。现有轮式平台对地面不连续（地板过渡、临时杂物、部分阻塞通道）的容忍度较低，需要更灵活的四足机器人解决方案。

Method: 采用Unitree Go2 Edu四足机器人，搭载4D LiDAR、前置深度相机和IMU；使用RTAB-Map进行视觉-LiDAR SLAM建图，AMCL与EKF融合传感器数据进行定位，Nav2框架集成A*全局规划与DWA局部避障。

Result: 在真实图书馆中，静态场景成功率为100%，低密度动态场景为96%，高密度动态场景为88%；地图验证的均方度量误差为3.7 cm。

Conclusion: 四足机器人结合多传感器融合与ROS 2导航栈能够有效应对图书馆中地面不连续、临时杂物和部分阻塞通道等实际部署挑战，具备替代轮式平台的潜力。

Abstract: Libraries require autonomous robots to move quietly through narrow aisles while remaining safe around readers, chairs, bags, and carts. This paper presents a ROS 2 navigation system for a Unitree Go2 Edu quadruped equipped with a 4D LiDAR, a front depth camera, and an IMU. Rather than assuming the library is rough terrain, we target the practical mobility discontinuities of real deployments, including floor transitions, temporary clutter, and partially blocked passages where low-clearance wheeled platforms are less tolerant. RTAB-Map is used for visual-LiDAR SLAM, AMCL and EKF-based sensor fusion provide localization, and a Nav2 stack with A* and DWA supports planning and local avoidance. In a real library, the system achieves 100%, 96%, and 88% success rates in static, low-density dynamic, and high-density dynamic scenes, while map validation against surveyed control distances yields a mean metric error of 3.7 cm.

</details>


### [421] [eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03374)
*A. Haroon Rasheed,Maria Kabtoul*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 eMEM，一个面向具身智能体的混合图结构记忆系统，支持按语义、空间和时间检索记忆；同时构建 eMEM-Bench v1 基准测试，基于8种认知心理学范式评估记忆能力，系统在988个探针上达到80.8加权平均分，纯RAG基线在上下文依赖检索和DRM诱饵拒绝上分别损失30和29个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆架构（如Generative Agents、MemGPT、A-MEM）将记忆视为文本流或知识图谱，但具身智能体需要能够同时按语义、空间和时间进行检索的记忆系统，而现有方法无法满足这一需求。

Method: 1) 多索引架构：SQLite用于结构化存储，hnswlib用于近似最近邻语义搜索，R-tree用于空间查询，统一在单一图模型下；2) 分层整合管线：将原始感知观测转化为压缩摘要，模仿生物海马体-新皮层的记忆巩固机制；3) 10个智能体可调用的检索工具；4) 系统完全嵌入并与智能体同进程运行。

Result: eMEM在eMEM-Bench v1的988个探针上达到80.8加权平均分；在1小时到1年的模拟延迟下，房间唯一项目的保持曲线平坦且达到天花板水平；纯RAG基线（flat_rag消融）在上下文依赖检索上损失30个百分点，在DRM诱饵拒绝上损失29个百分点。

Conclusion: eMEM通过多层存储和巩固机制显著优于纯RAG基线，证明了结构化多模态记忆对具身智能体的重要性；同时eMEM-Bench v1提供了比LoCoMo或OpenEQA更具诊断性的评估框架。

Abstract: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments. Current agent memory architectures, such as Generative Agents, MemGPT, and A-MEM, treat memory as text streams or knowledge graphs, but embodied agents require memory that is simultaneously searchable by meaning, space, and time. eMEM fills this gap with a multi-index architecture (SQL ITE for structured storage, hnswlib for approximate nearest neighbour semantic search, and an R-tree for spatial queries) unified behind a single graph model. A tiered consolidation pipeline transforms raw perceptual observations into compressed summaries, mirroring hippocampal-neocortical consolidation in biological systems. Ten agent-facing recall tools expose memory retrieval primitives, including concept-to-location resolution and cross layer recall, as first-class operations for LLM tool calling. The system is fully embedded and runs in-process alongside the agent. In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation. The benchmark is organised explicitly around eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, and a foil augmented retention curve), each chosen so that the result is interpretable against the broader memory-systems literature in humans and prior agent-memory systems; a level of diagnostic that surface-task benchmarks like LoCoMo or OpenEQA cannot provide. eMEM scores 80.8 weighted mean over 988 probes, with a flat retention curve at ceiling from 1 h to 1 yr of simulated delay on room-unique items. We show that a pure RAG baseline (the flat_rag ablation) loses 30 pt on context dependent retrieval and 29 pt on DRM lure rejection, isolating the contribution of multi-layer storage and consolidation respectively. We release both the system and the benchmark code.

</details>


### [422] [Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03385)
*Jiahao Xu,Peiyuan Wang,Hanzhuo Zhang,Zihao Yu,Tianyu Fu,Hao Chen,Xuanhao Xiang,Jianbo Yu,Chenchen Fu,Wanyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GTP-FA框架，通过抓取-规划两阶段架构与故障归因模型，解耦抓取与运动规划的失败原因，并基于诊断结果对两模块进行针对性优化，显著提升各类基学习器的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人操作任务中，抓取与运动规划的紧密耦合常常掩盖真实失败原因，导致低效的试错过程，需要解耦并归因失败来源以提升长程操作效率。

Method: 构建任务导向的两阶段抓取-规划框架，学习故障归因模型以泛化到未见抓取并生成稳定故障模式分布；基于归因结果，在抓取侧注入任务先验和风险惩罚，在规划侧针对高风险初始状态进行数据收集与微调。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人实验中，GTP-FA在RL、IL、扩散策略和VLA设置下均显著提升了基学习器的整体任务成功率。

Conclusion: 解耦抓取与规划的故障归因机制能够有效指导双模块协同优化，是提升长程操作任务成功率的关键方法。

Abstract: In robotic manipulation, the tight coupling between grasping and motion planning often obscures the true source of failure, leading to inefficient trial-and-error. To enable efficient long-horizon manipulation, we propose GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp. Given a failed manipulation trajectory, we learn a failure attribution model that generalizes to unseen grasps and produces a stable distribution over failure modes for diagnosis-guided optimization. Based on these attribution results, we then optimize both modules in a diagnosis-driven manner: on the grasping side, we inject task-level priors and risk penalties into grasp candidate scoring and optimization to suppress unstable or task-incompatible grasps; on the planning side, we target high-risk initial states through data collection and fine-tuning to address genuine planning bottlenecks. We evaluate the proposed framework in both simulation and real-robot experiments, and show that GTP-FA improves the corresponding base learners across RL, IL, diffusion-policy, and VLA-based settings, achieving substantially higher overall task success rates.

</details>


### [423] [Extreme Motion Generation via Hybrid Null-Space Control for Straight-Line Path Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03390)
*Xinyi Yuan,Weiwei Wan,Kensuke Harada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合控制框架，结合强化学习策略与模型控制，在沿预定轨迹运动时最大化机械臂的笛卡尔路径长度，将平均轨迹长度提升27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业中许多任务（如表面涂层、焊接）需要沿预定轨迹运动，而固定基座机械臂受限于可达范围，需在长时域内主动避开安全边界以极限利用运动学能力，现有方法难以应对这一长时域决策挑战。

Method: 提出步级混合控制器，根据归一化关节极限距离在RL策略与模型控制器之间切换；初始关节配置通过条件扩散采样生成，利用学习到的运动先验提升可达路径长度。

Result: 在7自由度Franka FR3上对10,000条直线轨迹任务进行测评，平均路径长度相比纯模型基线延长27%，部分任务达到极大提升。

Conclusion: 将长时域决策交由学习策略、近边界区域由模型控制器覆盖的混合范式可有效实现极限运动生成，缓解数据稀疏导致的学习策略退化问题。

Abstract: This work studies ``extreme motion generation'', which aims to maximize the Cartesian path length along a pre-defined trajectory within the manipulator's workspace. This objective is important in industry as long as path-following is fundamental to a large variety of tasks such as surface coating and welding. More critically, extreme motion enables a fixed-base manipulator to exploit the kinematic capability under limited reachability. However, such exploitation is challenging in practice, as the manipulator must actively avoid the safety boundary through execution, which is inherently a long-horizon problem. Accordingly, we claim that long-horizon decision-making should be delegated to a learning-based policy to maximize exploitation, while a classical model-based controller covers the near-boundary region, where the learning policy degrades sharply due to sparse data coverage. In detail, our proposed method is a step-level hybrid controller that switches between an RL-based and a model-based controller according to the normalized joint-limit distance. The initial joint configuration is sampled through conditional diffusion-based sampling, which improves the achievable path length based on the learned motion prior. We evaluate the proposed framework on 10,000 straight-line path-following tasks with a 7-DoF Franka FR3, extending the average rollout length by 27\% over the model-based baseline. Notably, certain tasks yield a pronounced extension toward the motion extreme, as reflected in the maximum improvement reported in the statistical results. The project website and related videos of this paper can be found at https://yuan-xinyi.github.io/extreme-motion-generation/.

</details>


### [424] [OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03392)
*Jinyuan Zhang,Luoyi Fan,Leiyu Wang,Yeqiang Wang,Yicheng Zhu,Cewu Lu,Nanyang Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OpenEAI-Platform 是一个完全开源平台，集成了低成本 6+1 自由度机械臂 OpenEAI-Arm 和可复现的视觉-语言-行动模型 OpenEAI-VLA，在真实世界操作任务中性能优于同等商用机械臂，并与大规模预训练基线模型表现相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能研究依赖昂贵的商用硬件和闭源模型，缺乏低成本、可复现、全开源的软硬件一体化平台，阻碍了研究的可重复性和规模化数据收集。

Method: OpenEAI-Arm 采用开源机械设计降低制造成本，并实现柔顺控制方法提升精度；OpenEAI-VLA 基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 视觉语言模型，使用 Diffusion Transformer 动作头，通过两阶段训练（仅使用开源机器人数据集和多模态数据集）进行训练。

Result: 在四项真实世界操作任务中，OpenEAI-Arm 在相同策略下优于两款商用 6+1 自由度机械臂；OpenEAI-VLA 在仅使用有限预训练数据的情况下，达到了与大规模预训练 pi0 基线相当的成功率。

Conclusion: OpenEAI-Platform 证明了低成本开源硬件与可复现 VLA 模型的可行性，为具身智能领域提供可复现研究平台，计划开源完整硬件设计、驱动、模型及训练/数据流水线。

Abstract: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.

</details>


### [425] [Reliability-Guided Depth Fusion for Glare-Resilient Navigation Costmaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03421)
*Shang-En Tsai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度可靠性建模的防眩光代价地图构建方法，通过DRM-Net预测像素级测量可信度并结合RGF融合机制，有效减少反光地板、玻璃墙面等镜面干扰导致的虚假障碍物插入，在真实移动机器人平台上验证了实时性能和导航安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动立体RGB-D深度传感器在镜面反射表面（如反光地板、玻璃边界、光滑室内表面）会产生深度测量空洞和尖峰噪声，这些噪声在占据网格代价地图中累积为持久的虚假障碍物，影响室内导航的安全性。现有方法多将此类问题视为密集深度补全任务，而本文认为应将其重构为测量可靠性建模问题。

Method: 1) 提出DRM-Net轻量级深度可靠性图网络，逐像素预测镜面干扰下的测量可信度；2) 设计基于可靠性引导的加权与门控融合机制（RGF），在将测量值累积到地图前，根据可靠性分数调制占据更新；3) 使用位姿对齐的多视图参考深度构建方法减少循环监督偏差。

Result: 在搭载Intel RealSense D435和Jetson Orin Nano的真实移动机器人平台上，在反光地板、玻璃墙、自然光眩光条件下，该方法减少了虚假障碍物插入、提高了自由空间保持率，并维持了实时吞吐量。通过融合变体消融、参数敏感性分析、跨条件测试、配对导航比较、可靠性图指标和嵌入式运行时剖析进行了全面评估。

Conclusion: 镜面眩光应被视为测量可靠性问题而非密集深度补全问题，该方法为安全关键型室内导航提供了更鲁棒的代价地图构建方案。
