Abstract: Specular glare on reflective floors, glass boundaries, and glossy indoor surfaces frequently corrupts active-stereo RGB-D depth measurements, producing holes and spikes that accumulate as persistent phantom obstacles in occupancy-grid costmaps. This paper presents a glare-resilient costmap construction method based on explicit depth-reliability modeling. A lightweight Depth Reliability Map network (DRM-Net) predicts per-pixel measurement trustworthiness under specular interference, and a reliability-guided weighted-and-gated fusion (RGF) mechanism modulates occupancy updates before corrupted measurements are accumulated into the map. To support robust training and evaluation, the method uses pose-aligned multi-view reference-depth construction to reduce circular-supervision bias and is evaluated through fusion-variant ablations, parameter-sensitivity analysis, cross-condition tests, paired navigation comparisons, reliability-map metrics, and embedded runtime profiling. Experiments on a real mobile robotic platform equipped with an Intel RealSense D435 and a Jetson Orin Nano show that the proposed method reduces false obstacle insertion, improves free-space preservation, and maintains real-time throughput under reflective-floor, glass-wall, and natural-light glare conditions. These results support treating glare as a measurement-reliability problem rather than as a dense depth-completion problem for safety-critical indoor navigation.

</details>


### [426] [PerchRL: Vision-Based Agile Perching on Inclined Platforms under Rapid and Irregular Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03441)
*Zihong Lu,Zongzhuo Liu,Huaxu Li,Jinqiang Cui,Jie Mei,Youmin Gong,U Kei Cheang,Boyu Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PerchRL是一个基于强化学习的框架，用于四旋翼无人机在快速不规则运动的倾斜平台上进行视觉敏捷着陆，采用两阶段学习策略（状态预训练+视觉微调）和混合学习框架，解决了视野受限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主视觉着陆对空地协作至关重要，但由于无人机视野受限，在快速不规则移动的倾斜平台上实现着陆极具挑战性。

Method: 提出PerchRL框架，采用两阶段学习策略：先进行基于状态的预训练，再进行基于视觉的微调；使用随机化平台轨迹防止过拟合和时间增广方法捕捉运动模式；在视觉微调阶段引入可见性感知状态增广和主动感知奖励的混合学习框架，增强对间歇性视觉丢失的鲁棒性。

Result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验验证了PerchRL的可行性、稳定性和实时性能，并在不同四旋翼平台上成功部署，证明了其适应性。

Conclusion: PerchRL有效解决了视野受限下在运动倾斜平台上的敏捷着陆问题，具有良好泛化能力和跨平台适应性。

Abstract: Autonomous vision-based perching of quadrotors on moving inclined platforms is critical for air-ground collaboration but remains challenging due to the limited field of view (FOV). In this paper, we propose PerchRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for vision-based agile perching on inclined platforms under rapid and irregular motion. Specifically, we employ a two-stage learning strategy consisting of state-based pre-training followed by vision-based fine-tuning. To improve generalization across diverse platform motions, we employ randomized platform trajectories to prevent overfitting and temporal augmentation methods to capture latent motion patterns from historical observations. During vision-based fine-tuning, a hybrid learning framework consisting of visibility-aware state augmentation and active perception rewards is presented to improve robustness under intermittent visual loss. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the feasibility, stability, and real-time performance of PerchRL, while successful deployment across distinct quadrotor platforms further validates its adaptability. The source code will be released to benefit the community.

</details>


### [427] [Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03476)
*Tianchen Huang,Feiyang Yuan,Junchi Gu,Shurui Fang,Xiaohu Zhang,Yu Wang,Wei Gao,Shiwu Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Human2Humanoid，一种基于CycleGAN的无监督运动重定向框架，通过骨架感知图卷积网络、形态不变末端执行器一致性损失和物理感知可行性约束，将人体运动高保真地迁移到人形机器人，无需配对数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动到人形机器人的重定向对于远程操控、模仿学习和人机交互至关重要，但由于人类与机器人在骨骼拓扑、肢体比例、自由度等方面的形态学差异以及配对运动数据的稀缺，该任务仍然充满挑战。

Method: 采用基于CycleGAN的架构，配备骨架感知图卷积网络捕获拓扑相关运动特征；引入形态不变末端执行器一致性损失对齐归一化末端执行器轨迹以保持运动语义；施加显式的物理感知可行性约束以鼓励源运动中接触模式的再现。

Result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上成功实现了无需配对数据的人体运动重定向，在下游可控性和物理可行性方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的无监督运动重定向框架有效弥合了人体与机器人之间的形态学差距，实现了高保真的运动迁移。

Abstract: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.

</details>


### [428] [SPADE: Sketch-guided Path Planning Augmented with Diffusion Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03512)
*Charbel Abi Hana,Tatiana Ghantous,Mikael Khalil,Anthony Rizk*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种增强的路径规划框架，通过改进的ROS 2标注工具和基于扩散的数据增强训练策略，解决了模仿学习方法在泛化性和鲁棒性上的不足。该方法在APE和FID上分别降低39.1%和33.5%，同时参数量减少93.8%，兼顾了扩散级别的泛化能力与实时边缘部署性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于模仿学习的路径规划方法存在两大局限：对未见环境的泛化能力有限，以及演示数据收集的鲁棒性差。作者旨在解决这些问题，同时避免传统方法中复杂的奖励工程或高成本的硬件方案。

Method: 1) 基于ROS 2重新设计了标注工具，提升数据收集效率与质量；2) 提出了一种结合扩散模型的数据增强训练策略，将其集成到基线行为克隆模型中；3) 提供专家演示数据集，并通过消融实验评估方案鲁棒性。

Result: 相比现有最优方法，该方法APE降低39.1%，FID降低33.5%，可训练参数减少93.8%。在保持实时性和边缘部署能力的同时，达到了扩散级别的泛化水平。

Conclusion: 通过改进标注工具和引入扩散增强训练策略，有效提升了模仿学习在AMR路径规划中的泛化能力和鲁棒性，在精度、生成质量和模型轻量化方面全面超越现有方法。

Abstract: Path planning is essential for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs). Conventional methods for incorporating human preferences into planning typically rely on either complex reward engineering or hardware-intensive solutions. Recent state-of-the-art frameworks leverage imitation learning to train behavior-specific path planning models from expert demonstrations. However, these approaches face two key limitations: limited generalization to unseen environments and low robustness in demonstration collection. To address these challenges, this work introduces an enhanced framework that focuses on two main contributions: an overhauled annotation tool built on ROS 2, and a novel training strategy that integrates diffusion-based augmentation into baseline behavioral cloning models. A dataset of expert demonstrations is provided and evaluated through ablation studies to assess the robustness of the proposed solution. The enhanced approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods with 39.1% lower Absolute Pose Error (APE) and 33.5% lower Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) while having 93.8% less trainable parameters. Moreover it attains diffusion-level generalization while preserving the real-time, on-edge properties of state-of-the-art models.

</details>


### [429] [Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03536)
*Tianchen Huang,Mingkuan Zhao,Yang Gao,Feiyang Yuan,Junchi Gu,Xiaohu Zhang,Dongdong Zhao,Shi Yan,Yu Wang,Wei Gao,Shiwu Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仿生生成-控制框架，用于人形机器人上的示例驱动风格迁移。通过物理感知的多条件潜扩散模型融合风格、内容和轨迹条件，结合分类器无导引调整风格强度，并将生成参考转化为G1兼容的机器人参考，由基于预阅的全身跟踪策略执行。在Unitree G1上实现125次真实机器人试验96.0%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数富有表现力的运动仍来自固定演示或手动设计的脚本，难以在不同运动内容间复用已演示的风格。受人类运动风格通过步态节奏、姿态、手臂摆动和身体摇摆传达情感和意图线索的启发，本文旨在实现从短人体风格示例到不同机器人运动内容的风格迁移。

Method: 提出仿生生成-控制框架：1）物理感知多条件潜扩散模型（融合风格、内容、轨迹条件）；2）分类器无导引调整风格强度；3）接触一致性和时间平滑正则化提升硬件可执行性；4）将生成参考转换为G1兼容参考；5）基于预阅的全身跟踪策略（采用聚类与蒸馏训练）。

Result: 仿真与Unitree G1实验表明：该方法能将短人体风格示例迁移到多样机器人运动内容；相比面向动画的风格迁移基线，减少了接触和抖动伪影；125次真实机器人试验成功率96.0%。

Conclusion: 验证了将短人体运动示例作为可复用仿生源，用于物理可执行的表现性人形运动的可行性。

Abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

</details>


### [430] [Static and Dynamic Representations for Tactile Contact-Angle Estimation with Event-Based Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03545)
*Yanhui Lu,Efi Psomopoulou,Benjamin Ward-Cherrier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究基于事件触觉传感器(NeuroTac)的事件流进行接触角估计，比较了动态、静态及组合三种空间轮廓表征方法。静态表征在场景特定训练下表现最优，连续滚动时平均MAE为0.160°，中断时平均MAE为0.251°，且所有方法P99处理延迟低于10ms，适用于高频机器人操作中的触觉角度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件触觉传感具有低延迟信号获取的优势，适用于接触丰富的机器人交互场景。本文旨在探索如何利用事件触觉传感器的事件流有效估计接触角，并比较不同空间轮廓表征方法的性能差异。

Method: 使用NeuroTac事件触觉传感器采集事件流，设计了三种事件衍生的空间轮廓表征：动态表征（捕捉近期事件活动）、静态表征（恢复更持久的接触状态）及二者的组合表征。在连续滚动和随机中断两种运动场景下进行实验评估。

Result: 所有表征管线在所有采样间隔下的P99处理延迟均低于10ms。静态表征在场景特定训练下性能最佳，连续滚动时总体平均MAE为0.160°，中断阶段平均MAE为0.251°，且在速度和压痕深度变化下性能波动更小。

Conclusion: 三种事件衍生的空间轮廓表征均具备高频事件触觉角度估计的潜力，其中静态表征在精度和鲁棒性方面优于动态和组合表征，适用于机器人操作中的接触角估计任务。

Abstract: Event-based tactile sensing offers low-latency signal acquisition for contact-rich robotic interaction. This paper investigates contact-angle estimation using event streams from an event-based tactile sensor (NeuroTac) and compares three event-derived spatial contour representations: a dynamic representation capturing recent event activity, a static representation recovering a more persistent contact state, and their combined representation. Across the evaluated motion scenarios, all representation pipelines exhibited P99 processing latency below 10 ms at all tested sampling intervals, demonstrating their potential for high-frequency event-based tactile angle estimation in robotic manipulation. The static representation consistently achieved marginally better performance than the dynamic and combined representations under scenario-specific training, yielding a mean overall MAE of 0.160° during continuous sensor rolling and a stop-phase mean MAE of 0.251° during randomly inserted motion interruptions. It also exhibited smaller performance fluctuations across speed and indentation depth variations than the other two representations.

</details>


### [431] [NVIDIA Isaac Sim: Enabling Scalable, GPU-Accelerated Simulation for Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03551)
*Sicong Gao,Maurice Pagnucco,Tomasz Bednarz,Yang Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了NVIDIA Isaac Sim的架构特性、应用模式与局限性，涵盖五大领域代表性研究，并展望了物理开放世界学习、仿真中心训练等未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有综述将Isaac Sim视为众多仿真器之一，缺乏对其架构特性、使用模式和局限性的系统性分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 从系统和应用两个视角综述Isaac Sim，分析其架构并与主流仿真器比较，归纳五大领域的代表性研究及通用使用模式（数据生成与高保真仿真）。

Result: 梳理了Isaac Sim的GPU加速架构优势及其在数据生成和高保真仿真中的典型使用模式。

Conclusion: Isaac Sim在机器人研究中具有核心基础设施地位，未来面临物理开放世界学习、仿真中心训练和实际可用性约束等挑战。

Abstract: Simulation has become a core infrastructure for robotics research. Unlike previous simulators, NVIDIA Isaac Sim leverages GPU acceleration to enable large-scale parallel training and physics-accurate modeling. Its synthetic data generation pipeline alleviates the scarcity of high-quality training data, supporting data-driven robot learning and large-scale simulation-centric experimentation. However, existing surveys often treat it as one simulator among many, without a systematic analysis of its architectural characteristics, usage patterns, and limitations. This survey reviews Isaac Sim from system and application perspectives, outlining its architecture and comparing it with widely used simulators. We analyze representative studies across five major domains and summarize common usage patterns, particularly in data generation and high-fidelity simulation. We also outline key future directions and challenges, including physics open-world learning, simulation-centric training and practical usability constraints.

</details>


### [432] [Partially Observable Adversarial Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03556)
*Xiaofei Wang,Mingliang Han,Tianyu Hao,Yi Yang,Yun-Bo Zhao,Keke Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对VLA模型的鲁棒性，提出了一种部分可观测威胁模型下的两阶段对抗补丁攻击框架，通过注意力图定位关键区域并优化补丁破坏语义对齐和动作轨迹，在仿真和真实环境中实现了长时域干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗补丁攻击VLA机器人的方法假设攻击者能访问完整执行轨迹，这在实际中不现实。因此本文旨在解决部分可观测条件下的对抗攻击问题，填补VLA模型鲁棒性研究空白。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 利用模型注意力图定位与完整指令对应的视觉关键区域；2) 优化补丁破坏目标对象的语义对齐并增加动作轨迹曲率，使感知与控制双重失效。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人环境中的实验表明，该方法在部分可观测条件下能维持对抗效果，诱导长时域干扰并显著降低任务成功率。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了VLA模型在更实际的部分可观测威胁下的脆弱性，提出的攻击框架为评估和提升VLA机器人鲁棒性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are gaining attention in robotics, yet their robustness to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing work shows that adversarial patches can mislead VLA-based robots but assumes full access to the entire execution trajectory, an unrealistic requirement in practice. We address this limitation by formulating a partially observable threat model, where the adversary can exploit only a short prefix of the trajectory to generate a fixed patch applied to all subsequent frames. Under this setting, we propose a two-phase framework. First, we localize the patch using the model's attention maps to identify visually critical regions that correspond to the full instruction. Then, we optimize the patch to disrupt the semantic grounding of target objects and increase the curvature of action trajectories, thereby compounding failures in both perception and control. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world robotic environments show that our method sustains adversarial effects under partial observability, inducing long-horizon disruptions and significantly reducing task success rates.

</details>


### [433] [CANMOT: Class-Aware Noise Modeling for Multi-Object Tracking in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03590)
*Timo Osterburg,Stefan Schütte,Torsten Bertram*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CANMOT，一种类别感知且面向对象坐标系的噪声建模框架，用于基于卡尔曼滤波的3D多目标跟踪。通过在nuScenes上的实验，该方法相比现有基线减少了身份切换次数，并改善了不确定性校准，但仍存在不一致性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的KF-based MOT系统对不同类别的交通参与者使用全局相同的噪声协方差假设，忽略了异质交通参与者的不确定性差异，导致跟踪性能受限。

Method: 提出CANMOT框架：引入类别特定的对角化过程噪声和测量噪声协方差矩阵，并可选地在目标坐标系中表达以保持纵向-横向各向异性。

Result: 在nuScenes基准上，CANMOT相比SotA减少了身份切换次数；通过ANEES和卡方检验发现标准KF基线存在严重过度自信，CANMOT改善了校准但仍存在不一致性。

Conclusion: 类别感知和面向对象坐标系的噪声建模能提升3D MOT性能与校准质量，但当前框架仍无法完全解决不确定性不一致问题，需进一步研究。

Abstract: Kalman filter (KF)-based multi-object tracking (MOT) remains a strong baseline for autonomous driving due to its strong performance, computational efficiency and interpretability. In most practical systems, the process noise and measurement noise covariances are defined globally and shared across object classes, presuming identical uncertainty characteristics across heterogeneous traffic participants.
  This work revisits this assumption and proposes CANMOT, a class-aware and object-aligned noise modeling framework for KF-based 3D MOT. Class-specific diagonal process and measurement covariance matrices are introduced and optionally expressed in the object coordinate frame to preserve longitudinal-lateral anisotropy.
  Systematic experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that class-aware and object-aligned noise modeling improves tracking performance and substantially reduces identity switches compared to state-of-the-art (SotA). In addition, the consistency of the estimated uncertainty is analyzed using the Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) and $χ^2$-based violation tests. The results reveal severe overconfidence in standard KF-based MOT baselines. While the proposed formulation improves calibration without modifying the underlying filtering framework, it still exhibits substantial inconsistency, highlighting the need for further research in this area.
  Code is available at https://github.com/rst-tu-dortmund/learned-3d-nms.

</details>


### [434] [PHASER: Phase-Aware and Semantic Experience Replay for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03598)
*Ziyang Chen,Shaoguang Wang,Weiyu Guo,Qianyi Cai,He Zhang,Pengteng Li,Yiren Zhao,Yandong Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PHASER是一个面向VLA模型的持续学习框架，通过阶段感知容量分配和多模态干扰路由策略解决灾难性遗忘问题，在LIBERO基准上提升成功率高达31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在开放环境中持续获取新技能时会遭遇严重的灾难性遗忘，现有经验回放方法由于均匀采样策略忽略操作轨迹的时间特性，导致关键子技能采样不足（阶段饥饿）且无法感知历史任务的遗忘程度差异。

Method: 提出PHASER框架，包含：1) 阶段感知容量分配，确保所有子技能获得均衡记忆支持；2) 多模态干扰路由策略，动态优先回放高遗忘风险的历史阶段；3) Auto-PC轻量级流水线，结合无监督动作信号变化点检测和VLM语义验证自动提取时间边界。

Result: 在三种VLA主干网络和LIBERO持续学习套件上评估，PHASER相比等预算经验回放提升平均成功率高达31%，在LIBERO-Goal CL设置中达到87.8%的最终成功率。

Conclusion: PHASER作为一种架构无关的持续学习框架，通过阶段感知机制有效缓解了VLA模型在机器人操作任务中的灾难性遗忘问题，并支持全自主的终身适应。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, deploying these models in open-ended environments requires continuously acquiring novel skills, a process that inevitably triggers severe catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behaviors. While experience replay (ER) serves as a standard mitigating strategy, naive uniform sampling fundamentally misaligns with the temporal characteristics of manipulation trajectories. It systematically under-samples brief but causally critical sub-skills, leading to phase starvation, and completely overlooks the varying degrees of forgetting across historical tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework. PHASER employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting. Furthermore, to enable fully autonomous lifelong adaptation, we integrate Auto-PC, a lightweight pipeline combining unsupervised action-signal change-point detection with VLM-based semantic verification to extract temporal boundaries without intensive manual supervision. Evaluated across three VLA backbones on LIBERO continual learning suites, PHASER yields substantial empirical improvements, increasing Average Success Rate (ASR) by up to 31% over matched-budget ER and achieving an 87.8% final ASR on the LIBERO-Goal CL setting.

</details>


### [435] [A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03609)
*Xuhui Lin,Stephen Law,Nanjiang Chen,Kunyao Li,Tao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种以3D等视域（isovist）作为预测目标的具身世界模型，用于城市导航。该模型预测的是可通行几何（负空间）而非外观，通过深度残差、自 rollout 调度采样和持久潜在鸟瞰空间图实现高效的下一帧等视域预测。一个意外的发现是：仅在曼哈顿和巴黎训练的模型产生了跨城市的空间签名，其城市身份可从时间潜在变量中线性解码，表明学习到的动态本身携带了城市几何特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市导航的世界模型要么预测外观（与导航无关），要么预测鸟瞰占据网格（丢失三维和多层结构）。缺少一个既能捕捉可通行几何又不坍塌三维维度的预测目标。

Method: 1) 以3D等视域（球形可见性深度图）作为预测目标；2) 将预测建模为深度残差以保留建筑锐利边缘；3) 采用自 rollout 调度采样防止训练-测试不匹配；4) 引入持久潜在鸟瞰空间图实现跨路径一致性。

Result: 单一城市盲模型在曼哈顿和巴黎上训练后，产生了跨城市空间签名；城市身份可从时间潜在变量中线性解码，且效果远优于单帧基线；模型轻量、可解释、可复现。

Conclusion: 3D等视域是城市导航中一个有效的几何预测目标，学习到的动态本身编码了城市几何特征，为具身AI、机器人和城市分析提供了几何表征基础。

Abstract: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

</details>


### [436] [GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03682)
*Xinhai Li,Xiaotao Zhang,Yuehao Huang,Jiankun Dong,Tianhang Wang,Sunyao Zhou,Yunzi Wu,Chengnuo Sun,Yunfei Ge,Qizhen Weng,Chi Zhang,Chenjia Bai,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了GN-Matrix，一个涵盖数据、仿真和学习的统一框架，用于解决视觉-语言导航（VLN）中数据稀缺和泛化能力不足的问题。该框架包含大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix、基于3D高斯溅射的高保真仿真平台、首个BEV基准GN-Bench，以及RL驱动的导航基础模型GN-BAE（采用BAE训练策略）。实验表明GN0在GN-Bench和VLN-CE上超越了现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN系统受限于导航数据的可用性和质量，导致泛化能力和长程导航能力不足。

Method: 1) 构建多样化3D场景并开发自动化管道，生成大规模GN-Matrix数据集；2) 基于3DGS引擎开发高保真仿真平台，支持交互式漫游和碰撞感知导航；3) 提出GN-Bench，首个基于BEV的基准，引入动态3DGS化身评估人机交互；4) 开发RL驱动的导航基础模型BAE，通过DAgger暴露模型于rollout诱导状态，打破专家分布限制；5) GN-BAE将3DGS渲染的BEV表示形式化为紧凑记忆，解锁VLM中的潜在空间推理。

Result: GN0在GN-Bench和VLN-CE基准上优于现有VLN方法。

Conclusion: GN-Matrix提供了一个统一框架，涵盖数据、仿真和学习，推动了具身导航在研究和工业应用中的发展。

Abstract: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

</details>


### [437] [Face versus Body Tracking for Human-Robot Interaction: An Egocentric Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03694)
*Jessica Wenninger,Gabriel Skantze*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对社交机器人在人机交互中面临的身份切换（IDSW）问题，提出了一种基于Furhat机器人采集的、自标注的自我中心数据集，系统评估了检测错误与跟踪逻辑分离、面部vs身体跟踪、扩展空间记忆与外观重识别（ReID）的影响。优化后的管线将IDSW降低49%，并揭示了ReID在身体跟踪提升与面部跟踪因侧面角度敏感而恶化的矛盾效果，强调了原生社交动态数据集对验证HRI感知模型的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉模型主要为监控或自动驾驶场景优化，社交机器人在自我中心视角下面临人员跳动、遮挡、离帧等独特挑战，频繁的身份切换（IDSW）导致机器人在对话中失去跟踪目标，影响交互连续性。

Method: 收集Furhat机器人的自我中心数据集并自定义标注；系统评估中隔离检测误差与跟踪逻辑；对比面部与身体跟踪；分析扩展空间记忆和外观重识别（ReID）对身份稳定性的影响。

Result: 增加空间记忆可缓解长时间遮挡但无法处理复杂动态事件；集成ReID虽显著提升身体跟踪稳定性，但因侧面角度敏感导致面部IDSW激增；优化后整体IDSW降低49%。

Conclusion: 标准基准缺乏密集近距离遮挡场景，需采用原生社交动态数据集验证HRI感知模型；ReID在身体与面部跟踪上的效果存在矛盾，需针对性设计。

Abstract: To enable meaningful human-robot interaction (HRI), a robot must continuously assess engagement by consistently tracking users over time. State-of-the-art computer vision models, however, are heavily optimized for surveillance or autonomous driving. A social robot faces distinct egocentric challenges, such as humans bouncing, obstructing each other, or leaving the frame. Frequent identity switches (IDSW) cause the robot to lose its footing mid-conversation. To address this, we introduce a novel, custom-annotated egocentric dataset collected via the Furhat robot to capture complex social dynamics. We present a systematic evaluation isolating detection errors from tracking logic, comparing face versus body tracking, and assessing the impact of extended spatial memory and appearance re-identification (ReID). Results indicate that increasing spatial memory mitigates prolonged occlusions but fails on complex dynamic events. Integrating ReID resolves complex switches but exhibits opposing effects: it substantially improves body tracking stability, yet causes facial IDSW to spike due to profile angle sensitivity. Ultimately, our optimized pipeline reduces IDSW by 49\%, mitigating interaction breakdowns. Because standard benchmarks lack dense, close-quarter occlusions, this work highlights the critical need for natively captured social dynamics to truly validate HRI perception models.

</details>


### [438] [Neural Navigation Functions for Zero-Shot Generalizable Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03756)
*Benjamin D. Shaffer,Pei-An Hsieh,Brooks Kinch,Nathaniel Trask,M. Ani Hsieh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出神经导航函数（Neural-NF），一种基于学习的反应式导航函数，能够在未见过的环境几何形状中实现零样本迁移。通过将数据驱动适应置于结构化椭圆规划器中，利用拉普拉斯特征映射到局部PDE系数，求解边值问题生成全局一致的势函数，保证无碰撞、单调下降和全局最小值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统导航函数依赖完整环境建模，难以泛化到新几何形状；而纯数据驱动方法缺乏结构化保证（如碰撞避免、收敛性）。目标是结合学习的适应性与结构化规划器的理论保证。

Method: 1) 提取环境中固有的拉普拉斯特征；2) 用神经网络将这些特征映射到椭圆PDE的局部系数；3) 求解边值问题生成全局势函数；4) 势函数的梯度保证无碰撞、单调下降及全局最小值。

Result: 在多种未见过的几何形状上实现强零样本迁移，相比直接预测势函数的学习规划器，性能提升高达5倍。

Conclusion: Neural-NF成功结合了数据驱动的适应性与结构化PDE规划器的理论保证，提供了可线性求解的最优控制解释，为导航函数的泛化学习提供了有效范式。

Abstract: We introduce Neural Navigation Functions (Neural-NF), a learned reactive navigation function capable of zero-shot transfer across unseen environment geometries. Neural-NF places data-driven adaptation within a structured elliptic planner, where the navigation objective is learned while planner structure is preserved by construction. Specifically, intrinsic Laplacian-derived features are mapped to local PDE coefficients, and solving the resulting boundary value problem produces a globally consistent value function on each target domain. For every admissible learned model, the resulting policy is collision-free, provides monotonic descent and a global minimum at the goal by construction. This admits a linearly-solvable optimal-control interpretation for any parameter setting. Empirically, Neural-NF achieves strong zero-shot transfer across diverse geometries and outperforms learned planners that directly predict the value function by up to a $5\times$ improvement.

</details>


### [439] [Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03784)
*Nan Sun,Yuan Zhang,Yongkun Yang,Wentao Zhao,Peiyan Li,Jun Guo,Wenxuan Song,Pengxiang Ding,Runze Suo,Yifei Su,Xin Xiao,Xinghang Li,Huaping Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了具身链式思维（Embodied CoT）在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的应用，构建了迄今最大的具身CoT语料库（97.8万条轨迹，2.263亿样本，2592.5小时机器人数据）。实验发现，有效的具身CoT应将高层语义理解具体化为动作指导（如末端执行器运动描述和图像空间轨迹），而仅依赖高层推理收益甚微。直接作为自回归动作前缀使用时CoT扩展性不佳，存在复合推理误差和不稳定耦合问题。为此提出ERVLA模型，将具身CoT作为表示塑形监督而非测试时推理，采用推理丢弃训练策略，在LIBERO-Plus上达到86.9%成功率，VLABench上达53.2%成功率，在真实机器人实验中表现优于竞争基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身链式思维（Embodied CoT）旨在连接语言推理与机器人控制，但其有效形式和集成策略尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 1) 构建最大规模具身CoT语料库（97.8万条轨迹，2.263亿样本，2592.5小时数据）；2) 系统实验比较不同CoT形式的效果；3) 提出ERVLA模型，将具身CoT作为表示塑形监督而非强制测试时推理，并采用推理丢弃（reasoning-dropout）训练策略。

Result: ERVLA在LIBERO-Plus上达86.9%成功率，VLABench上达53.2%成功率，在真实机器人实验中优于竞争基线，尤其在语义消歧和长程执行任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: 有效的具身CoT应将高层语义理解具体化为动作指导；显式CoT作为自回归动作前缀不可靠扩展；将CoT作为表示塑形监督而非测试时推理的ERVLA模型在规模化、泛化性和实际部署中表现更优。

Abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

</details>


### [440] [Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03787)
*Nicolas Gorlo,Derek K. Wise,Alberto Speranzon,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）作为机器人长期记忆形成的门控机制，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜在空间中计算惊讶值，通过门控情景记忆增强4D场景图空间记忆，在机器人问答任务上持续超越现有方法，并在事件分割任务中以无监督因果方法超越监督和非因果方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用型机器人需要能够将指令与过去的经验关联起来，但存储所有事件在内存上不可行。由于未来任务无法预先知道，需要一种选择性地保留对未来任务有用记忆的机制。

Method: 提出贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）作为记忆形成的门控机制。在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜在空间中计算惊讶值。使用门控情景记忆增强4D场景图空间记忆。

Result: 在机器人问答基准上持续超越现有方法，在时间、空间和二元问题上超越先前机器人记忆方法≥12%。在事件分割任务中，以无监督因果方法超越监督和非因果方法。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯惊讶是通用机器人选择性记忆形成的有效门控机制，能够在无需知道未来任务的情况下保留具有高通用效用的记忆，显著提升机器人对时间、空间和二元问题的回答能力。

Abstract: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [441] [Optimal Design and Analytical Modeling of a Soft Fin-Ray Effect Gripper Finger Using the Finite Rigid Elements Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03798)
*Sara Adeli,Hassan Sayyaadi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文设计、制造并建模了一种基于Fin Ray效应（FRE）的软体夹爪手指，采用有限刚性单元法（FREM）进行建模，优化后手指构型（长30mm、肋间距10mm、7根-15°肋、肋厚1mm）实现了2%-3%的变形预测误差，为精确力控夹持脆弱农产品（如番茄）提供了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Fin Ray软体夹爪在农业中处理脆弱、不规则物体时缺乏精确的力控能力，而软体机器人固有的非线性、无限自由度及材料变异性使得传统建模方法难以兼顾精度与控制器开发需求。

Method: 采用有限刚性单元法（FREM）进行理论建模，同时利用ANSYS建立详细的有限元模型（FEM），通过仿真与实验验证，以指尖位移、总变形、应力分布和接触力四个关键准则优化手指参数。

Result: 优化后的手指构型为：长度30mm、肋间距10mm、7根肋、肋角度-15°、肋厚1mm。FREM理论模型预测变形误差为3%，ANSYS数值模型误差为2%。

Conclusion: FREM方法既能保持分析精度，又为后续力控制器开发提供了可靠基础；所设计的FRE软体夹爪手指能够实现精确力控，适用于轻柔抓取番茄等脆弱农产品。

Abstract: Fin Ray-inspired soft grippers offer a promising solution for gently handling delicate, irregular objects, especially in agriculture. The objective of this research is to design, fabricate, and model a Fin Ray Effect (FRE) soft gripper finger to enable precise force control in future applications. This design aims to gently grasp delicate agricultural products, such as tomatoes, that require both adaptability and accurate force application. To address the inherent challenges of soft robotics, including nonlinear behavior, infinite degrees of freedom, and variable material properties, the Finite Rigid Elements Method (FREM) was employed for modeling. This method preserves analytical accuracy while providing a reliable foundation for the development of a force controller in later stages. A detailed Finite Element Model (FEM) was created using ANSYS, and the analytical results were validated through simulation and experimental testing. The gripper's fingers were optimized based on four key criteria: tip displacement, total deflection, stress distribution, and contact force. The optimal finger configuration includes a length of 30 mm, rib spacing of 10 mm, seven ribs angled at -15 deg, and a rib thickness of 1 mm. Theoretical modeling using the FREM predicted finger deformation with a 3% error, while the ANSYS numerical model achieved 2% error.

</details>


### [442] [Let the Dynamics Flow: Stable Flow Matching Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03834)
*Rodrigo Pérez-Dattari,Francisco Leiva,Andrea Testa,Leonel Rozo,Javier Ruiz del Solar,Noémie Jaquier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SFMDS框架，将流匹配生成模型与李雅普诺夫稳定性保证相结合，通过软约束和硬结构约束两种变体，在低维和高维状态空间上实现稳定、可扩展且多模态的机器人运动策略学习，并在基准数据集、仿真和人形机器人上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配在模仿学习中表现出色，能够建模可扩展、高表达力的多模态运动策略，但缺乏形式化的稳定性保证，而稳定性是确保机器人行为安全与泛化的前提。现有基于动力系统的方法虽能引入稳定性归纳偏置，却难以捕捉复杂任务中丰富的动作分布。因此，需要弥合高容量生成建模与形式化李雅普诺夫稳定性保证之间的鸿沟。

Method: SFMDS通过流匹配参数化动力系统，同时将模型约束到稳定解族中。提出两种变体：基于惩罚项的软约束和嵌入模型架构的硬结构约束，并将两种形式扩展到李群上。

Result: 在基准数据集、仿真环境以及人形机器人上的实验表明，SFMDS能够在低维和高维状态空间中学习稳定、可扩展且多模态的动力系统，实现安全且富有表达力的机器人运动生成。

Conclusion: SFMDS成功地弥合了高容量生成模型与形式化稳定性保证之间的差距，为机器人安全运动生成提供了一种兼具表达力与稳定性的新范式。

Abstract: Flow matching has recently emerged as a powerful approach for imitation learning, enabling scalable, expressive, and multimodal motion policies. However, incorporating formal stability guarantees into these generative models, a prerequisite to ensure safe and generalizable robot behaviors, remains a significant challenge. While modeling robot motions as dynamical systems allows for such stability-based inductive biases, existing frameworks struggle to capture the rich action distributions inherent in complex robotic tasks. This paper introduces Stable Flow Matching Dynamical Systems (SFMDS), a novel framework that bridges the gap between high-capacity generative modeling and formal Lyapunov stability guarantees. SFMDS parametrizes dynamical systems via flow matching while simultaneously constraining the model to a family of stable solutions. We propose two variants: a soft constraint based on a penalty term, and a hard structural constraint embedded directly in the model architecture. We further extend both formulations to Lie groups. Experiments on benchmark datasets, in simulation, and on a humanoid robot show that SFMDS learns stable, scalable, and multimodal dynamical systems in low- and high-dimensional state spaces, enabling safe and expressive robot motion generation.

</details>


### [443] [Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03847)
*Xiangdong Feng,Yuxuan Cheng,Chen Shi,Boyao Han,Yuxuan Yan,Yitong Hong,Zhuotao Tian,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DVAC（去噪方差自适应分块方法），通过监测流策略去噪过程中干净动作估计的方差信号，自适应地决定每个预测动作块中可执行的动作数量：在低方差（稳定运动）阶段执行更多动作，在高方差（接触/精度敏感）阶段提前重规划。实验表明该方法在多个基准和真实场景中提升了任务成功率并降低了重规划频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流的机器人策略通常使用固定的动作分块执行周期，忽略了自由空间运动和精度关键的交互阶段对重规划频率的不同需求，导致执行效率或成功率受限。

Method: DVAC利用流策略去噪过程最后几步中干净动作估计的方差作为任务阶段的内在信号：方差低表明动作预测稳定（可执行），方差高则触发提前重规划。通过计算滚动局部方差尺度来校准阈值，实现跨任务和轨迹的迁移。

Result: 在LIBERO上成功率从94.75%提升至98.00%，重规划减少43.0%；在RoboTwin、CALVIN和真实世界操作任务中均取得性能提升。

Conclusion: DVAC证明了流策略去噪方差可作为任务阶段的有效信号，自适应分块在提升成功率的同时降低计算开销，为基于流的机器人策略提供了一种简单高效的测试时改进方法。

Abstract: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.

</details>


### [444] [Semantic-weighted ICP for LiDAR Odometry: Class-Aware Residual Reweighting for Robust Scan Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03905)
*Vasco Carvalho,Tiago Barros,Urbano J. Nunes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种语义类别加权ICP方法用于LiDAR里程计，通过对不同语义类别的点云残差进行加权（而非硬性过滤），在保留不稳定但有信息量的结构的同时抑制动态物体影响，在SemanticKITTI和RELLIS-3D数据集上验证了有效性，尤其在越野场景中表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统几何方法在动态或非结构化环境中因运动物体、稀疏几何特征、植被和语义模糊结构导致配准退化，现有语义方法仍有局限，本文认为环境中不同元素对配准的相关性不同，因此提出语义类别加权策略。

Method: 提出语义类别加权ICP（Semantic-weighted ICP），不硬性滤除特定语义类别的点，而是根据其预期几何稳定性对残差进行加权，使不稳定但有信息量的结构参与配准，同时减轻动态物体的影响。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI（城市、高速、乡村）和RELLIS-3D（越野）数据集上进行实验，结果表明所提方法改进了位姿估计，尤其在传统刚性特征稀缺的越野场景中效果显著；且加权策略的有效性高度依赖于环境的结构和语义组成。

Conclusion: 语义加权ICP优于硬性过滤策略，能根据环境语义组成自适应调整配准贡献，其效果具有环境依赖性，为语义引导的里程计提供了更灵活的思路。

Abstract: LiDAR odometry is a fundamental component of autonomous robotic systems, relying on geometric registration between consecutive point clouds to estimate ego-motion. However, traditional geometric approaches often degrade in dynamic or unstructured environments due to unreliable correspondences caused by moving objects, sparse geometric features, vegetation, and semantically ambiguous structures. Existing works have shown that, some of these limitations can be addressed by introducing semantic information from the environment in the registration process. In this work, we build on this, and show that not all elements in the environment are equally relevant for registration. Hence, we propose a semantic class-weighted ICP for LiDAR odometry. Instead of strictly filtering out points belonging to specific semantic classes, the proposed approach weights the residuals of points belonging to semantic categories based on their expected geometric stability. This strategy enables informative but potentially unstable structures, to contribute to the registration process while mitigating the influence of dynamic objects. The experimental evaluation was conducted on the SemanticKITTI and RELLIS-3D datasets, which include urban, highway, rural, and off-road environments. The empirical results show that the proposed Semantic-weighted ICP improves pose estimation, especially in challenging off-road scenarios where conventional rigid features are scarce. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that the effectiveness of this weighting strategy is highly environment-dependent, influenced by the structural and semantic composition of the scene.

</details>


### [445] [Multi-Robot Bearing-only Pose Estimation via Angle Rigidity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03931)
*J. Francisco Presenza,Leonardo J. Colombo,Ignacio Mas,Juan I. Giribet*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于方位角的分布式位姿估计器，用于时变多机器人系统，仅需角度刚性感知拓扑，在无需方向先验知识的情况下估计位置和方向，并证明了局部一致指数稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于方位估计的方法通常需要方位刚性（bearing rigidity）等较强条件，本文旨在放宽拓扑约束，仅需更弱的角度刚性（angle-rigid）条件即可实现分布式位姿估计。

Method: 利用体坐标系下测量的方位角计算机器人位置（$\mathbb{R}^3$），再通过估计位置、方位及其导数恢复方向（SO(3)）；采用分布式架构，仅在角度刚性有向感知拓扑下运行。

Result: 建立了局部一致指数稳定性（LUES），仿真验证了方法的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: 所提方法在更弱的拓扑条件下实现了时变多机器人系统的分布式位姿估计，具有良好的稳定性和实用性。

Abstract: This letter proposes a novel distributed bearing-based pose estimator for time-varying multi-robot systems. The method uses angles computed from body-frame bearings to estimate the robots' positions in $\mathbb{R}^3$ without knowledge of their orientations. The orientations in $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ are recovered from the estimated positions, the bearings, and the bearing derivatives. The proposed observer only requires the (directed) sensing topology to be \textit{angle-rigid}, a weaker condition than the commonly used ones like bearing rigidity. Local uniform exponential stability of the proposed observer is established under the assumption of persistently exciting motions for a subset of robots. Simulations are presented and discussed to evaluate the scheme's effectiveness and practicality.

</details>


### [446] [PointAction: 3D Points as Universal Action Representations for Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03943)
*Mutian Tong,Han Jiang,Qiao Feng,Lingjie Liu,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PointAction通过显式的4D点云建模桥接视频预测与机器人动作，在预训练视频扩散模型基础上联合预测未来RGB帧和动态3D点图，以度量3D点动力学作为结构化的体态无关动作接口，减少RGB-only动作歧义，实现跨任务和跨本体的泛化，在仿真和真实机器人上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-动作模型仅依赖RGB视频预测，缺乏度量级3D运动、接触几何和细粒度空间约束，导致动作接地存在歧义；同时跨任务和跨本体的动作标注成本高昂。

Method: 微调基础视频生成模型，联合预测未来RGB帧和动态3D点图；以度量3D点动力学作为体态无关的结构化动作接口；使用扩散动作解码器将点动力学映射为可执行机器人动作。

Result: 在机器人场景4D生成质量上达到SOTA；仿真中超越现有基线；可泛化到预训练中未见过的两种真实机器人手臂。

Conclusion: 显式的4D点云建模有效解决了RGB-only动作接地歧义性，并以体态无关的方式实现跨任务和跨本体的泛化，为视频预测到动作控制的桥接提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Video-Action Models (VAMs) leverage the broad visual dynamics captured by pre-trained video diffusion models, offering a promising path toward generalizable robot manipulation. However, RGB-only video rollouts are not directly actionable: they leave metric 3D motion, contact geometry, and fine-grained spatial constraints under-specified, making action grounding ambiguous. Meanwhile, scaling action supervision across diverse tasks and embodiments remains costly. We present PointAction, a framework that bridges video predictions to robot actions through explicit point-based 4D modeling. PointAction fine-tunes a foundation video generation model to jointly predict future RGB frames and dynamic 3D pointmaps, producing temporally consistent 3D motion of task-relevant scene geometry. These point dynamics serve as a structured, embodiment-agnostic action interface, which a diffusion-based action decoder maps to executable robot actions. By using metric 3D point dynamics as the interface between video prediction and control, PointAction reduces the ambiguity of RGB-only action grounding and supports transfer across tasks and embodiments with limited action supervision. Experiments show that PointAction achieves state-of-the-art 4D generation quality on robot scenes, outperforms existing baselines in simulation, and generalizes to two real robot arms unseen during pretraining.

</details>


### [447] [Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03949)
*Zeyi Liu,Guangyao Liu,Yinuo Qu,Yuquan Xue,Bofang Jia,Chunhua Yang,Weihua Gui,Keke Huang,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACT是一个偏好校准的演员-评论家训练框架，通过利用人类干预中的隐式偏好信号，对次优轨迹片段进行信用重分配，直接指导策略训练，在五个真实机器人操作任务中平均成功率提升24.5%，收敛速度加快1.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HIL-RL方法对所有过渡帧使用统一的信用分配原则，忽略每个过渡帧对任务成功的实际贡献，导致高估Q值并误导策略更新朝向次优行为模式。

Method: 1) 设计进度模型从人类演示中学习并识别次优片段；2) 在干预状态下构建人类动作与重采样策略动作的偏好对，定义反事实优势来惩罚次优片段的Bellman目标；3) 在有界均值空间中直接对齐策略与人类纠正动作。

Result: 在五个真实机器人操作任务上，PACT平均成功率提升24.5%，收敛速度加快1.3倍。

Conclusion: PACT通过偏好校准的信用重分配有效提升了HIL-RL的样本效率和性能，为人类介入下的机器人操作学习提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

</details>


### [448] [Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03963)
*Roohan Ahmed Khan,Yasheerah Yaqoot,Muhammad Ahsan Mustafa,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticRL框架，利用多模态GPT智能体自动生成奖励函数、通过闭环反馈优化策略，并实现从仿真到真实环境的迁移，在无人机导航任务中取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习在自主导航中依赖人工设计的奖励函数和反复手动调参，耗时且无法保证任务成功率，亟需提高奖励设计和策略优化的自动化程度。

Method: AgenticRL使用多模态GPT智能体解释任务信息与视觉场景，自动生成奖励函数；采用PPO算法训练策略；智能体作为评论者通过诊断包评估策略并生成反馈，闭环改进奖励函数；推理阶段利用真实图像和自然语言自动识别场景并选择对应策略执行。

Result: 闭环优化相比初始奖励策略行为提升71%；真实世界成功率达91%，仿真到真实迁移准确率94%。

Conclusion: AgenticRL通过GPT智能体驱动的自动化奖励设计与闭环策略优化，显著提升了无人机导航任务的性能与部署效率，并成功实现了仿真到真实的迁移。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

</details>


### [449] [Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03985)
*Zekun Qi,Xuchuan Chen,Dairu Liu,Chenghuai Lin,Yunrui Lian,Sikai Liang,Zhikai Zhang,Yu Guan,Jilong Wang,Wenyao Zhang,Xinqiang Yu,He Wang,Li Yi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Humanoid-GPT是一个基于GPT架构的因果注意力Transformer，在20亿帧的运动语料上预训练，用于全身控制，实现了对高度动态行为的跟踪和前所未有的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往基于浅层MLP的跟踪器受限于数据稀缺和敏捷性-泛化之间的权衡，需要一种能够同时兼顾动态复杂动作跟踪与零样本泛化能力的方法。

Method: 构建一个GPT风格的因果注意力Transformer，并在一个统一的20亿帧重定向运动语料库上预训练，该语料库整合了所有主要动作捕捉数据集和大规模内部录制数据。

Result: 模型在跟踪高度动态行为的同时，实现了对未见过的动作和控制任务的零样本泛化，建立了新的性能前沿。

Conclusion: 通过扩大数据和模型容量，单个生成式Transformer能够同时实现动态动作跟踪和零样本泛化，打破了以往敏捷性与泛化能力之间的权衡。

Abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

</details>


### [450] [BEV-ODOM2: Enhanced BEV-based Monocular Visual Odometry with PV-BEV Fusion and Dense Flow Supervision for Ground Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14636)
*Yufei Wei,Chenxiao Hu,Wangtao Lu,Sha Lu,Yuxiang Cui,Fuzhang Han,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出BEV-ODOM2框架，通过密集BEV光流监督和PV-BEV融合策略，在无需额外标注的情况下显著提升了基于鸟瞰图的单目视觉里程计的尺度一致性和位姿估计精度，在多个数据集上实现了40%的RTE改进，并支持边缘设备实时推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BEV-based单目视觉里程计方法存在两个关键局限：仅依赖位姿监督导致稀疏监督信号，以及透视投影到BEV过程中的信息损失。本文旨在解决这两个问题，无需额外标注即可提升估计精度。

Method: (1) 从3-DoF位姿真值构建密集BEV光流监督，提供像素级引导；(2) 在投影前计算透视视图与BEV的关联体素，保留6-DoF运动线索；(3) 改进的旋转采样策略平衡训练中的多样化运动模式。

Result: 在KITTI、Oxford、NCLT和新收集的ZJH-VO四个数据集上，相比先前BEV方法RTE提升40%，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上实现实时推理。

Conclusion: BEV-ODOM2通过密集光流监督和视角融合有效克服了BEV里程计的信息损失和稀疏监督问题，实现了高精度且尺度一致的位姿估计，并具备边缘部署可行性。

Abstract: Scale-consistent ego-motion estimation is fundamental for autonomous ground robots. Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) representation naturally addresses the scale drift problem of monocular visual odometry (MVO) by providing a metric-scaled planar workspace, enabling the simplification of 6-DoF ego-motion to a more robust 3-DoF model. However, existing BEV-based methods suffer from two key limitations: sparse supervision signals from pose-only training, and information loss during perspective-to-BEV projection. We present BEV-ODOM2, an enhanced framework that addresses both limitations without requiring additional annotations. Our approach introduces (1) dense BEV optical flow supervision constructed directly from 3-DoF pose ground truth for pixel-level guidance, and (2) Perspective View (PV)-BEV fusion that computes correlation volumes before projection to preserve 6-DoF motion cues. An enhanced rotation sampling strategy further balances diverse motion patterns during training. We evaluate on four datasets with varied spatial scales: KITTI, Oxford, NCLT, and our newly collected ZJH-VO benchmark. BEV-ODOM2 achieves a 40\% RTE improvement over prior BEV-based methods, with real-time inference on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin confirming edge deployment feasibility. The source code and the ZJH-VO dataset are publicly released to facilitate future research.

</details>


### [451] [RadarSFD: Single-Frame Diffusion with Pretrained Priors for Radar Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.18068)
*Bin Zhao,Nakul Garg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RadarSFD是一个条件潜扩散框架，能从单帧毫米波雷达数据重建密集类LiDAR点云，无需合成孔径或多帧聚合，在紧凑机器人平台上实现鲁棒感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达成像方法依赖合成孔径（SAR）或多帧聚合提升分辨率，不适用于小型无人机、巡检或可穿戴等尺寸、重量和功率受限的机器人平台。需要一种无需运动或SAR的单帧密集点云重建方法。

Method: 提出RadarSFD条件潜扩散框架：(1) 将预训练单目深度估计器的几何先验迁移到扩散骨干网络；(2) 通过通道级潜特征拼接与雷达输入对齐；(3) 使用潜空间和像素空间损失相结合的双空间目标函数进行正则化。

Result: 在RadarHD基准上达到最先进性能；定性结果展示了精细墙壁和狭窄间隙的恢复；跨新环境实验证实了强泛化能力；消融研究验证了预训练初始化、雷达BEV条件和双空间损失的重要性。

Conclusion: RadarSFD建立了一种实用的单帧、无需SAR的毫米波雷达管线，适用于紧凑机器人系统中的密集点云感知，为资源受限平台提供了一种实用的雷达-激光雷达转换方案。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave radar provides robust perception in fog, smoke, dust, and low light, making it attractive for size-, weight-, and power-constrained robotic platforms. Existing radar imaging methods typically rely on synthetic aperture or multi-frame aggregation to improve resolution, which is impractical for small aerial, inspection, or wearable systems. We present RadarSFD, a conditional latent diffusion framework that reconstructs dense LiDAR-like point clouds from a single radar frame without motion or SAR. Our approach transfers geometric priors from a pretrained monocular depth estimator into the diffusion backbone, anchors them to radar inputs via channel-wise latent concatenation, and regularizes outputs with a dual-space objective combining latent and pixel-space losses. On the RadarHD benchmark, RadarSFD achieves state-of-the-art performance against baseline models. Qualitative results show recovery of fine walls and narrow gaps, and experiments across new environments confirm strong generalization. Ablation studies highlight the importance of pretrained initialization, radar BEV conditioning, and the dual-space loss. Together, these results establish a practical single-frame, no-SAR mmWave radar pipeline for dense point cloud perception in compact robotic systems.

</details>


### [452] [Plan-R1: Safe and Feasible Trajectory Planning as Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17659)
*Xiaolong Tang,Meina Kan,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Plan-R1是一个两阶段轨迹规划框架，先预训练通用轨迹预测器学习类人驾驶行为，再通过基于规则奖励的GRPO微调对齐安全、舒适等原则。同时提出VD-GRPO解决GRPO中组归一化抑制安全关键目标优化的问题，在nuBench上实现了最先进的规划安全性和可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的规划器过度依赖专家演示，缺乏明确的安全意识，且容易继承次优人类驾驶数据中的不良行为（如超速）。受大语言模型成功启发，旨在解耦原则对齐与行为学习，提升规划的安全性和可行性。

Method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段在专家数据上预训练通用轨迹预测器以捕获类人驾驶行为；第二阶段使用基于规则奖励的GRPO进行微调，对齐安全、舒适、交通规则遵守等原则。针对GRPO组归一化消除跨组尺度差异的问题，提出VD-GRPO，用中心化和固定缩放替代归一化，保留绝对奖励幅值。

Result: 在nuPlan基准测试上，Plan-R1显著提升了规划安全性和可行性，在现实反应式场景中达到了最先进性能。

Conclusion: 两阶段范式能够保留类人行为同时增强安全意识并丢弃演示中的不良模式。VD-GRPO有效解决了GRPO在规划任务中抑制安全关键目标优化的问题。

Abstract: Safe and feasible trajectory planning is critical for real-world autonomous driving systems. However, existing learning-based planners rely heavily on expert demonstrations, which not only lack explicit safety awareness but also risk inheriting undesirable behaviors such as speeding from suboptimal human driving data. Inspired by the success of large language models, we propose Plan-R1, a two-stage trajectory planning framework that decouples principle alignment from behavior learning. In the first stage, a general trajectory predictor is pre-trained on expert data to capture diverse, human-like driving behaviors. In the second stage, the model is fine-tuned with rule-based rewards using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), explicitly aligning ego planning with principles such as safety, comfort, and traffic rule compliance. This two-stage paradigm retains human-like behaviors while enhancing safety awareness and discarding undesirable patterns from demonstrations. Furthermore, we identify a key limitation of directly applying GRPO to planning: group-wise normalization erases cross-group scale differences, causing rare, high-variance safety-violation groups to have similar advantages as abundant low-variance safe groups, thereby suppressing optimization for safety-critical objectives. To address this, we propose Variance-Decoupled GRPO (VD-GRPO), which replaces normalization with centering and fixed scaling to preserve absolute reward magnitudes, ensuring that safety-critical objectives remain dominant throughout training. Experiments on the nuPlan benchmark demonstrate that Plan-R1 significantly improves planning safety and feasibility, achieving state-of-the-art performance, particularly in realistic reactive settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaolongTang23/Plan-R1.

</details>


### [453] [VLA-Arena: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22539)
*Borong Zhang,Jiahao Li,Jiachen Shen,Yuhao Zhang,Yishuai Cai,Yuanpei Chen,Juntao Dai,Jiaming Ji,Yaodong Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VLA-Arena是一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的综合基准，通过三个正交轴（任务结构、语言指令、视觉观测）量化任务难度，包含170个任务和多种难度级别，揭示了现有VLA模型在泛化、鲁棒性、安全性和长时程任务方面的关键局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管VLA模型正迅速发展为通用机器人策略，但定量理解其极限和失败模式仍然困难，因此需要系统化的基准来精确测量模型能力边界。

Method: 提出三维正交任务难度设计框架：任务结构（安全性、干扰物、外推、长时程四个维度，各设L0-L2三级难度，仅在L0上微调）、语言扰动（W0-W4）、视觉扰动（V0-V4），实现解耦的鲁棒性分析；包含170个任务，并提供完整工具链和VLA-Arena-S/M/L数据集。

Result: 对现有SOTA VLA模型的评估揭示了：强烈倾向于记忆而非泛化、不对称的鲁棒性、缺乏对安全约束的考虑、以及无法组合已学技能完成长时程任务等关键局限。

Conclusion: VLA-Arena为系统评估VLA模型提供了标准化框架，揭示了当前模型的根本性缺陷，为未来研究指明了方向，并提供完整开源资源以确保可复现性。

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are rapidly advancing towards generalist robot policies, it remains difficult to quantitatively understand their limits and failure modes. To address this, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark called VLA-Arena. We propose a novel structured task design framework to quantify difficulty across three orthogonal axes: (1) Task Structure, (2) Language Command, and (3) Visual Observation. This allows us to systematically design tasks with fine-grained difficulty levels, enabling a precise measurement of model capability frontiers. For Task Structure, VLA-Arena's 170 tasks are grouped into four dimensions: Safety, Distractor, Extrapolation, and Long Horizon. Each task is designed with three difficulty levels (L0-L2), with fine-tuning performed exclusively on L0 to assess general capability. Orthogonal to this, language (W0-W4) and visual (V0-V4) perturbations can be applied to any task to enable a decoupled analysis of robustness. Our extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLAs reveals several critical limitations, including a strong tendency toward memorization over generalization, asymmetric robustness, a lack of consideration for safety constraints, and an inability to compose learned skills for long-horizon tasks. To foster research addressing these challenges and ensure reproducibility, we provide the complete VLA-Arena framework, including an end-to-end toolchain from task definition to automated evaluation and the VLA-Arena-S/M/L datasets for fine-tuning. Our benchmark, data, models, and leaderboard are available at https://vla-arena.github.io.

</details>

### [454] [The vulnerable male brain: Men's spatial abilities are condition-dependent, sexually selected traits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02591)
*David C. Geary,David Giofrè,Marcia Collaer,Richard A. Lippa,Lewis G. Halsey*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究检验了性别差异在压力环境下的变化，发现男性空间认知优势在压力较小的国家更大，而女性情绪识别优势在不同国家间恒定。结果表明男性认知可能对早期或当前环境条件特别敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"性别间夸张的特质在压力环境下更容易受损"这一预测，探究社会和环境条件对人类认知的性别特异性影响。

Method: 跨国家比较分析：通过对比不同发展水平国家中男性空间认知优势和女性情绪识别优势的大小，检验压力暴露对性别差异的影响。

Result: 男性空间认知优势在压力较小的国家更大，支持假设；但女性情绪识别优势在不同国家间恒定，与假设相反。样本偏差提示实际效应可能被低估。

Conclusion: 男性认知可能比女性认知对环境条件更脆弱，社会和环境条件对人类认知具有性别特异性影响。

Abstract: Traits that are exaggerated in one sex relative to the other sex might be more vulnerable to stressor exposure because the development and expression of these traits are costly. Sex differences in such traits should therefore be smaller in populations with high stressor exposure. We tested this prediction in humans by examining the magnitude of men's advantage in spatial cognition and women's advantage in emotion recognition across nations that varied in their level of development. As predicted, men's advantage in spatial cognition was larger in nations relatively buffered from stressors. However, in contrast to our prediction, women's advantage in emotion recognition was constant across nations, suggesting aspects of men's cognition might be particularly vulnerable to early or current conditions. The samples were biased toward higher income and healthier individuals for nations in which men's spatial cognition was compromised; thus, we are likely underestimating the effects of living conditions on men's spatial cognition. The results further our understanding of how social and environmental conditions can have sex-specific effects on human cognition.

</details>


### [455] [BEAST3D: Animal behavioral analysis and neural encoding from multi-view video via Gaussian splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02937)
*Yanchen Wang,Lenny Aharon,Wangshu Zhu,Kyle Daruwalla,Linghua Zhang,Jiaru Zou,Selmaan Chettih,Helen Hou,Liam Paninski,Matthew R Whiteway*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: BEAST3D是一个自监督预训练框架，利用未标注的多视角视频学习3D视觉表征，通过预测3D高斯溅射重构视角并分割动物，仅需4个视角即可重建3D结构，在多个下游任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角视频记录在动物行为分析中日益普及，但监督式姿态估计需要大量人工标注，通用3D重建模型在实验室稀疏视角和特殊图像场景下效果不佳。

Method: 使用视觉Transformer预测3D高斯溅射，通过可微渲染重构留出视角，同时分割动物与背景；直接利用已知相机参数进行条件化，无需估计相机几何。

Result: 在四个物种上验证，BEAST3D产生丰富的视角不变特征，在新视角合成、多视角姿态估计和神经编码三个下游任务中有效迁移。

Conclusion: BEAST3D为利用现代实验室多视角记录中的3D结构进行行为分析建立了通用框架。

Abstract: Multi-view video recordings are increasingly used to capture the 3D movements of animals in experimental settings, yet extracting rich 3D representations from these recordings remains challenging. Supervised pose estimation requires extensive manual annotation, while general-purpose 3D reconstruction models trained on generic scene datasets fail on the specialized imagery and sparse-view setting of laboratory experiments. We address these limitations with BEAST3D, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns 3D visual representations from unlabeled, calibrated multi-view video. BEAST3D uses a vision transformer to predict 3D Gaussian splats that reconstruct held-out views through differentiable rendering, while simultaneously segmenting the animal from the background. BEAST3D reconstructs 3D structure with as few as four views by conditioning directly on known camera parameters--unlike general-purpose models, which must estimate camera geometry from dense overlapping viewpoints that are seldom available in lab settings. Through comprehensive evaluation across four species, we demonstrate that BEAST3D produces rich, viewpoint-invariant features that transfer effectively to three downstream tasks: novel view synthesis, which validates the quality of the learned 3D representations; multi-view pose estimation, which provides the sparse keypoint trajectories widely used in behavioral analysis; and neural encoding, which relates 3D behavioral features to simultaneously recorded neural activity. BEAST3D thus establishes a versatile framework for behavioral analysis that leverages 3D structure in modern multi-view laboratory recordings.

</details>


### [456] [Short-Term Synaptic Plasticity Stabilizes Goal-Conditioned Dynamics in a PFC-Inspired Reservoir Model for Multistep Goal-Directed Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03481)
*Jin Nakamura,Yuichi Katori*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文研究短时突触可塑性（STP）如何通过动态调节有效递归连接，在行为时间尺度上稳定目标信息为可用的目标条件动力学，从而在噪声环境下显著提升多步目标导向行为的选择成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前额叶皮层（PFC）通过递归回路维持目标信息以指导行动规划，但其如何在行为时间尺度上将目标信息稳定为可用的行动表征尚不清楚。本研究旨在探究短时突触可塑性（STP）是否能够将目标信息稳定为目标条件动力学，从而支持鲁棒的行动选择。

Method: 将STP整合到PFC启发的储备池计算模型中，结合基底节启发的时序差分读出学习，在含延迟执行的多步目标导向行动选择任务中，比较有/无STP的配对模型在100个独立生成网络上的表现，并进行时间分辨解码、状态空间可分性、动作值差异、有效连接分析及增益匹配/STP状态扰动控制实验。

Result: 无STP模型在状态噪声下成功率从75.8%降至49.5%，而STP模型基本保持不变（91.8% vs 89.2%，Cohen's dz=1.31）。STP保持了目标信息作为行动相关的目标条件动力学，有效连接分析显示STP产生了延迟期目标特异性模式且随时间增强，而增益匹配和扰动控制排除了简单固定递归缩放解释。

Conclusion: STP通过动态调节目标依赖的有效递归连接，支持鲁棒的目标条件动力学，在噪声环境下维持目标信息的行动可用性。

Abstract: The prefrontal cortex (PFC) maintains goal information for action planning, but how recurrent circuits preserve it in an action-usable form over behavioral timescales remains unclear. Here we ask whether short-term synaptic plasticity (STP) can stabilize goal information as action-usable, goal-conditioned dynamics. We incorporated STP into a PFC-inspired reservoir computing model with basal-ganglia-inspired temporal-difference readout learning, and evaluated paired models with and without STP across 100 independently generated networks in a multistep goal-directed action-selection task with delayed execution. Goal identity was highly decodable during the delay even without STP, so STP was not required to form a linearly readable goal representation. Under state noise, however, success without STP fell from 75.8% to 49.5%, whereas the model with STP remained essentially unchanged (91.8% without noise versus 89.2% under noise; paired Cohen's dz=1.31). Time-resolved decoding, state-space separability, and action-value-difference analyses showed that STP preserved goal information as action-relevant goal-conditioned dynamics available at later action opportunities. Gain-matched and STP-state perturbation controls argued against a simple fixed recurrent-scaling explanation and supported online, history-dependent synaptic modulation. Effective-connectivity analyses showed delay-period goal-specific patterning that increased toward the later part of the trial with STP, where it should be read as goal- and task-state-conditioned patterning; effective connectivity without STP was time-invariant. A grid search identified a facilitation-dominant range of STP time constants associated with high success rates. These results suggest that STP supports robust goal-conditioned dynamics through dynamic modulation of goal-dependent effective recurrent connectivity.

</details>


### [457] [Who Is in Mind Matters: Attachment Representations in Early Childhood Synchronize Child-Adult Interacting Brains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03700)
*Ruxin Su,Jiayang Xu,Saishuang Wu,Haiwa Wang,Yamin Li,Zihan Yang,Yuqi Liu,Jieqiong Liu,Shanbao Tong,Yunting Zhang,Xiaoli Guo,Fan Jiang*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究通过远程伙伴信念操纵范式，在40组儿童-母亲-陌生人互动中证明：3-4岁儿童对"对方是母亲"的信念（而非实际合作对象）显著增强了右侧颞顶联合区的脑间同步强度，且该同步与依恋安全性相关，揭示依恋表征是脑间同步的独立内源性驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类依恋以持久的内化表征为特征，塑造神经发育和社会情感功能，但这些表征在实时互动中的神经认知机制尚不明确，因为其作为不可观察的内在过程与社会线索和伴侣特定因素混杂在一起。

Method: 采用新颖的远程伙伴信念操纵范式（Remote Partner-Belief Manipulation paradigm），在40组儿童-母亲-陌生人的三方组合中，通过操纵3-4岁儿童对合作对象的信念（相信对方是母亲还是陌生人），在远程合作任务中实验性地分离出依恋表征。使用脑间同步（interbrain synchrony）作为测量指标，捕捉内在心理过程。

Result: 儿童对母亲伙伴的信念（无论实际合作对象是谁）显著增强了脑间同步；这种信念效应集中在儿童P4电极通道（覆盖右侧颞顶联合区），该通道的同步强度与依恋安全性及儿童因母亲信念产生的反应加速呈正相关。

Conclusion: 依恋表征是脑间同步的独立、内源性驱动因素，其作用机制可能通过儿童对依恋对象的增强注意力实现，暗示了分离时符号性依恋激活的作用。

Abstract: Human attachment is distinguished by enduring internalized representations that shapes neurodevelopment and social-emotional functioning. However, as unobservable inner processes mixed with social cues and partner-specific factors, the neurocognitive mechanisms of these representations during real-time interaction remain unclear. Using a novel Remote Partner-Belief Manipulation paradigm in 40 child-mother-stranger trios, we experimentally isolated attachment representations in 3-4-year-olds by manipulating children's partner-belief during remote cooperation. The inner processes were captured from synchrony between partners' EEG, showing that children's mother-partner belief, regardless of the actual partner, significantly enhanced interbrain synchrony. This partner-belief modulation concentrated on children's P4 channel (overlaying the attachment-designated right temporoparietal junction), where synchrony strength correlated to attachment security and children's response acceleration due to mother-partner belief. These findings established attachment representations as an independent, endogenous driver of interbrain synchrony, potentially via children's heightened attention towards their attachment figure, implying the role of symbolic attachment activation when separation.

</details>


### [458] [A Factorized Low-Rank RNN Framework for Uncovering Independent Neural Latent Dynamics and Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.13899)
*Chengrui Li,Yunmiao Wang,Yule Wang,Weihan Li,Dieter Jaeger,Anqi Wu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出Factored Recurrent Neural Network (FacRNN)，一种在低秩循环神经网络中引入组间独立性的生成式框架，通过变分自编码器框架和偏相关惩罚实现潜在动力学的解耦，在合成、猴M1和小鼠电压成像数据上提升了解释性和解缠性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩循环神经网络虽能揭示神经群体活动的低维潜在动力学，但其功能连接缺乏独立性解释，难以将不同计算角色分配给不同潜在维度。

Method: 提出FacRNN，是一种生成式lrRNN框架，假设潜在动力学之间具有组间独立性而组内可灵活纠缠；通过变分自编码器框架重新表述lrRNN，并引入偏相关惩罚项来鼓励潜在维度组之间的独立性。

Result: 在合成数据、猴M1运动皮层数据和小鼠电压成像数据上，FacRNN相较于不鼓励组间独立性的基线lrRNN，在低维空间和低秩连接中一致性地提升了解缠性能和神经潜在轨迹的可解释性。

Conclusion: FacRNN通过组间独立性正则化有效改进了低秩循环神经网络的可解释性，为神经群体活动中不同计算角色的分配提供了更清晰的潜在结构。

Abstract: Low-rank recurrent neural networks (lrRNNs) are a class of models that uncover low-dimensional latent dynamics underlying neural population activity. Although their functional connectivity is low-rank, it lacks independence interpretations, making it difficult to assign distinct computational roles to different latent dimensions. To address this, we propose the Factored Recurrent Neural Network (FacRNN), a generative lrRNN framework that assumes group-wise independence among latent dynamics while allowing flexible within-group entanglement. These independent latent groups allow latent dynamics to evolve separately, but are internally rich for complex computation. We reformulate the lrRNN under a variational autoencoder (VAE) framework, enabling us to introduce a partial correlation penalty that encourages independence between groups of latent dimensions. Experiments on synthetic, monkey M1, and mouse voltage imaging data show that FacRNN consistently improves the disentanglement and interpretability of learned neural latent trajectories in low-dimensional space and low-rank connectivity over baseline lrRNNs that do not encourage group-wise independence.

</details>


### [459] [Neural Fields as World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18690)
*Joshua Nunley*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出**同构世界模型**，通过保持感官拓扑结构的神经场架构实现物理预测、离线任务学习和具身表征的统一，实验证明该模型能进行无"瞬移"的弹道预测、通过冻结的世界模型离线改进抓取策略，并自发形成身体选择性运动通道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可以通过心理预演和梦境等方式离线模拟未来，表明世界模型能够支持脱离环境的任务学习。但标准机器学习世界模型会将视觉输入压缩为潜在向量，丢弃了感觉皮层特有的空间结构，限制了物理预测的几何一致性。

Method: 提出**同构世界模型**：架构保持感觉拓扑结构，将物理预测转化为几何传播而非抽象状态转移。具体实现为**运动门控神经场**，通过局部侧向连接驱动活动演化，运动命令通过乘法方式调制特定通道。

Result: 三个实验表明：1) 同架构能学习弹道预测，且物体不会发生"瞬移"；2) 通过将任务误差反向传播经过冻结的学得世界模型，可离线改进抓取策略；3) 模型无需身体标签即可自发形成身体选择性运动通道。

Conclusion: 物理预测、离线任务学习和身体链接表征共享同一计算基础：**空间地图内的动作条件预测**。

Abstract: Humans rehearse possible futures offline, as in mental practice and perhaps dreaming, suggesting that world models may support task learning away from the environment. Standard machine learning world models compress visual input into latent vectors, discarding the spatial structure that characterizes sensory cortex. We propose isomorphic world models: architectures that preserve sensory topology, so physics prediction becomes geometric propagation rather than abstract state transition. We implement this idea with motor-gated neural fields, where activity evolves through local lateral connectivity and motor commands multiplicatively modulate specific channels. Across three experiments, the same architecture learns ballistic prediction without ``teleporting,'' improves a catching policy offline by propagating task error through a frozen learned world model, and develops body-selective motor channels without body labels. These results provide preliminary evidence that physical prediction, offline task learning, and body-linked representation share a common computational substrate: action-conditional prediction within a spatial map.

</details>


### [460] [Quantifying plasticity: a network-based framework linking structure to dynamical regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25180)
*Igor Branchi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出可塑性的网络操作化定义（系统规模与连接强度的比值），将其转化为预测性工具，并论证最优可塑性区间对应于临界态，从而为跨系统适应性比较提供标准化度量（有效可塑性）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可塑性长期以来仅作为一个描述性概念，只能从观测结果中事后推断。研究旨在将可塑性形式化为可预测的量化工具，实现跨系统比较。

Method: 基于网络视角将可塑性操作化为系统规模与连接强度的比值；系统规模决定状态空间维度，连接强度调控系统运行状态；引入临界态作为理论基准，定义标准化度量"有效可塑性"。

Result: 在适中连接强度处出现可塑性的最优区间——平衡变化能力与维持连贯性的能力，该区间与临界态重合；有效可塑性可预测精神病理学中的心理状态转变；更大的系统能更稳健地维持临界动力学。

Conclusion: 可塑性与临界性的关系被重构为因果关系（可塑性驱动临界性而非伴随）；该框架区分了功能状态转变与热力学相变；可推广至生态学、经济学、社会系统等跨学科领域。

Abstract: Plasticity is a fundamental property of complex systems, such as the brain or an organism. Yet it typically remains a descriptive concept inferred retrospectively from observed outcomes, such as modifications in activity or morphology. Here, the network-based operationalization of plasticity is further formalized as the ratio between system size and connectivity strength among system elements. Within this framework, system size determines the dimensionality of the accessible state space, while connectivity strength tunes the system's regime. An optimal range of plasticity -- balancing capacity for change and capacity to maintain coherence -- emerges at intermediate connectivity strength. Notably, this balance coincides with the critical regime, which provides a theoretically motivated benchmark that enables a normalized unit of measure, termed effective plasticity, and comparisons of adaptive efficacy across diverse systems. Plasticity is thus transformed into a predictive tool that quantifies a system's capacity for change before it occurs. Its validity is supported across disciplines and, in particular, by evidence from psychopathology where it anticipates transitions between mental states. At a mechanistic level, plasticity acts as a structural tuning parameter for criticality, reframing their relationship as causal, with plasticity driving criticality rather than merely accompanying it. Furthermore, this network-based operationalization explains how larger systems can more robustly maintain critical dynamics. Crucially, the proposed perspective distinguishes functional regime shifts from thermodynamic phase changes, identifying plasticity as the system-level regulator that shapes and constrains the dynamic repertoire. This framework is applicable across domains, including ecology, economics, and social systems, and may foster cross-disciplinary integration within complexity science.

</details>
