### [461] [Evidence-Aware Protein Complex Detection: Methods, Benchmarks, and Reproducibility Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03178)
*Sima Soltani,Mehrdad Jalali,Yahya Forghani,Reza Sheybani*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文综述了证据感知方法（结合PPI拓扑与GO注释、表达谱、亚细胞定位、序列/结构域证据、时间信息和表示学习）在蛋白质复合物识别中的应用，指出透明证据感知图方法在生物学合理性和可重复性间提供最佳平衡，而深度、超图和动态异质模型虽扩展了生物学现实性但需更强基准控制。核心瓶颈已从算法缺乏转向缺乏统一、重叠感知和可重复的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质复合物是细胞组织的核心单元，但现有从蛋白质相互作用网络中识别复合物的方法面临噪音、不完整、上下文依赖和注释不均等问题，因此需要系统综述证据感知方法的能力与局限。

Method: 采用聚焦方法论综述形式，系统比较2018年后及历史基线方法，分类分析结合PPI拓扑与多种生物证据（GO注释、表达谱、亚细胞定位、序列/结构域证据、时间信息、表示学习）的方法。

Result: 透明证据感知图方法在生物学合理性和可重复性间提供最佳平衡；深度/超图/动态异质模型扩展了生物学现实性但需更强基准控制；当前核心瓶颈是缺乏统一、重叠感知和可重复的评估协议。

Conclusion: 建议采用统一基准版本、显式GO循环性控制、重叠感知指标、不确定性估计和可执行软件包，而非追求孤立的特定源F-measure提升。

Abstract: Protein complexes are central units of cellular organization, yet their identification from protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks remains difficult because interactome maps are noisy, incomplete, context dependent, and unevenly annotated. This focused methodological review examines evidence-aware approaches that combine PPI topology with Gene Ontology (GO) annotations, expression profiles, subcellular localization, sequence or domain evidence, temporal information, and representation learning, with emphasis on post-2018 methods and selected historical baselines. The central synthesis is that transparent evidence-aware graph methods currently offer the strongest tradeoff between biological plausibility and reproducibility, while deep, hypergraph, and dynamic heterogeneous models expand biological realism but require stronger benchmark control. The central bottleneck is no longer only the lack of algorithms, but the lack of harmonized, overlap-aware, and reproducible evaluation protocols. We therefore recommend unified benchmark versions, explicit GO-circularity controls, overlap-aware metrics, uncertainty estimates, and executable software packages over isolated source-specific F-measure gains.

</details>


### [462] [Ollivier-Ricci curvature in cycle overlap mode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03317)
*Zexian Zhou,Bo Jiao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于最优传输原理的曲率计算方法CCOM（Cycle Overlap Mode），通过利用3、4、5环来最小化传输距离，显著提升了大尺度无标度图上Ollivier-Ricci曲率计算的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Ollivier-Ricci曲率计算方法在大尺度无标度图上存在计算复杂度高或误差大的问题，限制了其实际应用。

Method: 提出基于最优传输原理的方法，通过包含边(x,y)的3、4、5环来最小化传输距离；设计了CCOM曲率计算方法，采用贪心与剪枝算法来近似最优传输原理。

Result: 理论分析与实验验证表明CCOM在真实网络上能够显著提高曲率计算的准确性，同时保持较低的时间消耗；在社区检测任务中，CCOM在大尺度无标度图上优于基线近似方法。

Conclusion: CCOM方法有效平衡了Ollivier-Ricci曲率计算的精度与效率，适用于大规模无标度图的曲率分析与下游任务。

Abstract: Ollivier-Ricci curvature of an edge (x,y) is defined by comparing the distance taken to transport from neighbors of x to neighbors of y. It is a structural measure that has been studied in many fields such as community detection and deep neural networks. However, high computational complexity or error limits its application in large scale-free graphs. This paper proposes an optimal transport principle to minimize the distance by 3,4,5-cycles that include the edge (x,y), and designs a curvature calculation approach named Curvature in Cycle Overlap Mode (CCOM). In this approach, a greedy and pruning algorithm is proposed to approximate the optimal transport principle. We theoretically and experimentally verified that our approach CCOM can significantly improve the accuracy of the curvature on real-world networks with low time consumption. In addition, we compared CCOM with baseline approximation approaches in community detection tasks using the same curvature-based framework, and experimentally confirmed the effectiveness of CCOM on large scale-free graphs.

</details>


### [463] [Explainable Forecasting of Scientific Breakthroughs from Concept Network Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03864)
*Thomas Maillart,Thibaut Chataing,Ntorina Antoni,David Dosu,Paul Bagourd,Julian Jang-Jaccard,Alain Mermoud*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出了一种可解释的机器学习方法，通过建模OpenAlex概念网络的时间演化，预测科学突破的结构性前兆（概念对的形成与权重增强），在四个科技与生物医学领域实现ROC-AUC [0.954, 0.967]且具备完全可解释性，并设计了从检测到决策的三层架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测科学突破的方法要么准确率有限（约0.90 AUC），要么依赖不透明的嵌入表示，缺乏可解释性。需要一种既能提升预测精度又能提供可审计、可理解特征归因的方法，以支持循证科研战略与政策制定。

Method: 两阶段LightGBM模型：第一阶段预测概念对是否形成链接，第二阶段回归预测链接权重（未来强度）。使用59个语义和拓扑特征（如Adamic-Adar相似度、基于度的Hadamard度量），在OpenAlex概念网络上建模时间演化，并在四个技术/生物医学领域跨时间窗口验证。

Result: ROC-AUC达[0.954, 0.967]（超越先前约0.90的基线），分类AUC约0.95，回归RMSLE在1-5年窗口内稳定在0.45-0.6。特征归因显示结构因素（尤其Adamic-Adar和Hadamard度量）是主要驱动因素。两个案例（量子退火、AI赋能量子架构）成功识别出专家一致认可的技术融合。

Conclusion: 所提出的可解释方法在预测精度和可解释性上均优于现有方法；突破性重组更可能发生在紧密连接的子网络内；可落地为三层决策架构（检测→专家翻译→制度整合），将预测转化为基于开放数据和可解释特征的循证科研策略。

Abstract: We introduce an explainable machine-learning approach that forecasts the structural precursors of scientific breakthroughs -- the emergence and intensification of links between research concepts -- by modelling how OpenAlex concept networks evolve over time. Using 59 semantic and topological features, a two-stage LightGBM model jointly predicts the formation and the future weight of concept pairs, adding a regression stage that quantifies expected intensity to prior link-existence forecasts. Relative to the state of the art, the approach improves accuracy and explainability at once: comparative validation across four technology and biomedical domains yields ROC-AUC in [0.954, 0.967] at all horizons without re-tuning, exceeding the roughly 0.90 of prior models, while every forecast rests on structural, auditable features rather than opaque embeddings. Classification performance is high (AUC about 0.95) and regression remains stable (RMSLE 0.45 to 0.6 over one to five years). Feature attribution shows that structural factors -- particularly Adamic-Adar similarity and degree-based Hadamard measures -- consistently drive accuracy, suggesting that breakthrough-relevant recombinations emerge in tightly connected sub-networks. Two expert-anchored cases, quantum annealing and AI-enabled quantum architectures, show the model surfacing technological convergence consistent with expert expectations. We then outline a three-layer decision architecture -- detection, expert translation, institutional integration -- that turns these forecasts into evidence-based research strategy and policy, anchored in open data and explainable features.

</details>


### [464] [Forecasting Conceptual Diffusion in Science: The Case of Quantum Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03919)
*Thomas Maillart,Thibaut Chataing,David Dosu,Paul Bagourd,Julian Jang-Jaccard,Alain Mermoud*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文利用量子计算子领域的概念共现网络和LightGBM模型，发现外生扩散和熵可被高度预测（R²达0.78），而内生强化基本不可预测；复制实验表明该不对称性并非普遍规律，神经植入领域内生可预测性显著上升（R²=0.83）。熵增对应新概念前沿，熵减预示技术趋同或范式更替。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学变革的理解需要区分概念的内生巩固与外生扩散，现有模型缺乏对这两种机制的系统性区分与预测。

Method: 基于OpenAlex量子计算概念子树构建时序概念共现网络，追踪概念对的引用谱系与下游扩散；使用LightGBM模型，以分布性和多样性感知特征预测四种结果（内生强化、外生扩散、二者比率、扩散熵），并通过SHAP分析解释特征重要性，并在机器人、先进材料、神经植入领域进行复制验证。

Result: 量子计算中内生强化基本不可预测；外生扩散和熵可被高度预测（R²达0.78），驱动因素为上游异质性、引用广度与分布离散度。复制实验中外生扩散在各领域均为最高预测目标（R²≈0.60-0.87），神经植入中内生可预测性显著上升（R²=0.83）。案例表明熵增对应新概念前沿，熵减预示技术趋同或范式更替。

Conclusion: 概念扩散受嵌入语义和引用环境中的稳定结构规律支配；基于早期多样性信号可预测跨领域吸收，为预见性科学计量学、技术前瞻和创新政策分析提供可扩展基础。

Abstract: Understanding and anticipating scientific change requires models that distinguish between endogenous consolidation and exogenous diffusion of scientific concepts. Using the quantum computing subtree of concepts in OpenAlex, we construct a temporally resolved concept co-occurrence network and track each concept pair through its upstream citation lineage and downstream diffusion. We train LightGBM models on distributional and diversity-aware features to predict four outcomes: endogenous reinforcement, exogenous diffusion, their ratio, and diffusion entropy. After controlling for overall publication growth of the scientific body, endogenous reinforcement proves largely unpredictable in the primary quantum-computing benchmark. In contrast, exogenous diffusion and entropy are strongly predictable ($R^2$ up to $0.78à) and are driven by upstream heterogeneity, citation breadth, and distributional dispersion, as shown by SHAP analyses; replications on robotics, advanced materials, and neuro implants confirm that exogenous diffusion remains the top-ranked target across fields ($R^2_test \sim 0.60-0.87$), while endogenous predictability rises markedly in neuro implants (R^2_test = 0.83), indicating that the quantum-computing asymmetry does not generalise uniformly. Case studies reveal that sharp entropy increases coincide with the opening of new conceptual frontiers, while entropy collapses signal technological convergence or paradigm displacement. These results demonstrate that conceptual diffusion is governed by stable structural regularities embedded in semantic and citation environments. By identifying early diversity-based signals of cross-domain uptake, the approach provides a scalable foundation for anticipatory scientometrics, technology foresight, and innovation-oriented policy analysis in rapidly evolving research fields.

</details>


### [465] [SAHG: Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph Model for Social Bot Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30166)
*Hanning Lu,Yingguang Yang,Jinwei Su,Yang Liu,Zhaoqian Yao,Yaoming Li,Taoran Liang,Ziyi Zhang,Ran Ran,Kefu Xu,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出SAHG（扇区各向异性双曲图）模型，通过方向依赖曲率场和双通道设计，同时解决图检测中欧氏GNN对层次/无标度社交图的扭曲问题以及不可靠关系证据导致的邻域聚合污染问题，在三个基准测试中取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的社交机器人能生成类人文本，削弱了基于内容检测的优势；但现有图检测方法面临两个挑战：1) 欧氏GNN扭曲层次/无标度社交图结构，固定曲率双曲模型在不同密度和分离需求的结构方向上分配统一几何分辨率；2) 关系证据不可靠，高级机器人会与真实用户建立异质连接，导致邻域聚合污染账户级证据。

Method: 1) 学习方向依赖曲率场γ(u)，在不同结构方向自适应调整几何分辨率；2) 使用扇区原型（sector prototypes）将角度集中度和对齐度转化为分类器可读特征；3) 双通道独立编码（dual-channel design）：独立编码账户级特征和图邻域表示，仅在分类器阶段融合，防止被污染的聚合淹没账户级证据。

Result: 在Fox8-23、BotSim-24和MGTAB三个基准上，SAHG在准确率和F1分数上均达到最高，优于基于特征、基于图、基于LLM和各向同性双曲基线方法。

Conclusion: 消融实验和几何分析验证了各向异性几何和双通道设计的有效性，表明方向依赖曲率和独立编码机制能有效提升社交机器人检测性能。

Abstract: LLM-driven social bots can generate fluent, human-like text, reducing the discriminative advantage of content-based detection alone. However, coordinated campaigns still leave relational patterns -- interactions, behavioral similarity, shared neighborhoods, community positions, and coordinated activity -- that graph-based methods can exploit. Existing graph detectors face two challenges when exploiting such evidence. First, Euclidean GNNs distort hierarchical and scale-free social graphs; while hyperbolic geometry addresses this volume-growth mismatch, fixed-curvature models still assign uniform geometric resolution to structural directions with different densities and separation needs. Second, relational evidence is not always reliable: sophisticated bots forge heterophilic connections with genuine users, causing neighborhood aggregation to mix bot and human signals and dilute account-level evidence. We propose SAHG (Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph), addressing both challenges. SAHG learns a direction-dependent curvature field $γ(u)$ that adapts geometric resolution across structural directions, and uses sector prototypes to convert angular concentration and alignment into classifier-readable features. To prevent contaminated aggregation from overwhelming account-level evidence, SAHG encodes per-account features and graph-neighborhood representations in two independent SAH channels, fusing them only at the classifier. Experiments on Fox8-23, BotSim-24, and MGTAB show that SAHG achieves the highest accuracy and F1 on all three benchmarks, outperforming feature-based, graph-based, LLM-based, and isotropic hyperbolic baselines. Ablation and geometric analyses confirm the effectiveness of the anisotropic geometry and dual-channel design.

</details>
